questions.question: Ms. Okafor asked that all expense reports be submitted ------ the end of the month.

explanation.en: Deadline = by; continuing action = until. If the verb is a one-time action like submit, send or finish, choose "by".
explanation.ko: 마감 = by, 계속 = until. 동사가 submit, send, finish처럼 한 번에 끝나는 동작이면 "by"를 고르세요.

questions.question: The new scheduling software allows employees to update ------ own shift preferences online.

explanation.en: "___ own + noun" always takes a possessive adjective (my, your, his, her, its, our, their).
explanation.ko: "___ own + 명사"에는 항상 소유격(my, your, his, her, its, our, their)이 들어갑니다.

questions.question: Haverford Electronics has seen a ------ increase in online sales since launching its mobile app.

explanation.en: Article + ___ + noun → adjective. Recognize common adjective endings: -al, -ive, -ous, -ful, -able.
explanation.ko: 관사 + ___ + 명사 → 형용사. 자주 나오는 형용사 어미 -al, -ive, -ous, -ful, -able을 알아 두세요.

questions.question: Visitors to the plant must wear safety goggles ------ they are in the production area.

explanation.en: Check what follows the blank: a clause (subject + verb) needs a conjunction; a noun phrase needs a preposition.
explanation.ko: 빈칸 뒤를 확인하세요. 절(주어 + 동사)이면 접속사, 명사구면 전치사입니다.

questions.question: The marketing team will ------ the results of the customer survey at Thursday's meeting.

explanation.en: For vocabulary questions, test each verb with its object: present results, attend a meeting, remind someone.
explanation.ko: 어휘 문제는 각 동사를 목적어와 연결해 보세요: present results, attend a meeting, remind someone.

questions.question: Applicants for the position should have at least three years of ------ in project management.

explanation.en: Preposition + ___ → noun (or gerund). "Years of experience" is a fixed phrase in job ads.
explanation.ko: 전치사 + ___ → 명사(또는 동명사). "Years of experience"는 채용 공고의 고정 표현입니다.

questions.question: Because of the heavy snowfall, the regional train service has been ------ suspended.

explanation.en: Between an auxiliary (has been, will be, is) and a main verb or participle, the answer is almost always an -ly adverb.
explanation.ko: 조동사(has been, will be, is)와 본동사/분사 사이에는 거의 항상 -ly 부사가 정답입니다.

questions.question: Mr. Delgado's proposal was approved by the board ------ some concerns about its cost.

explanation.en: Despite / in spite of + noun; although / even though + clause. Same meaning, different grammar.
explanation.ko: Despite / in spite of + 명사, although / even though + 절. 뜻은 같지만 문법이 다릅니다.

questions.question: Customers who wish to return an item must present the original receipt ------ a full refund.

explanation.en: When the blank explains why someone does something, look for "to + verb" or "in order to + verb".
explanation.ko: 빈칸이 어떤 행동의 목적을 설명하면 "to + 동사" 또는 "in order to + 동사"를 찾으세요.

questions.question: The conference room on the fifth floor is ------ booked for the rest of the week.

explanation.en: Learn adverb collocations as units: fully booked, highly recommended, widely used, deeply concerned.
explanation.ko: 부사 연어는 덩어리로 외우세요: fully booked, highly recommended, widely used, deeply concerned.

questions.question: Ridgeway Bank ------ its downtown branch to a larger building next spring.

explanation.en: Always scan the sentence for time markers (next, last, since, by the time) before choosing a tense.
explanation.ko: 시제를 고르기 전에 반드시 시간 표현(next, last, since, by the time)을 찾으세요.

questions.question: Please contact Ms. Tanaka in Human Resources if you have any questions ------ the new leave policy.

explanation.en: Regarding, concerning, and about are interchangeable in TOEIC business sentences: questions/concerns regarding something.
explanation.ko: TOEIC 비즈니스 문장에서 regarding, concerning, about은 서로 바꿔 쓸 수 있습니다: questions/concerns regarding something.

questions.question: Neither the sales director ------ her assistant was available to meet with the client.

explanation.en: Correlative pairs: either...or, neither...nor, both...and, not only...but also. Spot the first word and you have the answer.
explanation.ko: 상관접속사: either...or, neither...nor, both...and, not only...but also. 첫 단어를 보면 답이 보입니다.

questions.question: The warranty covers repairs to the device for two years ------ the date of purchase.

explanation.en: "For + period + from + starting point" is a common warranty and contract pattern.
explanation.ko: "For + 기간 + from + 시작점"은 보증서와 계약서에서 자주 쓰이는 구조입니다.

questions.question: Our online store offers a ------ range of office furniture at competitive prices.

explanation.en: Memorize: a wide range of, a wide variety of, a wide selection of.
explanation.ko: 외워 두세요: a wide range of, a wide variety of, a wide selection of.

questions.question: All laboratory equipment must be cleaned ------ after each use.

explanation.en: A sentence that is already complete (subject + passive verb) only has room for an adverb in the blank.
explanation.ko: 문장이 이미 완성되어 있으면(주어 + 수동태 동사) 빈칸에는 부사만 들어갈 수 있습니다.

questions.question: The keynote speaker, ------ book on leadership became a best seller, will arrive tomorrow morning.

explanation.en: If a noun comes right after the blank with no article (whose book, whose company), choose "whose".
explanation.ko: 빈칸 바로 뒤에 관사 없는 명사(whose book, whose company)가 오면 "whose"를 고르세요.

questions.question: Ms. Fischer was ------ to regional manager after only two years with the company.

explanation.en: "Be promoted to + position" is a high-frequency TOEIC phrase; also learn "be transferred to + place".
explanation.ko: "Be promoted to + 직책"은 TOEIC 빈출 표현입니다. "be transferred to + 장소"도 함께 익히세요.

questions.question: Employees are reminded that the parking garage will be closed for maintenance ------ Saturday and Sunday.

explanation.en: on + day/date, in + month/year, at + clock time.
explanation.ko: on + 요일/날짜, in + 월/연도, at + 시각.

questions.question: The quarterly report shows that operating costs were ------ lower than expected.

explanation.en: Adverbs modify adjectives and comparatives too: significantly lower, considerably higher, slightly better.
explanation.ko: 부사는 형용사와 비교급도 수식합니다: significantly lower, considerably higher, slightly better.

questions.question: ------ the shipment arrives, the warehouse staff will inspect each box for damage.

explanation.en: In time clauses (when, as soon as, once, after), use the present tense even when talking about the future.
explanation.ko: 시간 부사절(when, as soon as, once, after)에서는 미래를 말할 때도 현재 시제를 씁니다.

questions.question: The board of directors is expected to make a final ------ on the merger by the end of the quarter.

explanation.en: Adjective + ___ → noun. "Make a decision" is a key collocation.
explanation.ko: 형용사 + ___ → 명사. "Make a decision"은 핵심 연어입니다.

questions.question: Several local restaurants have agreed to ------ the food for the charity fundraiser.

explanation.en: Read the whole sentence for meaning: who is doing the action, and what is the logical action?
explanation.ko: 문장 전체를 읽고 의미를 파악하세요: 누가 행동하고, 어떤 행동이 논리적인가?

questions.question: Ms. Rahman prefers to review the contract terms ------ before signing any agreement.

explanation.en: When the sentence is already complete, a reflexive pronoun can be added for emphasis (do it yourself, review it herself).
explanation.ko: 문장이 완성되어 있으면 강조를 위해 재귀대명사를 덧붙일 수 있습니다(do it yourself, review it herself).

questions.question: Attendance at the safety training session is ------ for all new warehouse employees.

explanation.en: Synonyms to know: mandatory = compulsory = required = obligatory; the opposite is optional.
explanation.ko: 알아 둘 동의어: mandatory = compulsory = required = obligatory, 반의어는 optional.

questions.question: Had the supplier notified us earlier, we ------ the production schedule accordingly.

explanation.en: A sentence starting with Had/Should/Were without "if" is an inverted conditional. Had → would have + p.p.
explanation.ko: if 없이 Had/Should/Were로 시작하는 문장은 도치된 가정법입니다. Had → would have + p.p.

questions.question: The museum's new exhibit has attracted visitors ------ as far away as Brazil and Japan.

explanation.en: Learn the full phrase: visitors from as far away as...
explanation.ko: 표현 전체를 외우세요: visitors from as far away as...

questions.question: To ensure ------ delivery, please double-check the shipping address before placing your order.

explanation.en: Verb + ___ + noun → the blank modifies the noun, so choose the adjective.
explanation.ko: 동사 + ___ + 명사 → 빈칸이 명사를 수식하므로 형용사를 고릅니다.

questions.question: Only after the survey results were analyzed ------ the committee recommend changes to the menu.

explanation.en: Only after / Not until / Rarely / Never at the start → inverted order: auxiliary + subject + verb.
explanation.ko: Only after / Not until / Rarely / Never가 문두에 오면 → 도치: 조동사 + 주어 + 동사.

questions.question: The firm's consultants work ------ with clients to identify cost-saving opportunities.

explanation.en: "Work closely with" = cooperate tightly. Don't confuse with "close" as an adjective (a close friend).
explanation.ko: "Work closely with" = 긴밀히 협력하다. 형용사 "close"(a close friend)와 혼동하지 마세요.

Dear Mr. Moreau,

Thank you for joining Brightline Fitness. Your membership (131) ------ on March 10, and you will have full access to all of our facilities from that date.

As a new member, you are entitled to two free sessions with one of our certified personal trainers. (132) ------ To schedule your sessions, simply speak with a staff member at the front desk or use our mobile app.

Please note that our pool will be closed for (133) ------ maintenance from March 15 to March 18. During this time, members may use the pool at our Eastgate location at no extra charge.

We look forward to helping you reach your fitness goals. (134) ------ you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Sincerely,
Member Services Team
Brightline Fitness
items.descriptionKo: 수신: Daniel Moreau 발신: Brightline Fitness 회원 서비스팀 날짜: 3월 3일 제목: Brightline Fitness에 오신 것을 환영합니다 Moreau 님께, Brightline Fitness에 가입해 주셔서 감사합니다. 회원님의 멤버십은 3월 10일에 활성화되며, 그날부터 모든 시설을 이용하실 수 있습니다. 신규 회원으로서 공인 개인 트레이너와의 무료 세션 2회를 받으실 수 있습니다. 이 세션은 가입 후 첫 60일 이내에 사용하셔야 합니다. 세션을 예약하시려면 프런트 데스크 직원에게 말씀하시거나 모바일 앱을 이용하시면 됩니다. 3월 15일부터 18일까지 정기 점검으로 수영장이 문을 닫는다는 점 유의해 주십시오. 이 기간에는 추가 요금 없이 Eastgate 지점의 수영장을 이용하실 수 있습니다. 회원님이 운동 목표를 달성하실 수 있도록 돕겠습니다. 궁금한 점이 있으시면 언제든지 연락해 주십시오. 감사합니다. 회원 서비스팀 Brightline Fitness

explanation.en: The membership starts on a future date (March 10) and is activated by the gym, so the future passive "will be activated" is correct.
explanation.ko: 멤버십은 미래의 날짜(3월 10일)에 시작되고 피트니스 센터에 의해 활성화되므로 미래 수동태 "will be activated"가 맞습니다.

options: Unfortunately, all of our trainers are currently unavailable.
These sessions must be used within your first 60 days of membership.
The annual fee has recently been reduced.
questions.correct: These sessions must be used within your first 60 days of membership.

explanation.en: The sentence adds a condition about the free sessions just mentioned, and the next sentence explains how to schedule them. Saying trainers are unavailable would contradict the offer.
explanation.ko: 이 문장은 방금 언급한 무료 세션의 조건을 덧붙이고, 다음 문장은 예약 방법을 설명합니다. 트레이너가 불가하다는 말은 혜택과 모순됩니다.

explanation.en: An adjective is needed before the noun "maintenance": "routine maintenance" means regular, scheduled upkeep.
explanation.ko: 명사 "maintenance" 앞에는 형용사가 필요합니다: "routine maintenance"는 정기 점검을 뜻합니다.

explanation.en: "Should you have any questions" is an inverted conditional meaning "If you have any questions". It is a very common formal closing in business letters.
explanation.ko: "Should you have any questions"는 "If you have any questions"를 뜻하는 도치 가정법입니다. 비즈니스 서신에서 매우 흔한 격식 있는 맺음말입니다.

items.description:
NOTICE TO ALL TENANTS
Lakeview Office Plaza

Starting Monday, June 2, the main entrance on Harbor Street will be closed while workers (135) ------ the front steps and install a new wheelchair ramp. The project is expected to take about three weeks.

During this period, please use the side entrance on Pine Avenue. Visitors should also be (136) ------ of the change, so we encourage you to share this notice with any clients who are scheduled to visit. (137) ------

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. The improvements will make the building more (138) ------ for everyone. Thank you for your patience.

Building Management
items.descriptionKo: 전체 입주사 공지 Lakeview 오피스 플라자 6월 2일 월요일부터 작업자들이 정면 계단을 보수하고 새 휠체어 경사로를 설치하는 동안 Harbor 가의 정문이 폐쇄됩니다. 공사는 약 3주가 걸릴 예정입니다. 이 기간에는 Pine 가의 옆문을 이용해 주십시오. 방문객들도 이 변경 사항을 알아야 하므로, 방문 예정인 고객에게 이 공지를 공유해 주시기 바랍니다. 사람들을 옆문으로 안내하는 임시 표지판도 설치될 예정입니다. 불편을 드려 죄송합니다. 이번 개선으로 건물은 모든 사람이 더 쉽게 이용할 수 있게 될 것입니다. 양해해 주셔서 감사합니다. 건물 관리사무소

explanation.en: "Workers" is the subject of the clause after "while", and it needs a present-tense active verb parallel to "install": "while workers repair... and install...".
explanation.ko: "Workers"는 "while"절의 주어이며 "install"과 병렬을 이루는 현재 시제 능동태 동사가 필요합니다: "while workers repair... and install...".

explanation.en: "Be informed of" means to be told about something. The passive participle is required after "should also be".
explanation.ko: "Be informed of"는 ~에 대해 통보받다라는 뜻입니다. "should also be" 뒤에는 수동의 과거분사가 필요합니다.

options: The new ramp was completed last month.
Rent payments are due on the first of each month.
The Harbor Street entrance will remain open during this time.
Temporary signs will also be posted to direct people to the side entrance.
questions.correct: Temporary signs will also be posted to direct people to the side entrance.

explanation.en: The paragraph is about guiding visitors to the side entrance, so a sentence about signs directing people there fits. The ramp is not finished yet, and the main entrance will be closed.
explanation.ko: 이 단락은 방문객을 옆문으로 안내하는 내용이므로 안내 표지판에 관한 문장이 적절합니다. 경사로는 아직 완공되지 않았고 정문은 폐쇄됩니다.

explanation.en: A wheelchair ramp makes a building easier to enter, which is the meaning of "accessible".
explanation.ko: 휠체어 경사로는 건물 출입을 더 쉽게 만들며, 이것이 "accessible"의 의미입니다.

items.description:
Cordova Foods Expands into Plant-Based Market

SAN DIEGO (August 14) — Cordova Foods, a family-owned producer of frozen meals, announced yesterday that it will launch a line of plant-based dishes this fall. The company has (139) ------ been known for its traditional Mexican recipes, such as enchiladas and tamales.

According to CEO Lucia Cordova, the decision was driven by customer demand. "Over the past two years, we have received thousands of requests for meat-free options," she said. (140) ------

The new products will be sold in supermarkets across California and Arizona starting in October. The company plans to expand distribution nationwide next year if sales (141) ------ expectations.

To support the launch, Cordova Foods is hiring 50 additional workers at its production facility in Chula Vista. (142) ------ interested in applying can find details on the company's Web site.
items.descriptionKo: Cordova Foods, 식물성 식품 시장 진출 샌디에이고 (8월 14일) — 가족 경영 냉동식품 제조업체인 Cordova Foods는 어제 올가을 식물성 요리 제품군을 출시한다고 발표했다. 이 회사는 엔칠라다와 타말레 같은 전통 멕시코 요리법으로 오랫동안 알려져 왔다. Lucia Cordova CEO에 따르면 이번 결정은 고객 수요에 따른 것이다. "지난 2년 동안 고기 없는 메뉴를 원한다는 요청을 수천 건이나 받았습니다"라고 그녀는 말했다. "이 요리들이 기존 고객과 신규 고객 모두에게 사랑받을 것이라고 확신합니다." 신제품은 10월부터 캘리포니아와 애리조나 전역의 슈퍼마켓에서 판매된다. 회사는 판매가 기대에 부응하면 내년에 전국으로 유통을 확대할 계획이다. 출시를 지원하기 위해 Cordova Foods는 출라비스타 생산 시설에서 50명의 직원을 추가로 채용하고 있다. 지원에 관심 있는 사람은 회사 웹사이트에서 자세한 내용을 확인할 수 있다.

explanation.en: "Has long been known" uses the adverb "long" to mean for a long time. It fits between the auxiliary "has" and "been".
explanation.ko: "Has long been known"에서 부사 "long"은 오랫동안이라는 뜻이며 조동사 "has"와 "been" 사이에 옵니다.

options: The company's headquarters will move to Phoenix next year.
"We are confident these dishes will appeal to longtime customers and new ones alike."
Sales of frozen meals declined sharply last year.
She declined to comment on the company's plans.
questions.correct: "We are confident these dishes will appeal to longtime customers and new ones alike."

explanation.en: The CEO is being quoted about the new product line, so a second quotation expressing confidence in the dishes continues naturally. She clearly did comment, so (D) is contradictory.
explanation.ko: CEO가 새 제품군에 대해 인용되고 있으므로, 요리에 대한 자신감을 표현하는 두 번째 인용문이 자연스럽게 이어집니다. 그녀는 분명히 발언했으므로 (D)는 모순입니다.

explanation.en: "Meet expectations" is the standard collocation meaning to be as good as hoped.
explanation.ko: "Meet expectations"는 기대에 부응하다라는 뜻의 표준 연어입니다.

explanation.en: "Those interested in applying" means "people who are interested". "Those" can be followed directly by an adjective or participle phrase.
explanation.ko: "Those interested in applying"은 "관심 있는 사람들"이라는 뜻입니다. "Those"는 형용사구나 분사구를 바로 뒤에 둘 수 있습니다.

items.description:
MEMO
To: All Staff
From: Priya Natarajan, Office Manager
Date: November 5
Subject: Year-end office closure

As in previous years, our office will close for the holidays from December 24 through January 1. Employees who need to complete urgent tasks during this period must (143) ------ approval from their department head in advance.

Please make sure that all client deadlines falling within the closure period are either completed early or rescheduled. Department heads will review project timelines next week to identify any potential (144) ------.

Before leaving for the holidays, remember to shut down your computer and unplug any personal electronic devices. (145) ------ The cleaning crew will be performing a deep clean of all workstations on December 27.

Thank you for your cooperation, and I wish you all a (146) ------ holiday season.
items.descriptionKo: 회람 수신: 전 직원 발신: Priya Natarajan, 사무실 관리자 날짜: 11월 5일 제목: 연말 사무실 휴무 예년과 마찬가지로 우리 사무실은 12월 24일부터 1월 1일까지 연휴로 문을 닫습니다. 이 기간에 긴급 업무를 처리해야 하는 직원은 사전에 부서장의 승인을 받아야 합니다. 휴무 기간에 해당하는 모든 고객 마감일은 미리 완료하거나 일정을 조정해 주십시오. 부서장들은 다음 주에 프로젝트 일정을 검토하여 잠재적인 충돌을 파악할 것입니다. 휴가를 떠나기 전에 컴퓨터를 끄고 개인 전자 기기의 플러그를 뽑아 주십시오. 또한 책상 위의 서류와 개인 물품을 모두 치워 주십시오. 청소팀이 12월 27일에 모든 업무 공간을 대청소할 예정입니다. 협조해 주셔서 감사하며, 모두 편안한 연휴 보내시기 바랍니다.

explanation.en: The modal "must" is always followed by the base form of a verb: "must obtain approval".
explanation.ko: 조동사 "must" 뒤에는 항상 동사원형이 옵니다: "must obtain approval".

explanation.en: Reviewing timelines against the closure is meant to find scheduling problems, that is, potential "conflicts".
explanation.ko: 휴무 기간과 비교해 일정을 검토하는 것은 일정상의 문제, 즉 잠재적인 "충돌"을 찾기 위해서입니다.

options: In addition, please clear your desk of any papers and personal items.
The office will reopen on December 20.
New computers will be delivered on Monday.
Department heads must submit their budgets by Friday.
questions.correct: In addition, please clear your desk of any papers and personal items.

explanation.en: The sentence continues the list of things to do before leaving, and it explains why: the cleaning crew will deep clean the workstations. December 20 contradicts the closure dates.
explanation.ko: 이 문장은 떠나기 전에 할 일 목록을 이어 가고, 다음 문장이 그 이유(청소팀의 대청소)를 설명합니다. 12월 20일은 휴무 일정과 모순됩니다.

explanation.en: An adjective is needed before "holiday season". "Relaxing" describes something that makes people feel relaxed.
explanation.ko: "holiday season" 앞에는 형용사가 필요합니다. "Relaxing"은 사람을 편안하게 해 주는 것을 묘사합니다.

items.description:
Greenleaf Garden Center
Spring Planting Workshop Series

Join our expert gardeners every Saturday in April for free hands-on workshops at our Maple Road store. Topics include starting vegetables from seed, designing a pollinator-friendly garden, and caring for indoor plants.

Each session begins at 10:00 A.M. and lasts about 90 minutes. Space is limited to 20 participants per session, so please sign up in advance at the customer service desk or at www.greenleafgarden.com/events.

Workshop participants will receive a coupon for 15 percent off any purchase made on the day of the session.
items.descriptionKo: Greenleaf 가든 센터 봄 식재 워크숍 시리즈 4월 매주 토요일, Maple 로 매장에서 전문 정원사와 함께하는 무료 실습 워크숍에 참여하세요. 씨앗으로 채소 키우기, 꽃가루 매개 곤충에 좋은 정원 설계하기, 실내 식물 관리하기 등의 주제를 다룹니다. 각 세션은 오전 10시에 시작하며 약 90분간 진행됩니다. 세션당 정원은 20명으로 제한되니 고객 서비스 데스크나 www.greenleafgarden.com/events에서 미리 신청해 주세요. 워크숍 참가자는 세션 당일 구매 시 15퍼센트 할인 쿠폰을 받습니다.

questions.question: What is being advertised?
options: The opening of a new store

explanation.en: The advertisement invites people to "free hands-on workshops" every Saturday in April.
explanation.ko: 무엇이 광고되고 있습니까? 광고는 4월 매주 토요일에 열리는 "무료 실습 워크숍"에 사람들을 초대합니다.

questions.question: What will participants receive?
options: A discount on a same-day purchase
questions.correct: A discount on a same-day purchase

explanation.en: Participants get "a coupon for 15 percent off any purchase made on the day of the session".
explanation.ko: 참가자들은 무엇을 받게 됩니까? 참가자는 "세션 당일 구매 시 15퍼센트 할인 쿠폰"을 받습니다.

items.description:
Marcus Reyes (2:14 P.M.)
Hi Jenna, are you still at the print shop?

Jenna Liu (2:15 P.M.)
Just leaving. Why?

Marcus Reyes (2:16 P.M.)
The client just called. They want 50 more brochures for the trade show tomorrow.

Jenna Liu (2:17 P.M.)
Oh no. The shop closes at 3 today.

Marcus Reyes (2:17 P.M.)
Can you make it back in time?

Jenna Liu (2:18 P.M.)
Consider it done. I'll head back now and ask them to rush the order.

Marcus Reyes (2:19 P.M.)
Thanks! Have them bill it to the same account.
items.descriptionKo: Marcus Reyes (오후 2:14) 안녕하세요 Jenna, 아직 인쇄소에 계세요? Jenna Liu (오후 2:15) 막 나가려던 참이에요. 왜요? Marcus Reyes (오후 2:16) 방금 고객이 전화했는데, 내일 무역 박람회용 브로슈어를 50부 더 원한대요. Jenna Liu (오후 2:17) 이런. 인쇄소가 오늘 3시에 문을 닫아요. Marcus Reyes (오후 2:17) 시간 안에 돌아갈 수 있어요? Jenna Liu (오후 2:18) 걱정 마세요, 제가 처리할게요. 지금 바로 돌아가서 급하게 해 달라고 할게요. Marcus Reyes (오후 2:19) 고마워요! 같은 계정으로 청구해 달라고 해 주세요.

questions.question: Why does Mr. Reyes contact Ms. Liu?
options: To pass along a client's request for more brochures
To ask for a client's phone number
questions.correct: To pass along a client's request for more brochures

explanation.en: Mr. Reyes writes that the client "want[s] 50 more brochures for the trade show tomorrow".
explanation.ko: Reyes 씨가 Liu 씨에게 연락한 이유는 무엇입니까? Reyes 씨는 고객이 "내일 무역 박람회용 브로슈어를 50부 더 원한다"고 씁니다.

questions.question: At 2:18 P.M., what does Ms. Liu most likely mean when she writes, "Consider it done"?
options: She has already ordered extra brochures.
She thinks the trade show has ended.
She will not be able to help.

explanation.en: She immediately adds that she will go back and ask the shop to rush the order, showing she will take care of it. She has not placed the order yet, so (A) is wrong.
explanation.ko: 오후 2시 18분에 Liu 씨가 "Consider it done"이라고 쓴 의도는 무엇이겠습니까? 그녀는 곧바로 돌아가서 급하게 해 달라고 하겠다고 덧붙이므로, 그 일을 맡겠다는 뜻입니다. 아직 주문하지 않았으므로 (A)는 틀립니다.

items.description:
Riverside Public Library
Notice to Patrons

Beginning July 1, the library will extend its weekday hours. The library will now open at 8:00 A.M. and close at 9:00 P.M., Monday through Friday. Weekend hours will remain unchanged (10:00 A.M. to 5:00 P.M.).

The change is made possible by a grant from the Riverside Community Foundation, which will also fund the hiring of two additional staff members. In addition, the library's study rooms may now be reserved up to two weeks in advance through our Web site. Reservations are limited to three hours per day per patron.
items.descriptionKo: Riverside 공공 도서관 이용자 공지 7월 1일부터 도서관은 평일 운영 시간을 연장합니다. 월요일부터 금요일까지 오전 8시에 문을 열고 오후 9시에 닫습니다. 주말 운영 시간은 변동 없습니다(오전 10시~오후 5시). 이번 변경은 Riverside 지역사회 재단의 보조금 덕분에 가능해졌으며, 재단은 직원 2명의 추가 채용 비용도 지원합니다. 또한 이제 도서관 스터디룸을 웹사이트에서 최대 2주 전까지 예약할 수 있습니다. 예약은 이용자 1인당 하루 3시간으로 제한됩니다.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the notice?
options: To explain a closure for renovations

explanation.en: The notice opens with "the library will extend its weekday hours".
explanation.ko: 공지의 목적은 무엇입니까? 공지는 "도서관은 평일 운영 시간을 연장합니다"로 시작합니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about the study rooms?
options: They are available only on weekends.
They can be reserved through a Web site.
They can be used for up to five hours a day.
questions.correct: They can be reserved through a Web site.

explanation.en: Study rooms "may now be reserved up to two weeks in advance through our Web site". The limit is three hours, not five.
explanation.ko: 스터디룸에 대해 언급된 것은 무엇입니까? 스터디룸은 "웹사이트에서 최대 2주 전까지 예약할 수 있습니다". 제한은 5시간이 아니라 3시간입니다.

items.description:
To: Ana Kowalski <akowalski@mailbox.com>
From: Orders <orders@northpeakoutdoor.com>
Date: October 8
Subject: Your order #48213

Dear Ms. Kowalski,

Thank you for shopping at Northpeak Outdoor. Unfortunately, the Trailmaster hiking boots (size 8, brown) that you ordered are temporarily out of stock. We expect to receive a new shipment from the manufacturer by October 20.

The other items in your order—a waterproof jacket and two pairs of wool socks—were shipped this morning and should arrive within three business days.

If you would prefer not to wait for the boots, you may cancel that part of your order by replying to this e-mail, and the full amount will be refunded to your credit card. Alternatively, we can send you the same boots in black, which are currently available.

Customer Service Team
Northpeak Outdoor

items.description:
Harbor City Gets Its First Bike-Sharing Program

HARBOR CITY (May 12) — Residents of Harbor City will soon have a new way to get around town. The city council voted last week to approve a bike-sharing program that will place 300 bicycles at 25 stations throughout the downtown area. -[1]-

Users will be able to unlock a bike using a smartphone app and return it to any station. A single ride of up to 30 minutes will cost $2, while a monthly pass will be available for $20. -[2]-

The program is being funded through a partnership between the city and Velo Transit, a company that operates similar systems in eight other cities. -[3]- City officials hope the program will reduce traffic congestion and encourage healthier lifestyles.

The first stations are scheduled to open in mid-July. -[4]- Additional stations may be added in residential neighborhoods next year, depending on demand.
items.descriptionKo: 하버 시티, 첫 공공 자전거 프로그램 도입 하버 시티 (5월 12일) — 하버 시티 주민들은 곧 시내를 이동하는 새로운 방법을 갖게 된다. 시의회는 지난주 도심 25개 정류소에 자전거 300대를 배치하는 공공 자전거 프로그램을 승인했다. -[1]- 이용자는 스마트폰 앱으로 자전거 잠금을 해제하고 아무 정류소에나 반납할 수 있다. 30분 이내 1회 이용은 2달러이고, 월 이용권은 20달러이다. -[2]- 이 프로그램은 시와 다른 8개 도시에서 유사한 시스템을 운영하는 Velo Transit의 협력으로 자금이 마련된다. -[3]- 시 관계자들은 이 프로그램이 교통 체증을 줄이고 더 건강한 생활 방식을 장려하기를 기대하고 있다. 첫 정류소는 7월 중순에 문을 열 예정이다. -[4]- 수요에 따라 내년에는 주거 지역에도 정류소가 추가될 수 있다.

The opening of a bicycle shop
Road construction in the downtown area

explanation.ko: 기사에 따르면 월 이용권은 얼마입니까? "월 이용권은 20달러이다." 2달러는 1회 이용 요금입니다.

questions.question: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "Velo Transit will also be responsible for maintaining the bicycles and stations."

explanation.en: The sentence uses "also" and names Velo Transit, so it must come right after the sentence introducing Velo Transit's role in the partnership.

Before your start date, please complete the enclosed tax and direct deposit forms and return them in the prepaid envelope. If you have any questions, feel free to call me at 303-555-0174.

We look forward to having you on our team.

Gregory Hale
Managing Partner

items.description:
www.sunvalleyresort.com/about

About Sun Valley Mountain Resort

Nestled in the foothills of the Cascade Mountains, Sun Valley Mountain Resort has welcomed guests for more than 40 years. Our 120 guest rooms and 15 private cabins offer stunning views of Lake Arden and the surrounding forest.

Guests can enjoy a wide range of activities throughout the year, including hiking, kayaking, horseback riding, and, in winter, cross-country skiing. Our on-site spa offers massages and other treatments, and our restaurant, The Pine Table, serves dishes made with ingredients sourced from local farms.

Sun Valley is also an ideal venue for corporate retreats and weddings. Our events team will work with you to plan every detail, from catering to decorations. Our three meeting rooms can accommodate groups of up to 200 people.

Book directly through our Web site to receive complimentary breakfast for the duration of your stay.
items.descriptionKo: www.sunvalleyresort.com/about Sun Valley 마운틴 리조트 소개 Cascade 산맥 기슭에 자리 잡은 Sun Valley 마운틴 리조트는 40년 넘게 손님을 맞이해 왔습니다. 120개의 객실과 15채의 독채 오두막에서 Arden 호수와 주변 숲의 멋진 경치를 감상하실 수 있습니다. 손님들은 하이킹, 카약, 승마, 그리고 겨울에는 크로스컨트리 스키 등 연중 다양한 활동을 즐기실 수 있습니다. 리조트 내 스파에서는 마사지와 기타 트리트먼트를 제공하며, 레스토랑 The Pine Table에서는 지역 농장에서 공급받은 재료로 만든 요리를 선보입니다. items.description:
Karen Whitfield [9:02 A.M.]
Good morning, everyone. I just heard from the venue. The Grand Plaza Hotel can't host our product launch on May 14 after all. They double-booked the ballroom.

Raj Mehta [9:04 A.M.]
That's frustrating. Invitations already went out to over 150 guests.

Karen Whitfield [9:05 A.M.]
I know. They offered us the ballroom on May 21 instead, or a smaller room on the original date.

Elena Sousa [9:06 A.M.]
How small is the smaller room?

Karen Whitfield [9:07 A.M.]
It holds 100 people at most.

Elena Sousa [9:08 A.M.]
That won't work. We've already had 130 people confirm.

Raj Mehta [9:10 A.M.]
Moving the date might actually help us. The demo units from the factory won't arrive until May 12, which doesn't leave us much time to test them.

Tom Brennan [9:11 A.M.]
Agreed. And the hotel should give us a discount for the trouble.

Karen Whitfield [9:12 A.M.]
Good point, Tom. I'll ask about that when I call them back. Raj, could you draft a message to the guests about the new date?

Raj Mehta [9:13 A.M.]
Sure. I'll send it to you for review by noon.
items.descriptionKo: Karen Whitfield [오전 9:02] 좋은 아침이에요, 여러분. 방금 행사장에서 연락을 받았어요. Grand Plaza 호텔이 결국 5월 14일 제품 출시 행사를 진행할 수 없대요. 연회장을 이중으로 예약했다네요. Raj Mehta [오전 9:04] 답답하네요. 초대장이 이미 150명이 넘는 손님에게 나갔는데요. Karen Whitfield [오전 9:05] 알아요. 대신 5월 21일에 연회장을 쓰거나, 원래 날짜에 더 작은 방을 쓰라고 제안했어요. Elena Sousa [오전 9:06] 작은 방은 얼마나 작아요? Karen Whitfield [오전 9:07] 최대 100명이에요. Elena Sousa [오전 9:08] 그건 안 돼요. 이미 130명이 참석을 확정했어요. Raj Mehta [오전 9:10] 날짜를 옮기는 게 오히려 도움이 될 수도 있어요. 공장에서 오는 시연용 제품이 5월 12일에야 도착해서 테스트할 시간이 별로 없거든요. Tom Brennan [오전 9:11] 동의해요. 그리고 호텔이 이번 문제에 대해 할인을 해 줘야죠. Karen Whitfield [오전 9:12] 좋은 지적이에요, Tom. 다시 전화할 때 물어볼게요. Raj, 새 날짜에 대해 손님들에게 보낼 메시지 초안을 써 줄래요? Raj Mehta [오전 9:13] 물론이죠. 정오까지 검토용으로 보내 드릴게요.

items.description:
Local Bakery Rises to National Fame

PORTLAND (March 3) — When Grace Oyelaran opened Golden Crust Bakery in a small storefront on Alder Street in 2015, she had only two employees and a single oven. Today, her bakery supplies bread to more than 60 restaurants and grocery stores across the Pacific Northwest. -[1]-

Ms. Oyelaran's big break came in 2021, when her sourdough loaf won first prize at the National Artisan Baking Competition in Chicago. -[2]- Orders poured in from across the region, and she soon had to move production to a larger facility in nearby Beaverton.

Despite the company's growth, Ms. Oyelaran insists on maintaining the traditional methods that made her bread popular. Each loaf is still shaped by hand and fermented for at least 24 hours. -[3]-

Next month, Golden Crust will open its second retail location, in Seattle. The new shop will also feature a café serving sandwiches and pastries. -[4]- "We want people to see how bread is made," said Ms. Oyelaran. The Seattle shop will include a glass-walled kitchen where customers can watch the bakers at work.
items.descriptionKo: 지역 빵집, 전국적인 명성을 얻다 포틀랜드 (3월 3일) — Grace Oyelaran이 2015년 Alder 가의 작은 가게에 Golden Crust 베이커리를 열었을 때, 직원은 단 두 명에 오븐은 한 대뿐이었다. 현재 그녀의 빵집은 태평양 북서부 전역의 60곳이 넘는 식당과 식료품점에 빵을 공급한다. -[1]- Oyelaran 씨의 큰 전환점은 2021년, 그녀의 사워도우 빵이 시카고에서 열린 전국 수제 제빵 대회에서 1등상을 받으면서 찾아왔다. -[2]- 지역 곳곳에서 주문이 쏟아졌고, 그녀는 곧 인근 Beaverton의 더 큰 시설로 생산을 옮겨야 했다. 회사가 성장했음에도 Oyelaran 씨는 자신의 빵을 인기 있게 만든 전통 방식을 고수하고 있다. 모든 빵은 여전히 손으로 모양을 잡고 최소 24시간 발효시킨다. -[3]- 다음 달 Golden Crust는 시애틀에 두 번째 매장을 연다. 새 매장에는 샌드위치와 페이스트리를 파는 카페도 들어선다. -[4]- "사람들이 빵이 어떻게 만들어지는지 볼 수 있으면 좋겠습니다"라고 Oyelaran 씨는 말했다. 시애틀 매장에는 손님들이 제빵사들의 작업을 지켜볼 수 있는 유리벽 주방이 마련된다.

questions.question: What is the article mainly about?
options: A new restaurant opening in Portland

explanation.en: The article traces Golden Crust's growth from a small shop with two employees to a supplier for more than 60 businesses.
explanation.ko: 기사는 주로 무엇에 관한 것입니까? 기사는 직원 두 명의 작은 가게에서 60곳 이상의 업체에 공급하는 회사로 성장한 Golden Crust의 이야기를 다룹니다.

questions.question: What happened in 2021?
options: Ms. Oyelaran opened her first store.
Ms. Oyelaran's bread won a competition.
questions.correct: Ms. Oyelaran's bread won a competition.

explanation.en: "Her sourdough loaf won first prize at the National Artisan Baking Competition" in 2021. The bakery opened in 2015, and 60 is the number of customers, not employees.
explanation.ko: 2021년에 무슨 일이 있었습니까? 2021년에 "그녀의 사워도우 빵이 전국 수제 제빵 대회에서 1등상을 받았다". 빵집은 2015년에 열었고, 60은 직원이 아니라 거래처 수입니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about Golden Crust's bread?
options: It is made using a slow fermentation process.
It is sold only in Portland.
questions.correct: It is made using a slow fermentation process.

explanation.en: Each loaf is "fermented for at least 24 hours". It is shaped by hand and sold across the Pacific Northwest.
explanation.ko: Golden Crust의 빵에 대해 언급된 것은 무엇입니까? 모든 빵은 "최소 24시간 발효"시킵니다. 손으로 모양을 잡고 태평양 북서부 전역에서 판매됩니다.

questions.question: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "The award brought her bakery a great deal of media attention."

explanation.en: "The award" refers back to the first prize mentioned just before [2], and the media attention explains why "orders poured in" afterward.
explanation.ko: [1], [2], [3], [4]로 표시된 위치 중 다음 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은? "이 상으로 그녀의 빵집은 언론의 큰 주목을 받았다." "The award"는 [2] 바로 앞에 언급된 1등상을 가리키며, 언론의 주목은 그 뒤에 "주문이 쏟아진" 이유를 설명합니다.

items.description:
To: All Employees
From: Samuel Ortiz, IT Department
Date: January 15
Subject: New password policy

Dear colleagues,

To strengthen the security of our computer systems, the IT Department will be introducing a new password policy starting February 1. Under the new policy, all passwords must contain at least 12 characters, including at least one number and one special symbol. Passwords will also need to be changed every 90 days.

In addition, we will be introducing two-step verification for all employees who access company e-mail from outside the office. After entering their password, these employees will receive a code by text message that must be entered to complete the login.

To help everyone prepare, the IT Department will hold 30-minute information sessions in Conference Room B on January 22 and January 24 at 11:00 A.M. and 3:00 P.M. Attendance is not required, but it is highly recommended for staff who work remotely.

If you have trouble updating your password, please submit a request through the IT help desk portal rather than contacting team members directly. This will allow us to respond to all requests more efficiently.

Samuel Ortiz
items.descriptionKo: 수신: 전 직원 발신: Samuel Ortiz, IT 부서 날짜: 1월 15일 제목: 새 비밀번호 정책 동료 여러분께, 컴퓨터 시스템의 보안을 강화하기 위해 IT 부서는 2월 1일부터 새 비밀번호 정책을 시행합니다. 새 정책에 따라 모든 비밀번호는 숫자 1개와 특수 기호 1개 이상을 포함하여 최소 12자 이상이어야 합니다. 또한 비밀번호는 90일마다 변경해야 합니다. 아울러 사무실 밖에서 회사 이메일에 접속하는 모든 직원에게 2단계 인증을 도입합니다. 비밀번호를 입력한 후 이 직원들은 문자 메시지로 코드를 받게 되며, 로그인을 완료하려면 그 코드를 입력해야 합니다. 모두의 준비를 돕기 위해 IT 부서는 1월 22일과 24일 오전 11시와 오후 3시에 B 회의실에서 30분 설명회를 엽니다. 참석은 의무가 아니지만 원격 근무 직원에게는 적극 권장합니다. 비밀번호 변경에 어려움이 있으면 팀원에게 직접 연락하지 마시고 IT 헬프데스크 포털을 통해 요청을 제출해 주십시오. 그래야 모든 요청에 더 효율적으로 대응할 수 있습니다. Samuel Ortiz

questions.question: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
options: To introduce a new IT staff member
To explain changes to computer login rules
To request feedback on new software
questions.correct: To explain changes to computer login rules

explanation.en: The e-mail describes a new password policy and two-step verification, both of which are login rules.
explanation.ko: 이메일의 목적은 무엇입니까? 이메일은 새 비밀번호 정책과 2단계 인증을 설명하며, 둘 다 로그인 규정입니다.

questions.question: What is stated about the new passwords?
options: They will be assigned by the IT Department.
They must be at least eight characters long.
They can be reused after one year.

explanation.en: "Passwords will also need to be changed every 90 days." The minimum length is 12 characters, not 8.
explanation.ko: 새 비밀번호에 대해 언급된 것은 무엇입니까? "비밀번호는 90일마다 변경해야 합니다." 최소 길이는 8자가 아니라 12자입니다.

questions.question: Who is especially encouraged to attend an information session?

explanation.en: Attendance "is highly recommended for staff who work remotely".
explanation.ko: 설명회 참석이 특히 권장되는 사람은 누구입니까? 참석은 "원격 근무 직원에게는 적극 권장"됩니다.

questions.question: How should employees request help with their passwords?

explanation.en: Employees should "submit a request through the IT help desk portal rather than contacting team members directly".
explanation.ko: 직원들은 비밀번호 관련 도움을 어떻게 요청해야 합니까? 직원들은 "팀원에게 직접 연락하지 마시고 IT 헬프데스크 포털을 통해 요청을 제출"해야 합니다.

Lindell Apartments
Fitness Room Renovation

Dear Residents,

The fitness room on the first floor will be closed from July 7 to July 25 for renovation. New treadmills, exercise bikes, and a stretching area will be added. We will also be extending the room's hours. Once it reopens, the fitness room will be open 24 hours a day.

During the closure, residents may use the facilities at FitZone Gym, located two blocks away at 310 Grant Street, free of charge. Simply show your resident ID card at the front desk.

Property Management Office
To: Property Management Office
From: Kenji Watanabe, Unit 5B
Date: July 9
Subject: FitZone access

Hello,

I visited FitZone yesterday evening, but the staff told me that my resident ID card could not be accepted because my name was not on their list. I moved into Lindell Apartments only last week, so perhaps the list hasn't been updated yet. Could you please contact FitZone and add my name?

Also, I'd like to know whether the renovated fitness room will include lockers. I usually exercise before work, and it would be convenient to store my belongings there.

Thank you,
Kenji Watanabe
FitZone Gym ★★★★☆
Reviewed by K. Watanabe, July 20

I've been using FitZone for the past two weeks while my apartment building's gym is being renovated. The equipment is modern and well maintained, and the staff were very helpful once the issue with my access was resolved. My only complaint is that the gym gets extremely crowded between 6:00 and 8:00 A.M., which is when I prefer to work out. I sometimes had to wait 15 minutes for a treadmill. Still, I'd recommend it to anyone living in the area.

items.description:
Fairmont Hosts Its First Food Truck Festival

FAIRMONT (August 2) — The city of Fairmont will host its first-ever food truck festival on Saturday, August 23, at Riverside Park. More than 30 food trucks from across the state are expected to take part, offering everything from Korean barbecue to vegan desserts.

Admission is free, but visitors are encouraged to purchase a $10 tasting pass, which provides small samples from five different trucks. Passes can be bought online in advance or at the park entrance on the day of the event. A portion of the proceeds will go to the Fairmont Food Bank.

In addition to food, the festival will feature live music and cooking demonstrations by local chefs. Organizer Diane Petrakis said the city hopes to make the festival an annual event. "We want to support small businesses and give residents a fun way to spend the day," she said.
Fairmont Food Truck Festival
Cooking Demonstrations — Main Stage

11:00 A.M. — Fresh Pasta Made Simple
Chef Antonio Bellini, Trattoria Bellini

12:30 P.M. — Street Tacos at Home
Chef Maria Gonzalez, Casa Maria

2:00 P.M. — Plant-Based Grilling
Chef Owen Fletcher, Green Fork Café

3:30 P.M. — Desserts in a Hurry
Chef Sophie Laurent, Petite Pâtisserie

*Schedule subject to change
To: Diane Petrakis
From: Owen Fletcher
Date: August 20
Subject: Saturday's demonstration

Dear Ms. Petrakis,

I'm afraid I have a scheduling conflict on Saturday. A large catering order for a wedding has come in, and I will need to be at my restaurant until mid-afternoon. Would it be possible to switch time slots with the last presenter of the day? I've already spoken with Sophie, and she said she would be happy to go earlier.

Also, I'd like to bring some free samples of the dishes I prepare for audience members to try. Please let me know if there are any rules about serving food on the main stage.

Best regards,
Owen Fletcher

questions.question: The board has requested that the revised budget ------ to all department heads before the quarterly review.

explanation.en: request / recommend / insist / require + that + subject + BASE verb (no -s, no tense). Passive version: "be + past participle".
explanation.ko: request / recommend / insist / require + that + 주어 + 동사원형(-s 없음, 시제 없음). 수동태는 "be + 과거분사"입니다.

questions.question: Ms. Varga's ------ handling of the supplier dispute saved the company a considerable amount in legal fees.

explanation.en: Possessive + ___ + noun → adjective. Words ending in -ing can be nouns (handling, planning, pricing), so check what the blank modifies.
explanation.ko: 소유격 + ___ + 명사 → 형용사. -ing로 끝나는 단어도 명사일 수 있으므로(handling, planning, pricing) 빈칸이 무엇을 수식하는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: ------ the merger been announced earlier, the shareholders would have had more time to evaluate the terms.

explanation.en: Inversion in conditionals: Had + S + p.p. (past), Should + S + verb (future), Were + S + to/noun (present). Match it with the verb in the main clause.
explanation.ko: 가정법 도치: Had + 주어 + p.p.(과거), Should + 주어 + 동사(미래), Were + 주어 + to/명사(현재). 주절의 동사와 맞춰 보세요.

questions.question: Delivery of the replacement parts is ------ on the manufacturer receiving full payment in advance.

explanation.en: Learn the preposition with the adjective: contingent on/upon, subject to, eligible for, responsible for, compliant with.
explanation.ko: 형용사와 짝을 이루는 전치사를 외우세요: contingent on/upon, subject to, eligible for, responsible for, compliant with.

questions.question: All employees, ------ their length of service, are required to complete the new data security training.

explanation.en: regardless of / irrespective of + noun = no matter what the noun is. Useful in policy sentences that apply to everyone.
explanation.ko: regardless of / irrespective of + 명사 = 명사가 무엇이든 상관없이. 모든 사람에게 적용되는 규정 문장에서 유용합니다.

questions.question: The architectural firm ------ for the museum's expansion was selected from a pool of more than forty applicants.

explanation.en: Noun + ___ + prepositional phrase, followed by the main verb: use -ed (passive meaning) or -ing (active meaning) as a reduced relative clause.
explanation.ko: 명사 + ___ + 전치사구 뒤에 본동사가 오면, 축약 관계절로 -ed(수동 의미) 또는 -ing(능동 의미)를 씁니다.

questions.question: Because the original venue was unavailable, the awards ceremony will ------ be held at the Corliss Hotel.

explanation.en: instead = in place of the original plan; otherwise = if that does not happen; nevertheless = despite that.
explanation.ko: instead = 원래 계획 대신, otherwise = 그렇게 되지 않으면, nevertheless = 그럼에도 불구하고.

questions.question: The report was so ------ researched that the committee approved its recommendations without revision.

explanation.en: so + adjective/adverb + that. Ask what the blank describes: a verb or participle needs the -ly adverb.
explanation.ko: so + 형용사/부사 + that. 빈칸이 무엇을 설명하는지 확인하세요. 동사나 분사를 수식하면 -ly 부사가 필요합니다.

questions.question: Mr. Oduya will oversee the project until a permanent manager is appointed, ------ he will return to his role in the finance department.

explanation.en: Relative expressions like at which point, by which time and in which case can join clauses; plain adverbs (then, by then) cannot.
explanation.ko: at which point, by which time, in which case 같은 관계 표현은 절을 연결할 수 있지만, 단순 부사(then, by then)는 연결할 수 없습니다.

questions.question: Interns are encouraged to attend the weekly strategy meetings ------ they are not expected to contribute.

explanation.en: Contrast + clause: although, even though, even if. Contrast + noun: despite, in spite of, notwithstanding.
explanation.ko: 대조 + 절: although, even though, even if. 대조 + 명사: despite, in spite of, notwithstanding.

questions.question: The price increase was ------ by rising raw material costs rather than by higher labor expenses.

explanation.en: Cause verbs in TOEIC: prompted by, triggered by, attributed to, resulting from. Watch for look-alike words (prompted / promoted).
explanation.ko: TOEIC의 원인 동사: prompted by, triggered by, attributed to, resulting from. 형태가 비슷한 단어(prompted / promoted)에 주의하세요.

questions.question: Of the three proposals submitted, the one from Halvorsen Logistics was by far the ------ cost-effective.

explanation.en: "of the three/all..." + the ___ → superlative. "by far" and "much" intensify comparatives and superlatives.
explanation.ko: "of the three/all..." + the ___ → 최상급. "by far"와 "much"는 비교급과 최상급을 강조합니다.

questions.question: Applications submitted after the deadline will be considered only ------ positions remain unfilled.

explanation.en: "only if" = in that one condition. Contrast with "unless" = except if.
explanation.ko: "only if" = 그 한 가지 조건에서만. "unless" = ~가 아니라면과 구별하세요.

questions.question: To ------ the approval process, managers may now sign purchase orders electronically.

explanation.en: High-level verbs for faster/easier: expedite, accelerate, streamline, facilitate.
explanation.ko: 더 빠르게/쉽게를 뜻하는 고급 동사: expedite, accelerate, streamline, facilitate.

questions.question: The new warehouse management system has proven far more reliable than ------ it replaced.

explanation.en: To avoid repeating a singular noun before a relative clause, use "the one (that/which)..."; plural: "the ones".
explanation.ko: 관계절 앞에서 단수 명사의 반복을 피하려면 "the one (that/which)..."을, 복수는 "the ones"를 씁니다.

questions.question: ------ to the press conference are asked to arrive no later than 9:30 A.M. for security screening.

explanation.en: "Those + p.p./-ing" = the people who... (Those interested, Those attending, Those invited).
explanation.ko: "Those + p.p./-ing" = ~하는 사람들(Those interested, Those attending, Those invited).

questions.question: The quality control team identified a ------ in the labeling of several product batches.

explanation.en: Audit / quality vocabulary: discrepancy, inconsistency, deviation, defect, error.
explanation.ko: 감사 / 품질 관련 어휘: discrepancy, inconsistency, deviation, defect, error.

questions.question: Ms. Brandt ------ for the Lisbon office for nearly a decade by the time she was named regional director.

explanation.en: by the time + past simple → past perfect in the other clause; by the time + present simple → future perfect.
explanation.ko: by the time + 과거 시제 → 다른 절은 과거완료, by the time + 현재 시제 → 미래완료.

questions.question: The keynote speaker's remarks were ------ received by the audience, many of whom stood to applaud.

explanation.en: be + ___ + p.p. → adverb. Common pairs: warmly received, enthusiastically received, widely reported.
explanation.ko: be + ___ + p.p. → 부사. 자주 쓰이는 짝: warmly received, enthusiastically received, widely reported.

questions.question: Tenants must notify the property manager in writing at least sixty days ------ to vacating the premises.

explanation.en: Fixed preposition phrases: prior to, ahead of, in advance of, subsequent to (= after).
explanation.ko: 고정 전치사구: prior to, ahead of, in advance of, subsequent to(= after).

questions.question: Not only ------ the product launch on schedule, but it also came in under budget.

explanation.en: Negative adverbs at the start (Not only, Rarely, Seldom, Never, Only after) → question word order: auxiliary + subject.
explanation.ko: 부정 부사가 문두에 오면(Not only, Rarely, Seldom, Never, Only after) → 의문문 어순: 조동사 + 주어.

questions.question: The agreement will remain in effect for two years, ------ which time both parties may renegotiate the terms.

explanation.en: Preposition + which time = after which time, during which time, by which time.
explanation.ko: 전치사 + which time = after which time, during which time, by which time.

questions.question: Customers can track the status of their orders ------ through the company's mobile app.

explanation.en: When the sentence is already grammatically complete, the blank is usually an adverb.
explanation.ko: 문장이 이미 문법적으로 완성되어 있으면 빈칸은 대개 부사입니다.

questions.question: The consultants ------ that the company consolidate its two distribution centers into one facility.

explanation.en: First check whether the sentence has a main verb. If not, the blank must be a finite verb.
explanation.ko: 먼저 문장에 본동사가 있는지 확인하세요. 없다면 빈칸에는 정동사가 들어가야 합니다.

questions.question: Please keep your receipt, as it serves ------ proof of purchase for any warranty claims.

explanation.en: serve as / act as / function as + role. "Like" compares, "as" states the role.
explanation.ko: serve as / act as / function as + 역할. "Like"는 비교를, "as"는 역할을 나타냅니다.

questions.question: Because of an ------ high volume of calls, customers may experience longer wait times today.

explanation.en: article + ___ + adjective + noun → adverb modifying the adjective (unusually high, exceptionally large).
explanation.ko: 관사 + ___ + 형용사 + 명사 → 형용사를 수식하는 부사(unusually high, exceptionally large).

questions.question: Ms. Iwata declined the offer, explaining that she preferred to remain with a company ------ values she shares.

explanation.en: Relative pronoun + noun with no article = whose (a company whose values, an employee whose contract).
explanation.ko: 관계대명사 + 관사 없는 명사 = whose(a company whose values, an employee whose contract).

questions.question: The pilot program was discontinued after it failed to produce any ------ improvement in customer retention.

explanation.en: -able/-ible adjectives = can be ___ (measurable, noticeable, achievable). Prefer them over -ing/-ed when the meaning is "possible".
explanation.ko: -able/-ible 형용사 = ~할 수 있는(measurable, noticeable, achievable). 가능의 의미일 때는 -ing/-ed보다 이것을 고르세요.

questions.question: ------ his extensive experience in retail, Mr. Castellano was asked to lead the store redesign project.

explanation.en: Given + noun / Given that + clause = because of / considering. Very common at the start of TOEIC sentences.
explanation.ko: Given + 명사 / Given that + 절 = ~ 때문에 / ~을 고려하면. TOEIC 문장의 첫머리에 매우 자주 나옵니다.

questions.question: The relocation allowance is intended ------ to cover moving expenses and may not be used for any other purpose.

explanation.en: Adverbs like solely, primarily, exclusively and partly can modify a whole phrase (solely to cover, primarily for).
explanation.ko: solely, primarily, exclusively, partly 같은 부사는 구 전체를 수식할 수 있습니다(solely to cover, primarily for).

items.description:
To: All Staff <staff@corvellapharma.com>
From: Renata Szabo <rszabo@corvellapharma.com>
Date: 14 May
Subject: Expense reporting

Dear colleagues,

As of 1 June, all business expenses must be submitted through the Ledgerly app rather than on paper forms. The change is intended to (131) ------ reimbursement, which currently takes up to three weeks.

To submit a claim, photograph each receipt and attach it to the corresponding entry. Claims (132) ------ receipts will be returned to the employee without processing. (133) ------

The finance team will hold two optional training sessions next week. (134) ------, a step-by-step guide is available on the intranet for anyone unable to attend.

Regards,
Renata Szabo
Finance Director
items.descriptionKo: 수신: 전 직원 <staff@corvellapharma.com> 발신: Renata Szabo <rszabo@corvellapharma.com> 날짜: 5월 14일 제목: 경비 보고 동료 여러분께, 6월 1일부터 모든 업무 경비는 종이 양식 대신 Ledgerly 앱을 통해 제출해야 합니다. 이번 변경은 현재 최대 3주가 걸리는 환급을 신속히 처리하기 위한 것입니다. 청구서를 제출하려면 각 영수증을 촬영하여 해당 항목에 첨부하십시오. 영수증이 없는 청구서는 처리되지 않고 직원에게 반려됩니다. 승인된 금액은 다음 정기 급여에 추가됩니다. 재무팀은 다음 주에 선택 참여 교육을 두 차례 진행합니다. 또한 참석할 수 없는 분들을 위해 인트라넷에 단계별 안내서가 마련되어 있습니다. 감사합니다. Renata Szabo 재무 이사

explanation.en: The e-mail says reimbursement "currently takes up to three weeks", so the purpose of the change is to speed it up: "expedite".
explanation.ko: 이메일에 환급이 "현재 최대 3주가 걸린다"고 되어 있으므로 변경의 목적은 이를 빠르게 하는 것, 즉 "expedite"입니다.

explanation.en: "Claims lacking receipts" is a reduced relative clause (= claims that lack receipts). The sentence already has the main verb "will be returned".
explanation.ko: "Claims lacking receipts"는 축약된 관계절(= claims that lack receipts)입니다. 문장에는 이미 본동사 "will be returned"가 있습니다.

options: The finance department is located on the third floor.
Receipts should be kept for your personal records.
Paper forms will continue to be accepted for amounts under $50.
Approved amounts will be added to the next scheduled paycheck.
questions.correct: Approved amounts will be added to the next scheduled paycheck.

explanation.en: The paragraph describes the claim process in order; the next logical step after submitting is being paid. Accepting paper forms would contradict "rather than on paper forms".
explanation.ko: 이 단락은 청구 절차를 순서대로 설명하므로, 제출 다음의 논리적 단계는 지급입니다. 종이 양식을 받는다는 내용은 "종이 양식 대신"과 모순됩니다.

explanation.en: The guide is a second resource added to the training sessions, so "In addition" is the correct connector.
explanation.ko: 안내서는 교육 외에 추가되는 두 번째 자료이므로 "In addition"이 알맞은 연결어입니다.

items.description:
Tidewater Ferries Adds Electric Vessels

PORT ALDER (9 March) — Tidewater Ferries announced on Tuesday that it will replace two of its diesel-powered boats with electric vessels by the end of next year. The company estimates that the change will cut its fuel costs (135) ------ 40 percent.

The new ferries, which are being built in Norway, can carry up to 300 passengers and 60 vehicles. (136) ------ Charging stations will be installed at both the Port Alder and Gull Island terminals.

CEO Marta Lindqvist said passengers should notice a quieter and smoother ride. "Our goal has always been to provide (137) ------ service while reducing our impact on the harbor," she said.

Tidewater's remaining diesel boats (138) ------ over the following five years as funding becomes available.
items.descriptionKo: Tidewater Ferries, 전기 선박 도입 포트 앨더 (3월 9일) — Tidewater Ferries는 화요일, 내년 말까지 디젤 선박 2척을 전기 선박으로 교체한다고 발표했다. 회사는 이번 변경으로 연료비가 40퍼센트 절감될 것으로 추산한다. 노르웨이에서 건조 중인 새 페리는 최대 승객 300명과 차량 60대를 실을 수 있다. 각 선박은 20분 충전 한 번으로 항로를 운항할 수 있다. 충전소는 포트 앨더 터미널과 걸 아일랜드 터미널 양쪽에 설치될 예정이다. Marta Lindqvist CEO는 승객들이 더 조용하고 부드러운 승선감을 느낄 것이라고 말했다. "저희의 목표는 언제나 항만에 미치는 영향을 줄이면서 신뢰할 수 있는 서비스를 제공하는 것이었습니다"라고 그녀는 말했다. Tidewater의 나머지 디젤 선박은 자금이 확보되는 대로 이후 5년에 걸쳐 교체될 예정이다.

explanation.en: "Cut by 40 percent" expresses the amount of change. "By" is the standard preposition after verbs of increase and decrease.
explanation.ko: "Cut by 40 percent"는 변화의 폭을 나타냅니다. "By"는 증감 동사 뒤에 쓰는 표준 전치사입니다.

options: Ticket prices for the route were last raised in 2019.
Each vessel will be able to complete the crossing on a single 20-minute charge.
The diesel boats have been sold to a company in Canada.
Passengers have complained about the lack of parking.
questions.correct: Each vessel will be able to complete the crossing on a single 20-minute charge.

explanation.en: The paragraph describes the new vessels and the next sentence mentions charging stations, so a sentence about charging fits. The other options do not link the two sentences.
explanation.ko: 이 단락은 새 선박을 설명하고 다음 문장이 충전소를 언급하므로 충전에 관한 문장이 적절합니다. 다른 선택지는 두 문장을 연결하지 못합니다.

explanation.en: An adjective is needed before the noun "service": "reliable service".
explanation.ko: 명사 "service" 앞에는 형용사가 필요합니다: "reliable service".

explanation.en: "Over the following five years" refers to the future, and the boats receive the action, so the future passive "will be replaced" is correct.
explanation.ko: "Over the following five years"는 미래를 가리키고 선박이 동작을 받으므로 미래 수동태 "will be replaced"가 정답입니다.

items.description:
Notice to Visitors
Hollin Botanical Conservatory

The Tropical House will be closed from 3 to 21 February while the glass roof panels are (139) ------. During this period, the Desert Garden and the Fern Gallery will remain open (140) ------ normal hours.

Members who had reserved places on guided tours of the Tropical House will be contacted by e-mail and offered a full refund or an alternative date. (141) ------

We regret any disappointment this may cause. Once the work is complete, the improved insulation will allow us to maintain more stable temperatures for our most (142) ------ plants.
items.descriptionKo: 방문객 안내 Hollin 식물원 열대관은 유리 지붕 패널이 교체되는 동안 2월 3일부터 21일까지 문을 닫습니다. 이 기간에 사막 정원과 양치식물 갤러리는 정상 운영 시간 동안 계속 개방됩니다. 열대관 가이드 투어를 예약한 회원에게는 이메일로 연락하여 전액 환불 또는 다른 날짜를 제안해 드립니다. 휴관 기간에는 비회원 입장료가 절반으로 할인됩니다. 이로 인해 실망을 드리게 된 점 양해 바랍니다. 작업이 완료되면 개선된 단열 덕분에 가장 섬세한 식물들을 위해 더 안정적인 온도를 유지할 수 있게 됩니다.

explanation.en: "Are" + past participle forms the present passive: the panels are being worked on by others, so "are replaced" is correct.
explanation.ko: "Are" + 과거분사는 현재 수동태입니다: 패널은 다른 사람에 의해 작업되므로 "are replaced"가 정답입니다.

explanation.en: "During normal hours" means "in the usual opening time". "Within" would refer to limits, not a schedule.
explanation.ko: "During normal hours"는 평소 운영 시간 동안이라는 뜻입니다. "Within"은 일정이 아니라 한계를 나타냅니다.

options: The Tropical House first opened to the public in 1998.
Tickets can be purchased at the main entrance.
Tours of the Desert Garden are also fully booked for the month.
Admission for non-members will be reduced by half during the closure.
questions.correct: Admission for non-members will be reduced by half during the closure.

explanation.en: After explaining what members receive, the notice adds what non-members receive during the closure. The other sentences are unrelated or contradict the reduced service.
explanation.ko: 회원이 받는 혜택을 설명한 뒤, 휴관 기간에 비회원이 받는 혜택을 덧붙입니다. 다른 문장은 관련이 없거나 축소된 서비스와 모순됩니다.

explanation.en: "Most" + adjective + noun forms the superlative: "our most delicate plants".
explanation.ko: "Most" + 형용사 + 명사는 최상급을 이룹니다: "our most delicate plants".

items.description:
Mr. Farid Nasser
27 Wexley Road
Brantford

2 October

Dear Mr. Nasser,

Thank you for your interest in the Senior Analyst position at Orrin & Pike Consulting. We were impressed by your qualifications, and we would like to invite you to a second interview with our partners.

The interview will last approximately two hours and will include a short case-study exercise. You (143) ------ to analyze a client's data and present your recommendations to the panel. (144) ------

Please confirm your availability for 12 or 13 October by replying to this letter or by calling my office directly. Should (145) ------ dates be inconvenient, we will do our best to arrange an alternative.

We look forward to meeting you again. (146) ------, please do not hesitate to contact me with any questions about the process.

Sincerely,
Julia Moretti
Human Resources Manager
items.descriptionKo: Farid Nasser 님 27 Wexley Road Brantford 10월 2일 Nasser 님께, Orrin & Pike Consulting의 선임 분석가 직책에 관심을 가져 주셔서 감사합니다. 귀하의 자격 요건에 깊은 인상을 받았으며, 파트너들과의 2차 면접에 귀하를 초대하고자 합니다. 면접은 약 2시간 동안 진행되며 짧은 사례 연구 과제가 포함됩니다. 귀하는 고객의 데이터를 분석하고 심사위원단에게 권고안을 발표하도록 요청받을 것입니다. 필요한 자료는 당일에 제공됩니다. 이 편지에 회신하시거나 제 사무실로 직접 전화하셔서 10월 12일 또는 13일 중 가능한 날짜를 확인해 주십시오. 두 날짜 모두 불편하시다면 다른 일정을 마련하도록 최선을 다하겠습니다. 다시 뵙기를 고대합니다. 그동안 절차에 관해 궁금한 점이 있으시면 언제든지 연락해 주십시오. Julia Moretti 인사 관리자

explanation.en: The interview has not happened yet, and the candidate receives the request, so the future passive "will be asked" is correct.
explanation.ko: 면접은 아직 진행되지 않았고 지원자가 요청을 받는 입장이므로 미래 수동태 "will be asked"가 정답입니다.

options: We received over two hundred applications.
The materials you will need will be provided on the day.
Our offices are closed on national holidays.
The position was advertised in several newspapers.
questions.correct: The materials you will need will be provided on the day.

explanation.en: The sentence continues the description of the case-study exercise. The other options do not relate to the exercise or the interview arrangements.
explanation.ko: 이 문장은 사례 연구 과제에 대한 설명을 이어 갑니다. 다른 선택지는 과제나 면접 일정과 관련이 없습니다.

explanation.en: The plural noun "dates" and the plural verb "be" need a plural determiner: "Should both dates be inconvenient" (= if both dates are inconvenient). "Either", "neither" and "each" take a singular noun.
explanation.ko: 복수 명사 "dates"와 복수 동사 "be"에는 복수 한정사가 필요합니다: "Should both dates be inconvenient"(= 두 날짜 모두 불편하다면). "Either", "neither", "each"는 단수 명사와 함께 씁니다.

explanation.en: "In the meantime" means "during the time before the interview", which fits an offer to answer questions before the meeting.
explanation.ko: "In the meantime"은 면접 전까지의 기간 동안이라는 뜻으로, 만남 전에 질문에 답하겠다는 제안에 어울립니다.

items.description:
Kessler Tower Parking Garage

Beginning Monday, 4 August, Levels 1 and 2 of the garage will be reserved for vehicles displaying a valid Kessler Tower tenant permit. Visitors should park on Levels 3 through 5, which can be reached by the ramp on the east side of the building.

Tenant permits are issued by the building management office in Suite 110. Each company may request up to five permits per 1,000 square feet of leased space. Vehicles without a permit parked in the reserved levels after 4 August will be issued a warning on the first occasion and towed at the owner's expense thereafter.
items.descriptionKo: Kessler Tower 주차장 8월 4일 월요일부터 주차장 1층과 2층은 유효한 Kessler Tower 입주사 주차증을 부착한 차량 전용으로 지정됩니다. 방문객은 건물 동쪽 경사로를 통해 갈 수 있는 3층부터 5층까지 주차해 주십시오. 입주사 주차증은 110호 건물 관리사무소에서 발급합니다. 각 회사는 임대 면적 1,000제곱피트당 최대 5장의 주차증을 신청할 수 있습니다. 8월 4일 이후 전용 층에 주차증 없이 주차한 차량은 처음에는 경고를 받고, 그 이후에는 소유자 부담으로 견인됩니다.

questions.question: For whom is the notice most likely intended?
options: People who use the parking garage
questions.correct: People who use the parking garage

explanation.en: The notice explains where tenants and visitors may park, so it is aimed at everyone who parks in the garage.
explanation.ko: 이 공지는 누구를 대상으로 하겠습니까? 공지는 입주사와 방문객이 어디에 주차할 수 있는지 설명하므로 주차장에 주차하는 모든 사람을 대상으로 합니다.

questions.question: What will happen to a vehicle without a permit that is parked on Level 2 for the second time?
options: Its owner will be charged a daily fee.
It will be moved to Level 3.
Its owner will receive a warning.

explanation.en: A first offense receives a warning, and vehicles will be "towed at the owner's expense thereafter", i.e. on later occasions.
explanation.ko: 주차증 없이 2층에 두 번째로 주차한 차량은 어떻게 됩니까? 첫 위반은 경고를 받고, 차량은 "그 이후에는 소유자 부담으로 견인"됩니다. 즉 이후 위반 시 견인됩니다.

items.description:
Priya Ramaswamy (10:02 A.M.)
The projector in Conference Room B won't connect to my laptop. The Hollister clients arrive in twenty minutes.

Tomasz Wolak (10:04 A.M.)
Did you try the adapter in the top drawer of the cabinet?

Priya Ramaswamy (10:05 A.M.)
The drawer's empty.

Tomasz Wolak (10:06 A.M.)
Someone must have borrowed it again. Room D is free all morning, and its system was updated last week.

Priya Ramaswamy (10:07 A.M.)
I'm on my way.

Tomasz Wolak (10:07 A.M.)
I'll let reception know so they can direct the clients there.
items.descriptionKo: Priya Ramaswamy (오전 10:02) B 회의실 프로젝터가 제 노트북에 연결이 안 돼요. Hollister 고객들이 20분 후에 도착해요. Tomasz Wolak (오전 10:04) 캐비닛 맨 위 서랍에 있는 어댑터는 써 봤어요? Priya Ramaswamy (오전 10:05) 서랍이 비어 있어요. Tomasz Wolak (오전 10:06) 누가 또 빌려 간 모양이네요. D 회의실이 오전 내내 비어 있고, 그곳 시스템은 지난주에 업데이트됐어요. Priya Ramaswamy (오전 10:07) 지금 갈게요. Tomasz Wolak (오전 10:07) 안내 데스크에 알려서 고객들을 그쪽으로 안내하게 할게요.

questions.question: What problem does Ms. Ramaswamy have?
options: A conference room has been double-booked.
Her clients have canceled a meeting.
She cannot use some presentation equipment.
questions.correct: She cannot use some presentation equipment.

explanation.en: She writes that "the projector in Conference Room B won't connect to my laptop".
explanation.ko: Ramaswamy 씨에게 어떤 문제가 있습니까? 그녀는 "B 회의실 프로젝터가 제 노트북에 연결이 안 된다"고 씁니다.

questions.question: At 10:07 A.M., what does Ms. Ramaswamy most likely mean when she writes, "I'm on my way"?
options: She will move to a different meeting room.
She will look for the adapter in another office.
She is going to meet the clients at the entrance.
She is leaving to buy a new adapter.
questions.correct: She will move to a different meeting room.

explanation.en: She replies directly to Mr. Wolak's suggestion that Room D is free and has an updated system, so she is going to Room D.
explanation.ko: 오전 10시 7분에 Ramaswamy 씨가 "I'm on my way"라고 쓴 의도는 무엇이겠습니까? 그녀는 D 회의실이 비어 있고 시스템이 업데이트되었다는 Wolak 씨의 제안에 바로 답하고 있으므로 D 회의실로 가겠다는 뜻입니다.

items.description:
Brightwater Linens
Hospitality Division

Hotels and restaurants across the region rely on Brightwater for table linens, towels and bedding that withstand daily commercial laundering. Our fabrics are woven at our own mill, allowing us to guarantee consistent quality and shorter lead times than importers.

New business accounts opened before 30 November will receive:
• Free embroidery of your logo on orders of 200 items or more
• Net-60 payment terms
• A dedicated account representative

Request a sample kit at www.brightwaterlinens.com/trade.
items.descriptionKo: Brightwater Linens 호스피탈리티 사업부 지역 전역의 호텔과 식당들은 매일 이루어지는 업소용 세탁을 견뎌 내는 식탁보, 수건, 침구를 Brightwater에 믿고 맡깁니다. 저희 원단은 자체 공장에서 직조되므로 수입업체보다 일관된 품질과 더 짧은 납기를 보장할 수 있습니다. 11월 30일 이전에 개설된 신규 기업 계정은 다음 혜택을 받습니다. • 200개 이상 주문 시 로고 자수 무료 • 60일 후 결제 조건 • 전담 계정 담당자 샘플 키트는 www.brightwaterlinens.com/trade에서 신청하세요.

questions.question: What is suggested about Brightwater Linens?
options: It recently opened a new store.
It sells mainly to private households.

explanation.en: The advertisement says "Our fabrics are woven at our own mill", which means it produces its own fabric.
explanation.ko: Brightwater Linens에 대해 암시된 것은 무엇입니까? 광고에 "저희 원단은 자체 공장에서 직조된다"고 되어 있으므로 자체적으로 원단을 생산합니다.

questions.question: What is NOT offered to new business accounts?
options: Free logo embroidery on large orders
A personal contact at the company

explanation.en: Embroidery, Net-60 payment terms and an account representative are listed. Delivery is not mentioned.
explanation.ko: 신규 기업 계정에 제공되지 않는 것은 무엇입니까? 자수, 60일 후 결제 조건, 계정 담당자는 나열되어 있습니다. 배송은 언급되지 않습니다.

items.description:
To: Dmitri Halloran <dhalloran@fenwickpress.com>
From: Aiko Sato <asato@fenwickpress.com>
Date: 18 April
Subject: Translation schedule

Hi Dmitri,

I've just heard from Ms. Delacroix, who is translating The Salt Road into French. She has finished eleven of the sixteen chapters but has asked for a three-week extension on the remainder. — [1] — She explained that the final chapters contain a large amount of regional dialect, which is taking longer to render accurately than she had anticipated.

I'm inclined to agree to her request. — [2] — Her earlier translations for us have been praised by reviewers, and rushing this one would not serve the book well. — [3] — However, an extension would push the French release past the Lyon Book Fair in June, where we had planned to promote it.

Could we discuss whether to launch at the fair with an advance excerpt instead? — [4] — I'm free tomorrow afternoon if that suits you.

Aiko
items.descriptionKo: 수신: Dmitri Halloran <dhalloran@fenwickpress.com> 발신: Aiko Sato <asato@fenwickpress.com> 날짜: 4월 18일 제목: 번역 일정 Dmitri 씨, 안녕하세요. The Salt Road를 프랑스어로 번역하고 있는 Delacroix 씨에게서 방금 연락을 받았습니다. 그녀는 16개 장 중 11개 장을 마쳤지만, 나머지 부분에 대해 3주 연장을 요청했습니다. — [1] — 마지막 장들에 지역 방언이 많이 들어 있어 정확하게 옮기는 데 예상보다 시간이 오래 걸리고 있다고 설명했습니다. 저는 그녀의 요청을 받아들이는 쪽으로 기울어 있습니다. — [2] — 그녀가 이전에 저희를 위해 한 번역은 평론가들의 호평을 받았고, 이번 번역을 서두르면 책에 도움이 되지 않을 것입니다. — [3] — 다만 연장하면 프랑스어판 출간이 6월 리옹 도서전 이후로 밀리게 되는데, 저희는 그곳에서 책을 홍보할 계획이었습니다. 대신 도서전에서 사전 발췌본으로 출시하는 방안을 논의해 볼 수 있을까요? — [4] — 괜찮으시다면 저는 내일 오후에 시간이 됩니다. Aiko

items.description:
Logistics Coordinator — Ashgrove Distribution

Ashgrove Distribution, a supplier of packaged foods to independent grocers, is seeking a logistics coordinator for its Ridgefield warehouse. The successful candidate will schedule outbound deliveries, liaise with third-party carriers, and resolve delivery exceptions such as damaged or missing items.

Requirements:
• At least two years of experience in transportation or warehouse operations
• Familiarity with route-planning software
• Strong written communication skills

A commercial driver's license is an advantage but is not required. The position is full-time, with occasional weekend shifts during peak seasons. To apply, send a résumé and a brief cover letter to careers@ashgrovedist.com by 15 March. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

items.description:
MEMO
To: All laboratory staff
From: Dr. Henrik Aalto, Facilities Manager
Date: 22 January
Re: Fume hood inspections

Our annual safety inspection of all fume hoods will be carried out by Certex Safety Services on 3 and 4 February. Each hood will be out of service for about 45 minutes while airflow is tested.

To minimize disruption, please do not schedule any experiments requiring a fume hood on those dates without first checking the inspection timetable, which will be posted on the door of each lab by 29 January. Hoods must be cleared of all chemicals and equipment before testing begins; any hood that is not cleared cannot be certified and will be locked until a second inspection can be arranged, at the department's expense.

Thank you for your cooperation.
items.descriptionKo: 회람 수신: 전 실험실 직원 발신: Henrik Aalto 박사, 시설 관리자 날짜: 1월 22일 제목: 흄 후드 점검 모든 흄 후드에 대한 연례 안전 점검이 2월 3일과 4일에 Certex Safety Services에 의해 실시됩니다. 각 후드는 공기 흐름을 시험하는 동안 약 45분간 사용할 수 없습니다. 업무 차질을 최소화하기 위해, 1월 29일까지 각 실험실 문에 게시될 점검 일정표를 먼저 확인하지 않고는 해당 날짜에 흄 후드가 필요한 실험을 잡지 마십시오. 시험이 시작되기 전에 후드에서 모든 화학 물질과 장비를 치워야 합니다. 비워지지 않은 후드는 인증을 받을 수 없으며, 부서 비용으로 2차 점검이 마련될 때까지 잠깁니다. 협조해 주셔서 감사합니다.

items.description:
Grace Okonkwo [9:14 A.M.]
Morning, everyone. Quick update: the printer has told us the annual report proofs won't be ready until Thursday instead of Tuesday.

Lars Bergmann [9:15 A.M.]
That leaves us only one day to review them before the shareholders' mailing on Friday.

Grace Okonkwo [9:16 A.M.]
Exactly. I'd like to split the review so we're not all reading the whole thing.

Hana Petrovic [9:17 A.M.]
I can take the financial statements. I prepared most of the tables anyway.

Lars Bergmann [9:18 A.M.]
Then I'll check the CEO's letter and the sustainability section.

Owen Mbeki [9:20 A.M.]
That leaves the photos and captions. I can do those, but I'm at the Denver office on Thursday.

Grace Okonkwo [9:21 A.M.]
Not a problem. The printer is sending a PDF as well as the hard copies.

Owen Mbeki [9:22 A.M.]
Perfect. Send it my way as soon as it comes in.
items.descriptionKo: Grace Okonkwo [오전 9:14] 좋은 아침이에요, 여러분. 간단히 알려 드릴게요. 인쇄소에서 연례 보고서 교정쇄가 화요일이 아니라 목요일에야 준비된대요. Lars Bergmann [오전 9:15] 그러면 금요일 주주 발송 전에 검토할 시간이 하루밖에 없네요. Grace Okonkwo [오전 9:16] 맞아요. 모두가 전체를 다 읽지 않도록 검토를 나눠서 하고 싶어요. Hana Petrovic [오전 9:17] 재무제표는 제가 맡을게요. 어차피 표는 대부분 제가 만들었으니까요. Lars Bergmann [오전 9:18] 그럼 저는 CEO 서한과 지속 가능성 섹션을 확인할게요. Owen Mbeki [오전 9:20] 그러면 사진과 캡션이 남네요. 제가 할 수 있는데, 목요일에는 덴버 사무소에 있어요. Grace Okonkwo [오전 9:21] 문제없어요. 인쇄소에서 인쇄본과 함께 PDF도 보내 준대요. Owen Mbeki [오전 9:22] 좋아요. 도착하는 대로 저한테 보내 주세요.

items.description:
Regional Airline Bets on Smaller Airports

WESTBURY (11 June) — While most carriers are concentrating their flights at major hubs, Kestrel Air is moving in the opposite direction. — [1] — Starting in September, the airline will launch direct routes between six secondary airports that currently have no connection to one another.

Chief Executive Rosa Albright said the strategy reflects a shift in passenger demand. "Business travelers increasingly work for companies based outside large cities," she said. "They don't want to drive two hours to a hub and then connect." — [2] —

Analysts are divided on the plan. Some note that smaller airports charge lower landing fees and suffer fewer delays. — [3] — Others caution that demand on such routes tends to be seasonal, which could leave aircraft underused in the winter months.

Kestrel intends to operate the routes with a fleet of 76-seat turboprop aircraft, which consume considerably less fuel than jets on short distances. — [4] — The company said it would review the routes after eighteen months and adjust its schedule according to demand.
items.descriptionKo: 지역 항공사, 소규모 공항에 승부를 걸다 웨스트버리 (6월 11일) — 대부분의 항공사가 주요 허브 공항에 항공편을 집중하고 있는 가운데, Kestrel Air는 정반대 방향으로 나아가고 있다. — [1] — 이 항공사는 9월부터 현재 서로 연결편이 없는 6개 지방 공항 사이에 직항 노선을 개설한다. Rosa Albright 최고경영자는 이 전략이 승객 수요의 변화를 반영한 것이라고 말했다. "출장객들은 점점 더 대도시 밖에 기반을 둔 회사에서 일하고 있습니다"라고 그녀는 말했다. "그들은 허브 공항까지 두 시간을 운전한 뒤 환승하고 싶어 하지 않습니다." — [2] — 이 계획에 대해 분석가들의 의견은 엇갈린다. 일부는 소규모 공항이 착륙료가 낮고 지연이 적다는 점을 지적한다. — [3] — 다른 이들은 이런 노선의 수요가 계절을 타는 경향이 있어 겨울철에는 항공기가 충분히 활용되지 못할 수 있다고 경고한다. Kestrel은 단거리에서 제트기보다 연료를 훨씬 적게 소비하는 76석 터보프롭 항공기로 노선을 운항할 계획이다. — [4] — 회사는 18개월 후 노선을 재검토하고 수요에 따라 일정을 조정하겠다고 밝혔다.

items.description:
Lindholm Café Opens Second Location

BRAXTON (3 May) — Lindholm Café, known for its Scandinavian pastries and single-origin coffee, will open a second location on Quarry Street on 20 May. Owner Elsa Lindholm said the new café will be twice the size of the original on Market Square and will include a bakery where customers can watch pastries being made.

The Quarry Street café will also offer a weekday lunch menu of soups and open-faced sandwiches, something the Market Square location has never served because of its small kitchen. Ms. Lindholm has hired chef Anders Wik, formerly of the Nordlys restaurant in Copenhagen, to develop the menu.
To: Elsa Lindholm
From: Anders Wik
Date: 24 May
Subject: First week

Elsa,

The first week has gone better than we hoped. Lunch has been especially busy; we sold out of soup by 12:45 every day except Tuesday, when it rained and we still had some left at closing. I'd like to make larger batches from next week, but we'll need a second soup pot, as our current one is at capacity. I've found one from our usual kitchen supplier for $380.

One other thing: several customers asked whether we deliver. It might be worth looking into, at least for nearby offices.

Anders
Review: Lindholm Café, Quarry Street ★★★★☆

I stopped in for lunch on a weekday afternoon and was disappointed to find that the soup had already run out by 1:00 P.M. Fortunately, the smoked-salmon sandwich was excellent, and the cardamom bun I took with me was the best I've had outside Sweden. The bakery window is a nice touch; my children could have watched it all day. I'll be back, but next time I'll come earlier.
— Rafael Duarte
items.descriptionKo: Lindholm 카페, 2호점 개점 브랙스턴 (5월 3일) — 스칸디나비아 페이스트리와 싱글 오리진 커피로 유명한 Lindholm 카페가 5월 20일 Quarry 가에 2호점을 연다. 주인 Elsa Lindholm은 새 카페가 Market 광장에 있는 본점보다 두 배 넓으며, 손님들이 페이스트리를 만드는 모습을 볼 수 있는 베이커리도 갖출 것이라고 말했다. Quarry 가 카페에서는 수프와 오픈 샌드위치로 구성된 평일 점심 메뉴도 제공하는데, 이는 Market 광장 매장이 주방이 좁아 한 번도 제공한 적이 없는 메뉴이다. Lindholm 씨는 메뉴 개발을 위해 코펜하겐 Nordlys 레스토랑 출신의 Anders Wik 셰프를 영입했다.수신: Elsa Lindholm 발신: Anders Wik 날짜: 5월 24일 제목: 첫 주 Elsa 씨, 첫 주는 기대 이상으로 잘 흘러갔어요. 특히 점심이 바빴는데, 비가 와서 마감 때까지 수프가 조금 남았던 화요일을 빼고는 매일 12시 45분이면 수프가 다 팔렸어요. 다음 주부터는 더 많이 만들고 싶은데, 지금 쓰는 냄비가 용량이 꽉 차서 수프 냄비가 하나 더 필요해요. 늘 거래하는 주방용품 업체에서 380달러짜리를 찾아 두었어요. 한 가지 더요. 배달이 되는지 묻는 손님이 여럿 있었어요. 적어도 근처 사무실을 대상으로는 검토해 볼 만할 것 같아요. Anders리뷰: Lindholm 카페, Quarry 가 ★★★★☆ 평일 오후에 점심을 먹으러 들렀는데, 오후 1시에 이미 수프가 다 떨어져서 실망했습니다. 다행히 훈제 연어 샌드위치는 훌륭했고, 포장해 간 카다멈 번은 스웨덴 밖에서 먹어 본 것 중 최고였습니다. 베이커리 창은 멋진 아이디어예요. 아이들은 하루 종일이라도 구경할 기세였습니다. 다시 오겠지만, 다음번에는 더 일찍 오겠습니다. — Rafael Duarte

items.description:
Thornbury Business Park — Notice to Tenants

From 1 July, the management office will no longer arrange window cleaning for individual units. Tenants who wish to continue the service should contract directly with a provider. To help with the transition, we have negotiated reduced rates with ClearView Window Services for any Thornbury tenant who signs a twelve-month agreement before 31 July. Tenants who sign after that date will pay ClearView's standard rates.

Common areas, including the lobby and stairwells, will continue to be cleaned by building management at no charge.
ClearView Window Services — Invoice

Customer: Fairbank Architects, Unit 14, Thornbury Business Park
Agreement signed: 12 August (12 months)
Service: Monthly exterior and interior window cleaning

Monthly rate (standard) ....... $260.00
Total for August ....... $260.00

Payment is due within 15 days. To change your service frequency, contact your account manager, Neil Cartwright.
To: Neil Cartwright <ncartwright@clearview.com>
From: Olga Brenner <obrenner@fairbankarch.com>
Date: 20 August
Subject: Invoice for Unit 14

Dear Mr. Cartwright,

I've received our August invoice. When I spoke to your sales team in July, I understood that we would receive the Thornbury tenant rate of $195 a month. I confirmed our intention to sign up on 25 July, but because our managing partner was traveling, the agreement could not be signed until after he returned.

I'd appreciate it if you could look into this. Also, we would like to have our interior windows cleaned only every other month from now on, which I hope will lower the cost further.

Best regards,
Olga Brenner
Office Manager, Fairbank Architects
