questions.question: The new procurement policy is ------ intended to reduce delays in approving routine purchases.

explanation.en: be + ______ + past participle: the gap is almost always an adverb (-ly).
explanation.ko: be + ______ + 과거분사: 빈칸은 거의 항상 부사(-ly)입니다.

questions.question: By the time the renovation is finished next spring, the museum ------ closed for nearly two years.

explanation.en: By the time + present tense (future meaning) + future perfect "will have + past participle".
explanation.ko: By the time + 현재 시제(미래 의미) + 미래완료 "will have + 과거분사".

questions.question: Mr. Okafor will serve as interim director ------ a permanent replacement is appointed.

explanation.en: Before a clause (subject + verb) use a conjunction; before a noun phrase use a preposition. "Until" can be both, "by" and "during" cannot.
explanation.ko: 절(주어 + 동사) 앞에는 접속사, 명사구 앞에는 전치사를 씁니다. "Until"은 둘 다 가능하지만 "by"와 "during"은 그렇지 않습니다.

questions.question: Applicants for the scholarship must submit the required forms ------ rather than through an agent.

explanation.en: A reflexive pronoun at the end of a clause can mean "personally / without help": do it yourself, submit it themselves.
explanation.ko: 절 끝의 재귀대명사는 "직접 / 도움 없이"라는 뜻이 될 수 있습니다: do it yourself, submit it themselves.

questions.question: All visitors to the plant must ------ with the safety regulations posted at the main entrance.

explanation.en: comply with / adhere to / conform to + rules. Obey / follow / observe + rules (no preposition).
explanation.ko: comply with / adhere to / conform to + 규칙. Obey / follow / observe + 규칙(전치사 없음).

questions.question: The marketing team conducted a thorough ------ of competitors' pricing before launching the new line.

explanation.en: a / an / the + (adjective) + ______ + of: the gap is a noun.
explanation.ko: a / an / the + (형용사) + ______ + of: 빈칸은 명사입니다.

questions.question: ------ had the shipment arrived than the warehouse staff began unloading it.

explanation.en: Inverted time expressions: No sooner had ... THAN ... / Hardly (Scarcely) had ... WHEN ...
explanation.ko: 도치된 시간 표현: No sooner had ... THAN ... / Hardly (Scarcely) had ... WHEN ...

questions.question: The quarterly sales figures will be released ------ after the stock market closes on Friday.

explanation.en: shortly before / shortly after = soon before / soon after. Use the adverb, not "short".
explanation.ko: shortly before / shortly after = 직전에 / 직후에. "short"가 아니라 부사를 쓰세요.

questions.question: The architect ------ design was selected for the new library will present her plans at next week's council meeting.

explanation.en: Relative pronoun + noun (no article) = whose: the company whose products..., the author whose book...
explanation.ko: 관계대명사 + 명사(관사 없음) = whose: the company whose products..., the author whose book...

questions.question: It is essential that every participant ------ the confidentiality agreement before the session begins.

explanation.en: It is essential / important / vital / necessary that + subject + BASE verb.
explanation.ko: It is essential / important / vital / necessary that + 주어 + 동사원형.

questions.question: Ms. Haruki has been ------ to oversee the merger because of her extensive experience in corporate law.

explanation.en: appoint / assign / designate someone to (do) a role.
explanation.ko: appoint / assign / designate someone to (do) 역할.

questions.question: The upgraded software is ------ faster than the previous version but also easier to install.

explanation.en: Correlative pairs: not only ... but also / both ... and / either ... or / neither ... nor.
explanation.ko: 상관접속사: not only ... but also / both ... and / either ... or / neither ... nor.

questions.question: Documents ------ after the deadline will not be reviewed by the selection committee.

explanation.en: Noun + past participle = passive meaning (reports submitted late). Noun + -ing = active meaning (staff submitting reports).
explanation.ko: 명사 + 과거분사 = 수동 의미(reports submitted late). 명사 + -ing = 능동 의미(staff submitting reports).

questions.question: Employees may take additional vacation days ------ overtime pay for hours worked during the holiday period.

explanation.en: in lieu of = instead of. on behalf of = representing someone. in charge of = responsible for.
explanation.ko: in lieu of = ~ 대신에. on behalf of = ~을 대표하여. in charge of = ~을 책임지는.

questions.question: Of the three proposals received, the one from Halberd Consulting is by far the ------.

explanation.en: Among three or more / of all + the + superlative. "by far" strengthens a superlative.
explanation.ko: 셋 이상 중에서 / of all + the + 최상급. "by far"는 최상급을 강조합니다.

questions.question: The board praised the ------ growth of the company's overseas division over the past year.

explanation.en: the + ______ + noun: the gap is an adjective.
explanation.ko: the + ______ + 명사: 빈칸은 형용사입니다.

questions.question: Had the vendor informed us of the delay earlier, we ------ an alternative supplier.

explanation.en: Had + subject + past participle ..., subject + would have + past participle (= If + had ...).
explanation.ko: Had + 주어 + 과거분사 ..., 주어 + would have + 과거분사 (= If + had ...).

questions.question: The new regulations will ------ manufacturers to label all products that contain recycled materials.

explanation.en: require / ask / encourage / allow + someone + TO do. insist / demand / suggest + THAT.
explanation.ko: require / ask / encourage / allow + 사람 + TO do. insist / demand / suggest + THAT.

questions.question: Online registration for the leadership workshop closes ------ noon on Thursday, 9 March.

explanation.en: at + clock time (at noon, at 5 P.M.); on + day/date; in + month/year.
explanation.ko: at + 시각(at noon, at 5 P.M.); on + 요일/날짜; in + 월/연도.

questions.question: Ms. Ferreira spoke ------ about the need to modernize the company's distribution network.

explanation.en: Verb (+ object) + ______: describing HOW an action is done = adverb.
explanation.ko: 동사 (+ 목적어) + ______: 동작을 어떻게 하는지 설명하면 부사입니다.

questions.question: Please retain your original receipts, as they will be required for ------ of any travel expenses.

explanation.en: reimbursement of expenses / reimburse someone for costs: common in TOEIC expense policies.
explanation.ko: reimbursement of expenses / reimburse someone for costs: TOEIC 경비 정책에서 자주 나옵니다.

questions.question: The east wing of the hospital ------ at present, so visitors should use the main entrance.

explanation.en: Ongoing action done TO the subject now: am / is / are + being + past participle.
explanation.ko: 지금 주어에게 행해지고 있는 동작: am / is / are + being + 과거분사.

questions.question: ------ the forecast predicts heavy rain, the outdoor concert will proceed as scheduled.

explanation.en: Contrast + clause = although / even though. Contrast + noun = despite / in spite of.
explanation.ko: 대조 + 절 = although / even though. 대조 + 명사 = despite / in spite of.

questions.question: The committee has ------ approved the budget, pending a final review by the director.

explanation.en: tentatively = provisionally (tentatively scheduled, tentatively approved), often with "pending" or "subject to".
explanation.ko: tentatively = 잠정적으로(tentatively scheduled, tentatively approved). "pending"이나 "subject to"와 자주 함께 쓰입니다.

questions.question: The discount offered to members is considerably larger than ------ offered to non-members.

explanation.en: In comparisons, replace a singular noun with "that" and a plural noun with "those".
explanation.ko: 비교 구문에서 단수 명사는 "that", 복수 명사는 "those"로 대신합니다.

questions.question: The factory expects to increase its production ------ by 15 percent once the new assembly line is installed.

explanation.en: production / seating / storage capacity = the maximum amount something can hold or produce.
explanation.ko: production / seating / storage capacity = 무언가가 수용하거나 생산할 수 있는 최대량.

questions.question: Investors were ------ by the company's sudden decision to postpone its annual report.

explanation.en: People feel -ED (confused, interested). Things that cause the feeling are -ING (confusing, interesting).
explanation.ko: 사람이 느끼는 감정은 -ED(confused, interested), 감정을 일으키는 사물은 -ING(confusing, interesting).

questions.question: The city council voted to ------ the parking ordinance, which had been in effect since 1998.

explanation.en: repeal / revoke / abolish a law = cancel it. enact / pass a law = create it.
explanation.ko: repeal / revoke / abolish a law = 법을 폐지하다. enact / pass a law = 법을 제정하다.

questions.question: To ------ the approval process, applicants should include all supporting documents with their forms.

explanation.en: To + BASE verb (purpose). expedite = speed up; expeditious (adj.) = fast.
explanation.ko: To + 동사원형(목적). expedite = 신속히 처리하다; expeditious(형용사) = 신속한.

questions.question: Shuttle buses will run every fifteen minutes ------ the duration of the trade fair.

explanation.en: for the duration of + event = for the whole time the event lasts.
explanation.ko: for the duration of + 행사 = 행사가 계속되는 기간 내내.

items.description:
To: All Staff <staff@velmoratextiles.com>
From: Ingrid Solberg <isolberg@velmoratextiles.com>
Date: 2 October
Subject: Office move

Dear colleagues,

As announced last month, our Dunmore Street office (131) ------ to the Halcyon Building on Riverbend Avenue over the weekend of 18–19 October.

Professional movers will pack the contents of all shared areas, such as the kitchen and the supply room. However, each employee is (132) ------ for packing his or her own desk. Crates and labels will be delivered to every floor on Wednesday, 15 October. (133) ------

Our IT team will reconnect all computers on Sunday evening, so the new office should be (134) ------ operational by Monday morning.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Ingrid Solberg
Operations Manager
items.descriptionKo: 수신: 전 직원 <staff@velmoratextiles.com> 발신: Ingrid Solberg <isolberg@velmoratextiles.com> 날짜: 10월 2일 제목: 사무실 이전 동료 여러분께, 지난달 공지한 대로 Dunmore Street 사무실은 10월 18~19일 주말에 Riverbend Avenue의 Halcyon Building으로 이전할 것입니다. 전문 이삿짐 업체가 주방과 비품실 같은 공용 공간의 물품을 모두 포장할 것입니다. 하지만 각자의 책상은 직원 본인이 포장할 책임이 있습니다. 상자와 라벨은 10월 15일 수요일에 각 층으로 배달됩니다. 각 상자에 이름과 새 책상 번호를 표시해 주십시오. IT팀이 일요일 저녁에 모든 컴퓨터를 다시 연결할 예정이므로 새 사무실은 월요일 아침까지 완전히 가동될 것입니다. 협조해 주셔서 감사합니다. Ingrid Solberg 운영 관리자

explanation.en: The e-mail is dated 2 October and the move takes place on 18–19 October, so it is still in the future: "will relocate". "As announced last month" refers to the announcement, not the move.
explanation.ko: 이메일은 10월 2일 자이고 이전은 10월 18~19일에 이루어지므로 아직 미래의 일입니다: "will relocate". "As announced last month"는 이전이 아니라 공지를 가리킵니다.

explanation.en: "However" contrasts the movers' job with the employees' job, and the blank is followed by "for packing". "Responsible for" means it is their duty.
explanation.ko: "However"는 이삿짐 업체의 일과 직원의 일을 대조하며, 빈칸 뒤에 "for packing"이 옵니다. "Responsible for"는 그것이 직원의 의무라는 뜻입니다.

options: The Halcyon Building was completed in 2015.
Please mark each crate with your name and new desk number.
Parking at the new site is free for visitors.
The move has been postponed until further notice.
questions.correct: Please mark each crate with your name and new desk number.

explanation.en: The previous sentence says crates and labels will be delivered, so an instruction on how to label the crates follows naturally. A postponement would contradict the rest of the e-mail.
explanation.ko: 앞 문장에서 상자와 라벨이 배달된다고 했으므로 상자에 라벨을 붙이는 방법에 대한 안내가 자연스럽게 이어집니다. 연기되었다는 내용은 이메일의 나머지 부분과 모순됩니다.

explanation.en: The blank modifies the adjective "operational", so an adverb is needed: "fully operational".
explanation.ko: 빈칸은 형용사 "operational"을 수식하므로 부사가 필요합니다: "fully operational".

items.description:
Branford Public Library Launches Digital Lending

Beginning in January, Branford Public Library cardholders will be able to borrow e-books and audiobooks (135) ------ through the new Shelfwise app, without visiting a branch.

Cardholders may borrow up to five digital titles at a time. Each loan lasts 21 days, (136) ------ which the title is returned automatically. (137) ------ Titles that are currently on loan can be reserved, and users will receive a notification when they become available.

The app is free and works on most smartphones and tablets. Staff at the circulation desk (138) ------ help anyone who needs assistance setting it up.
items.descriptionKo: Branford 공공도서관, 디지털 대출 서비스 시작 1월부터 Branford 공공도서관 회원증 소지자는 지점을 방문하지 않고도 새 Shelfwise 앱을 통해 전자책과 오디오북을 직접 대출할 수 있게 됩니다. 회원은 한 번에 최대 5권의 디지털 자료를 대출할 수 있습니다. 대출 기간은 21일이며, 그 후에는 자료가 자동으로 반납됩니다. 따라서 디지털 자료에는 연체료가 없습니다. 현재 대출 중인 자료는 예약할 수 있으며, 이용 가능해지면 알림을 받게 됩니다. 앱은 무료이며 대부분의 스마트폰과 태블릿에서 작동합니다. 대출 데스크 직원들이 앱 설정에 도움이 필요한 분들을 기꺼이 도와드릴 것입니다.

explanation.en: The blank modifies the verb phrase "borrow ... through the app", so an adverb is needed: "borrow directly through the app".
explanation.ko: 빈칸은 동사구 "borrow ... through the app"을 수식하므로 부사가 필요합니다: "borrow directly through the app".

explanation.en: The title is returned automatically when the 21 days end, so "after which" (= after the 21 days) is correct.
explanation.ko: 21일이 끝나면 자료가 자동으로 반납되므로 "after which"(= 21일 후에)가 맞습니다.

options: Late fees for printed books will also be reduced.
The library will close early on public holidays.
There are therefore no late fees for digital titles.
Visitors can reserve study rooms online.
questions.correct: There are therefore no late fees for digital titles.

explanation.en: Because digital titles are returned automatically, they can never be late. "Therefore" connects this result to the previous sentence. The other options change the topic.
explanation.ko: 디지털 자료는 자동으로 반납되므로 연체될 수 없습니다. "Therefore"가 이 결과를 앞 문장과 연결합니다. 나머지 선택지는 주제를 바꿉니다.

explanation.en: The service starts in January, so the offer of help refers to the future. "Will be happy to help" also fits the grammar (modal + base verb "help").
explanation.ko: 서비스는 1월에 시작되므로 도움 제안은 미래를 가리킵니다. "Will be happy to help"는 문법적으로도 맞습니다(조동사 + 동사원형 "help").

items.description:
Ostrander Business Suites
Flexible workspace in the heart of Lowell Harbor

Need a professional workspace without signing a long-term lease? Ostrander Business Suites offers private offices and meeting rooms that can be rented by the day, week, or month. All suites come (139) ------ with desks, ergonomic chairs, and high-speed Internet.

Members also enjoy access to a staffed reception desk, which accepts deliveries and greets visitors (140) ------ your behalf. (141) ------ Simply log in to your account and choose a time.

For a limited time, new members who sign a three-month agreement will receive their first week (142) ------ charge. Call 555-0174 to arrange a tour.
items.descriptionKo: Ostrander Business Suites Lowell Harbor 중심부의 유연한 업무 공간 장기 임대 계약 없이 전문적인 업무 공간이 필요하십니까? Ostrander Business Suites는 일, 주, 월 단위로 임대할 수 있는 개인 사무실과 회의실을 제공합니다. 모든 사무실에는 책상, 인체공학적 의자, 초고속 인터넷이 갖춰져 있습니다. 회원은 또한 직원이 상주하는 안내 데스크를 이용할 수 있으며, 안내 데스크에서 회원을 대신해 택배를 받고 방문객을 맞이합니다. 회의실은 최대 30일 전까지 온라인으로 예약할 수 있습니다. 계정에 로그인하여 시간을 선택하기만 하면 됩니다. 한정 기간 동안 3개월 계약을 체결하는 신규 회원은 첫 주를 무료로 이용할 수 있습니다. 견학을 예약하시려면 555-0174로 전화해 주십시오.

explanation.en: "Come + adjective" describes the state the suites are in. The past participle "furnished" means equipped with furniture.
explanation.ko: "Come + 형용사"는 사무실이 어떤 상태로 제공되는지를 나타냅니다. 과거분사 "furnished"는 가구가 갖춰졌다는 뜻입니다.

explanation.en: "On your behalf" is a fixed expression meaning "for you, as your representative".
explanation.ko: "On your behalf"는 "당신을 대신하여"라는 뜻의 고정 표현입니다.

options: Our café serves breakfast until 11 A.M.
The building was designed by a well-known architect.
Meeting rooms can be reserved online up to 30 days in advance.
questions.correct: Meeting rooms can be reserved online up to 30 days in advance.

explanation.en: The next sentence, "Simply log in to your account and choose a time", only makes sense after a sentence about booking something online.
explanation.ko: 다음 문장 "계정에 로그인하여 시간을 선택하기만 하면 됩니다"는 온라인으로 무언가를 예약하는 내용 뒤에 와야 자연스럽습니다.

explanation.en: "Free of charge" is the fixed expression meaning "at no cost".
explanation.ko: "Free of charge"는 "무료로"라는 뜻의 고정 표현입니다.

items.description:
Harwick Seafoods to Open Processing Plant

MILLPORT (12 June) — Harwick Seafoods announced yesterday that it will open a processing plant in the Millport Industrial Park next spring. The facility is expected to create about 180 jobs, (143) ------ of which will be filled by local residents.

Construction (144) ------ in August, pending final approval from the county planning board. Harwick currently ships its catch to a plant more than 200 kilometers away. Once the Millport plant opens, the fish will travel less than five kilometers. (145) ------, the company expects to lower its transportation costs significantly.

The announcement was welcomed by local officials. (146) ------
items.descriptionKo: Harwick Seafoods, 가공 공장 개설 예정 MILLPORT (6월 12일) — Harwick Seafoods는 내년 봄 Millport 산업단지에 가공 공장을 개설할 것이라고 어제 발표했습니다. 이 시설은 약 180개의 일자리를 창출할 것으로 예상되며, 그중 대부분은 지역 주민으로 채워질 것입니다. 카운티 계획위원회의 최종 승인을 조건으로 공사는 8월에 시작될 것입니다. Harwick은 현재 어획물을 200킬로미터 이상 떨어진 공장으로 운송하고 있습니다. Millport 공장이 문을 열면 생선의 이동 거리는 5킬로미터 미만으로 줄어듭니다. 그 결과 회사는 운송비를 크게 절감할 것으로 기대하고 있습니다. 이 발표는 지역 관계자들의 환영을 받았습니다. Ellen Thorpe 시장은 이 공장을 "지역에 큰 활력"이라고 평가했습니다.

explanation.en: "Most of which" refers back to the countable noun "jobs". "Much" is used with uncountable nouns, and "almost" and "mostly" cannot be followed by "of which".
explanation.ko: "Most of which"는 가산 명사 "jobs"를 가리킵니다. "Much"는 불가산 명사에 쓰이고, "almost"와 "mostly"는 뒤에 "of which"가 올 수 없습니다.

explanation.en: The article is dated June, construction depends on an approval that has not been given yet ("pending"), and the plant opens next spring. The start in August is therefore in the future: "will begin".
explanation.ko: 기사는 6월 자이고, 공사는 아직 나지 않은 승인에 달려 있으며("pending"), 공장은 내년 봄에 문을 엽니다. 따라서 8월의 착공은 미래의 일입니다: "will begin".

explanation.en: Lower transport costs are the consequence of the shorter distance described in the previous sentence, so "As a result" is the correct connector.
explanation.ko: 운송비 절감은 앞 문장에서 설명한 거리 단축의 결과이므로 "As a result"가 올바른 연결어입니다.

options: Harwick was founded in 1987 by two brothers.
The planning board rejected a similar proposal last year.
Local fishermen have opposed the plan.
Mayor Ellen Thorpe called the plant "a major boost for the region."
questions.correct: Mayor Ellen Thorpe called the plant "a major boost for the region."

explanation.en: The previous sentence says that local officials welcomed the announcement, and the mayor's positive comment is an example of this. Opposition from fishermen would contradict it.
explanation.ko: 앞 문장에서 지역 관계자들이 발표를 환영했다고 했으며, 시장의 긍정적인 발언이 그 예입니다. 어민들의 반대는 이와 모순됩니다.

items.description:
Lakemont Aquatic Center

The main pool will be closed from Monday, 3 March, through Sunday, 16 March, while its filtration system is replaced. During this period, the therapy pool and sauna will remain open, although their hours will be shortened to 7:00 A.M.–1:00 P.M.

Members with monthly passes will have their memberships extended by two weeks at no cost. Swimming classes scheduled during the closure will be held at the Fenwick Community Pool; instructors will contact participants with details.
items.descriptionKo: Lakemont 수영 센터 본 수영장은 여과 시스템 교체 공사로 3월 3일 월요일부터 3월 16일 일요일까지 휴장합니다. 이 기간 동안 치료용 수영장과 사우나는 계속 운영되지만, 운영 시간은 오전 7시~오후 1시로 단축됩니다. 월간 이용권 회원의 멤버십은 무료로 2주 연장됩니다. 휴장 기간에 예정된 수영 강습은 Fenwick 커뮤니티 수영장에서 진행되며, 강사가 참가자에게 세부 사항을 연락드릴 예정입니다.

questions.question: Why will the main pool be closed?

explanation.en: The pool will be closed "while its filtration system is replaced", which means new equipment is being installed.
explanation.ko: 본 수영장이 휴장하는 이유는 무엇입니까? 수영장은 "여과 시스템 교체 공사"로 휴장하며, 이는 새 장비를 설치한다는 뜻입니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about members with monthly passes?
options: They may use the Fenwick pool free of charge.
They will receive a partial refund.

explanation.en: Monthly pass holders "will have their memberships extended by two weeks at no cost".
explanation.ko: 월간 이용권 회원에 대해 언급된 것은 무엇입니까? 월간 이용권 회원은 "멤버십이 무료로 2주 연장"됩니다.

items.description:
Selin Arda (8:41 A.M.)
My train is stuck outside Halden Station. There's a signal problem.

Gareth Mwangi (8:42 A.M.)
The Brookfield people are due at 9:30. Should I push the meeting back?

Selin Arda (8:44 A.M.)
Let's not. They've rescheduled twice already. Can you open with the cost summary? It's on the shared drive.

Gareth Mwangi (8:45 A.M.)
Sure. Which version—the one from Tuesday?

Selin Arda (8:46 A.M.)
No, I updated it last night. It's labeled "final."

Gareth Mwangi (8:47 A.M.)
Got it. I'll take it from there.
items.descriptionKo: Selin Arda (오전 8:41) 제가 탄 열차가 Halden 역 밖에서 멈춰 있어요. 신호 문제가 있대요. Gareth Mwangi (오전 8:42) Brookfield 쪽 사람들이 9시 30분에 오기로 돼 있는데요. 회의를 미룰까요? Selin Arda (오전 8:44) 그러지 말죠. 벌써 두 번이나 일정을 바꿨거든요. 비용 요약으로 회의를 시작해 줄 수 있어요? 공유 드라이브에 있어요. Gareth Mwangi (오전 8:45) 그럴게요. 어느 버전이요? 화요일 거요? Selin Arda (오전 8:46) 아니요, 어젯밤에 업데이트했어요. "final"이라고 표시돼 있어요. Gareth Mwangi (오전 8:47) 알겠어요. 나머지는 제가 알아서 할게요.

questions.question: What problem does Ms. Arda mention?
options: She left a file at home.
A client has canceled a meeting.
She cannot access a shared drive.

explanation.en: Ms. Arda writes, "My train is stuck outside Halden Station. There's a signal problem."
explanation.ko: Arda 씨는 어떤 문제를 언급합니까? Arda 씨는 "제가 탄 열차가 Halden 역 밖에서 멈춰 있어요. 신호 문제가 있대요"라고 씁니다.

questions.question: At 8:47 A.M., what does Mr. Mwangi most likely mean when he writes, "I'll take it from there"?
options: He will lead the start of the meeting.
He will pick up Ms. Arda at the station.
He will revise the cost summary.
questions.correct: He will lead the start of the meeting.

explanation.en: Ms. Arda asked him to "open with the cost summary" instead of postponing. After finding the right file, he agrees to begin the meeting himself.
explanation.ko: 오전 8시 47분에 Mwangi 씨가 "I'll take it from there"라고 쓸 때 의도한 것은 무엇이겠습니까? Arda 씨는 회의를 미루지 말고 "비용 요약으로 회의를 시작해" 달라고 요청했습니다. 올바른 파일을 확인한 뒤 그는 직접 회의를 시작하겠다고 동의합니다.

items.description:
To: Engineering staff
From: Vivek Rao
Date: 10 September
Subject: Workspace survey

As many of you know, the third floor will be redesigned early next year. Before the architects finalize their plans, management would like your input. Please complete the short online survey linked below by 20 September. It asks about noise levels, lighting, and the number of meeting rooms you feel the floor needs.

The results will be shared at the all-hands meeting on 2 October, and a draft floor plan will be posted in the break room shortly afterward. Those who would like to discuss the plans in more depth are welcome to join a focus group. Space is limited to twelve people, so please sign up early with Ms. Ostrowski in Human Resources.

Vivek Rao
Facilities Manager
items.descriptionKo: 수신: 엔지니어링 직원 발신: Vivek Rao 날짜: 9월 10일 제목: 업무 공간 설문 조사 많은 분들이 아시다시피 3층이 내년 초에 새로 설계될 예정입니다. 건축가들이 계획을 확정하기 전에 경영진은 여러분의 의견을 듣고자 합니다. 아래 링크된 간단한 온라인 설문 조사를 9월 20일까지 작성해 주십시오. 설문은 소음 수준, 조명, 그리고 층에 필요하다고 생각하는 회의실 수에 대해 묻습니다. 결과는 10월 2일 전체 회의에서 공유되며, 그 직후 휴게실에 평면도 초안이 게시될 것입니다. 계획에 대해 더 깊이 논의하고 싶은 분은 포커스 그룹에 참여하실 수 있습니다. 인원이 12명으로 제한되어 있으니 인사부의 Ostrowski 씨에게 일찍 신청해 주십시오. Vivek Rao 시설 관리자

questions.question: What is the purpose of the e-mail?

explanation.en: Management "would like your input" and asks staff to complete a survey about the redesign.
explanation.ko: 이메일의 목적은 무엇입니까? 경영진은 "여러분의 의견을 듣고자" 하며, 직원들에게 재설계에 관한 설문 조사를 작성해 달라고 요청합니다.

questions.question: In paragraph 2, line 1, the word "shared" is closest in meaning to

explanation.en: The survey results "will be shared at the all-hands meeting", meaning they will be presented or made known to everyone.
explanation.ko: 두 번째 단락 1행의 단어 "shared"와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은? 설문 결과가 "전체 회의에서 공유된다(will be shared)"는 것은 모두에게 발표되거나 알려진다는 뜻입니다.

questions.question: How can employees join the focus group?
options: By contacting a human resources employee
questions.correct: By contacting a human resources employee

explanation.en: Employees should "sign up early with Ms. Ostrowski in Human Resources".
explanation.ko: 직원들은 어떻게 포커스 그룹에 참여할 수 있습니까? 직원들은 "인사부의 Ostrowski 씨에게 일찍 신청"해야 합니다.

items.description:
Careers at Tamsin Biologics

Position: Laboratory Logistics Coordinator (full-time)
Location: Greywell research campus

Tamsin Biologics is seeking a detail-oriented coordinator to manage the receipt, storage, and distribution of laboratory supplies. Responsibilities include tracking inventory, arranging temperature-controlled shipments, and serving as the main point of contact for vendors.

Requirements
• At least two years of experience in logistics or supply-chain management
• Familiarity with cold storage procedures
• A valid driver's license (occasional travel between campuses)

A background in the life sciences is an advantage but is not required. Benefits include a relocation allowance and tuition support for job-related courses. To apply, upload a résumé and cover letter at tamsinbio.com/careers by 31 May.
items.descriptionKo: Tamsin Biologics 채용 직책: 실험실 물류 코디네이터(정규직) 근무지: Greywell 연구 캠퍼스 Tamsin Biologics는 실험실 물품의 입고, 보관, 배분을 관리할 꼼꼼한 코디네이터를 찾고 있습니다. 업무에는 재고 추적, 온도 관리 배송 준비, 공급업체의 주요 연락 창구 역할이 포함됩니다. 자격 요건 • 물류 또는 공급망 관리 분야 경력 2년 이상 • 냉장 보관 절차에 대한 이해 • 유효한 운전면허(캠퍼스 간 수시 이동) 생명과학 관련 배경은 우대하지만 필수는 아닙니다. 복리후생으로 이전 지원금과 직무 관련 과정의 학비 지원이 제공됩니다. 지원하시려면 5월 31일까지 tamsinbio.com/careers에 이력서와 자기소개서를 업로드해 주십시오.

questions.question: What is one responsibility of the position?

explanation.en: The coordinator will be "arranging temperature-controlled shipments" of laboratory supplies.
explanation.ko: 이 직책의 업무 중 하나는 무엇입니까? 코디네이터는 실험실 물품의 "온도 관리 배송을 준비"하게 됩니다.

questions.question: What is NOT listed as a requirement for the position?
options: A degree in the life sciences
questions.correct: A degree in the life sciences

explanation.en: A life sciences background "is an advantage but is not required". The other three appear under "Requirements".
explanation.ko: 이 직책의 자격 요건으로 언급되지 않은 것은 무엇입니까? 생명과학 관련 배경은 "우대하지만 필수는 아닙니다". 나머지 세 가지는 "자격 요건"에 나와 있습니다.

questions.question: What is offered to the successful applicant?

explanation.en: Benefits include "a relocation allowance", which is money to help with moving.
explanation.ko: 합격자에게 무엇이 제공됩니까? 복리후생에는 이사를 돕기 위한 비용인 "이전 지원금"이 포함됩니다.

items.description:
Hollis Bay Bakery Wins Regional Award

HOLLIS BAY (22 November) — Hollis Bay Bakery has been named Best Independent Bakery by the Coastal Food Guild. — [1] —. Owner Teodora Lisac opened the shop eight years ago with a single oven and two employees. — [2] —. Today the bakery employs fourteen people and supplies bread to six local cafés.

Judges praised the bakery's sourdough, which is made with flour from a mill in the nearby Wrenfield Valley. — [3] —. Ms. Lisac said the award would help her pursue a long-held plan to offer baking classes. "Customers have been asking for them for years," she said. — [4] —. The first classes are expected to begin in the spring.
items.descriptionKo: Hollis Bay Bakery, 지역 상 수상 HOLLIS BAY (11월 22일) — Hollis Bay Bakery가 Coastal Food Guild로부터 최우수 독립 제과점으로 선정되었습니다. — [1] —. 소유주 Teodora Lisac은 8년 전 오븐 한 대와 직원 두 명으로 가게를 열었습니다. — [2] —. 현재 이 제과점은 14명을 고용하고 있으며 지역 카페 여섯 곳에 빵을 공급합니다. 심사위원들은 인근 Wrenfield Valley의 제분소에서 나온 밀가루로 만든 이 제과점의 사워도우를 높이 평가했습니다. — [3] —. Lisac 씨는 이번 수상이 오랫동안 계획해 온 제빵 강좌 개설을 추진하는 데 도움이 될 것이라고 말했습니다. "고객들이 몇 년째 강좌를 요청해 왔어요"라고 그녀는 말했습니다. — [4] —. 첫 강좌는 봄에 시작될 예정입니다.

questions.question: What is the article mainly about?
options: The opening of a new café

explanation.en: The article reports that Hollis Bay Bakery "has been named Best Independent Bakery" by a food guild.
explanation.ko: 기사는 주로 무엇에 관한 것입니까? 기사는 Hollis Bay Bakery가 한 식품 협회로부터 "최우수 독립 제과점으로 선정되었다"고 보도합니다.

questions.question: What does Ms. Lisac plan to do?

explanation.en: She plans "to offer baking classes", which customers have been asking for.
explanation.ko: Lisac 씨는 무엇을 할 계획입니까? 그녀는 고객들이 요청해 온 "제빵 강좌를 개설"할 계획입니다.

questions.question: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "The guild received more than 90 nominations this year."

explanation.en: The sentence gives information about the award competition, so it belongs directly after the sentence naming the guild and the award, in position [1].
explanation.ko: [1], [2], [3], [4]로 표시된 위치 중 다음 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은? "협회는 올해 90건이 넘는 후보 추천을 받았습니다." 이 문장은 시상 경쟁에 관한 정보를 제공하므로 협회와 상을 언급한 문장 바로 뒤인 [1]에 들어가야 합니다.

items.description:
Dear Mr. Okonjo,

Thank you for staying at the Marlow Grange Hotel during your recent visit to Edinburgh. We were sorry to read on your comment card that the air-conditioning unit in Room 412 was not working properly on the night of 14 July.

Our maintenance team has since inspected the unit and replaced a faulty part. As a gesture of apology, we have refunded the cost of one night to the credit card you used at check-in. Please allow five to seven business days for the amount to appear.

We would also like to offer you a complimentary room upgrade on your next stay. Simply mention code MG-412 when booking by telephone.

Sincerely,
Alistair Penrose
Guest Relations Manager
items.descriptionKo: Okonjo 님께, 최근 Edinburgh 방문 중 Marlow Grange Hotel에 머물러 주셔서 감사합니다. 7월 14일 밤 412호 객실의 에어컨이 제대로 작동하지 않았다는 고객 의견 카드를 읽고 매우 죄송스러웠습니다. 이후 저희 유지 보수팀이 해당 장치를 점검하고 결함이 있는 부품을 교체했습니다. 사과의 뜻으로 체크인 시 사용하신 신용카드로 1박 요금을 환불해 드렸습니다. 금액이 표시되기까지 영업일 기준 5~7일이 소요될 수 있습니다. 또한 다음 숙박 시 무료 객실 업그레이드를 제공해 드리고자 합니다. 전화로 예약하실 때 코드 MG-412를 말씀해 주시기만 하면 됩니다. Alistair Penrose 드림 고객 관리 매니저

questions.question: Why did Mr. Penrose write the letter?

explanation.en: He is replying to Mr. Okonjo's comment card, which reported that the air-conditioning "was not working properly".
explanation.ko: Penrose 씨가 편지를 쓴 이유는 무엇입니까? 그는 에어컨이 "제대로 작동하지 않았다"고 알린 Okonjo 씨의 고객 의견 카드에 답하고 있습니다.

questions.question: What has the hotel done?
options: Moved Mr. Okonjo to another room
Installed new air conditioners in every room

explanation.en: "We have refunded the cost of one night to the credit card you used at check-in."
explanation.ko: 호텔은 무엇을 했습니까? "체크인 시 사용하신 신용카드로 1박 요금을 환불해 드렸습니다."

questions.question: How can Mr. Okonjo receive an upgrade?
options: By booking through a Web site
By staying at least two nights
By showing the letter at check-in
By giving a code over the phone
questions.correct: By giving a code over the phone

explanation.en: He should "mention code MG-412 when booking by telephone".
explanation.ko: Okonjo 씨는 어떻게 업그레이드를 받을 수 있습니까? 그는 "전화로 예약하실 때 코드 MG-412를 말씀"해야 합니다.

items.description:
Notice to Residents of Calloway Court

The annual inspection of all fire alarms and sprinkler systems will take place on Thursday, 9 May, between 9:00 A.M. and 4:00 P.M. Inspectors will need to enter every apartment for approximately ten minutes. Residents do not need to be present, as building staff will accompany the inspectors at all times.

Please make sure that the area around each smoke detector is clear and that pets are secured. Alarms will sound intermittently throughout the day, so residents who work from home may wish to make other arrangements. Questions may be directed to the management office at extension 220.
items.descriptionKo: Calloway Court 입주민 안내 모든 화재경보기와 스프링클러 시스템에 대한 연례 점검이 5월 9일 목요일 오전 9시부터 오후 4시까지 실시됩니다. 점검원은 모든 세대에 약 10분간 들어가야 합니다. 건물 직원이 점검원과 항상 동행하므로 입주민은 자리에 계시지 않아도 됩니다. 각 연기 감지기 주변을 비워 두시고 반려동물을 안전하게 묶어 두거나 격리해 주십시오. 하루 종일 경보가 간헐적으로 울릴 예정이므로 재택근무하시는 분은 다른 방안을 마련하시는 것이 좋습니다. 문의 사항은 관리사무소 내선 220번으로 연락해 주십시오.

questions.question: What will happen on 9 May?
options: A fire drill will be held.

explanation.en: On 9 May there will be an "annual inspection of all fire alarms and sprinkler systems".
explanation.ko: 5월 9일에 무슨 일이 있겠습니까? 5월 9일에 "모든 화재경보기와 스프링클러 시스템에 대한 연례 점검"이 있습니다.

questions.question: What are residents asked to do?
options: Be at home during the inspection

explanation.en: Residents should make sure "that pets are secured". They "do not need to be present".
explanation.ko: 입주민들은 무엇을 하도록 요청받습니까? 입주민은 "반려동물을 안전하게 묶어 두거나 격리"해야 합니다. 그들은 "자리에 계시지 않아도 됩니다".

questions.question: The word "intermittently" in paragraph 2, line 2, is closest in meaning to

explanation.en: Alarms will sound at intervals during the inspections, not all the time. "Intermittently" means on and off.
explanation.ko: 두 번째 단락 2행의 단어 "intermittently"와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은? 경보는 계속이 아니라 점검 중 간격을 두고 울립니다. "Intermittently"는 "on and off(간간이)"라는 뜻입니다.

items.description:
Noor Haddad [1:12 P.M.]
Quick update: the Linwood Hotel just told me their ballroom is double-booked for the 18th.

Callum Price [1:13 P.M.]
That's our product launch! We've already printed the invitations.

Noor Haddad [1:14 P.M.]
They've offered us the Garden Pavilion at the same price. It holds 150, and we're expecting about 120.

Irene Vasquez-Lowe [1:15 P.M.]
Is it indoors? The forecast for that week isn't great.

Noor Haddad [1:16 P.M.]
It's a heated glass structure, so the weather won't be an issue.

Callum Price [1:17 P.M.]
And the invitations?

Mateo Fröhlich [1:18 P.M.]
They only list the hotel's name and address. The pavilion is on the same grounds.

Callum Price [1:19 P.M.]
Fair enough. Noor, can you confirm the pavilion today?

Noor Haddad [1:20 P.M.]
I'll call them right after this.
items.descriptionKo: Noor Haddad [오후 1:12] 간단히 알려 드려요. Linwood Hotel에서 방금 18일 연회장이 이중 예약됐다고 연락이 왔어요. Callum Price [오후 1:13] 그날 우리 제품 출시 행사잖아요! 초대장도 이미 인쇄했는데요. Noor Haddad [오후 1:14] 같은 가격에 Garden Pavilion을 제안했어요. 150명을 수용할 수 있고, 우리는 120명 정도 예상하고 있죠. Irene Vasquez-Lowe [오후 1:15] 실내인가요? 그 주 일기 예보가 별로 좋지 않던데요. Noor Haddad [오후 1:16] 난방이 되는 유리 건물이라 날씨는 문제없을 거예요. Callum Price [오후 1:17] 초대장은요? Mateo Fröhlich [오후 1:18] 초대장에는 호텔 이름과 주소만 나와 있어요. 파빌리온은 같은 부지 안에 있고요. Callum Price [오후 1:19] 그렇다면 괜찮네요. Noor, 오늘 파빌리온 확정해 줄 수 있어요? Noor Haddad [오후 1:20] 이거 끝나면 바로 전화할게요.

questions.question: What is the discussion mainly about?

explanation.en: The hotel ballroom is double-booked, and the group discusses moving the event to the Garden Pavilion.
explanation.ko: 논의는 주로 무엇에 관한 것입니까? 호텔 연회장이 이중 예약되어 일행은 행사를 Garden Pavilion으로 옮기는 것에 대해 논의합니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about the Garden Pavilion?
options: It costs more than the ballroom.
It is not suitable for cold weather.
It can accommodate the expected guests.
questions.correct: It can accommodate the expected guests.

explanation.en: The pavilion "holds 150", and the company is "expecting about 120" guests.
explanation.ko: Garden Pavilion에 대해 언급된 것은 무엇입니까? 파빌리온은 "150명을 수용"할 수 있고, 회사는 "120명 정도"의 손님을 예상하고 있습니다.

questions.question: At 1:19 P.M., what does Mr. Price most likely mean when he writes, "Fair enough"?
options: He thinks the price is reasonable.
He accepts that the invitations do not need to be reprinted.
He agrees that the weather will be a problem.
He wants more guests to be invited.
questions.correct: He accepts that the invitations do not need to be reprinted.

explanation.en: He had asked about the invitations, and Mr. Fröhlich explained that they show only the hotel's address, which is still correct. "Fair enough" shows that Mr. Price accepts this.
explanation.ko: 오후 1시 19분에 Price 씨가 "Fair enough"라고 쓸 때 의도한 것은 무엇이겠습니까? 그는 초대장에 대해 물었고, Fröhlich 씨는 초대장에 호텔 주소만 나와 있어 여전히 맞다고 설명했습니다. "Fair enough"는 Price 씨가 이를 받아들인다는 것을 보여 줍니다.

questions.question: What will Ms. Haddad most likely do next?

explanation.en: Asked to confirm the pavilion, she replies, "I'll call them right after this."
explanation.ko: Haddad 씨는 다음에 무엇을 하겠습니까? 파빌리온을 확정해 달라는 요청에 그녀는 "이거 끝나면 바로 전화할게요"라고 답합니다.

items.description:
Rail Line Extension Approved

BRENNARD (5 February) — The regional transit authority voted on Monday to extend the Silverline commuter rail service to the town of Ashcombe, ending more than a decade of debate. — [1] —. The 14-kilometer extension will add three stations and is expected to open in 2029.

Supporters argue that the project will ease traffic on Highway 9, where average commuting times have risen by 25 percent since 2018. — [2] —. Critics, however, have questioned the cost, which is estimated at $620 million. Roughly a third of that amount will be covered by a federal grant.

Transit authority chair Rosalind Achebe acknowledged the concerns. "This is a significant investment," she said. "But the alternative is to keep widening roads that fill up again within a few years." — [3] —.

Public meetings on the locations of the new stations will be held in March. — [4] —. Residents may also submit comments through the authority's Web site.
items.descriptionKo: 철도 노선 연장 승인 BRENNARD (2월 5일) — 지역 교통 당국은 월요일 Silverline 통근 철도 서비스를 Ashcombe 시까지 연장하기로 의결하여 10년 넘게 이어진 논쟁에 마침표를 찍었습니다. — [1] —. 14킬로미터 연장 구간에는 역 세 곳이 추가되며 2029년에 개통될 예정입니다. 지지자들은 이 사업이 2018년 이후 평균 통근 시간이 25퍼센트 늘어난 9번 고속도로의 교통 체증을 완화할 것이라고 주장합니다. — [2] —. 그러나 비판론자들은 6억 2천만 달러로 추산되는 비용에 의문을 제기해 왔습니다. 그 금액의 약 3분의 1은 연방 보조금으로 충당됩니다. 교통 당국 의장 Rosalind Achebe는 이러한 우려를 인정했습니다. "이것은 상당한 투자입니다"라고 그녀는 말했습니다. "하지만 대안은 몇 년 안에 다시 막히는 도로를 계속 넓히는 것뿐입니다." — [3] —. 새 역의 위치에 관한 공청회가 3월에 열릴 예정입니다. — [4] —. 주민들은 당국 웹사이트를 통해서도 의견을 제출할 수 있습니다.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the article?

explanation.en: The article reports that the transit authority "voted on Monday to extend the Silverline commuter rail service".
explanation.ko: 기사의 목적은 무엇입니까? 기사는 교통 당국이 "월요일 Silverline 통근 철도 서비스를 연장하기로 의결했다"고 보도합니다.

questions.question: According to the article, what has happened on Highway 9?
options: It has been closed for repairs.
Travel times on it have increased.
A new station has been built near it.
questions.correct: Travel times on it have increased.

explanation.en: "Average commuting times have risen by 25 percent since 2018."
explanation.ko: 기사에 따르면 9번 고속도로에 무슨 일이 있었습니까? "2018년 이후 평균 통근 시간이 25퍼센트 늘어났습니다."

questions.question: What is suggested about the project's funding?
options: Most of it will come from a federal source.
It will be raised through higher fares.
Part of it will be paid for by the national government.
questions.correct: Part of it will be paid for by the national government.

explanation.en: "Roughly a third of that amount will be covered by a federal grant", so the national government will pay part of the cost, but not most of it.
explanation.ko: 사업 자금에 대해 암시된 것은 무엇입니까? "그 금액의 약 3분의 1은 연방 보조금으로 충당됩니다"라고 했으므로 중앙 정부가 비용의 일부를 부담하지만 대부분은 아닙니다.

questions.question: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "The first of these will take place at Ashcombe Town Hall on 12 March."

explanation.en: "The first of these" refers to "public meetings ... in March", so the sentence belongs right after that sentence, in position [4].
explanation.ko: [1], [2], [3], [4]로 표시된 위치 중 다음 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은? "그중 첫 번째 공청회는 3월 12일 Ashcombe 시청에서 열립니다." "The first of these"는 "3월에 열리는 공청회"를 가리키므로 이 문장은 그 문장 바로 뒤인 [4]에 들어가야 합니다.

1:00 P.M. | Workshop: Visual Merchandising on a Budget | Ines Carvalho, Shopfront Studio

All sessions take place in Hall C except the workshop, which is held in Room 5 and is limited to 40 participants. Advance registration for the workshop is required.
To: Lena Fischbach <lfischbach@northbridgesummit.org>
From: Ravi Menon <rmenon@cartwell.com>
Date: 8 October
Subject: Day 2 timing

Dear Ms. Fischbach,

I have just learned that I must attend a board meeting in Glasgow on the evening of 17 October, and the last train that will get me there on time leaves at 2:45 P.M. Would it be possible to move my talk to earlier in the day? I noticed that the presenter in the 1:00 P.M. slot is a former colleague of mine. I would be glad to ask her whether she would trade slots with me, although I realize that the difference in rooms may complicate things.

I will, of course, still attend Wednesday's networking dinner as planned.

Best regards,
Ravi Menon

Ravi Menon 드림

options: It has a limited number of places.
It will be held in Hall C.
It is led by Mr. Renner.
questions.correct: It has a limited number of places.

explanation.en: The workshop "is limited to 40 participants" and requires advance registration.
explanation.ko: 워크숍에 대해 언급된 것은 무엇입니까? 워크숍은 "참가 인원이 40명으로 제한"되며 사전 등록이 필요합니다.

questions.question: Why did Mr. Menon write the e-mail?

explanation.en: He asks, "Would it be possible to move my talk to earlier in the day?"
explanation.ko: Menon 씨가 이메일을 쓴 이유는 무엇입니까? 그는 "제 강연을 더 이른 시간으로 옮길 수 있을까요?"라고 묻습니다.

questions.question: Who is Mr. Menon's former colleague?

explanation.en: The e-mail says his former colleague presents in the 1:00 P.M. slot. The schedule shows that Ines Carvalho leads the 1:00 P.M. workshop.
explanation.ko: Menon 씨의 예전 동료는 누구입니까? 이메일에 따르면 그의 예전 동료는 오후 1시에 발표합니다. 일정표를 보면 Ines Carvalho가 오후 1시 워크숍을 진행합니다.

questions.question: What will Mr. Menon most likely do on 16 October?

explanation.en: Day 2 of the summit is Thursday, 17 October, so the day before is Wednesday, 16 October. Mr. Menon writes that he "will still attend Wednesday's networking dinner".
explanation.ko: Menon 씨는 10월 16일에 무엇을 하겠습니까? 서밋 2일 차는 10월 17일 목요일이므로 그 전날은 10월 16일 수요일입니다. Menon 씨는 "수요일 네트워킹 만찬에는 참석하겠다"고 씁니다.

items.description:
Lexiwell Translation Services

Professional translation for businesses in more than 30 languages.

Standard – $0.12 per word. Delivery within 5 business days.
Priority – $0.18 per word. Delivery within 2 business days.
Certified – $0.22 per word. Delivery within 5 business days. Includes an official stamp accepted by courts and government offices.

Every document is reviewed by a second linguist before delivery. First-time clients receive 10 percent off their first order. Delivery within 24 hours is available for documents under 2,000 words at double the Standard rate.
To: orders@lexiwell.com
From: Haruto Nishimura <hnishimura@tamarindmotors.jp>
Date: 3 March
Subject: Order LX-2290

Hello,

I received the Spanish translation of our dealer agreement this morning, two business days after placing the order, exactly as promised. Our legal team in Madrid was very pleased with the quality.

However, I noticed that the invoice did not include the discount mentioned on your Web site, even though this was the first time our company had used your services. Could you please issue a corrected invoice?

We expect to send you three more contracts next month. One of them will need to be submitted to a government agency in Spain.

Regards,
Haruto Nishimura
Tamarind Motors
items.descriptionKo: Lexiwell 번역 서비스 30개 이상 언어로 기업을 위한 전문 번역을 제공합니다. Standard – 단어당 $0.12. 영업일 기준 5일 이내 납품. Priority – 단어당 $0.18. 영업일 기준 2일 이내 납품. Certified – 단어당 $0.22. 영업일 기준 5일 이내 납품. 법원과 관공서에서 인정하는 공식 인증 도장 포함. 모든 문서는 납품 전에 두 번째 언어 전문가가 검토합니다. 첫 이용 고객은 첫 주문 시 10퍼센트 할인을 받습니다. 2,000단어 미만 문서는 Standard 요금의 두 배로 24시간 이내 납품이 가능합니다.수신: orders@lexiwell.com 발신: Haruto Nishimura <hnishimura@tamarindmotors.jp> 날짜: 3월 3일 제목: 주문 LX-2290 안녕하세요, 오늘 아침 저희 딜러 계약서의 스페인어 번역본을 받았습니다. 약속하신 대로 정확히 주문 후 영업일 기준 2일 만이었습니다. Madrid에 있는 저희 법무팀도 품질에 매우 만족했습니다. 그런데 저희 회사가 귀사의 서비스를 처음 이용했는데도 청구서에 웹사이트에 안내된 할인이 반영되지 않은 것을 발견했습니다. 수정된 청구서를 발행해 주시겠습니까? 다음 달에 계약서 세 건을 더 보낼 예정입니다. 그중 한 건은 스페인 정부 기관에 제출해야 합니다. Haruto Nishimura 드림 Tamarind Motors

questions.question: What is stated about all of Lexiwell's translations?
options: They are checked by a second translator.
They are delivered within two days.
They cost the same per word.
questions.correct: They are checked by a second translator.

explanation.en: "Every document is reviewed by a second linguist before delivery."
explanation.ko: Lexiwell의 모든 번역에 대해 명시된 것은 무엇입니까? "모든 문서는 납품 전에 두 번째 언어 전문가가 검토합니다."

questions.question: Which service did Mr. Nishimura most likely use?

explanation.en: He received the translation "two business days after placing the order, exactly as promised". The advertisement shows that the Priority service offers "Delivery within 2 business days".
explanation.ko: Nishimura 씨는 어떤 서비스를 이용했겠습니까? 그는 "약속하신 대로 정확히 주문 후 영업일 기준 2일 만에" 번역본을 받았습니다. 광고에 따르면 Priority 서비스가 "영업일 기준 2일 이내 납품"을 제공합니다.

questions.question: What problem does Mr. Nishimura mention?
options: A price reduction was not applied.
An invoice was sent to the wrong office.
questions.correct: A price reduction was not applied.

explanation.en: The invoice "did not include the discount mentioned on your Web site".
explanation.ko: Nishimura 씨는 어떤 문제를 언급합니까? 청구서에 "웹사이트에 안내된 할인이 반영되지 않았습니다".

questions.question: What is indicated about Tamarind Motors?
options: It recently opened a dealership in Japan.
It plans to hire its own translators.
It has used Lexiwell's services before.

explanation.en: Mr. Nishimura mentions "our legal team in Madrid". It was the company's first order with Lexiwell, so (D) is wrong.
explanation.ko: Tamarind Motors에 대해 언급된 것은 무엇입니까? Nishimura 씨는 "Madrid에 있는 저희 법무팀"을 언급합니다. 이번이 회사의 첫 Lexiwell 주문이었으므로 (D)는 틀립니다.

questions.question: Which service will Mr. Nishimura most likely need for one of next month's contracts?

explanation.en: One contract "will need to be submitted to a government agency". The advertisement says that only the Certified service includes "an official stamp accepted by courts and government offices".
explanation.ko: Nishimura 씨는 다음 달 계약서 중 한 건에 어떤 서비스가 필요하겠습니까? 계약서 한 건은 "정부 기관에 제출해야" 합니다. 광고에 따르면 "법원과 관공서에서 인정하는 공식 인증 도장"이 포함된 것은 Certified 서비스뿐입니다.

items.description:
Fernhill Library
Meeting Room Policy

• The Oak Room (capacity 12) and the Cedar Room (capacity 40) may be reserved free of charge by nonprofit community groups.
• Commercial organizations may reserve the Cedar Room only, at a rate of $35 per hour.
• Reservations must be made at least seven days in advance.
• A projector is available in the Cedar Room only.
• Food is not permitted in either room; drinks in covered containers are allowed.
Meeting Room Request
Organization: Westbrook Writers' Circle (nonprofit)
Contact: Odile Marchetti
Room requested: Oak Room
Date: Saturday, 14 June | Time: 10:00 A.M.–12:00 P.M.
Expected attendance: 25
Equipment needed: projector
Date submitted: 10 June
To: Odile Marchetti
From: Bernard Achterberg, Fernhill Library
Date: 11 June
Subject: Your room request

Dear Ms. Marchetti,

Thank you for your request. Unfortunately, we cannot accept it as submitted, for two reasons. First, the room you selected is too small for your group. Second, requests must be received further in advance than yours was.

The larger room is available on Saturday, 21 June, at the same time, and I have placed a temporary hold on it for you. It also has the equipment you asked for. Please confirm by 13 June, or the hold will be released.

Best wishes,
Bernard Achterberg
items.descriptionKo: Fernhill 도서관 회의실 이용 규정 • Oak Room(수용 인원 12명)과 Cedar Room(수용 인원 40명)은 비영리 지역 단체가 무료로 예약할 수 있습니다. • 영리 단체는 Cedar Room만 시간당 $35에 예약할 수 있습니다. • 예약은 최소 7일 전에 해야 합니다. • 프로젝터는 Cedar Room에서만 이용할 수 있습니다. • 두 회의실 모두 음식 반입은 금지되며, 뚜껑이 있는 용기에 담긴 음료는 허용됩니다.회의실 신청서 단체: Westbrook Writers' Circle(비영리) 담당자: Odile Marchetti 신청 회의실: Oak Room 날짜: 6월 14일 토요일 | 시간: 오전 10:00–오후 12:00 예상 참석 인원: 25명 필요 장비: 프로젝터 제출일: 6월 10일수신: Odile Marchetti 발신: Bernard Achterberg, Fernhill 도서관 날짜: 6월 11일 제목: 회의실 신청 건 Marchetti 님께, 신청해 주셔서 감사합니다. 안타깝게도 두 가지 이유로 제출하신 신청을 그대로 받아들일 수 없습니다. 첫째, 선택하신 회의실은 귀 단체에 비해 너무 작습니다. 둘째, 신청서는 귀하의 신청보다 더 일찍 접수되어야 합니다. 더 큰 회의실은 6월 21일 토요일 같은 시간에 이용 가능하며, 귀하를 위해 임시로 예약을 잡아 두었습니다. 이 회의실에는 요청하신 장비도 있습니다. 6월 13일까지 확정해 주시지 않으면 임시 예약은 취소됩니다. Bernard Achterberg 드림

questions.question: What is indicated about the Cedar Room?
options: It is reserved for commercial use.
It can hold more people than the Oak Room.
Food may be served in it.
It is free for all organizations.
questions.correct: It can hold more people than the Oak Room.

explanation.en: The Cedar Room has a capacity of 40, while the Oak Room holds 12.
explanation.ko: Cedar Room에 대해 언급된 것은 무엇입니까? Cedar Room의 수용 인원은 40명이고, Oak Room은 12명입니다.

questions.question: What is true about the Westbrook Writers' Circle?
options: It must bring its own projector.
It will not be charged for using a room.
questions.correct: It will not be charged for using a room.

explanation.en: The form shows that the group is a nonprofit, and the policy says rooms "may be reserved free of charge by nonprofit community groups".
explanation.ko: Westbrook Writers' Circle에 대해 사실인 것은 무엇입니까? 신청서에 이 단체가 비영리 단체로 나와 있으며, 규정에 따르면 회의실은 "비영리 지역 단체가 무료로 예약할 수 있습니다".

questions.question: Why was Ms. Marchetti's request rejected?
options: She did not give enough notice.
She asked for a room that is closed.
Her group planned to serve food.
Her group is not a nonprofit.
questions.correct: She did not give enough notice.

explanation.en: She submitted the form on 10 June for a meeting on 14 June, but the policy requires reservations "at least seven days in advance". Mr. Achterberg confirms that requests "must be received further in advance".
explanation.ko: Marchetti 씨의 신청이 거절된 이유는 무엇입니까? 그녀는 6월 14일 모임을 위해 6월 10일에 신청서를 제출했지만, 규정은 "최소 7일 전" 예약을 요구합니다. Achterberg 씨도 신청서가 "더 일찍 접수되어야 한다"고 확인합니다.

questions.question: Which room has been held for Ms. Marchetti?
options: A room at a community center

explanation.en: Mr. Achterberg has held "the larger room", which has a projector. According to the policy, that is the Cedar Room.
explanation.ko: Marchetti 씨를 위해 어떤 회의실이 임시 예약되었습니까? Achterberg 씨는 프로젝터가 있는 "더 큰 회의실"을 잡아 두었습니다. 규정에 따르면 그것은 Cedar Room입니다.

questions.question: What is Ms. Marchetti asked to do by 13 June?
options: Reduce the size of her group

explanation.en: "Please confirm by 13 June, or the hold will be released."
explanation.ko: Marchetti 씨는 6월 13일까지 무엇을 하도록 요청받습니까? "6월 13일까지 확정해 주시지 않으면 임시 예약은 취소됩니다."

items.description:
MEMO
To: Sales staff
From: Corinne Valdés, Finance
Date: 1 August
Re: Revised travel allowances

Effective 1 September, the following daily limits will apply to domestic business travel:
• Hotel: $180 per night ($220 in Toronto and Vancouver)
• Meals: $65 per day
• Ground transportation: actual cost; receipts required for amounts over $25

Employees who expect to exceed these limits must obtain written approval from their regional manager before departure.
Itinerary — Jun-seo Park
Trip: Client visits, 9–11 September
9 September: Flight AC 418, Halifax → Toronto, arrives 11:40 A.M.
Hotel: Bayview Suites, Toronto, 2 nights, $205 per night
11 September: Flight AC 425, Toronto → Halifax, departs 6:15 P.M.
To: Corinne Valdés
From: Jun-seo Park
Date: 13 September
Subject: Expense report

Hi Corinne,

I've submitted my report for last week's trip. You'll notice that the meal total for 10 September is $82. I took two clients from Marston Packaging to dinner that evening, and my regional manager, Ms. Feld, approved this in writing on 5 September. Her e-mail is attached, along with my taxi receipts.

Thanks,
Jun-seo
items.descriptionKo: 회람 수신: 영업 직원 발신: Corinne Valdés, 재무팀 날짜: 8월 1일 제목: 출장 경비 한도 개정 9월 1일부터 국내 출장에 다음 일일 한도가 적용됩니다. • 숙박: 1박당 $180(Toronto와 Vancouver는 $220) • 식비: 1일 $65 • 현지 교통비: 실비; $25 초과 금액은 영수증 필요 이 한도를 초과할 것으로 예상되는 직원은 출발 전에 지역 관리자의 서면 승인을 받아야 합니다.여행 일정 — Jun-seo Park 출장: 고객 방문, 9월 9~11일 9월 9일: AC 418편, Halifax → Toronto, 오전 11:40 도착 숙박: Bayview Suites, Toronto, 2박, 1박당 $205 9월 11일: AC 425편, Toronto → Halifax, 오후 6:15 출발수신: Corinne Valdés 발신: Jun-seo Park 날짜: 9월 13일 제목: 경비 보고서 안녕하세요 Corinne, 지난주 출장 보고서를 제출했습니다. 9월 10일 식비 합계가 $82인 것을 보실 텐데요. 그날 저녁 Marston Packaging의 고객 두 분과 저녁 식사를 했고, 제 지역 관리자인 Feld 씨가 9월 5일에 서면으로 승인해 주셨습니다. 그분의 이메일과 택시 영수증을 첨부합니다. 감사합니다. Jun-seo

questions.question: What is the purpose of the memo?

explanation.en: The memo lists "Revised travel allowances" that take effect on 1 September.
explanation.ko: 회람의 목적은 무엇입니까? 회람은 9월 1일부터 시행되는 "출장 경비 한도 개정" 내용을 나열합니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about Mr. Park's hotel?
options: It was within the allowed rate.
It was booked by a client.
It was located near the airport.
questions.correct: It was within the allowed rate.

explanation.en: The hotel cost $205 per night in Toronto. The memo allows "$220 in Toronto and Vancouver", so the rate was within the limit.
explanation.ko: Park 씨의 호텔에 대해 언급된 것은 무엇입니까? Toronto 호텔 요금은 1박당 $205였습니다. 회람은 "Toronto와 Vancouver는 $220"까지 허용하므로 요금은 한도 이내였습니다.

questions.question: Why does Mr. Park mention Ms. Feld?
options: She traveled with him to Toronto.
She authorized an expense in advance.
questions.correct: She authorized an expense in advance.

explanation.en: Ms. Feld "approved this in writing on 5 September", before the trip began, as the memo requires.
explanation.ko: Park 씨가 Feld 씨를 언급한 이유는 무엇입니까? Feld 씨는 회람의 요구대로 출장 시작 전인 "9월 5일에 서면으로 승인"했습니다.

questions.question: By how much did Mr. Park's meal costs on 10 September exceed the limit?

explanation.en: The memo sets a meal limit of $65 per day, and Mr. Park's meal total for 10 September was $82: $82 − $65 = $17.
explanation.ko: 9월 10일 Park 씨의 식비는 한도를 얼마나 초과했습니까? 회람의 식비 한도는 1일 $65이고, 9월 10일 Park 씨의 식비 합계는 $82였습니다: $82 − $65 = $17.

questions.question: Where was Mr. Park on 10 September?

explanation.en: The itinerary shows that he flew to Toronto on 9 September, stayed two nights, and returned to Halifax on 11 September.
explanation.ko: 9월 10일에 Park 씨는 어디에 있었습니까? 여행 일정에 따르면 그는 9월 9일 Toronto로 가서 2박을 묵고 9월 11일 Halifax로 돌아왔습니다.

items.description:
Rivermark Harvest Market
Vendor Information

The Rivermark Harvest Market runs every Saturday from 7 September to 26 October in Linden Square.

Booth fees
• Full season (all 8 Saturdays): $320
• Half season (any 4 Saturdays): $180
• Single day: $50

Vendors selling prepared food must hold a valid county food-handling permit. Electricity is available at a limited number of booths for an additional $10 per day and is assigned in the order in which applications are received.
Vendor Application
Business name: Copperleaf Preserves
Owner: Maeve Doherty
Products: jams, chutneys, and pickled vegetables (in sealed jars)
Booth option: 14 September, 28 September, 12 October, 26 October
Electricity needed: No
Date submitted: 15 August
To: Maeve Doherty
From: Kwame Larsson
Date: 20 August
Subject: Your application

Dear Ms. Doherty,

Thank you for applying to this year's market. I am pleased to tell you that your application has been approved. Because your products are sold in sealed jars, you do not need the permit that is required of some vendors.

Please note one change: the market will not take place on 12 October, as Linden Square has been reserved for a city event that day. You may choose another Saturday to replace it at no extra cost, or you may receive a refund for that date. Please let me know your preference by 1 September.

Kind regards,

items.descriptionKo: Rivermark 수확 장터 판매자 안내 Rivermark 수확 장터는 9월 7일부터 10월 26일까지 매주 토요일 Linden Square에서 열립니다. 부스 이용료 • 전체 시즌(토요일 8회 모두): $320 • 하프 시즌(원하는 토요일 4회): $180 • 1일: $50 조리 식품을 판매하는 판매자는 유효한 카운티 식품 취급 허가증을 소지해야 합니다. 전기는 일부 부스에서만 1일 $10의 추가 요금으로 이용할 수 있으며, 신청서 접수 순서대로 배정됩니다.판매자 신청서 상호: Copperleaf Preserves 소유주: Maeve Doherty 상품: 잼, 처트니, 채소 피클(밀봉 병 포장) 부스 선택: 9월 14일, 9월 28일, 10월 12일, 10월 26일 전기 필요 여부: 아니요 제출일: 8월 15일수신: Maeve Doherty 발신: Kwame Larsson 날짜: 8월 20일 제목: 신청 건 Doherty 님께, 올해 장터에 신청해 주셔서 감사합니다. 신청이 승인되었음을 알려 드리게 되어 기쁩니다. 귀하의 상품은 밀봉된 병에 담겨 판매되므로 일부 판매자에게 요구되는 허가증은 필요하지 않습니다. 한 가지 변경 사항에 유의해 주십시오. 10월 12일에는 Linden Square가 시 행사용으로 예약되어 장터가 열리지 않습니다. 추가 비용 없이 다른 토요일로 대체하시거나 해당 날짜에 대한 환불을 받으실 수 있습니다. 9월 1일까지 원하시는 방법을 알려 주십시오. explanation.en: Reflexive pronouns (herself, himself, themselves) are used when the subject and object of the verb are the same person — "Emily introduced herself" means Emily is both the introducer and the one introduced.
explanation.ko: 재귀대명사(herself, himself, themselves)는 동사의 주어와 목적어가 같은 사람일 때 사용됩니다 — "Emily introduced herself"는 Emily가 소개하는 사람이자 소개받는 사람임을 뜻합니다.

questions.question: ------ to the e-mail from the supervisor as soon as possible and ask questions if anything is unclear.

explanation.en: In an imperative sentence giving instructions, keep parallel structure: "Respond... and ask..." uses two base-form verbs joined by "and" — whatever fills the blank must match that same verb form.
explanation.ko: 지시사항을 전달하는 명령문에서는 병렬 구조를 유지해야 합니다: "Respond... and ask..."는 "and"로 연결된 두 개의 동사 원형을 사용합니다 — 빈칸에 들어갈 말도 같은 동사 형태여야 합니다.

questions.question: The ------ of the retreat was to allow all of the employees to bond with one another.

explanation.en: When options are near-synonyms (purpose, measure, convention, scheme), check the word's typical collocation and connotation — "scheme" often implies a dishonest plan, while "measure" is neutral for an action taken to achieve a goal.
explanation.ko: 선택지가 유의어(purpose, measure, convention, scheme)일 때는 단어의 일반적인 연어와 뉘앙스를 확인하세요 — "scheme"은 종종 부정직한 계획을 암시하는 반면, "measure"는 목표 달성을 위한 조치를 가리키는 중립적인 단어입니다.

questions.question: The wildlife preserve was created by the Florida Nature Commission to ------ the state's endangered species.

explanation.en: The passive pattern "was created by ... to V" needs the bare infinitive after "to" expressing purpose — ask "created in order to do what?" to find the right verb form.
explanation.ko: 수동태 패턴 "was created by ... to V"는 목적을 나타내기 위해 "to" 뒤에 원형부정사가 필요합니다 — "무엇을 하기 위해 만들어졌는가?"라고 자문해 올바른 동사 형태를 찾으세요.

questions.question: Staff members with ------ engagements need not feel obliged to attend next week's field trip.

explanation.en: Adjectives with similar spelling (prior, timely, late, old) have very different meanings — "prior" means "before", so check whether the sentence needs a time-order word or a quality word.
explanation.ko: 철자가 비슷한 형용사(prior, timely, late, old)는 의미가 매우 다릅니다 — "prior"는 "이전의"라는 뜻이므로, 문장이 시간 순서를 나타내는 단어를 필요로 하는지 성질을 나타내는 단어를 필요로 하는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: The building's new tenants ------ in the next couple of days, so the staffs is getting everything ready.

explanation.en: A time phrase like "in the next couple of days" signals a planned future action, which in TOEIC grammar is often expressed with present continuous (is/am/are + V-ing), not simple present.
explanation.ko: "in the next couple of days"와 같은 시간 표현은 계획된 미래 행동을 나타내며, TOEIC 문법에서는 흔히 현재진행형(is/am/are + V-ing)으로 표현하지 단순현재로 표현하지 않습니다.

questions.question: The banquet hall was ------ decorated for the fund-raising gala on June 11.

explanation.en: Adverbs modify verbs and usually sit right before the main verb in a passive sentence: "was + ADV + decorated" — make sure the blank takes an adverb, not an adjective or noun.
explanation.ko: 부사는 동사를 수식하며 수동태 문장에서 보통 본동사 바로 앞에 옵니다: "was + ADV + decorated" — 빈칸이 형용사나 명사가 아니라 부사를 필요로 하는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: The Whitby Town Council recently prepared a brochure recommending ways that residents can play an ------ role in the community.

explanation.en: When a blank sits between an article and a noun ("an ___ role"), it needs an adjective to modify that noun — check the surrounding words' part of speech before picking a word that merely "sounds right".
explanation.ko: 빈칸이 관사와 명사 사이에 있을 때("an ___ role")는 그 명사를 수식할 형용사가 필요합니다 — 그저 "어울려 보이는" 단어를 고르기 전에 주변 단어의 품사를 확인하세요.

questions.question: Ms. Johnson ------ a feasible solution to the customer's network problem.

explanation.en: Phrasal verbs (come up with, drop by, look in on, run out of) each carry a distinct fixed meaning — memorize them as whole units rather than translating word by word.
explanation.ko: 구동사(come up with, drop by, look in on, run out of)는 각각 고유한 고정된 의미를 가지고 있습니다 — 단어별로 번역하지 말고 통째로 외우세요.

questions.question: The human resources department is ------ pressure to find a replacement for the senior accountant.

explanation.en: Idioms like "under pressure" must be learned as a fixed phrase — swapping the preposition ("in pressure", "on pressure") is a common trap for non-native speakers.
explanation.ko: "under pressure" 같은 관용구는 고정된 표현으로 익혀야 합니다 — 전치사를 바꾸는 것("in pressure", "on pressure")은 비원어민이 흔히 빠지는 함정입니다.

questions.question: BelTrax has ------ reanked as one of the top providers of marketing research since its foundation seven years ago.

explanation.en: Adverbs ending in -ly can look interchangeable but differ sharply in meaning (consistently = unchanging, conveniently = suitable, temporarily = short-lived) — always check what idea the sentence needs, not just the part of speech.
explanation.ko: -ly로 끝나는 부사들은 서로 바꿔 쓸 수 있어 보이지만 의미가 크게 다릅니다(consistently = 변함없이, conveniently = 편리하게, temporarily = 일시적으로) — 품사만이 아니라 문장이 필요로 하는 의미를 항상 확인하세요.

questions.question: Mansfield Chemical built an extension that ------ additional space for the newly purchased machinery.

explanation.en: In "built an extension that ___", the relative clause describes a completed past event, so the verb should be in past simple (V2) to match the tense of "built".
explanation.ko: "built an extension that ___"에서 관계절은 완료된 과거 사건을 나타내므로, "built"의 시제와 맞추기 위해 동사는 과거형(V2)이어야 합니다.

questions.question: As the argument raised at the last meeting was on a ------ point, it did not affect the proposal's overall plan.

explanation.en: "Minor" (small in importance) is easy to confuse with "critical" (very important) — read the full sentence for a contrast clue (e.g. "despite being only a ___ issue") before choosing.
explanation.ko: "Minor"(중요도가 낮은)는 "critical"(매우 중요한)과 혼동하기 쉽습니다 — 선택하기 전에 대조 단서(예: "despite being only a ___ issue")를 찾아 문장 전체를 읽으세요.

questions.question: ------ who still wish to submit applications after the deadline must pay a $45 late fee in order to be considered.

explanation.en: Subject-verb agreement depends on whether the subject is singular or plural: "those" takes a plural verb while "anyone" always takes a singular verb, even though both can refer to people.
explanation.ko: 주어-동사 일치는 주어가 단수인지 복수인지에 따라 달라집니다: "those"는 복수 동사를 취하지만 "anyone"은 항상 단수 동사를 취합니다. 둘 다 사람을 가리킬 수 있어도 마찬가지입니다.

questions.question: Everyone at Hammond Construction, Inc. was surprised to find out that the year's greatest cost saving measure was ------ by an intern.

explanation.en: Verbs like suggest, attract, reserve, and continue take different structures after them — check whether the sentence needs a verb followed by a noun, an -ing form, or a that-clause.
explanation.ko: suggest, attract, reserve, continue와 같은 동사는 뒤에 서로 다른 구조를 취합니다 — 문장이 명사, -ing형, 혹은 that절이 뒤따르는 동사를 필요로 하는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: Upon his retirement, Mr. Ross was highly commended for his vital contributions during the company's ------ years.

explanation.en: "Formative" (relating to early development) is a low-frequency word worth memorizing in context — "the company's formative years" means the period when it was just starting out.
explanation.ko: "Formative"(초기 발전과 관련된)는 자주 쓰이지 않지만 문맥과 함께 외워둘 가치가 있는 단어입니다 — "the company's formative years"는 회사가 막 시작하던 시기를 의미합니다.

questions.question: Ms. Waddill provided a few members of her department with an ------ covering the key points of the CEO's speech.

explanation.en: Nouns with related meanings (overview, objection, expansion, experience) are distinguished by context clues — an "overview" gives general information without details, so look for a word signaling a summary.
explanation.ko: 의미가 관련된 명사(overview, objection, expansion, experience)는 문맥 단서로 구별됩니다 — "overview"는 세부사항 없이 일반적인 정보를 제공한다는 뜻이므로, 요약을 암시하는 단어를 찾으세요.

questions.question: The doubts among investors ------ the company's ability to expand in the coming year led to a steep decline in the stock's price.

explanation.en: "Regarding" (about/concerning) is a common formal preposition in business email openers — practice recognizing prepositions that introduce a topic versus those that show position (behind, across).
explanation.ko: "Regarding"(~에 관하여)는 업무 이메일 도입부에서 흔히 쓰이는 격식 있는 전치사입니다 — 주제를 소개하는 전치사와 위치를 나타내는 전치사(behind, across)를 구별하는 연습을 하세요.

questions.question: ------ at the Latipa Film Festival increased be nearly 30 percent this year thanks to an online marketing campaign.

explanation.en: Related noun forms sharing a root (attendance, attend, attendee, attendant) each have a distinct grammatical role — "attendance" is uncountable and refers to the overall turnout, not an individual person.
explanation.ko: 같은 어근을 공유하는 명사(attendance, attend, attendee, attendant)는 각각 고유한 문법적 역할을 가집니다 — "attendance"는 불가산명사로 개별 사람이 아니라 전체 참석자 수를 가리킵니다.

questions.question: During the summer, rooms at the Marigold Hotel are always fully booked ------ the large size of the facility.

explanation.en: Linking words like notwithstanding/despite (+ noun or V-ing) and even though/although (+ clause) require different grammar after them — check whether what follows the blank is a noun phrase or a full clause.
explanation.ko: notwithstanding/despite(+ 명사 또는 V-ing)와 even though/although(+ 절) 같은 연결어는 뒤에 서로 다른 문법 구조가 필요합니다 — 빈칸 뒤에 오는 것이 명사구인지 완전한 절인지 확인하세요.

questions.question: All employees need a written ------ from the manager to access the office during off-hours.

explanation.en: The same word can be a noun or a verb with a different meaning: "permit" as a verb means "to allow", but as a noun it means "an official document" — check the article "a" before the blank as a clue it's a noun.
explanation.ko: 같은 단어가 명사와 동사로 쓰이며 뜻이 다를 수 있습니다: "permit"은 동사로는 "허가하다"라는 뜻이지만, 명사로는 "공식 문서(허가증)"라는 뜻입니다 — 빈칸 앞의 관사 "a"는 그것이 명사임을 암시하는 단서입니다.

questions.question: Since the trainees were having difficulty following the instruction manual, the trainer decided to create a ------ version.

explanation.en: Words that look alike (simplified, similar, controversial, contradictory) can trip you up — "simplified" means made easier to understand, while "contradictory" means conflicting with something else.
explanation.ko: 비슷하게 생긴 단어들(simplified, similar, controversial, contradictory)은 혼동을 일으킬 수 있습니다 — "simplified"는 이해하기 쉽게 만들었다는 뜻이고, "contradictory"는 다른 것과 상충한다는 뜻입니다.

questions.question: HGS Company was awarded the construction contract as it had a ------ bid than any of the other competing firms.

explanation.en: Comparative structures follow the pattern ADJ/ADV + -er + than — whenever you see "than" later in the sentence, that's the signal the blank needs a comparative form.
explanation.ko: 비교 구조는 ADJ/ADV + -er + than 패턴을 따릅니다 — 문장 뒤쪽에서 "than"이 보이면 빈칸에 비교급이 필요하다는 신호입니다.

questions.question: Ms. Nissim, the founder of Hartwell Industries, will ------ a talk on effective sales strategies at the marketing convention.

explanation.en: Verbs like deliver, register, showcase, and imply each pair with specific objects — "deliver a speech/talk" is a fixed collocation, so learn common verb-noun pairings rather than translating literally.
explanation.ko: deliver, register, showcase, imply와 같은 동사는 각각 특정 목적어와 짝을 이룹니다 — "deliver a speech/talk"는 고정된 연어이므로, 직역하지 말고 흔한 동사-명사 짝을 익히세요.

questions.question: Many people have succeeded in reducing household waste by buying fewer ------ products.

explanation.en: "Disposable" (meant to be thrown away after one use) is often confused with general quality adjectives like "basic" or "effective" — check if the sentence is describing a product's intended lifespan.
explanation.ko: "Disposable"(한 번 쓰고 버리도록 만들어진)는 "basic"이나 "effective" 같은 일반적인 품질 형용사와 자주 혼동됩니다 — 문장이 제품의 사용 수명을 설명하고 있는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: The next work of art for sale ------ one of finest paintings ever exhibited at the Cole Morton Meseum.

explanation.en: A singular subject ("The next work of art") paired with a passive verb needs "is/are + V3", and present simple passive describes a general fact rather than an ongoing or completed action.
explanation.ko: 단수 주어("The next work of art")는 수동태 동사와 함께 "is/are + V3"가 필요하며, 단순현재 수동태는 진행 중이거나 완료된 동작이 아니라 일반적인 사실을 나타냅니다.

questions.question: The tenor received widespread ------ for his superb performances at the annual opera festival.

explanation.en: Abstract nouns with related meanings (recognition, criticism, persuasion, deliberation) are best learned with their typical verb partners — "gain recognition" is a common collocation worth memorizing.
explanation.ko: 의미가 관련된 추상명사(recognition, criticism, persuasion, deliberation)는 자주 짝지어지는 동사와 함께 익히는 것이 가장 좋습니다 — "gain recognition"은 외워둘 만한 흔한 연어입니다.

questions.question: ------ having television stations across the state, the American Media Corporation owns several magazines and newspapers.

explanation.en: Prepositions and conjunctions that look similar (besides, rather, among, along) serve very different grammatical roles — "besides" means "in addition to", so check whether the sentence is adding information or comparing.
explanation.ko: 비슷하게 생긴 전치사/접속사(besides, rather, among, along)는 문법적 역할이 매우 다릅니다 — "besides"는 "~외에도"라는 뜻이므로, 문장이 정보를 추가하는지 비교하는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: Delegates from the industry's most widely ------ social media marketing firms will speak at next week's summit.

explanation.en: Words sharing the root "respect" (respected, respectful, respecting, respective) change meaning entirely with the suffix — "respected" describes someone admired, while "respective" means "belonging separately to each".
explanation.ko: "respect" 어근을 공유하는 단어들(respected, respectful, respecting, respective)은 접미사에 따라 의미가 완전히 달라집니다 — "respected"는 존경받는 사람을 묘사하고, "respective"는 "각자에게 개별적으로 속하는"이라는 뜻입니다.

questions.question: TNP Tech will allow users to download its new software for free until September 1 bit will start charging for it ------.

explanation.en: "Thereafter" (from that point onward) is a formal time connector common in TOEIC reading passages — build a small list of these formal connectors (hereby, thereof, thereafter) since they rarely appear in everyday speech.
explanation.ko: "Thereafter"(그 이후로)는 TOEIC 독해 지문에 흔히 나오는 격식체 시간 연결어입니다 — 일상 회화에서는 거의 쓰이지 않으니 이러한 격식체 연결어(hereby, thereof, thereafter) 목록을 작게 만들어 두세요.

items.description:
ATTENTION ALL TENANTS

'Wimberley Group' will (131) ------ its rent collection system to electronic one. This change will apply to all apartments effective February 1. (132) ------. Cash and personal checks will no longer be accepted.

Every tenant needs to create a user profile an www.wimberlygroup.com. After logging in, tenants will be able to (133) ------ a payment. You can do this by selecting the unpaid bill and then clicking on the button at the bottom of the screen. (134) ------ you hit 'Pay', the amount you designate will be deducted from your registered credit card or bank account. If you wish to arrange automatic payments, please click the button labeled 'Pay this amount every month.'

Thank you for you cooperation. If you have any questions, e-mail us at help@wimberlygroup.com.

explanation.en: Convert A to B (a fixed collocation)
explanation.ko: Convert A to B (고정 연어)

options: Tenants had found the new system easy to use.
From that day on, tenants must pay their rental fees online.
The new system allowed for a greater variety of payment options.
Only certain 'Wimberley Group' occupants will be affected.
questions.correct: From that day on, tenants must pay their rental fees online.

explanation.en: The inserted sentence must logically connect 'effective February 1' with the next sentence about cash and checks no longer being accepted
explanation.ko: 삽입된 문장은 'effective February 1'과 현금 및 수표가 더 이상 받아들여지지 않는다는 다음 문장을 논리적으로 연결해야 함

explanation.en: Make a payment (fixed collocation)
explanation.ko: Make a payment (고정 연어)

explanation.en: As soon as + S + V, S + will + V: an action that happens immediately after another
explanation.ko: As soon as + S + V, S + will + V: 다른 행동 직후에 일어나는 행동

items.description:
To: Angela Thornberry <athornberry@fastmail.com>
From: Vincent Nakamura <vnakamura@traxcomputers.com>
Subject: Your laptop
Date: June 18

Dear Ms. Thornberry

I am writing about the Trax 2700 laptop you dropped off at our store on June 15 because of problems with its screen. After sending it to our (135) ------ for examination, we discovered that it contained a faulty component. At present, your laptop is being (136) ------. As requested, we are also thoroughly testing the device to see if there are any other issues.

As this problem appears to have been entirely our fault, we will provide you with a $50 voucher to use at our retail store. (137) ------, e-coupons for our Web site are also available. Just let us know which you'd prefer.

(138) ------. If you have not received it by then, please call customer service.

Best wishes,

Vincent Nakamura
Customer Satisfaction Department

explanation.en: Send it to our + N: a noun naming the people/department is needed as the object of 'our'
explanation.ko: Send it to our + N: 'our'의 목적어로 사람/부서를 나타내는 명사가 필요함

explanation.en: Context: a faulty component was found and the device is being fixed, then thoroughly tested before being sent back
explanation.ko: 맥락: 고장난 부품이 발견되었고 기기가 수리 중이며, 이후 반송 전에 철저히 테스트됨

explanation.en: Alternatively introduces another option/choice (a $50 voucher OR e-coupons)
explanation.ko: Alternatively는 다른 선택지/옵션을 소개함 (50달러 상품권 또는 전자 쿠폰)

options: The model you inquired about is no longer available at this location.
We will send the computer back to you within three days.
You are not covered under the warranty as it has expired.
We have been receiving a number of complaints about our service.
questions.correct: We will send the computer back to you within three days.

explanation.en: The following sentence 'If you have not received it by then...' requires a prior sentence stating when the laptop will be sent back
explanation.ko: 다음 문장 'If you have not received it by then...'은 랩탑이 언제 반송될지 밝히는 이전 문장이 필요함

items.description:
Notice for All Staff

The shopping mall our store is located in will be closed from December 24 to 26. (139) ------, some of you will be coming in on December 24 to set up for our post-holiday sale. The guard who usually opens the mall doors in the morning is off duty during this time. (140) ------. Daniel Monahan is the most senior staff member, so I will give it to him, and he will let everyone inside.

It is vital that you (141) ------ Daniel at the entrance at exactly 10 A.M. We don't want to waste time making him go back and forth to open the doors, so please be considerate and arrive as (142) ------ as you can.

Thank you for your understanding.

Alison Culpeper
Store manager

explanation.en: However shows contrast: the mall is closed, BUT some staff still need to come in
explanation.ko: However는 대조를 보여줌: 쇼핑몰은 문을 닫지만, 일부 직원은 여전히 출근해야 함

options: Making sure we answer customer inquiries in a timely manner is our priority.
You should be able to use your employee pass to access the mall.
A security code will therefore be required to enter the building.
You will need to handle backorders caused by his absence.
questions.correct: A security code will therefore be required to enter the building.

explanation.en: The pronoun 'it' in the next sentence ('I will give it to him') must refer back to something mentioned in this sentence — a security code
explanation.ko: 다음 문장의 대명사 'it'('I will give it to him')은 이 문장에서 언급된 것을 가리켜야 함 — 보안 코드

explanation.en: It is vital/essential/important that + S + V (bare infinitive) — subjunctive mood
explanation.ko: It is vital/essential/important that + S + V (동사원형) — 가정법

explanation.en: As + ADV + as + S + can: expresses 'as ... as possible'; punctually fits the context of arriving on time
explanation.ko: As + ADV + as + S + can: 'as ... as possible'를 나타냄; punctually가 제시간에 도착하는 맥락에 맞음

items.description:
To: Rajesh Singh <rajesh.signh@indiaclothing.in>
From: Faria Deveraj <f.deveraj@mumbai.gov.in>
Subject: Scheduled Inspection
Date: October 12

Dear Mr. Singh,

On October 17, your clothing factory will face its yearly government inspection. This annual (143) ------ will verify that all labor laws are being followed. Your factory passed the (144) ------ evaluation with no major problems, so our inspectors hope to see a similar level of compliance this time around.

You are (145) ------ obliged to provide access to any part of the factory that the inspectors may wish to see. Failure to comply in this regard may result in fines and further investigation. Also, the inspectors need to confirm that workers are being properly compensated. (146) ------.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Faria Deveraj
Inspection Team Leader
City Government of Mumbai

explanation.en: 'This annual ___' refers back to 'its yearly government inspection' in the previous sentence — a synonym for inspection is needed
explanation.ko: 'This annual ___'는 앞 문장의 'its yearly government inspection'을 다시 가리킴 — inspection의 동의어가 필요함

explanation.en: The October 17 inspection is upcoming, so 'no major problems' must refer to an earlier (previous) evaluation
explanation.ko: 10월 17일 검사는 아직 일어나지 않은 미래의 일이므로, 'no major problems'는 이전(previous) 평가를 가리켜야 함

explanation.en: An adverb is needed to modify the passive verb 'obliged' (are ___ obliged)
explanation.ko: 수동태 동사 'obliged'(are ___ obliged)를 수식할 부사가 필요함

options: A copy of the receipt for your recent payment has been sent yo you in the mail.
The human resources department will need to prepare the relevant documents.
Consequently, the company wishes to avoid paying any such penalties.
We are interested in hearing about certain products that were recalled.
questions.correct: The human resources department will need to prepare the relevant documents.

explanation.en: Follows logically from 'the inspectors need to confirm that workers are being properly compensated,' which requires payroll/compensation documents
explanation.ko: 'the inspectors need to confirm that workers are being properly compensated'와 논리적으로 이어지며, 이는 급여/보상 관련 문서가 필요함을 의미함

items.description:
Cardigan Bay General Hospital Fundraising Dinner

You are cordially invited to attend a dinner fundraiser in aid of Cardigan bay General Hospital on April 25 at 7:30 P.M. in the Iris Room at the Beaufort Hotel.

The hospital was first built in 1960, and while much of it has been completely renovated, the east wing has barely changed since the opening day. In order to make improvements to it, the hospital needs about $300,000, which this dinner will raise funds for.

Tickets can be purchased for $100 at the hospital's main reception desk. Those purchasing four tickets or more at one time will receive a copy of Dr. Dianne Larsen's book on nutrition, Food Fit, valued at $25, as a gift.

We sincerely hope you will attend so that the hospital can make some necessary upgrades that will improve the level of care we provide.

questions.question: Why does the hospital need funding?
options: It needs to pay for extra research into diseases.
It has to hire more medical personnel.
It would like to refurbish a section of the building.
It requires the purchase of new medical equipment.
questions.correct: It would like to refurbish a section of the building.

explanation.en: "the east wing has barely changed since the opening day. In order to make improvements to it, the hospital needs about $300,000".
explanation.ko: "동관은 개원일 이후 거의 변화가 없었습니다. 이를 개선하기 위해 병원은 약 30만 달러가 필요합니다"

questions.question: How can guests obtain a complimentary item?
options: By paying for at least four guests
By presenting an invitation from a previous event

Eagle Canyon City Park

Over the past month, there has been a sharp increase in reported sightings of raccoons in the open spaces of the park. The park rangers suspect the creatures are attracted by food scraps that are left - whether on purpose of accidentally - by visitors to the park. -- [1] --. The city's public health department does not want to encourage the raccoons to leave the wooded areas of the park as they can be carriers of disease and pose a risk to visitors and their pets. -- [2] --. With that in mind:

  • Please do not leave any garbage in the park - either take it with you when you leave, or please it in the closed garbage bins that are provided throughout the park.
  • If you see reccoons, do not approach them or give them food as they are wild animals with sharp claws and can be dangerous when feel frightened.

-- [3] --. Along with this, we will be holding volunteer park cleanups on the last Saturday of each month. Our next one is scheduled for June 27. Anyone interested in taking park should report to the park visitor center to register. -- [4] --. All participants will be provided with protective gloves and vests, water, and a light lunch.
