items.description:
Hanlan's Coffee Company - Ethical Purchasing Policy

At Hanlan's, we know that our customers like to drink only the finest coffee from around the world. We also recognize that they want to be sure that the people who grow that coffee are treated fairly. Many coffee producers provide their employees with poor working conditions and low pay, which are practices that Hanlan's does not support. -- [1] --.

Coffee companies that buy their stock on the open market never know exactly where it comes from. But at Hanlan's, we take a different approach. We have exclusive contracts with farms in Guatemala, Ethiopia, and Vietnam. -- [2]--. Because of this, we know exactly who is producing our coffee and the conditions in which it is being grown. We appreciate all the hard work of our farmers and ensure that they have acceptable working conditions and wages. But our commitment doesn't end there. -- [3]--. Hanlan's pays them an additional 10 percent above curreny market prices as our way of saying 'Thanks.'

Furthermore, to give even more back to these communities, we have started the Hanlan's Development Foundation. Each year through this organization, we put five percent of our total corporate profits into building shcools, water pumps and purification plants, and health care facilities in the towns and villages near where our coffee is grown. The main foal is to make certain that all our workers' children are safe, healthy, and have the chance to go to school and receive a full education. -- [4] --.

Find out more about Hanlan's development projects, our coffee producers, and what you can do to support our cause at www.hanlancoffee.com/foundation.

items.description:
Ping Software's Head Honored as Tech Woman of the Year

By Carmen Marshall

Rebecca Curtis, CEO of software company Ping, has been named the most successful woman in the tech world by Gadget Lover magazine. Ms. Curtis, who took over the company five years ago and transformed it into a thriving multi-platform enterprise, is expected to deliver an acceptance speech at the Gadget Lover annual conference on December 2.

Ms. Curtis's achievements as CEO have been widely celebrated. When she replaced the previous CEO, Mark Spalding, Ping was mainly known for its word processing software. Due to the influx of new word processing product, Ping's software was not selling as well as it once had. Ms. Curtis quickly reversed that situation by developing a wide range of high-quality software including photo-editing and spreadsheet programs. Now the name 'Ping' is notable for its cutting-edge, dependable technology.

Over the next several years, Ms. Curtis says Ping will create a membership plan for its frequent users. Those who sign up will be able to download new Ping products at reduced rate. Ms. Curtis says the company also plans to redevelop its Web site. With all these plans ahead, Ping is expected to grow even more. Most experts agree that Ms. Curtis has been the primary reason behind the company's success.

items.description:
City Trends Report - Valencia

Tourism numbers in Valencia have been increasing for three years running as people are beginning to discover this often underrated city on the eastern coast of Spain. At the beginning of the survey period, the city received just under a milion visitors a year, but the latest figures show this has jumped to over 1.4 milion.

There are a number of factors that ca account for this change. The new Sanchez Museum of Iberian Art and its nearby conference facilities to rail services from Valancia to Madrid and Barcelona have reduced travel time significantly. With a major airport expansion due to be completed before the end of the year, things are expected to get even better for Valencia.

In addition, the city government's launch of an international advertising campaign two years ago has also proved beneficial. The city was marketed by television, print, and social media as a tourism destination. Reaction to the campaign continues to be positive.

Finally, as well as its attraction tourists and business visitors, Valencia is increasingly being recognized as an excellent place to live. The consultancy Apollo and Company recently put the city in third place in a report measuring the quality of life in small European cities. They cited its lovely waterfront location, low housing costs, and modern infrastructure as reasons for its high place.

options: Campaigns to make a city more liveable

explanation.en: The report as a whole tracks rising visitor numbers to Valencia and the museum, transit, marketing, and quality-of-life factors behind the increase — an overview of the city's growing tourism industry.
explanation.ko: 보고서 전체는 발렌시아와 박물관을 찾는 방문객 수의 증가, 그리고 그 증가의 배경이 되는 교통, 마케팅, 삶의 질 요인들을 다루고 있다 — 즉 도시의 성장하는 관광 산업에 대한 개관이다.

Announcement for Woodlands Business Owners:

The Woodlands Merchants Association is planning to host Thursday evening concerts on the Center Square lawn from May 28 through July 2, from 6 P.M. until 9 P.M. We have held the concerts over the past few years and have had a good turnout every time. However, these events do entail a significant expense for the association, as we most pay our performers. As a result, we are offering local businesses the opportunity to sponsor a concert. This will help the association to control costs while promoting your stores or shops to the public.

A sponsorship includes a banner with your business name on it that will be attached to the performance stage. You have the option of setting up a promotional booth on the lawn and are allowed to hand out flyers or give away coupons and product samples. Those sponsoring a concert for $500 or more will also have their business's name, logo, and contact information printed with event advertisements in The Woodlands Times newspaper.

The Woodlands Merchant Association aims to bring together the business community and local residents, and the sponsored concerts will be an enjoyable way to achieve that goal. If you would like to participate, contact the event coordinator, Dan Perry, at DanPerry@woodlandsmerchantsassn.com to finalize the sponsorship arrangements.

items.description:
Gunton City Council to Consider Blandfolk Superstore Proposal

At a Gunton City Council meeting on May 2, members listened to a presentation from representatives of Blandfolk Superstore about building a branch locally. The retail giant proposed erecting an outlet measuring 9,500 square meters just within city limits on Medford Avenue. However, the chosen land has not yet been authorized for commercial establishments, so Blankfolk has requested that the property be rezoned. Gunton mayor Claire O'Rourke told representatives that the council would discuss the proposition this month and address it at their next meeting in June. A spokesperson for Blankfolk said the corporation hopes the proposal will pass, emphasizing that the development would provide employment for up to 190 local residents.

Gunton Herald
www.guntonherald.com
Home|News|Sports|Business|Entertainment|Lifestyle|Opinion|Contact Us

Readers' Comments

Ronald Pinero posted on May 7:
I am writing in regard to an article printed in your newspaper's May 3 edition about the construction proposal from Blandfolk Superstore. As a long-time business owner in Gunton, I am concerned. I manage Ballas Boutique, a clothing store in the downtown area, and many of my friends and business acquaintances also operate private shops in the city. Large corporate retailers have forced many smaller stores out of business in other locations where they have opened, even when such establishments have been situated on the outskirts of towns. I'm not sure most businesses line mine will be able to compete without significantly dropping prices and, by extension, the quality of our godds. For now, Gunton is very vibrant and diverse city, and I hope the mayor and council members will reject the proposal in order to keep that way.

TORonald Pinero <rpinero@dailymaily.com>
FROMAdeline Morris <amorris@guntoncoc.org>
SUBJECTRequest from Gunton COC
DATEMay 8

Dear Mr.Pinero,

I came across your comments on the Gunton Herald Web site. Your concern is something the board the Gunton Chamber of Commerce has been duscussing, and we agree that something must be done to project stores in the downtown area, like yours. On June 3, the city council will be holding a public meeting that some of us will be attending. It would helpful if you joined us at the event. You could give a short talk describing the concerns you mentioned in your comments. You are welcome to use visual aids, bring supporting documents, and invite others who share our concerns. Please let me know if you would like to participate.

Sincerely yours,

Adeline Morris
Secretary, Gunton Chamber of Commerce

questions.question: With the help of one of the IT technicians, the missing accounting files have been ------.

explanation.en: "Have been" is always followed by a past participle (V3) or, less often paired here, another perfect form — never a plain base verb or a present participle used as the main verb.
explanation.ko: "Have been" 뒤에는 항상 과거분사(V3)가 옵니다 — 동사 원형이나 본동사로 쓰인 현재분사가 오지 않습니다.

questions.question: A private reception for gallery donors will be ------ on March 5, prior to the grand opening of the exhibit.

explanation.en: Some nouns collocate with only one specific verb — "a reception is held", not "made" or "done" — so memorize event-related collocations (hold a meeting, hold a reception) as fixed pairs.
explanation.ko: 일부 명사는 오직 하나의 특정 동사와만 짝을 이룹니다 — "a reception is held"이지 "made"나 "done"이 아닙니다 — 행사 관련 연어(hold a meeting, hold a reception)를 고정된 짝으로 외우세요.

questions.question: Aurora Furnishings is finding it difficult to make a profit in its ------ competitive market.

explanation.en: An adjective ("competitive") needs an adverb, not another adjective, to describe its degree — words like "increasingly" answer "how competitive?" and slot in right before the adjective.
explanation.ko: 형용사("competitive")는 정도를 나타내기 위해 다른 형용사가 아니라 부사가 필요합니다 — "increasingly" 같은 단어는 "얼마나 경쟁적인가?"에 답하며 형용사 바로 앞에 옵니다.

questions.question: A minor electrical malfunction was discovered by the pilot ------ before the plane took off.

explanation.en: Time-related adverbs (shortly, barely, absolutely, exclusively) look similar but only one fits a "right before" meaning — always test each option against the exact meaning the sentence needs.
explanation.ko: 시간 관련 부사(shortly, barely, absolutely, exclusively)는 비슷해 보이지만 "바로 직전"이라는 의미에 맞는 것은 하나뿐입니다 — 항상 문장이 필요로 하는 정확한 의미로 각 선택지를 검증하세요.

questions.question: We will make a final decision about changing the landscaping of the property after reviewing the ------ costs.

explanation.en: A blank right before a plural noun ("costs") needs an adjective, not a verb or noun — and "estimated cost" is a fixed phrase worth memorizing as a unit.
explanation.ko: 복수 명사("costs") 바로 앞의 빈칸은 동사나 명사가 아니라 형용사가 필요합니다 — 그리고 "estimated cost"는 통째로 외워둘 만한 고정 표현입니다.

questions.question: MyHealth Co. has produced a wide range of vitamin supplements for ------ two decades.

explanation.en: When a sentence already contains "for" expressing duration, don't add "during" too — prepositions of time (along, for, during, over) each fit only specific structures, so eliminate ones that clash with wording already present.
explanation.ko: 문장에 이미 기간을 나타내는 "for"가 있다면 "during"을 또 추가하지 마세요 — 시간 전치사(along, for, during, over)는 각각 특정 구조에만 맞으므로, 이미 있는 표현과 충돌하는 것은 제외하세요.

questions.question: The April edition of Fishing and More magazine looks ------ different from previous issues because of the new art editor.

explanation.en: An adjective ("different") needs an adverb before it to show degree of difference — "completely different" is a natural intensifier pairing worth remembering.
explanation.ko: 형용사("different")는 차이의 정도를 나타내기 위해 앞에 부사가 필요합니다 — "completely different"는 기억해둘 만한 자연스러운 강조 표현입니다.

questions.question: The customer's order ------ will be sent by e-mail within twenty-four hours.

explanation.en: After a possessive noun ("customer's"), the blank needs another noun, not a verb or adjective — possessives always modify a noun that follows.
explanation.ko: 소유격 명사("customer's") 뒤의 빈칸은 동사나 형용사가 아니라 또 다른 명사가 필요합니다 — 소유격은 항상 뒤따르는 명사를 수식합니다.

questions.question: The maintenance team's repair requests should be ------ in groups according to the urgency.

explanation.en: After the verb "be", the blank usually needs V-ing or V-pp (for continuous or passive meaning) — check if the subject performs the action or receives it before picking the form.
explanation.ko: 동사 "be" 뒤의 빈칸은 보통 진행형이나 수동형 의미를 위해 V-ing나 V-pp가 필요합니다 — 형태를 고르기 전에 주어가 동작을 수행하는지 받는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: Following Ms. Rivera's ------ statement, the official awards ceremony for FPlex Industries will commence.

explanation.en: "Brief statement" is a natural, fixed collocation meaning "a short statement" — unrelated adjectives (straight, former, steep) may fit grammatically but never fit the meaning, so always sanity-check meaning first.
explanation.ko: "Brief statement"은 "짧은 진술"을 뜻하는 자연스럽고 고정된 연어입니다 — 관련 없는 형용사(straight, former, steep)는 문법적으로는 맞을 수 있어도 의미에는 결코 맞지 않으므로, 항상 의미부터 확인하세요.

questions.question: Due to the high volume of foot traffic, the shop must polish its floors more ------ than usual during the peak season.

explanation.en: A blank modifying a verb ("polish") needs an adverb of frequency or manner — words like "frequently" answer "how often?" and typically sit right before the verb they modify.
explanation.ko: 동사("polish")를 수식하는 빈칸은 빈도나 방식을 나타내는 부사가 필요합니다 — "frequently" 같은 단어는 "얼마나 자주?"에 답하며 보통 수식하는 동사 바로 앞에 옵니다.

questions.question: The Master Gardeners Club had to ------ its monthly meeting because the community center's conference room was double-booked.

explanation.en: Near-synonym verbs (oppose, postpone, extend) each imply a different action — "postpone a meeting" specifically means delay it to a later time, which is the only one matching a double-booked room.
explanation.ko: 유의어 동사(oppose, postpone, extend)는 각각 다른 동작을 암시합니다 — "postpone a meeting"은 구체적으로 나중으로 미룬다는 뜻으로, 방이 이중 예약된 상황에 맞는 유일한 단어입니다.

questions.question: Financial advisors report that older investors tend to be ------ than their younger counterparts.

explanation.en: The word "than" later in the sentence is the clearest signal that the blank needs a comparative form — for longer adjectives, that means "more + adjective", not the adjective alone.
explanation.ko: 문장 뒤쪽에 나오는 "than"이라는 단어는 빈칸에 비교급이 필요하다는 가장 명확한 신호입니다 — 긴 형용사의 경우 이는 형용사 단독이 아니라 "more + 형용사"를 의미합니다.

questions.question: Mr. Allbrecht's ------ in replying to the HFIR director's e-mail demonstrated that he was highly interested in the position.

explanation.en: After a possessive name ("Mr. Allbrecht's"), the blank needs a noun describing a quality of that person — abstract nouns like "promptness" work here, while verbs or adjectives don't fit the slot.
explanation.ko: 소유격 이름("Mr. Allbrecht's") 뒤의 빈칸은 그 사람의 특성을 묘사하는 명사가 필요합니다 — "promptness" 같은 추상명사가 여기에 적합하며, 동사나 형용사는 이 자리에 맞지 않습니다.

questions.question: The soccer players usually practice on the main field at Waterbury Park, but they sometimes practice ------ .

explanation.en: "Elsewhere" (somewhere else) is a single-word adverb of place that often signals a contrast with a usual location mentioned earlier in the sentence — watch for that "usually X, but sometimes elsewhere" pattern.
explanation.ko: "Elsewhere"(다른 곳에서)는 문장 앞부분에서 언급된 평소 장소와의 대조를 흔히 나타내는 한 단어짜리 장소 부사입니다 — "보통은 X, 하지만 가끔은 다른 곳에서"라는 패턴을 주의하세요.

questions.question: The accountants were unable to produce a full report by the deadlline but promised that ------ would give a summary of the important points.

explanation.en: After "promise that", the following clause needs a subject pronoun (they, she, he), not a reflexive (themselves) or possessive (theirs) form, since the blank is acting as the subject of its own clause.
explanation.ko: "promise that" 뒤에 오는 절은 재귀형(themselves)이나 소유형(theirs)이 아니라 주격 대명사(they, she, he)가 필요합니다. 빈칸이 그 절 자체의 주어 역할을 하기 때문입니다.

questions.question: Despite having some problems with the sound system during the performance, the concert was an ------ experience for everyone.

explanation.en: A blank right before a noun ("experience") needs an adjective to describe it — check the ending of each option (-able, -ing, -tion) to quickly spot which one is grammatically an adjective.
explanation.ko: 명사("experience") 바로 앞의 빈칸은 그것을 묘사할 형용사가 필요합니다 — 각 선택지의 어미(-able, -ing, -tion)를 확인하면 문법적으로 어느 것이 형용사인지 빠르게 알 수 있습니다.

questions.question: ------ the building has an excellent location and a modern interior, it is popular among visitors.

explanation.en: Conditional connectors (provided that, in view of, other than, seeing that) each fit a different logical relationship — "provided that" specifically signals a condition ("if/as long as"), matching a condition-result sentence pair.
explanation.ko: 조건 연결어(provided that, in view of, other than, seeing that)는 각각 다른 논리적 관계에 맞습니다 — "provided that"는 특별히 조건("만약/~하는 한")을 나타내며, 조건-결과 문장 쌍에 맞습니다.

questions.question: The Parks and Recreation Department offers ------ opportunities for volunteers to improve the community.

explanation.en: Adjectives ending in -ing (rewarding) describe a thing that produces a feeling, while adjectives ending in -ed (rewarded) describe a person who receives that feeling — match the suffix to whether the noun is a thing or a person.
explanation.ko: -ing로 끝나는 형용사(rewarding)는 감정을 유발하는 사물을 묘사하고, -ed로 끝나는 형용사(rewarded)는 그 감정을 느끼는 사람을 묘사합니다 — 명사가 사물인지 사람인지에 맞춰 접미사를 선택하세요.

questions.question: The vacant rooms on the inn's second floor have ------ been cleaned.

explanation.en: Quantifiers (all, most, every, some) all seem plausible but only one precisely matches the intended scope of the sentence — read carefully whether the sentence implies totality or partiality.
explanation.ko: 수량사(all, most, every, some)는 모두 그럴듯해 보이지만 문장이 의도하는 범위에 정확히 맞는 것은 하나뿐입니다 — 문장이 전체를 의미하는지 일부를 의미하는지 주의 깊게 읽으세요.

questions.question: The short story cannot be reprinted ------ explicit permission from the writer.

explanation.en: Prepositions like 'among', 'unlike', 'regarding', and 'without' each require a specific following structure and meaning — "without + noun/V-ing" expresses lacking something, which is the clue for permission-related sentences.
explanation.ko: 'among', 'unlike', 'regarding', 'without' 같은 전치사는 각각 뒤에 특정 구조와 의미가 필요합니다 — "without + 명사/V-ing"는 무언가가 없다는 것을 표현하며, 이는 허가 관련 문장의 단서입니다.

questions.question: The restaurant has a ------ decorated room that is perfect for hosting children's parties.

explanation.en: A past participle used as an adjective ("decorated") can still be modified by an adverb describing manner — "cheerfully decorated" tells us how the decorating was done, not just that it happened.
explanation.ko: 형용사로 쓰인 과거분사("decorated")도 방식을 나타내는 부사로 수식될 수 있습니다 — "cheerfully decorated"는 장식이 어떻게 되었는지를 알려주지, 단지 일어났다는 사실만을 알려주지 않습니다.

questions.question: A wildlife expert is scheduled to give a talk on the ------ that the factory has had on the surrounding forest.

explanation.en: Near-synonym nouns (component, degree, requirement, impact) each have their own fixed collocation — "have an impact on something" is the natural pairing, so learn the whole phrase rather than the word alone.
explanation.ko: 유의어 명사(component, degree, requirement, impact)는 각각 고유한 고정 연어를 가집니다 — "have an impact on something"이 자연스러운 짝이므로, 단어만이 아니라 구 전체를 익히세요.

questions.question: The landlord raised the monthly rent for the first time in several years, and ------ so.

explanation.en: A fixed phrase like "and reasonably so" acts as an adverb modifying the whole previous clause, confirming that an action (raising rent) was done justifiably — recognize such phrases as set expressions, not word-by-word grammar.
explanation.ko: "and reasonably so" 같은 고정 표현은 앞 절 전체를 수식하는 부사 역할을 하며, 어떤 행동(임대료 인상)이 정당하게 이루어졌음을 확인합니다 — 이런 표현은 단어별 문법이 아니라 관용 표현으로 인식하세요.

questions.question: As long as there are no further delays, the factory will be fully ------ by June 18.

explanation.en: After "be", when no -ing or -ed form fits the meaning, the blank likely needs a plain adjective — "operational" describing a state, unlike the verb or noun forms of the same root.
explanation.ko: "be" 뒤에 -ing나 -ed 형태가 의미에 맞지 않을 때는 빈칸에 순수한 형용사가 필요할 가능성이 큽니다 — "operational"은 같은 어근의 동사나 명사 형태와 달리 상태를 묘사합니다.

questions.question: Thanks to his experience, Mr. Warren is ------ capable of completing the job on his own.

explanation.en: An adjective ("capable") needs an adverb before it to express certainty or degree — "certainly capable" strengthens the claim rather than changing its core meaning.
explanation.ko: 형용사("capable")는 확신이나 정도를 나타내기 위해 앞에 부사가 필요합니다 — "certainly capable"는 핵심 의미를 바꾸기보다는 주장을 강화합니다.

questions.question: Because of ------ fuel costs, some people are choosing to stay home for the summer vacation rather than drive tourist sites.

explanation.en: A blank before a noun phrase ("fuel costs") needs an adjective describing that noun — "rising fuel costs" is a common real-world collocation about costs going up over time.
explanation.ko: 명사구("fuel costs") 앞의 빈칸은 그 명사를 묘사하는 형용사가 필요합니다 — "rising fuel costs"는 시간이 지나며 비용이 오르는 것을 나타내는 흔한 실생활 연어입니다.

questions.question: The green light on the side of the water purifier lights up ------ the filter needs to be replaced.

explanation.en: Connectors like likewise, therefore, whereas, and whenever each signal a different logical relationship (addition, cause, contrast, time) — "whenever" fits when the sentence means "any time that", not cause or contrast.
explanation.ko: likewise, therefore, whereas, whenever 같은 연결어는 각각 다른 논리적 관계(추가, 원인, 대조, 시간)를 나타냅니다 — "whenever"는 문장이 원인이나 대조가 아니라 "~할 때는 언제나"를 의미할 때 맞습니다.

questions.question: Two items in Ms. Burke's order were out of stock, so her invoice was adjusted ------ .

explanation.en: Adverbs that look similar (continuously, accordingly, immeasurably, recognizably) carry very different meanings — "accordingly" means "in a way that matches the situation", fitting when an invoice was adjusted to reflect a change.
explanation.ko: 비슷해 보이는 부사(continuously, accordingly, immeasurably, recognizably)는 의미가 매우 다릅니다 — "accordingly"는 "상황에 맞는 방식으로"라는 뜻으로, 변경 사항을 반영해 청구서가 조정된 경우에 맞습니다.

questions.question: The notice indicated that a first-aid training course will be provided free of charge to ------ next month.

explanation.en: "Provide something to someone" needs a noun referring to people in that slot, not an adjective or verb — check the word ending to tell a person-noun (residents) apart from a place-noun (residence).
explanation.ko: "Provide something to someone"은 그 자리에 형용사나 동사가 아니라 사람을 가리키는 명사가 필요합니다 — 사람을 뜻하는 명사(residents)와 장소를 뜻하는 명사(residence)를 구별하려면 단어 어미를 확인하세요.

items.description:
November 11
John Adams
Tri-State, Apt 408
New York, NY
10873

Executive Manager

explanation.en: Need a passive verb form ("to be chosen").
explanation.ko: "선택되다" 때문에 수동태 동사가 필요함 -> C 선택

explanation.en: Fixed phrase: "apply for a position".
explanation.ko: Apply for position: 어떤 직위에 지원하다 -> A 선택 - Location (n): 위치 - Career (n): 경력 - Appointment (n): 약속

options: The building is easy to locate.
We would like you to come in at 1:00 P.M.
Our interviewers will ask you several questions.
You will be given a specific schedule.
questions.correct: We would like you to come in at 1:00 P.M.

explanation.ko: - 앞 문장은 면접이 진행되는 시간을 언급함. 뒤 문장은 그 장소가 회사 본사임을 소개함. - A 제외: 앞 문장과 관련이 없음 - C 제외: 관련이 없음(면접관이 몇 가지 질문을 할 것입니다) - D 제외: 이미 specific schedule이 있음 -> 중복 - B 선택: 오후 1시에서 6시 사이에 호출될 것입니다 -> 고용주는 당신이 1시에 도착하기를 원함

explanation.en: Enable = make possible; approve = to agree to; refuse = to decline; qualify = to meet requirements — "qualify" fits the meaning best (whether you meet the requirements).
explanation.ko: - Enable (v): 가능하게 하다 - Approve (v): 승인하다 - Refuse (v): 거절하다 - Qualify (v): 자격을 갖추다 -> 의미상 D가 적절함(귀하가 자격을 갖추면 최대한 빨리 알려드리겠습니다)

items.description: SEOUL (July 19) - Breanun's Group opened the doors to its first B&G clothing shop on the famed Abgujeong Rodeo street in South Korea to long lines of frantic shoppers. -[1]- The frenzy was over th e limited edition line designed by Marichio Bucci in partnership with B&G. Within just a couple of hours of opening the doors, most of the Bucci design items were sold out. Si1nilar reports of chaos and empty shelves which once held items from the Bucci line were echoed in major cities around the world including New York, London, Tokyo, and Milan. -[2]- Although B&G has released limited edition collaborations with other famous designers, this is the first time that B&G shops have reported a complete depletion of items within hours of its release. The Bucci and B&G collaboration is the most successful to date and, already, talks are in progress over future collaborations for more clothing lines. -[3]- Meanwhile in Seoul, shoppers who were unable to purchase from the Bucci line were disappointed but excited to have the popular retailer open in Korea. -[4]-.

items.description:
MEMO

To: All staff
From: Elizabeth Paine
Date: January 24
Subject: Sick Leave

Attention employees.

We are going to make adjustments to our policies concerning sick leave here at Zimnet Corporation, We are considering reducing the number of paid vacation days and instead increasing the number of paid sick days available to employees. Before we make any changes, we would like to gather the opinions of employees on this matter. Please e-mail Tony Nugent at tonynugent@zimnet.com. He will be collecting and analyzing your responses. Afterward, Management will produce a corresponding policy proposal by February 24. Once the proposal has been made, a meeting will be called to discuss its implementation among all of our employees. I hope this process can be helpful to all of our employees, and please be active in your participation

Sincerely,
Elizabeth Paine

items.description:
Penny Jones3:27
I just got a call from Martin that his client Mr. Patrick would like to have his order two weeks earlier than originally planned. So, by next week Monday essentially. Do you think this is possible? I'd like your input.
Karen Norman3:28
There's no problem on our end. Most of the leather has already been cut. We've already sent many of the pieces to be sewn. The rest of the work should take a couple of hours
Neil Park3:29
The handles are complete and about half the bags are near completion. I'll get them to Lauren soon. I think we should be able to finish sewing the bags by tomorrow evening.
Penny Jones3:30
I'm glad to hear that most of the handbags are almost finished. Lauren, how long will it take to get the hardware attached or sewn in?
Lauren Nichols3:31
We're currently working on the Jenk and Cenk twin's orders...
Penny Jones3:32
We have more than enough time to complete the twin's orders so I can authorize your workers to put aside that project for now. How long will Mr. Patrick's order take?
Lauren Nichols3:33
The zippers need to be sewn in but the studs will be glued, which makes the work easier. I think we need about a day.
Kevin Harding3:34
It'll take us only a couple of hours to have the order packaged safely to be shipped.
Penny Jones3:35
Thank you so much. I'll let our client know.

questions.question: What kind of business does the client most likely own?

explanation.en: "The handles are complete and about half of the bags are nearly completion. I’ll get them to Lauren soon."
explanation.ko: 손잡이는 완성되었고 가방의 약 절반이 거의 완성되었습니다. 곧 Lauren에게 전달하겠습니다. 참고 메시지 체인에서 언급된 상품은 핸드백임 -> 고객은 핸드백 사업을 운영함.

questions.question: According to the conversation, whose department must complete the work first?

explanation.en: "There is no problem on our end. Most of the leather has already been cut. We’ve already sent many of the pieces to be sewn"
explanation.ko: 저희 쪽은 문제가 없습니다. 가죽은 대부분 이미 재단되었습니다. 많은 부분을 이미 봉제 작업에 보냈습니다 참고 Karen Norman의 부서는 하드웨어 부분을 담당하며, 이는 생산 과정의 첫 단계임 -> A 선택.

questions.question: At 3:31, why does Lauren Nichols say "We’re currently working on the Jenk and Cenk twin’s orders"?
options: To inform everyone that they have their own clients
To explain why they refuse to help
To imply that they are busy with another project
To make everyone speed up their work
questions.correct: To imply that they are busy with another project

explanation.en: We’re currently working on the Jenk and Cenk twin’s orders. - We have more than enough time to complete the twin’s orders so I can authorize your workers to put aside that project for now.
explanation.ko: 저희는 현재 Jenk와 Cenk 쌍둥이의 주문을 처리하고 있습니다. - 쌍둥이의 주문을 완료할 시간이 충분히 있으니, 당신 직원들이 그 프로젝트를 잠시 미뤄두도록 허가할 수 있습니다. 참고 키워드: "3:31" -> 이 시간대 부분을 찾아 주변 정보를 읽으세요. Lauren은 다른 주문도 처리해야 한다고 말하고 있음 -> 그들이 바쁘다는 것을 암시함.

questions.question: What will Penny Jones most likely tell Mr. Patrick?
options: That his order will be finished two weeks later.
That his request can be fulfilled.
That his order will cost him extra money.
That there may be a delay to his order.
questions.correct: That his request can be fulfilled.

explanation.en: Thank you so much. I’ll let our client know
explanation.ko: 정말 감사합니다. 저희 고객에게 알리겠습니다 참고 이전에 모두가 작업이 완료되는 데 하루 정도만 더 걸린다고 말했으므로, Penny Jones 씨는 고객인 Patrick 씨에게 그의 요청이 이루어질 수 있다고 알리기로 결정함.

For Sale by Owner
Palmer Standard Cabin Yacht

Asking price: $45,000 or best offer

Basic Specifications:
This boat was built four years ago. It is 12 feet wide by 36 feet long. The hull is made of fiberglass, making it light yet strong, The boat includes 2 double bedrooms as well as a sleeper sofa, kitchen, and bathroom.

Features:
This boat is very stable and offers a spacious deck. It is perfect for large families and social gatherings. It includes an eight-speaker sound system With USB connectivity, it also has a lockable storage compartment where personal belongings can be kept.

I have owned and operated this boat for three and a half years. The boat comes with a five-year warranty that still has one and a half years remaining. The warranty is transferable to the buyer upon purchase.

123 Gllmoew Street
Orange County, CA 48857

November 15
Mr. Peter Kang
3820 Rivervalley Heights
Seattle, WA 19387

Dear Mr. Kang,

We at Travel & Recreation thank you for your subscription to our magazine. As you have been a long time subscriber, I am excited to inform you about our new subscription plan for our VIP members. -[1]- As a member, you will continue to receive monthly editions of our magazine and access to our new online e-magazine services. You can simply download a digital version of the print magazine to any mobile device at no extra cost. -[2]- Furthermore, you can access background information about our authors, journalists, and guest writers, as well as detailed information about the locations and places that are covered in the magazine. In addition, you can access the recipes to the most popular restaurants around the world and, most exciting of all, we will hold an exclusive competition for our VIP members with a chance to win a trip for two to Hawai. -[3]- Our regular subcribers, as well as VIP members, will have a chance to win a dining experience at 5-star restaurant Bellisimo.

Again we thank you for your continued support and we hope you enjoy the many changes we have made to our services as we strive to entertain and educate our loyal subscribers. -[4]- Please fill out the application form that is attached to this letter. Please check which subscription plan you wish to join. If you send in a $100 fee, you will receive the regular subscription plan. If you send in a $200 fee, you will become a VIP member.

We appreciate your support and hope to hear from you soon.
Sincerely,
Victoria Adams

options: To remind him to send in his travel journals
To explain about a new subscription plan
To inquire about his travel plans
To determine his qualifications for a position
questions.correct: To explain about a new subscription plan

explanation.en: We at Travel & Recreation thank you for your subscription to our magazine. As you have been a long time subscriber, I am excited to inform you about our new subscription plan for our VIP members.
explanation.ko: 저희 Travel & Recreation은 저희 잡지 구독에 감사드립니다. 오랜 기간 구독해 주셨기에, 저희 VIP 회원을 위한 새로운 구독 플랜을 알려드리게 되어 기쁩니다. 참고 편지의 목적은 첫 문장에 있음

explanation.ko: 이 편지에 첨부된 신청서를 작성해 주세요 Attach (v): 첨부하다

questions.question: In the middle of the first paragraph of the letter, the term "at no extra cost" is Closest in meaning to:

explanation.ko: 추가 비용 없이 인쇄 잡지의 디지털 버전을 어떤 모바일 기기로든 간단히 다운로드하실 수 있습니다. At no extra cost = free: 무료

questions.question: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence belong? "Your subscription expires next month, but we invite you to consider joining our VIP membership"

explanation.ko: "Your subscription expires next month, but we invite you to consider joining our VIP membership" 참고 [1] 위치의 앞뒤 문장은 VIP 회원 가입에 대해 이야기하고 있음. 따라서 이 위치가 가장 적합한데, 이 문장 또한 기존 구독이 곧 만료됨과 새 가입을 제안하는 내용이기 때문임. -> A 선택

For questions about booking group visits, contact David Smith at dsmith@belmonthistoricaisociety.com For more details regarding upcoming events and venue locations, or to rent one of our venues, visit us at www.belmonthistoricalsociety.com.
To: David Smith <dsmith@belmonthistoricalsociety.com>
From: Jared Tate <jtate@clarkuniversity.com>
Date: April 22
Subject: Group Visit
Dear Mr. Smith,

Hello, my name is Jared Tate and I am a professor in the History Department at Clark . University in downtown Maryville.

I am teaching an introductory history course for freshmen this semester, and I thought it would be helpful to attend the event featurin.g Mr. Campbell. His talk is very pertinent to the subjects we are currently covering in class.

I was also wondering if it would be possible to arrange a question-and answer session between Mr. Campbell and my group of about 50 students. Please tell him that we are looking forward to seeing him.

I appreciate your reading my e-mail and I hope to hear back from you soon.

Jared Tate
History Department, Clark University

Dear Mr. Walker,

Iam finalizing the calendar of summer events for our company. Because we went over budget last year on employee appreciation events, I think it would be wise to find more affordable recreational activities. Attached is a breakdown of projected expenses for summer events that I have planned.

July 6: Anchorage Flower Festtival

August 6: Bicycle Tours of the Anchorage Countryside

I have scheduled fewer outdoor activities this year compared to last year. Suzie Mason
Human Resources Manager
Anchorage Reporter
Bike Tours of the Anchorage Countryside to Start August 6

May 2—The Anchorage Bike Club will be hosting an annual bike riding event this summer, beginning on August 6 and running through August 7. The event will start at 10:00 A.M. on both days at the Anchorage Community Center, If you are driving a vehicle to the starting point, it would be better to use the parking lot behind the community center.

Anchorage Bike Club President Jean Frost stated, "The xides will range from 5 to 20 miles and will take bikers through scenic areas in Anchorage, Overall, the bike tours will go ahead at a leisurely pace so that bikers of all skill levels can participate. However, local bikers with ample experience might lead a faster-paced group."

Bikers in the tours will learn about riding techniques, bicycle maintenance, and proper nutrition half an hour before the event starts. AU participants must have biking helmets on. They are also encouraged to bring their own water to prevent dehydration while biking.
BICYCLE TOUR SIGN-UP SHEET

If you intend to participate in the August 6 bicycle tour, please write down your name, department, and level of experience or fittness. If we have enough people sign up as advanced, we can coordinate two separate tours. If there are not enough for two tours, we would like to encourage all riders to stay together so that everyone can join in the team building exercises we have planned. Thank you for your participation and we look forward to seeing everyone at the event!

questions.question: All of the trees on the property were damaged in the storm ------ the one near the rear entrance.

explanation.en: "Considering" is the classic trap here — it sounds close in meaning to "except" but actually means "taking into account", the opposite direction of exclusion the sentence needs; always check whether the sentence is excluding something or factoring it in.
explanation.ko: "Considering"는 여기서 전형적인 함정입니다 — "except"와 의미가 비슷하게 들리지만 실제로는 "고려하여"라는 뜻으로, 문장이 필요로 하는 배제와는 반대 방향입니다 — 문장이 무언가를 배제하는지 아니면 고려하는지 항상 확인하세요.

questions.question: Mr. Hotei had to undergo several medical tests before receiving ------ diagnosis from the physician.

explanation.en: "Himself" is the most common wrong pick here because learners assume any pronoun matching the subject must be reflexive — but a reflexive pronoun only fits at a clause's end or right after the subject, never right before a noun like "diagnosis".
explanation.ko: "Himself"는 여기서 가장 흔한 오답인데, 학습자들이 주어와 일치하는 대명사는 재귀대명사여야 한다고 가정하기 때문입니다 — 하지만 재귀대명사는 절의 끝이나 주어 바로 뒤에만 어울리며, "diagnosis" 같은 명사 바로 앞에는 결코 오지 않습니다.

questions.question: Entrepreneur James Mosby is featured in the most ------ issue of the magazine.

explanation.en: "Later" is an easy wrong pick since it relates to time like "recent" does, but "the most recent" is the fixed collocation for describing something newest — "the most later" is never grammatical, so collocation, not just meaning, rules this one out.
explanation.ko: "Later"는 "recent"처럼 시간과 관련이 있어 고르기 쉬운 오답이지만, "the most recent"는 가장 최신의 것을 묘사하는 고정 연어입니다 — "the most later"는 결코 문법적으로 성립하지 않으므로, 의미뿐 아니라 연어 자체가 이 답을 배제합니다.

questions.question: The official decision made by the judge must be based ------ on the evidence presented.

explanation.en: "Remarkably" is tempting because it's also an adverb of degree, but it means "notably" (drawing attention), not "rigidly/exactly" — read for the precise shade of meaning the legal context needs (strict adherence to evidence), not just the right part of speech.
explanation.ko: "Remarkably"도 정도를 나타내는 부사이기 때문에 유혹적이지만, 이는 "엄격하게/정확하게"가 아니라 "눈에 띄게"(주목을 끄는)라는 뜻입니다 — 올바른 품사만이 아니라, 법적 맥락(증거에 대한 엄격한 준수)이 필요로 하는 정확한 의미 뉘앙스를 읽어야 합니다.

questions.question: Due to his decades of experience, Mr. Finley was responsible for the training of the ------ for the new gym.

explanation.en: When the blank sits right after "the", test-takers sometimes pick an adjective-looking option instead of a noun — memorize common noun endings (-or, -er, -ant, -ee) so you can instantly recognize "instructors" as the noun the sentence needs.
explanation.ko: 빈칸이 "the" 바로 뒤에 있을 때, 응시자들은 때때로 명사 대신 형용사처럼 보이는 선택지를 고릅니다 — 흔한 명사 어미(-or, -er, -ant, -ee)를 외워두면 "instructors"가 문장에 필요한 명사임을 즉시 알아챌 수 있습니다.

questions.question: Customers at Blaze Restaurant may use the valet parking service or park the vehicles ------.

explanation.en: A personal pronoun like "them" looks like an easy fit at the end of a sentence, but right after a noun ("the vehicles") referring back to that same noun, only the reflexive form "themselves" is grammatically correct.
explanation.ko: "them" 같은 인칭대명사는 문장 끝에 쉽게 맞는 것처럼 보이지만, 같은 명사를 다시 가리키는 명사("the vehicles") 바로 뒤에서는 재귀형인 "themselves"만이 문법적으로 옳습니다.

questions.question: Last year, the young chemists contributed ------ to the development of a new adhesive.

explanation.en: A sentence that's already grammatically complete without the blank is a strong signal the missing word is an optional adverb — don't assume every blank needs a core grammatical element; sometimes it's just extra descriptive detail like "constructively".
explanation.ko: 빈칸 없이도 이미 문법적으로 완전한 문장은 빠진 단어가 선택적 부사임을 강하게 시사합니다 — 모든 빈칸이 핵심 문법 요소를 필요로 한다고 가정하지 마세요; 때로는 "constructively"처럼 추가적인 묘사 디테일일 뿐입니다.

questions.question: The experts at Prime Carpentry can handle any piece of wooden furniture, restoring it ------ its original condition.

explanation.en: "Restore something to its original condition" is a fixed phrase where the preposition "to" cannot be swapped for "for", "in", or "with" even though those might seem interchangeable in casual English — memorize the exact preposition with the verb.
explanation.ko: "Restore something to its original condition"은 고정 표현으로, 전치사 "to"는 일상 영어에서 서로 바꿔 쓸 수 있어 보여도 "for", "in", "with"로 바꿀 수 없습니다 — 동사와 함께 정확한 전치사를 외우세요.

questions.question: The library has requested funding for ------ doors for the convenience of patrons.

explanation.en: "Frequent" is a tempting distractor since doors could plausibly open "frequently", but the sentence is about the mechanism itself (self-operating), not how often it's used — read what the adjective is actually describing before choosing.
explanation.ko: 문이 "자주" 열릴 수 있다는 점에서 "Frequent"는 유혹적인 오답이지만, 문장은 얼마나 자주 사용되는지가 아니라 메커니즘 자체(자동 작동)에 관한 것입니다 — 선택하기 전에 형용사가 실제로 무엇을 설명하는지 읽으세요.

questions.question: After noticing the wardrobe's ------ condition, the owner of the antique shop lowered its price.

explanation.en: When a blank modifies a noun ("condition"), only an adjective form fits — "deteriorating" (adjective/participle) is easy to confuse with the verb "deteriorate", so check the word's actual grammatical form, not just its root meaning.
explanation.ko: 빈칸이 명사("condition")를 수식할 때는 형용사 형태만 맞습니다 — "deteriorating"(형용사/분사)은 동사 "deteriorate"와 혼동하기 쉬우므로, 어근의 의미만이 아니라 단어의 실제 문법적 형태를 확인하세요.

questions.question: For the past decade, Henley Vivian ------ to be a talented and motivated journalist.

explanation.en: "For the past decade" is the exact trigger phrase for present perfect — an easy mistake is picking a simple past or present tense verb because the sentence otherwise reads naturally, but this specific time signal locks in "has proven".
explanation.ko: "For the past decade"는 현재완료를 위한 정확한 신호 문구입니다 — 문장이 다른 시제로도 자연스럽게 읽히기 때문에 단순과거나 현재형 동사를 고르는 실수를 하기 쉽지만, 이 특정 시간 신호는 "has proven"을 확정합니다.

questions.question: ------ who suffers from sleep problems could benefit from drinking this herbal tea.

explanation.en: "Others" is a common wrong pick because it also refers to unspecified people, but it implies other people were already mentioned — since no one was mentioned before, only "anyone" (introducing a new, general person) fits.
explanation.ko: "Others"는 특정되지 않은 사람들을 가리키기도 하기 때문에 흔한 오답이지만, 이는 이미 다른 사람들이 언급되었음을 암시합니다 — 앞에서 아무도 언급되지 않았으므로, 새롭고 일반적인 사람을 소개하는 "anyone"만이 적합합니다.

questions.question: An additional route was added to the rail line to reduce travel times in the southern ------.

explanation.en: "Function" and "distance" are both abstract nouns that could plausibly follow "in the southern ___", but only "region" pairs naturally with a geographic direction — test whether the noun can physically be located on a map.
explanation.ko: "Function"과 "distance"는 둘 다 "in the southern ___" 뒤에 그럴듯하게 올 수 있는 추상명사이지만, 지리적 방향과 자연스럽게 짝을 이루는 것은 "region"뿐입니다 — 그 명사가 실제로 지도에 위치할 수 있는지 테스트하세요.

questions.question: During the holiday season, Schwartz Department Store will ------ special makeup gift sets.

explanation.en: "Occupy" is a tricky near-miss because it can relate to space like a store does, but it means "to take up space", not "to stock/sell goods" — "carry" is the specific retail verb for having merchandise available.
explanation.ko: "Occupy"는 상점처럼 공간과 관련이 있어 까다로운 오답이지만, 이는 "공간을 차지하다"라는 뜻이지 "상품을 구비/판매하다"라는 뜻이 아닙니다 — "carry"는 상품을 갖추고 있다는 것을 나타내는 소매업 전용 동사입니다.

questions.question: Buying a home for the first time can be complocated and even ------ without help from a licensed real estate agent.

explanation.en: "Decreased" is a plausible-sounding negative adjective, but it describes a reduced quantity, not a dangerous situation — "risky" specifically captures the idea of potential harm that the sentence about buying a home without help implies.
explanation.ko: "Decreased"는 그럴듯하게 들리는 부정적 형용사이지만, 이는 줄어든 수량을 묘사하는 것이지 위험한 상황을 묘사하는 것이 아닙니다 — "risky"가 도움 없이 집을 사는 것에 관한 문장이 암시하는 잠재적 해로움의 개념을 정확히 포착합니다.

questions.question: The Brownsville Homeless Shelter has helped thousands of people since its ------ last year.

explanation.en: After a possessive ("its"), test-takers sometimes pick a verb form by mistake — only a noun like "creation" can follow a possessive pronoun, so train yourself to always expect a noun immediately after "its/his/her/their".
explanation.ko: 소유격("its") 뒤에서 응시자들은 때때로 실수로 동사 형태를 선택합니다 — "creation" 같은 명사만이 소유대명사 뒤에 올 수 있으므로, "its/his/her/their" 바로 뒤에는 항상 명사가 온다고 스스로 훈련하세요.

questions.question: The semi-finalists for the community art contest will be ------ by a panel of judges tomorrow.

explanation.en: "Complemented" (praised) is a sound-alike trap for "complimented", and both are easy to confuse in meaning with "selected" — but only "selected" fits a contest that is choosing finalists, not praising them.
explanation.ko: "Complemented"(칭찬받은)는 "complimented"와 발음이 비슷한 함정이며, 둘 다 "selected"와 의미상 혼동하기 쉽습니다 — 하지만 결선 진출자를 뽑는 대회에는 그들을 칭찬하는 것이 아니라 "selected"만이 맞습니다.

questions.question: The penalties for cancelling the cell phone contract early were ------ stated in the agreement.

explanation.en: When a sentence is grammatically complete without the blank, an adverb like "expressly" is the answer — resist the urge to search for a noun or adjective just because the sentence structure looks unfinished at first glance.
explanation.ko: 빈칸 없이도 문장이 문법적으로 완전할 때는 "expressly" 같은 부사가 정답입니다 — 언뜻 보기에 문장 구조가 미완성처럼 보인다고 해서 명사나 형용사를 찾으려는 충동을 참으세요.

questions.question: ------ the researcher's report, eating fresh fruits and vegetables more often is a better health goal than avoiding fast food.

explanation.en: "Rather than" is the sneakiest wrong option because it also introduces a comparison, but it means "instead of" (replacing one option with another), while "according to" means "as stated by" — check whether the sentence cites a source or substitutes a choice.
explanation.ko: "Rather than"도 비교를 도입하기 때문에 가장 교묘한 오답이지만, 이는 "~ 대신에"(한 선택지를 다른 것으로 대체)라는 뜻이고, "according to"는 "~에 따르면"이라는 뜻입니다 — 문장이 출처를 인용하는지 선택을 대체하는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: To make the tour accessible to Spanish speakers, the language ------ plans to provide translation services.

explanation.en: This blank forms part of the subject noun phrase itself ("the language ___"), so it needs a noun like "interpreter" — a common mistake is picking a verb form that seems to relate to language/translation without checking its grammatical role in the sentence.
explanation.ko: 이 빈칸은 주어 명사구 자체의 일부("the language ___")이므로 "interpreter" 같은 명사가 필요합니다 — 흔한 실수는 문장에서의 문법적 역할을 확인하지 않고 언어/번역과 관련되어 보이는 동사 형태를 고르는 것입니다.

questions.question: Joggers are asked to keep to the right side of the path, as ------ cyclists will need space to pass on the left.

explanation.en: "Each" is a frequent wrong pick because it also means "every one", but "each" must be followed by a singular noun, while "cyclists" is plural — always check the number of the noun right after the quantifier before choosing.
explanation.ko: "Each"는 "모든 사람"이라는 뜻도 있어 흔한 오답이지만, "each"는 반드시 단수 명사가 뒤따라야 하는 반면 "cyclists"는 복수입니다 — 선택하기 전에 항상 수량사 바로 뒤 명사의 수를 확인하세요.

questions.question: Prior to a viewing by potential buyers, the real estate agent makes sure the home is ------.

explanation.en: "Presentation" and "presenting" both sound like reasonable nominalizations of the idea, but neither makes sense after "is" describing a home's state — "presentable" (an adjective meaning neat/attractive) is the only option that fits both grammar and meaning.
explanation.ko: "Presentation"과 "presenting" 둘 다 그 개념의 그럴듯한 명사화처럼 들리지만, 집의 상태를 설명하는 "is" 뒤에서는 둘 다 의미가 통하지 않습니다 — "presentable"(단정한/매력적인이라는 뜻의 형용사)만이 문법과 의미 모두에 맞는 유일한 선택지입니다.

questions.question: For the payment ------ last week, the necessary state and federal taxes must be paid by the recipient.

explanation.en: This is a reduced relative clause ("the payment [which was] remitted last week") — learners often miss that the missing "which was" means the blank needs a past participle like "remitted", not a base verb or noun.
explanation.ko: 이것은 축약된 관계절입니다("the payment [which was] remitted last week") — 학습자들은 종종 생략된 "which was"가 빈칸에 동사 원형이나 명사가 아니라 "remitted" 같은 과거분사가 필요함을 의미한다는 것을 놓칩니다.

questions.question: Everyone is in favor of shortening working hours, but ------ the president approves the change, nothing will happen.

explanation.en: "Because" is tempting since the sentence involves a condition-like delay, but "because" signals a reason/cause, while "until" signals a time boundary ("up to the time that") — the sentence is about waiting for approval, not explaining why.
explanation.ko: 문장이 조건 같은 지연을 포함하기 때문에 "Because"는 유혹적이지만, "because"는 이유/원인을 나타내고 "until"은 시간적 경계("~할 때까지")를 나타냅니다 — 이 문장은 이유를 설명하는 것이 아니라 승인을 기다리는 것에 관한 것입니다.

questions.question: The manufacturing company's recent ------ to reduce on-site accidents was appreciated by the staff.

explanation.en: "Value" is a near-miss because it's also a positive abstract noun, but the sentence needs a noun meaning "an effort to do something" (attempt), not "worth/importance" — always substitute your chosen word back into the sentence to test if the meaning truly fits.
explanation.ko: "Value"도 긍정적인 추상명사이기 때문에 까다로운 오답이지만, 문장은 "가치/중요성"이 아니라 "무언가를 하려는 노력"(attempt)을 의미하는 명사가 필요합니다 — 선택한 단어를 항상 문장에 다시 넣어서 의미가 진짜로 맞는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: The dining room furniture was left ------ in the house because the new owner bought it.

explanation.en: When a sentence reads as grammatically complete without the blank, the missing word is likely an adverb — don't overthink it into a noun or adjective just because the sentence topic (safety/accidents) feels like it needs a "heavier" word.
explanation.ko: 빈칸 없이도 문장이 문법적으로 완전하게 읽힌다면, 빠진 단어는 부사일 가능성이 높습니다 — 문장 주제(안전/사고)가 "더 무거운" 단어가 필요하다고 느끼게 한다고 해서 명사나 형용사로 지나치게 생각하지 마세요.

questions.question: The Garrison Theater will _ _ allow student groups to view rehearsals during the day.

explanation.en: "Substantially" is a common wrong pick because it also implies a significant degree, but it means "to a great extent", the opposite frequency implication of "occasionally" (from time to time) that the sentence about allowing rehearsal viewing needs.
explanation.ko: "Substantially"도 상당한 정도를 암시하기 때문에 흔한 오답이지만, 이는 "상당한 정도로"라는 뜻으로, 리허설 관람을 허용하는 것에 관한 문장이 필요로 하는 "occasionally"(가끔)의 빈도 의미와는 반대입니다.

questions.question: Pro Sports magazine made a name for itself ------ the publication of a series of exclusive interviews with top athletes.

explanation.en: "So" is a tempting wrong pick because it can also connect two related ideas, but it means "therefore" (a result), while "with" here means "by means of" — check whether the second half of the sentence explains a cause/result or a method.
explanation.ko: "So"는 두 관련 개념을 연결할 수도 있어 유혹적인 오답이지만, 이는 "그러므로"(결과)라는 뜻이고 여기서 "with"는 "~을 통해"라는 뜻입니다 — 문장의 뒷부분이 원인/결과를 설명하는지 방법을 설명하는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: Only ------ delegates wearing their ID badges will be allowed into the conference venue.

explanation.en: This is another reduced relative clause ("people who [are] delegates" → "those") — the trap is treating the blank as a simple subject pronoun choice instead of recognizing the clause has been shortened, which is what makes "those" the only fit.
explanation.ko: 이것은 또 다른 축약 관계절입니다("people who [are] delegates" → "those") — 함정은 절이 축약되었다는 것을 인식하지 못하고 빈칸을 단순한 주격 대명사 선택으로 취급하는 것이며, 그것이 바로 "those"만이 유일하게 적합한 이유입니다.

questions.question: ------ the candidate's official announcement that he will run for office, he met privately with his advisors.

explanation.en: "As long as" is a strong distractor because it also expresses a time/condition relationship, but it must be followed by a full clause, while the blank here is followed by a noun phrase ("the candidate's official announcement") — check the grammar of what follows before the meaning.
explanation.ko: "As long as"도 시간/조건 관계를 나타내기 때문에 강력한 오답이지만, 반드시 완전한 절이 뒤따라야 하는 반면, 여기 빈칸 뒤에는 명사구("the candidate's official announcement")가 옵니다 — 의미보다 먼저 뒤따르는 내용의 문법을 확인하세요.

items.description:
It's Raining Cats and Dogs

Brentwood (May 2) - - [1] - Brentwood City finally has its very own cat cafe called Catastrophe and dog cafe called Hotdogs, both opened by owners Kevin and Ginger Blake. Both cafes opened last month to fanfare and a great deal of press coverage. - [2] - "Business has been booming", says Kevin Blake. "We knew we'd be successful; we just didn't think we'd be this successfull". Not only are customers enthusiastically flocking to both cafes to hang out with the animals while drinking coffee and tea, many of them are adopting the animals and giving them forever homes. - [3] - "We thought it would be a good idea to take in some of the animals because of the overcrowding in many of the shelters", explained Ginger Blake. "And customers have a chance to interact with the animals, which is the best form of advertisement for the shelters." Since the cafes' opening, more than 10 dogs and 15 cats have been adopted. "I don't yet own a dog, but I've always wanted one," says Laurie Jordan, a regular customer. "I come here to play with them. Maybe one day I'll find a dog that I really want." - [4] -
Because of the success, the Blakes are considering expanding by purchasing the adjacent shops. "We need more space to fit all our customers and the animals," explained Kevin. "It can get very crowded at times," The Blakes are looking to renovate the dog cafe next month and the cat cafe during the fall.

Movies in the Park

This fall Glenwood Springs Park will host a weekly Movies in the Park night for residents of Gilenwood Springs. In cooperation with various local business sponsors including Paxton Inc. and GS Mall, family-friendly movies will be shown every Friday night at the center of the park. Tickets are not necessary for these events because they are free to the public.

Running from September through November, Movies in the Park promises a wonderful line-up of fun and touching movies for the whole family. You are encouraged to bring blankets and chairs as well as picnic snacks. Movie starting times depend on sunset times, so it is advised to come early to secure your spot beforehand. Please visit our website at www..gllenwoodsprings.org/movies to see a schedule of upcoming films and a list of our local sponsors.

In the event of heavy rain, low temperatures, or strong winds, the film screening may be canceled. If this occurs, the announcement for the film cancellation will be made both on our website and on the local radio. You can also ask about event cancellations by calling the Glenwood Springs Department of Parks and Recreation at 715-555-5358.

Kenneth Global Journalism internship

The Kenneth Global Journalism Internship will provide you with great opportunities to train with the world's most renowned international multimedia news agency, work with professional reporters and editors, and gain valuable experiences in fast-paced newsrooms in big cities such as London, Berlin, and Paris. It will offer talented college graduates an opportunity to learn and develop their journalistic skills and first-hand knowledge.

This is a paid internship that offers free lodging as well as lunch and dinner. Interns will receive several weeks of formal training focused on writing skills, journalism ethics, and basic workplace knowledge. They are also able to take advantage of other regularly scheduled training opportunities during the internship free of charge. The internship will last 4 months, beginning on August 1.

Applications for the internship can be found on our website at www.kennethglobal.com and must be submitted by June 20. Applicants who advance past this stage will be asked to interview at our headquarters on June 27. Any questions can be directed toward Ruby Hart at rubyhart@kennethglobal.com or asked in person at our headquarters in Austin.

items.description:
April 5—Clearwater Hospital in downtown Scranton has launched a new pen pal letter-writing program between terminally ill hospital patients and adult volunteers. Hospital Director Zack Chambers, who was recently presented with an Outstanding Leader Award from the National Health Care Alliance, started the program to create stronger connections between the hospital and the community. Mr. Chambers encourages adults of all types and occupations to apply even if they don't feel completely qualified. Simply visit the Clearwater Hospital website and become a member of the hospital free of charge.

"I hope through this program, volunteers can form close relationships with patients to help them get through these difficult times in their lives," said Mr. Chambers. He also hopes that the program will lead to more people visiting terminally ill patients in person.
Clearwater Hospital
May 4

Monica Greene
4100 Washington Road
Scranton, Wisconsin 54481

Dear Ms. Greene,

I was delighted to receive your letter, I am very excited to have been paired with you as pen pals. I hope we can learn a lot from each other and build a lasting friendship.

As you know, I live in California, which is a long way from Wisconsin. 1 hope that in the coming months I can find some time off work and visit you. Please let me know when the most convenient time would be for me to meet you.

I look forward to hearing from you,
Jessica Wrigt
Dear Jessica,

You don't know how much I appreciate your kind words. Although the staff at Clearwater are very kind, I feel the need to connect with people who are not part of the staff. My surviving family also live a great distance away, in Florida, and so most of the time I am just communicating with the paid staff or the other patients. I would welcome a visit, if you truly wanted to come, and the best time would be for our meeting is the Thanksgiving holiday party here at the center I suppose. My own family might be here as well. If it is too much for you, or if you can't get the time off of work, don't worry about it too much. I do hope that we can continue to communicate through our letters.

All the best,
Monica Greene

Mr, John Morris
1423 Bernard Avenue
Millville, CA 90117

Dear Mr. Morris,

24/7 Fitness is the most successful workout facility in the United States, With over 3 million members nationwide, our franchise has become known as a reputable and trustworthy brand. Our success is a result of great relationships between us the franchiser and our franchisees.

You are receiving this mailing because you expressed interest in partnering with 24/7 Fitness in order to open a new location in your town. According to our preliminary research, your town has a large population of young, single people working in the professional field. This is our target demographic, and it means the business outlook for your 24/7 Fitness location is positive in your town. If you would like more information about the specific terms and regulations when partnering with 24/7 Fitness, please don't hesitate to call me at 347-555-3363. Additionally, if you would like to talk to another franchise owner, that information can be supplied by one of our associates.

Sincerely,
Lori Swanson
Chief Operating Officer
To: Zack Carter <zcarter@zenmail.com>
From: John Morris <jimorris@cbnet.com>
Subject: 24/7 Fitness
Date: March 6
Dear Mr. Carter,

My name is John Morris and I am a small business owner living in the Millville area. I am currently in negotiations with 24/7 Fitness to open my own location here in Millville. As someone who works with 24/7 Fitness, you would help me a lot by sharing your opinions.

I am interested in how you assess 24/7 Fitness as a franchiser. I operated several franchises in the past, and I always found that trust and honesty are the most important factors in a successful relationship. More importantly, I was also wondering what kind of support is provided by the parent company. Before opening your location, did you receive adequate training to allow you to smoothly begin operating your business? Any advice you can give me would be much appreciated.

Sincerely,
John Morris
To: John Morris <jmorris@cbnet.com>
From: Zack Carter <zcarter@zenmail.com>
Subject: 24/7 Fitness
Date: March 7
Dear Mr. Morris,

I am happy to provide some insight into the operation of a 24/7 Fitness franchise. I have been working with 24/7 Fitness as a franchise owner for 10 years now. I actually run three different branches now. I completely agree with you that trust and honesty are the two most important aspects of any business relationship. On that count, I believe the fact that I own three franchises is testament to my faith in the franchiser.

Let me put your mind at ease. First off, 24/7 Fitness has a very specific way that they want their brand to develop no matter who owns the branch. The parent company will not only provide training, but they insist on controlling the actual layout of the facilities from the locker rooms to the free weights. They want any of their 3 million members to be able to walk into any one of their gyms and feel at home. Until you have been operating for one full year, you must make monthly reports to corporate headquarters detailing all aspects of sales, membership, and a flow chart describing the usage of the facilities. It really is hands on until they have confidence you can represent the brand. I hope this helps you decide to join the 24/7 Fitness team!

All the best,
Zack Carter

items.description:
To: Kevin Scott <kevinscott@startrealty.com>
From: Steven Mason <smason@turnerelectronics.com>
Date: February 2
Subject: A warehouse
Dear Mr. Scott,

My name is Steven Mason and I work for the consumer electronics company Turner Electronics. I am currently scouting for a warehouse in the Pittsburg area. As you know, having an effective distribution strategy is critical for every company in today's fast-paced business world.

Therefore, I am looking for a warehouse located in the outskirts of Pittsburg. The warehouse needs to be located close to the highway. We are shipping a high volume of products, so we would prefer a dedicated warehouse to be used exclusively for Turner Electronics operations. A warehouse with a spacious loading bay for large trucks is necessary. Additionally, a warehouse that also has office space would be ideal. Because of the valuable nature of our products, we would like a warehouse that provides precautions against theft and damage.

I look forward to hearing your response soon.

Steven Mason
Turner Electronics
To: Steven Mason <smason@turnerelectronics.com>
From: Kevin Scott <kevinscott@startrealty.com>
Date: February 3
Subject: Re: A warehouse
Dear Mr. Mason,

It seems that as your company expands, you would like to improve the operations of your distribution network and deliver products to sellers more quickly. We have a variety of warehouse options, and I trust one of them will fit your company's needs. All locations have a state-of-the-art security system as well as experienced staff.

Location 1—$3,499 per month for a 10,000-square-foot warehouse space shared by multiple businesses. Because this location is a shared operations site, we offer it at a discounted price.
Location 2-$5,500 per month for an older warehouse located in downtown Pittsburg. This warehouse is currently empty, and therefore can be used by your company exclusively. It also features a walk-in freezer.
Location 3-$6,500 per month for a very spacious warehouse located a few miles outside of Pittsburg. Although currently used by two other businesses as a storage space, it can be converted into a warehouse only for your company.
Location 4—$2,600 per month for a medium-size warehouse. This warehouse is provided at a discounted price because it has no area for trucks to unload cargo conveniently. It is best for smaller-sized operations.

These are the locations currently available for use. If you have any questions or would like to visit a .location in person, please contact me.

Kevin Scott
To: Kevin Scott <kevinscott@startrealty.com>
From: Steven Mason <smason@turnerelectronics.com>
Date: February 3
Subject: Location 3
Dear Mr. Scott,

Thank you so much for responding to my inquiry so quickly. Although none of the warehouses is exactly what I was looking for, I think the best option for our business will be Location 3. This, of course, is contingent on the other two businesses moving their storage into another warehouse. Our operations, as I noted in my first e-mail, are expanding, and I want to make sure that we have ample room to grow. I am delighted that there is security at your warehouses as well.

I have some time early next week if it would be possible to take a walk through Location 3. I think once I get a feel for the space, I will be able to make a firm decision. Please contact me by phone at your convenience so we can set up a time.
You can reach me at (351) 546-9899.

All the best,
Steve Mason
Turner Electronics
