explanation.en: "Attract" (A, verb) and "attracted" (C, past participle) are tempting because they share the same root as the correct answer, but after "to be", only the plain adjective "attractive" fits — checking the word's exact grammatical category, not just its root, is the key skill here.
explanation.ko: "Attract"(A, 동사)와 "attracted"(C, 과거분사)는 정답과 같은 어근을 공유하기 때문에 유혹적이지만, "to be" 뒤에는 순수 형용사 "attractive"만이 적합합니다 — 어근만이 아니라 단어의 정확한 문법 범주를 확인하는 것이 여기서 핵심 기술입니다.

questions.question: For Friday's dinner reservation, please ------ the number of seats from eight to ten guests.

explanation.en: "Reflect" (B) and "invite" (C) are both plausible-sounding verbs in a business context, but neither fits the specific meaning of "raising the number of seats from 8 to 10" — always translate the sentence's actual meaning rather than picking a verb that merely sounds professional.
explanation.ko: "Reflect"(B)와 "invite"(C)는 둘 다 비즈니스 맥락에서 그럴듯한 동사이지만, "좌석 수를 8개에서 10개로 늘리는" 구체적 의미에는 맞지 않습니다 — 그저 전문적으로 들리는 동사를 고르지 말고 항상 문장의 실제 의미를 파악하세요.

questions.question: Mr. Brandt asked for the banner to be hung ------ the exterior wall of the building.

explanation.en: "Interior" (opposite of the correct "exterior") is the classic trap here — both are adjectives about location, so this tests vocabulary meaning, not grammar; always re-read for whether the sentence describes inside or outside.
explanation.ko: "Interior"(정답인 "exterior"의 반대)는 여기서 전형적인 함정입니다 — 둘 다 위치에 관한 형용사이므로, 이는 문법이 아니라 어휘 의미를 시험합니다 — 문장이 안쪽을 묘사하는지 바깥쪽을 묘사하는지 항상 다시 읽으세요.

questions.question: In case you have problems with the device in the future, you should retain your newly ------ receipt.

explanation.en: "Express" (A) and "predict" (B) are both verbs that could describe an action related to a receipt, but only "issued" correctly describes a receipt that was given out — check what the noun (receipt) is meant to receive as an action, not just verb plausibility.
explanation.ko: "Express"(A)와 "predict"(B)는 둘 다 영수증과 관련된 동작을 묘사할 수 있는 동사이지만, 발급된 영수증을 올바르게 묘사하는 것은 "issued"뿐입니다 — 동사의 그럴듯함만이 아니라 명사(receipt)가 어떤 동작을 받아야 하는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: If the patient's nasal problem does not show signs of improvement ------ two days, he should visit the clinic again.

explanation.en: "Regarding" (B) is a common wrong pick because it also sounds like it could introduce a time-related clause, but it means "about/concerning" a topic — "within" is the correct preposition for a time frame ("within two days"), so match the preposition to the specific relationship (time vs. topic).
explanation.ko: "Regarding"(B)는 시간 관련 절을 도입할 수 있을 것처럼 들려서 흔한 오답이지만, 이는 주제에 대해 "~에 관하여"라는 뜻입니다 — "within"이 기간("이틀 이내")에 맞는 올바른 전치사이므로, 전치사를 정확한 관계(시간 대 주제)에 맞추세요.

questions.question: Those giving demonstrations at the department store ------ explained the product's features and benefits.

explanation.en: "Enthusiast" (B, a noun for a person) is a sneaky trap because it looks similar to the correct adverb "enthusiastically" — remember that a blank modifying a verb (explained) always needs an adverb, never a noun, no matter how related the words look.
explanation.ko: "Enthusiast"(B, 사람을 뜻하는 명사)는 정답인 부사 "enthusiastically"와 비슷해 보여서 교묘한 함정입니다 — 동사(explained)를 수식하는 빈칸은 단어들이 아무리 관련 있어 보여도 항상 부사가 필요하지 명사가 필요하지 않다는 것을 기억하세요.

questions.question: Because its latest exhibit is highly valuable, the Gabe Gallery took more precautions than it ------ did in the past.

explanation.en: "Yet" (B) is tempting because it's also time-related, but it means "not yet" (negative expectation), while "ever" specifically refers to past experience up to now — the phrase "more...than it ever did" is a fixed comparative pattern worth memorizing.
explanation.ko: "Yet"(B)도 시간과 관련이 있어 유혹적이지만, 이는 "아직"(부정적 기대)이라는 뜻이고, "ever"는 특별히 현재까지의 과거 경험을 가리킵니다 — "more...than it ever did"라는 표현은 외워둘 만한 고정 비교 패턴입니다.

questions.question: ------ making structural changes to a house must first apply for a building permit.

explanation.en: "Who" (B) and "them" (C) are common wrong picks because they're both pronoun-like, but "who" is a relative pronoun (not a standalone subject) and "them" is an object pronoun — only "anyone" can stand alone as the subject of the main verb "must apply".
explanation.ko: "Who"(B)와 "them"(C)은 둘 다 대명사처럼 보여서 흔한 오답이지만, "who"는 관계대명사(독립적인 주어가 아님)이고 "them"은 목적격 대명사입니다 — 주동사 "must apply"의 주어로 홀로 설 수 있는 것은 "anyone"뿐입니다.

questions.question: Employees who attend the workshop on improving communication skills will be given a certificate of ------ by the instructor.

explanation.en: Since a preposition ("of") both precedes and follows this blank, the safe default is a noun — "achievement" fits, and this pattern (noun surrounded by prepositions) is a reliable shortcut whenever you're unsure of the part of speech needed.
explanation.ko: 전치사("of")가 이 빈칸의 앞뒤에 모두 있으므로, 안전한 기본값은 명사입니다 — "achievement"가 맞으며, 이 패턴(전치사로 둘러싸인 명사)은 필요한 품사가 확실하지 않을 때 믿을 만한 지름길입니다.

questions.question: ------ its distinguished faculty in the science department, the university has state-of-the-art laboratory facilities.

explanation.en: "Otherwise", "as well", and "hardly ever" (B, C, D) are all adverbs that could seem to fit generally, but only "in addition to" (A) is a preposition that can correctly connect to the following noun phrase ("its distinguished faculty") — check what grammatically follows the blank.
explanation.ko: "Otherwise", "as well", "hardly ever"(B, C, D)는 모두 대체로 맞아 보이는 부사이지만, 뒤따르는 명사구("its distinguished faculty")와 올바르게 연결될 수 있는 전치사는 "in addition to"(A)뿐입니다 — 빈칸 뒤에 문법적으로 무엇이 오는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: The donations received from the fundraiser ------ among the charity's three locations equally.

explanation.en: The verb "divide" is transitive and followed by a preposition ("among") here — a common mistake is picking an active form, but this structure signals passive voice is needed ("will be divided"), matching the plural subject "the donations".
explanation.ko: 동사 "divide"는 타동사이며 여기서는 전치사("among")가 뒤따릅니다 — 흔한 실수는 능동태를 선택하는 것이지만, 이 구조는 복수 주어 "the donations"와 맞는 수동태("will be divided")가 필요함을 나타냅니다.

questions.question: ------ tthe building's age, the ventilation system must be up-to-date with all safety codes.

explanation.en: "Since" (D) is a trap because it also means "because", similar in feel to "regardless of", but "since" must be followed by a full clause (subject + verb), while the blank here precedes a noun phrase ("the building's age") — always check the grammar of what follows first.
explanation.ko: "Since"(D)도 "때문에"라는 뜻이 있어 "regardless of"와 느낌이 비슷한 함정이지만, "since"는 반드시 완전한 절(주어+동사)이 뒤따라야 하는 반면, 여기서 빈칸은 명사구("the building's age") 앞에 있습니다 — 항상 뒤따르는 것의 문법을 먼저 확인하세요.

questions.question: The train delays on the Trenton line were caused by a ------ error at one of the stations.

explanation.en: "Proceed" (A, verb) and "proceeded" (B, past tense verb) are tempting since they share the root with the correct "procedural", but a blank directly before a noun ("error") always needs an adjective — the shared root is a distraction, not a clue.
explanation.ko: "Proceed"(A, 동사)와 "proceeded"(B, 과거 동사)는 정답인 "procedural"과 어근을 공유하기 때문에 유혹적이지만, 명사("error") 바로 앞의 빈칸은 항상 형용사가 필요합니다 — 공유된 어근은 주의를 흐트러뜨리는 것이지 단서가 아닙니다.

questions.question: As we expect to receive hundreds of applications for the position, please ------ your resume to two pages.

explanation.en: "Follow" (B) and "unfold" (D) are both plausible verbs about instructions/documents, but the sentence specifically means "keep the resume within a length constraint" — "limit" is the only verb matching that specific meaning of restricting length.
explanation.ko: "Follow"(B)와 "unfold"(D)는 둘 다 지시사항/문서에 관한 그럴듯한 동사이지만, 문장은 구체적으로 "이력서를 분량 제한 내로 유지하는" 것을 의미합니다 — "limit"이 그 분량 제한이라는 특정 의미에 맞는 유일한 동사입니다.

questions.question: The lecturer ------ on the country's struggle for independence when he gives his talk.

explanation.en: This is a classic time-clause pattern: main clause uses future tense ("will V"), but the "when" clause must stay in simple present, not future — a common mistake is putting "will" in both clauses when only one should have it.
explanation.ko: 이것은 전형적인 시간절 패턴입니다: 주절은 미래시제("will V")를 사용하지만, "when"절은 미래가 아니라 단순현재를 유지해야 합니다 — 흔한 실수는 하나의 절에만 있어야 할 "will"을 두 절 모두에 넣는 것입니다.

questions.question: The welcome activity is an opportunity to improve communication ------ volunteers before the project begins.

explanation.en: "Between" is the trap that comes to mind for "among", but "between" is specifically for two people/things while "among" is for three or more — "volunteers" (a group) signals "among" is needed, not "between".
explanation.ko: "Between"은 "among"을 보면 떠오르는 함정이지만, "between"은 특별히 두 사람/사물에만 쓰이고 "among"은 셋 이상일 때 쓰입니다 — "volunteers"(그룹)는 "between"이 아니라 "among"이 필요함을 나타냅니다.

questions.question: The balconies connected to the rooms at the Orwell Hotel provide a ------ view of a private beach.

explanation.en: "Stunned" (D, past participle meaning shocked/surprised, describing a person) is easy to confuse with "stunning" (C, meaning breathtakingly beautiful, describing a thing) — a view can be "stunning" but never "stunned"; match -ing/-ed endings to whether the noun is a person or a thing.
explanation.ko: "Stunned"(D, 충격받은/놀란이라는 뜻의 과거분사로 사람을 묘사)는 "stunning"(C, 숨막히게 아름답다는 뜻으로 사물을 묘사)과 혼동하기 쉽습니다 — 전망은 "stunning"할 수 있지만 결코 "stunned"할 수 없습니다 — 명사가 사람인지 사물인지에 맞춰 -ing/-ed 어미를 맞추세요.

questions.question: The travel agent's ------ of the ticket purchase was sent to the customer by e-mail as soon as the payment was made.

explanation.en: "Extent", "awareness", and "proposal" (A, C, D) are all abstract nouns that sound business-appropriate, but only "confirmation" fits the specific meaning of a notice sent after a purchase — always check meaning fit, not just whether the noun sounds formal enough.
explanation.ko: "Extent", "awareness", "proposal"(A, C, D)는 모두 비즈니스에 적합하게 들리는 추상명사이지만, 구매 후 발송되는 통지라는 특정 의미에 맞는 것은 "confirmation"뿐입니다 — 명사가 충분히 격식 있게 들리는지가 아니라 항상 의미가 맞는지를 확인하세요.

questions.question: After examining the vehicle, the mechanic had ------ identified the reason why the engine lost power.

explanation.en: "Corrections" (A, noun) and "correct" (C, adjective) are tempting since they share the root with the right answer, but a blank modifying the verb "identified" needs the adverb "correctly" — always check what word the blank is actually modifying.
explanation.ko: "Corrections"(A, 명사)와 "correct"(C, 형용사)는 정답과 어근을 공유하기 때문에 유혹적이지만, 동사 "identified"를 수식하는 빈칸은 부사 "correctly"가 필요합니다 — 빈칸이 실제로 어떤 단어를 수식하는지 항상 확인하세요.

questions.question: Because of her hearing disability, Ms. Frasier will be ------ by a sign language expert so she can participate in the meeting.

explanation.en: "Convinced" and "cautioned" (A, D) are near-miss verbs about influencing someone, but the sentence specifically needs "accompanied" (going along with someone) to match the meaning of a hearing-impaired person being assisted by an expert — test the exact real-world scenario the sentence describes.
explanation.ko: "Convinced"와 "cautioned"(A, D)는 누군가에게 영향을 미치는 것에 관한 근접 동사이지만, 문장은 청각 장애가 있는 사람이 전문가의 도움을 받는다는 의미에 맞도록 구체적으로 "accompanied"(누군가와 동행하다)가 필요합니다 — 문장이 묘사하는 정확한 현실적 시나리오를 테스트하세요.

questions.question: The project development team is partially responsible for the selection and ------ of potential building sites.

explanation.en: The preposition "of" right after the blank is the giveaway that a noun is needed here — "appraisal" (assessment) fits, so whenever you see a preposition immediately following a blank, strongly favor a noun over a verb form.
explanation.ko: 이 빈칸 바로 뒤에 오는 전치사 "of"는 여기에 명사가 필요하다는 확실한 단서입니다 — "appraisal"(평가)이 맞으므로, 빈칸 바로 뒤에 전치사가 오는 것을 볼 때마다 동사 형태보다 명사를 강하게 선호하세요.

questions.question: The easy-to-prepare meal packets come with all the ingredients necessarry for an individual dinner ------ boiling water.

explanation.en: "Despite" and "past" (B, D) are tempting since they're also common prepositions, but only "except" fits the meaning "everything is included but boiling water" — this tests precise meaning among several grammatically valid prepositions, not just grammar.
explanation.ko: "Despite"와 "past"(B, D)도 흔한 전치사이기 때문에 유혹적이지만, "끓는 물을 제외한 모든 것이 포함되어 있다"는 의미에 맞는 것은 "except"뿐입니다 — 이는 문법적으로 유효한 여러 전치사 중에서 정확한 의미를 시험하는 것이지, 단순히 문법만을 시험하는 것이 아닙니다.

questions.question: The education center provides training classes in key skills ------ that the unemployed can find jobs more easily.

explanation.en: "So that" is a fixed purpose conjunction always paired with "can/could" in the following clause — memorize this whole pattern as a unit rather than treating "so" and "that" as separate, analyzable words.
explanation.ko: "So that"는 항상 뒤따르는 절에서 "can/could"와 짝을 이루는 고정된 목적 접속사입니다 — "so"와 "that"을 분리하여 분석 가능한 단어로 취급하지 말고 이 전체 패턴을 하나의 단위로 외우세요.

questions.question: The terms of the licensing agreement are quite ------ and do not require legal experience to be understood.

explanation.en: "Energetic" and "accomplished" (A, D) are positive-sounding adjectives that could describe many things, but only "straightforward" specifically means "easy to understand", matching a sentence about not requiring legal expertise — always verify the adjective's precise meaning against the sentence's logic.
explanation.ko: "Energetic"와 "accomplished"(A, D)는 많은 것을 묘사할 수 있는 긍정적인 형용사이지만, 구체적으로 "이해하기 쉬운"을 의미하는 것은 "straightforward"뿐이며, 이는 법적 전문지식이 필요 없다는 문장과 맞습니다 — 항상 형용사의 정확한 의미를 문장의 논리에 맞춰 확인하세요.

questions.question: The informational materials sent to conference attendees ------ the presentation schedule and social events.

explanation.en: "Expand", "solicit", and "allow" (A, B, C) are all verbs that could plausibly relate to documents, but only "outline" (to sketch out/summarize) matches materials that summarize a schedule — verbs with similar formality can still have very different precise meanings.
explanation.ko: "Expand", "solicit", "allow"(A, B, C)는 모두 문서와 그럴듯하게 관련될 수 있는 동사이지만, 일정을 요약하는 자료에 맞는 것은 "outline"(개요를 서술하다/요약하다)뿐입니다 — 격식 수준이 비슷한 동사라도 정확한 의미는 매우 다를 수 있습니다.

questions.question: You may have the merchandise sent directly to your home or pick it up in person at the store, ------ you prefer.

explanation.en: "Everybody" and "another" (C, D) are tempting because the sentence involves choice, but the structure "...or..., ___ you prefer" specifically needs "whichever" (referring back to the two options just given) — recognize this specific two-choice pattern.
explanation.ko: "Everybody"와 "another"(C, D)는 문장이 선택을 포함하기 때문에 유혹적이지만, "...or..., ___ you prefer" 구조는 구체적으로 "whichever"(방금 제시된 두 선택지를 다시 가리킴)가 필요합니다 — 이 특정한 두 선택지 패턴을 인식하세요.

questions.question: ------ occurring substances are used in the vitamin supplement instead of chemicals.

explanation.en: "Natural" (B, adjective) is the classic trap for "naturally" (A, adverb) — the pattern "adverb + adjective" (naturally occurring) is easy to get backwards, so always check whether the blank modifies a following adjective/verb or a noun.
explanation.ko: "Natural"(B, 형용사)은 "naturally"(A, 부사)에 대한 전형적인 함정입니다 — "부사 + 형용사"(naturally occurring) 패턴은 뒤바뀌기 쉬우므로, 빈칸이 뒤따르는 형용사/동사를 수식하는지 명사를 수식하는지 항상 확인하세요.

questions.question: The bus driver used a side street rather than the main highway, ------ avoiding rush hour traffic.

explanation.en: "Than" and "unless" (B, C) are tempting connectors, but the sentence needs "thereby" (meaning "as a result of this") to link an action (using a side street) with its consequence (avoiding traffic) — look for a cause-effect relationship, not comparison or condition.
explanation.ko: "Than"과 "unless"(B, C)는 유혹적인 연결어이지만, 문장은 어떤 행동(옆길 이용)을 그 결과(교통 정체 회피)와 연결하기 위해 "thereby"("그 결과로"라는 뜻)가 필요합니다 — 비교나 조건이 아니라 원인-결과 관계를 찾으세요.

questions.question: The crew members ------ the main section of the building by the time the waste removal trucks arrive at 3:30.

explanation.en: This is the fixed future-perfect time pattern: "will have + past participle" + "by the time" + present tense clause — a common mistake is using future tense in the "by the time" clause too, when it must stay present.
explanation.ko: 이것은 고정된 미래완료 시간 패턴입니다: "will have + 과거분사" + "by the time" + 현재시제절 — 흔한 실수는 "by the time" 절에도 미래시제를 사용하는 것인데, 그 절은 현재시제여야 합니다.

questions.question: Should you find any manufacturing ------ in your ultra-high-definition television, contact the place of purchase as soon as possible.

explanation.en: "Premises", "impacts", and "distractions" (A, C, D) are all plausible business/product nouns, but only "defects" (flaws/faults) fits a sentence about manufacturing problems in a television — always match the noun to the specific complaint scenario described.
explanation.ko: "Premises", "impacts", "distractions"(A, C, D)는 모두 그럴듯한 비즈니스/제품 명사이지만, 텔레비전 제조 문제에 관한 문장에 맞는 것은 "defects"(결함/하자)뿐입니다 — 항상 명사를 설명된 구체적인 불만 시나리오에 맞추세요.

items.description: Come visit Wild Water Parks, your summer destination for family and friends of all ages. We have kiddie pools, we have outdoor pools, we have indoor pools, we have waves, and we have (131) ------ water slides, including our Death Fall, the largest slide in the state. We have everything for everyone in (132) ------ group. Don't forget our delicious snack stands and restaurants. We also have gift shops and playgrounds. (133) ------. items.description:
Northshore Financial News

June 29-A local mainstay at Northshore City may soon go nationnaal. - [1] - The Northshore Creamery first opened its doors in 1951 by owner Bill Bradley and has become an iconic landmark of the city with it's huge rotating ice cream cone on the roof of the shop. Over the years it has remained a local favorite hangout for the residents of the city and soon captured the eyes of tourists driving through. - [2] - Bill Jr. took over the business and expanded the shop to keep up with the demand of locals and tourists. Northshore Creamery was even selected as a top-ten shop to visit by Travel & Tour Magazine.
In 1988, Northshore Creamery was featured in the hit Hollywood movie Future Then and Now, which made it the top ice cream shop to visit by out-of-towners and tourists. - [3] - Efforts were made by various corporations to buy the business from the Bradley family, but Bill Jr. and his son William insisted on keeping the business within the family, which pleased the residents of Northshore. - [4] - "We're keeping things small in scale and we're slowly expanding", explained William. "In order to keep the quality of our ice cream fresh andjust the way my grandfather created his recipes, we don't want to take any short cuts, which is why we need time."

Unsworthy Manufacturing
Date: Wednesday, October 17
Subject: Recycling

In response to pressure from local environmental groups, as of November 1 we will be separating all of our industrial waste for recycHng. Collections will be made twice weekly on Tuesdays and Fridays from the regional recycling center, which will be supplying colored receptacles for different kinds of waste. All oils should be placed in the green container. All metals and glass belong in the red one. ATI paper waste should go into the blue one. Plastics will be collected for recyclrng as normal.

As this new policy also carries a financial benefit to the company, managers In all manufacturing bays are responsible for ensuring that the new protocols for waste disposal are followed, and failure to comply with the policy could result in disciplinary action.

Further information about our updated environmental practices will shortly be available on the website. Training sessions for managers will be held on Monday, October 22, but please contact me if you have any further questions in the meantime.

Regards,
Davis Jeeland
Operations Director, Unsworthy Manufacturing

April 9
Dear Normanville Resident,

This year's first Normanville Farmers' Market will be open on Saturday, April 14, on Clark Street, between Main Street and Park Street. The farmers' market will be available between 9:00A.M. and 5s:o00o P.M. The mayor of Normanville, Tom Daley, will be present to deliver an address at the opening ceremony. "This vibrant market will give our local farmers a nice place to sell their fresh produce. Additionally, because we cut out some middle processes, our prices are lower than those of average grocery stores," said Suzy Hammer, executive director of the Normanville Farmers' Association.

Please come this Saturday and see what the Normanville Farmers' Market has to offer!

Sincerely,
Naormanville Farmers' Association

Tech Life Hires New CEO

New York, April 12—'Amid a crisis of low sales and disappointing performance, the technology company Tech Life has hired Steve Cross as its new chief executive officer. Previously, he was the chief financial officer at the technology investment firm Esta Resources in San Francisco, California. He assumed the position of CEO at the company—based in Dallas, Texas just this Monday. Stockholders voted unanimously for the appointment, hoping the new CEO will bring renewed vitality and strength to thecompany.

"Mr. Cross has an impressive record as a business leader who makes smart decisions," commented Lynn Dyer, the director of human resources at Tech Life. "We have faith that he will lead us in a new direction that will help develop new markets and optimize our company operations hi general,"

Steve Cross graduated from Chester University in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania, with a master's degree in business administration. He once served as head of the American League of Business Leaders and is a dedicated family man.

items.description:
To: Lillian Ross <lillian@goods.com>
From: Eric West <eric@gmail.com>
Date: November 4, 10:34 A.M.
Subject: Website Development
Attachment: Details
Dear Ms. Ross,

You contacted us last week in order to ask some of our computer programmers to help your company develop a website. JM Solutions would be happy to offer you our services.

As I said on the phone, we will help design and program a website that will attract more customers and offer an online sales platform. During this time, we will need to hold meetings with your marketing division in order to best capture your company's goals. Once the website has been completed in mid-February next year, we will hold a training seminar in order to train your employees in the skills necessary to maintain and update your website. The website development and training seminar will cost a total of $32,000. We request that a deposit of 10% be paid in advance. Please see the attached file for detailed costs and schedules.

We look forward to working with you in the near future. Our staff members will strive to meet all your needs. Therefore, just let me know when your marketing division is available to meet us in person and discuss some of the details of the project. Please contact me at your convenience.

Eric West
To: Lillian Ross <lillian@goods.com>
From: Raymond Wells <raymond@gmail.com>Date: Novemeber 4, 10:37 A.M.
Subject: First Quater Budget
Attachment: Q1_Budget
Dear Ms. Ross,

I have attached tthie current draft for the company's budget for the first quarter of next year. As you will notice, all of the profits made from this year's back-to-school sale are planned to be spent on billboard advertisements on the main highways. I will call a design team later this afternoon and ask them to create eye-catching images for the advertisement.

At our last meeting, you mentioned that you would like to review the budget before it is finalized. I have already included employee raises in the first quarter's expenses, but if you can think of anything else, please let me know. I would like to have the budget finalized before next week's planning meeting.

Raymond Wells
To: Raymond Wells <raymond@gmail.com>
From: <lillian@goods.com>
Date: November 4, 10:40 AM
Subject: Emergency Budget Addition
Dear Mr. Wells,

I1 am glad you forwarded me your proposed budget when you did. Just prior to receiving your e-mail, I received an estimate for our planned website development. It looks like it is going to be more expensive than I had anticipated. Altthough the final bill of $32,000 is not due immediately, we will have to find an extra $3,200 in next year's first quarter budget if we want to proceed with JM Solutions' proposal.

If you have any questions regarding this matter, please just come to my office and we can go over where we can make the tough cuts to come up with this funding.

questions.question: Our spokesperson will explain an ------ opportunity for property investors.

explanation.en: "Excited" (C) is the classic trap here because it's grammatically an adjective too, but it describes a person's feeling, while "opportunity" is a thing that causes excitement, not something that feels it — remember: things are "exciting", people are "excited".
explanation.ko: "Excited"(C)는 문법적으로도 형용사이기 때문에 여기서 전형적인 함정이지만, 이는 사람의 감정을 묘사하는 반면 "opportunity"는 흥분을 유발하는 사물이지 그것을 느끼는 것이 아닙니다 — 기억하세요: 사물은 "exciting"이고 사람은 "excited"입니다.

questions.question: Some of the leather used in this handbag must ------ from Italy.

explanation.en: "Will import" (A) is tempting because it also expresses future meaning, but you can't stack two modal verbs ("must will") — after a modal like "must", only the bare infinitive or "be + past participle" (for passive) follows, never another modal.
explanation.ko: "Will import"(A)는 미래의 의미도 나타내기 때문에 유혹적이지만, 두 개의 조동사("must will")를 겹쳐 쓸 수는 없습니다 — "must" 같은 조동사 뒤에는 동사 원형이나 (수동태를 위한) "be + 과거분사"만 올 수 있으며, 다른 조동사가 오는 법은 없습니다.

questions.question: Rockwell Bank's automated teller machines are ------ located in various sections of the city.

explanation.en: All four choices are grammatically valid adverbs here, which is the real trap — this question can't be solved by grammar at all, only by meaning; "periodically" (about timing) is easy to pick by mistake when the sentence is actually about physical placement.
explanation.ko: 네 가지 선택지 모두 문법적으로 유효한 부사여서, 그것이 진짜 함정입니다 — 이 문제는 문법으로는 전혀 풀 수 없고 오직 의미로만 풀 수 있습니다; 문장이 실제로 물리적 위치에 관한 것일 때 "periodically"(시기에 관한)를 실수로 고르기 쉽습니다.

questions.question: As soon as both sides reach ------ terms, the licensing contract will be signed,.

explanation.en: "Agreed" (D) is a strong trap because it shares the root with the correct "agreeable" and seems to fit the topic of negotiation — but "agreed" implies the terms are already settled, while the sentence describes terms still being worked toward, which only "agreeable" (acceptable to both sides) captures.
explanation.ko: "Agreed"(D)는 정답인 "agreeable"과 어근을 공유하고 협상 주제와도 맞아 보여서 강력한 함정이지만, "agreed"는 조건이 이미 합의되었음을 암시하는 반면 문장은 여전히 도달하려는 조건을 설명하고 있으며, 이는 오직 "agreeable"(양측 모두에게 받아들여질 수 있는)만이 포착합니다.

questions.question: Anyone who cannot ------ one of the safety training workshops before September 1 should inform a manager.

explanation.en: "Impress" (A) and "employ" (B) are both verbs that could plausibly appear near "a workshop" in a business context, but only "attend" is the specific collocation for going to and participating in an event — always check if a verb pairs naturally with the exact noun given.
explanation.ko: "Impress"(A)와 "employ"(B)는 비즈니스 맥락에서 "a workshop" 근처에 그럴듯하게 나타날 수 있는 동사이지만, 어떤 행사에 가서 참여한다는 특정 연어는 "attend"뿐입니다 — 동사가 주어진 정확한 명사와 자연스럽게 짝을 이루는지 항상 확인하세요.

questions.question: ------ for using the hotel's spa and dining services have appeared on the final invoice.

explanation.en: The verb "have appeared" is plural, which is the hidden clue — a singular noun (A) or a gerund/participle form (C, D) can't be the subject of a plural verb, so working backward from the verb's number is often faster than guessing the noun directly.
explanation.ko: 동사 "have appeared"는 복수형인데, 이것이 숨겨진 단서입니다 — 단수 명사(A)나 동명사/분사 형태(C, D)는 복수 동사의 주어가 될 수 없으므로, 동사의 수에서 거꾸로 추론하는 것이 명사를 직접 추측하는 것보다 흔히 더 빠릅니다.

questions.question: Members of the security team have been instructed to report ------ unattended bag to the local police department.

explanation.en: "Most" and "all" (C, D) are tempting quantifiers, but they typically need a plural noun or "of the" construction, while the blank here precedes a singular countable noun ("bag") — "any" is the only option that correctly pairs with a singular noun to mean "whichever one".
explanation.ko: "Most"와 "all"(C, D)은 유혹적인 수량사이지만, 보통 복수 명사나 "of the" 구조가 필요한 반면, 여기 빈칸은 가산 단수 명사("bag") 앞에 있습니다 — "any"가 "어느 것이든"이라는 의미로 단수 명사와 올바르게 짝을 이루는 유일한 선택지입니다.

questions.question: The head chef has the restaurant manager ------ the order for the ingredients every evening.

explanation.en: This is the causative structure "have + object + bare verb" — nouns (B, C) and adjectives (A) don't fit this slot at all; recognizing the causative pattern immediately narrows you to verb forms only, which is the real skill being tested.
explanation.ko: 이것은 사역 구조 "have + 목적어 + 동사원형"입니다 — 명사(B, C)와 형용사(A)는 이 자리에 전혀 맞지 않습니다; 사역 패턴을 즉시 인식하면 동사 형태로만 좁혀지는데, 이것이 실제로 시험되는 기술입니다.

questions.question: The automotive company ------ pursued technologies that would improve the efficiency of its engines.

explanation.en: Nouns (B, D) are tempting since the sentence is about a business strategy, but a blank modifying the verb "pursued" always needs an adverb — "aggressively" is the only grammatically possible fit regardless of how business-appropriate the other options sound.
explanation.ko: 명사(B, D)는 문장이 비즈니스 전략에 관한 것이기 때문에 유혹적이지만, 동사 "pursued"를 수식하는 빈칸은 항상 부사가 필요합니다 — 다른 선택지가 아무리 비즈니스에 적합하게 들려도 "aggressively"가 문법적으로 유일하게 가능한 답입니다.

questions.question: On the first day of the painting course, students should provide the teacher with proof of ------.

explanation.en: "Proposal" (B) is a near-miss because it also relates to formal documents submitted somewhere, but it means a suggestion for something not yet decided, while "proof of registration" specifically means evidence that enrollment already happened — match the noun to whether the sentence is about something proposed or something confirmed.
explanation.ko: "Proposal"(B)은 어딘가에 제출되는 공식 문서와도 관련이 있어 까다로운 오답이지만, 이는 아직 결정되지 않은 것에 대한 제안을 의미하는 반면 "proof of registration"은 특별히 등록이 이미 이루어졌다는 증거를 의미합니다 — 문장이 제안된 것에 관한 것인지 확인된 것에 관한 것인지에 명사를 맞추세요.

questions.question: The furniture in this apartment is not ------ but belongs to the landlord and must be returned at the end of the lease.

explanation.en: "Us" (D, object pronoun) is a common wrong pick because it also relates to "we", but a blank standing completely alone (with no following noun) showing possession needs the absolute possessive form "ours" — check whether a noun follows the blank to decide between possessive adjective and absolute possessive pronoun.
explanation.ko: "Us"(D, 목적격 대명사)는 "we"와도 관련이 있어 흔한 오답이지만, 완전히 홀로 서 있는(뒤에 명사가 없는) 빈칸이 소유를 나타낼 때는 절대 소유대명사 "ours"가 필요합니다 — 소유형용사와 절대 소유대명사 중 무엇을 쓸지 결정하려면 빈칸 뒤에 명사가 있는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: The driver ------ Mr. Dwight is expected to arrive at the conference venue 20 minutes prior to the ending time.

explanation.en: "Among" (D) is tempting because it also relates to people/groups, but "the driver for someone" is a fixed way to express a driver assigned to a specific person — "among" would need a group of multiple people being divided or shared, which doesn't fit here.
explanation.ko: "Among"(D)는 사람/그룹과도 관련이 있어 유혹적이지만, "the driver for someone"은 특정인에게 배정된 운전사를 표현하는 고정된 방식입니다 — "among"은 무언가를 나누거나 공유하는 여러 사람의 그룹이 필요한데, 이는 여기에 맞지 않습니다.

questions.question: Three of the new chemists, who ------ developed the material, will be recognized by the CEO at Saturday's ceremony.

explanation.en: "Developed" (B, bare verb) is tempting since it looks like it could pair directly with the subject, but the blank here modifies the already-conjugated verb "developed" and needs an adverb — "collaboratively" describes how the developing was done, not another action itself.
explanation.ko: "Developed"(B, 동사 원형)는 주어와 직접 짝을 이룰 수 있어 보여 유혹적이지만, 여기서 빈칸은 이미 활용된 동사 "developed"를 수식하며 부사가 필요합니다 — "collaboratively"는 개발이 어떻게 이루어졌는지를 설명하는 것이지, 또 다른 동작 자체가 아닙니다.

questions.question: The goal of the program is to make health services readily available to those in both rural and urban ------.

explanation.en: "Purposes" and "standards" (A, D) are both plausible nouns in a formal-sounding sentence, but "rural and urban settings" is the specific, fixed collocation meaning "areas/environments" — memorize this pairing rather than picking any noun that sounds formal enough.
explanation.ko: "Purposes"와 "standards"(A, D)는 공식적으로 들리는 문장에서 그럴듯한 명사이지만, "rural and urban settings"는 "지역/환경"을 의미하는 특정 고정 연어입니다 — 그저 충분히 공식적으로 들리는 명사를 고르지 말고 이 조합을 외우세요.

questions.question: Please send a check in the amount of £550 ------ the document that needs to be checked by our agency.

explanation.en: "While" (B) is a strong trap because it can mean "together with" in casual speech, but grammatically it needs a clause (subject + verb) or introduces contrast/time, not a simple object — "with" is the correct preposition for "send X together with Y".
explanation.ko: "While"(B)는 일상 회화에서 "~와 함께"를 의미할 수 있어 강력한 함정이지만, 문법적으로는 절(주어+동사)이 필요하거나 대조/시간을 도입하며, 단순 목적어를 취하지 않습니다 — "X를 Y와 함께 보내다"에 올바른 전치사는 "with"입니다.

questions.question: Using a fingerprint system is generally ------ as the primary means of security at laboratories in this country.

explanation.en: "To + V" (A) is tempting because infinitives often follow "be", but this specific passive structure "is ... accepted as" (meaning "is regarded as") requires the past participle form directly — recognize "be + Vpp + as" as a fixed passive pattern.
explanation.ko: "To + V"(A)는 부정사가 종종 "be" 뒤에 오기 때문에 유혹적이지만, 이 특정 수동 구조 "is ... accepted as"("~로 여겨지다"라는 뜻)는 과거분사 형태가 직접 필요합니다 — "be + Vpp + as"를 고정된 수동태 패턴으로 인식하세요.

questions.question: Living further from the city center will ------ your rental costs, but it affects your commute.

explanation.en: "Shorten" (A) is a very tempting near-synonym because it also means "to reduce", but it's specifically used for time, distance, or length — not costs — so "lowers" is the only verb that correctly collocates with rental costs going down.
explanation.ko: "Shorten"(A)은 "줄이다"라는 뜻도 있어 매우 유혹적인 유의어이지만, 이는 시간, 거리, 또는 길이에만 특별히 사용되며 비용에는 사용되지 않습니다 — 따라서 "lowers"가 임대 비용이 내려가는 것과 올바르게 짝을 이루는 유일한 동사입니다.

questions.question: FryMate brand cookware can be purchased directly from the company's website or at a retailer ------ you.

explanation.en: "To" and "along" (B, C) both seem like reasonable prepositions of direction/location, but "a retailer near you" is the natural, idiomatic way to express proximity to the reader — always check which preposition natively pairs with the specific noun in everyday usage.
explanation.ko: "To"와 "along"(B, C) 둘 다 방향/위치를 나타내는 그럴듯한 전치사로 보이지만, "a retailer near you"는 독자와의 근접성을 표현하는 자연스럽고 관용적인 방식입니다 — 일상적인 사용에서 어떤 전치사가 정확한 명사와 본래 짝을 이루는지 항상 확인하세요.

questions.question: Weekly ------ of the facility help to ensure that minor maintenance issues are discovered and resolved early.

explanation.en: A verb in singular form (D) is a common wrong pick because it looks close to what should follow, but it can't agree with the plural verb "help" — "investigations" (plural noun) is the only option matching the verb's number, so always check subject-verb agreement first.
explanation.ko: 단수형 동사(D)는 뒤따라야 할 것과 가까워 보여서 흔한 오답이지만, 복수 동사 "help"와 일치할 수 없습니다 — "investigations"(복수 명사)가 동사의 수와 맞는 유일한 선택지이므로, 항상 주어-동사 일치를 먼저 확인하세요.

questions.question: Patients should call the emergency line immediatelly if they experience ------ changes in temperature.

explanation.en: "Contemporary" (B) is tempting because it's a common formal adjective, but it means "modern/current", not "sudden" — "sudden changes in temperature" specifically describes abrupt, unexpected shifts, which is what makes the situation an emergency in this sentence.
explanation.ko: "Contemporary"(B)는 흔한 격식체 형용사여서 유혹적이지만, 이는 "현대의/현재의"라는 뜻이지 "갑작스러운"이라는 뜻이 아닙니다 — "sudden changes in temperature"는 구체적으로 갑작스럽고 예상치 못한 변화를 묘사하며, 이것이 이 문장의 상황을 응급 상황으로 만드는 요소입니다.

questions.question: Participants who are taking part in the half- day historical tour should be at the meeting point ------ than 7:45A.M.

explanation.en: This is a fixed expression: "no later than + time" meaning "at the latest by that time" — options A, B, C simply don't grammatically pair with "than" at all, so recognizing this whole idiom as a unit avoids needing to analyze each option separately.
explanation.ko: 이것은 고정 표현입니다: "no later than + 시간"은 "늦어도 그 시간까지는"이라는 뜻입니다 — 선택지 A, B, C는 "than"과 문법적으로 전혀 짝을 이루지 못하므로, 이 관용구 전체를 하나의 단위로 인식하면 각 선택지를 따로 분석할 필요가 없어집니다.

questions.question: The supervisor allowed Mr. Martin to take three additional vacation days because of his ------ achievement.

explanation.en: "Satisfied" (D) is a sneaky trap because it's a positive-sounding adjective, but it describes a person's feeling, not a quality of an achievement itself — "noteworthy" (worth being noticed) is the only option that correctly describes why the achievement earned a reward.
explanation.ko: "Satisfied"(D)는 긍정적으로 들리는 형용사여서 교묘한 함정이지만, 이는 사람의 감정을 묘사하는 것이지 업적 자체의 특성이 아닙니다 — "noteworthy"(주목할 만한)가 그 업적이 왜 보상을 받았는지를 올바르게 설명하는 유일한 선택지입니다.

questions.question: Ms. Stevens ------ acknowledged that she was unable to complete the task in the specified time frame.

explanation.en: Verbs (B, C) are tempting since the sentence involves an action (acknowledging), but the blank modifies that already-conjugated verb and needs an adverb — "regretfully" describes the manner/attitude of the acknowledgment, which only an adverb can express here.
explanation.ko: 동사(B, C)는 문장이 어떤 행동(인정하기)을 포함하기 때문에 유혹적이지만, 빈칸은 이미 활용된 그 동사를 수식하며 부사가 필요합니다 — "regretfully"는 인정의 방식/태도를 묘사하며, 이는 여기서 부사만이 표현할 수 있습니다.

questions.question: The customer's steak was ------ undercooked, so he requested that it be sent back to the kitchen.

explanation.en: "Rarely" (D) is a strong trap since it's also an adverb, but it expresses frequency (how often), while the blank needs a degree adverb before the adjective "undercooked" — "rather" (meaning quite/fairly) is the one that correctly intensifies the adjective's degree.
explanation.ko: "Rarely"(D)도 부사여서 강력한 함정이지만, 빈도(얼마나 자주)를 나타내는 반면, 빈칸은 형용사 "undercooked" 앞에 정도 부사가 필요합니다 — "rather"(꽤/상당히라는 뜻)가 형용사의 정도를 올바르게 강화하는 것입니다.

questions.question: The contact details provided on this survey are for in-house purposes and will not be ------ to a third party.

explanation.en: "Responded" (B) is tempting because it also relates to communication about information, but "released to a third party" specifically means information was disclosed/given out to someone outside the organization — match the verb to the precise action of sharing data externally, not just any information-related verb.
explanation.ko: "Responded"(B)도 정보를 전달하는 것과 관련이 있어 유혹적이지만, "released to a third party"는 정보가 조직 외부의 누군가에게 특별히 공개/제공되었다는 것을 의미합니다 — 정보와 관련된 아무 동사가 아니라 외부로 데이터를 공유하는 정확한 동작에 동사를 맞추세요.

questions.question: Mr. Brannon can assemble the shelves for the booth ------ as long as he has a set of tools.

explanation.en: "His" (A, possessive adjective) is a common wrong pick since it also relates to "he", but the phrase needs a reflexive pronoun for emphasis (meaning "he can do it alone/by himself") — the emphatic reflexive use is a distinct grammatical pattern from simple possession.
explanation.ko: "His"(A, 소유형용사)는 "he"와도 관련이 있어 흔한 오답이지만, 이 구문은 강조를 위한 재귀대명사가 필요합니다("그는 혼자서/스스로 할 수 있다"라는 뜻) — 강조를 위한 재귀 용법은 단순 소유와는 별개의 문법 패턴입니다.

questions.question: Ms. Stevenson contacted the real estate agent ------ nname and phone number appeared on the advertisement.

explanation.en: "Who" (D) is the classic trap for "whose" — both are relative pronouns referring to people, but "who" replaces a subject/object (a person), while "whose" specifically shows possession ("the agent's name") — check whether the relative clause needs a person or something that person owns.
explanation.ko: "Who"(D)는 "whose"에 대한 전형적인 함정입니다 — 둘 다 사람을 가리키는 관계대명사이지만, "who"는 주어/목적어(사람)를 대체하고, "whose"는 구체적으로 소유를 나타냅니다("대리인의 이름") — 관계절이 사람을 필요로 하는지, 그 사람이 소유한 것을 필요로 하는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: The home's sale becomes ------ when the official document is recorded at the county office.

explanation.en: A verb (B) is tempting right after "becomes", but "becomes" is a linking verb that must be followed by an adjective describing the subject's new state, not another action — "final" is the only grammatically valid option in this position.
explanation.ko: 동사(B)는 "becomes" 바로 뒤에서 유혹적이지만, "becomes"는 연결동사로 주어의 새로운 상태를 설명하는 형용사가 뒤따라야 하며, 다른 동작이 오면 안 됩니다 — "final"이 이 위치에서 문법적으로 유일하게 유효한 선택지입니다.

questions.question: The main activity performed at the workshop required team members to ------ with each other.

explanation.en: "Oversee" (B) is tempting because it's also a workplace-related verb about managing something, but "cooperate with each other" is a specific fixed phrase meaning to work together as equals — "oversee" implies a hierarchy that doesn't match the mutual, equal relationship the sentence describes.
explanation.ko: "Oversee"(B)도 무언가를 관리하는 것에 관한 직장 관련 동사여서 유혹적이지만, "cooperate with each other"는 대등하게 함께 일한다는 특정 고정 표현입니다 — "oversee"는 문장이 설명하는 상호적이고 평등한 관계와 맞지 않는 위계를 암시합니다.

questions.question: According to the physician, Ms. Oliver's pain ------ within two hours of taking the medication.

explanation.en: "Alleviated" alone in an active form (C, D) would wrongly suggest the pain is doing the relieving itself — pain is always the receiver of relief (passive), and since a doctor is predicting a future outcome, only the future passive "will be alleviated" fits both the voice and the tense needed.
explanation.ko: 능동형(C, D)의 "Alleviated" 단독으로는 통증이 스스로 완화된다고 잘못 암시할 것입니다 — 통증은 항상 완화의 대상(수동)이며, 의사가 미래의 결과를 예측하고 있으므로 미래 수동형 "will be alleviated"만이 필요한 태와 시제 모두에 맞습니다.

items.description:
International Goods Fair

If you want (131) ------ your packaged goods to an international audience, join the 8th annual International Goods Fair. The fair runs from March 5 to March 7 at the Galaxy Convention in downtown New York. With over 200 booths (132) ------ by companies from all over the world, you can make business connections while promoting your own products to interested customers and businesses. The products should be mainly packaged foods ranging (133) ------ desserts and snacks to canned meats and dried jerky. (134) ------ Spots are limited and going fast.

The Nightingales of Fall is the eagerly awaited sequel to his best- selling debut novel. Tepper burst onto the scene over a decade ago with the acclaimed poetry collection, King Harmon's Castle, and the expectation for this latest novel is another chart- topping success. items.description:
More Buses During the Holidays

November 28- - [1] - Although the holiday season signals a nice week-long vacation for many, bus drivers will work longer hours and straight into the holidays to accommodate the many tourists that are flooding the city this lime of year and the shoppers that are busy buying those last-minute gifts, - [2] - The city announced new bus schedules for the next few weeks which included some routes where the buses would run all day and all night. While most buses stop running by 1:00 A.M.. some parts of downtown will see buses running ail night. The Bingham shopping district will also see buses running until 3:00 A.M. "This is when we have the most tourists and out-of-town folks coming to visit," explained Mayor Bill Nate, "We felt it was important to provide the necessary services during this time," - [3] -
When the bus drivers' union leader, Nathan Reiner, was asked about the new schedules he responded, "We worked out a payment that is agreeable on both sides and have enough drivers that can work in shifts so that there is no danger of overworking or exhaustion. Many of us will still get some time off during the holidays with our families." - [4] -

questions.question: What is the purpose of the article?

To describe the city during the holidays
To inform the public about traffic delays
questions.correct: To report changes in public transportation

explanation.en: "The city announced new bus schedules for the next few weeks which included some routes where the buses would run all day and all night."
explanation.ko: 시는 앞으로 몇 주간의 새로운 버스 시간표를 발표했으며, 일부 노선은 하루 종일 밤낮으로 운행될 예정입니다.

explanation.en: "We worked out a payment that is agreeable on both sides and have enough drivers that can work in shifts so that there is no danger of overworking or exhaustion. Many of us will still get some time off during the holidays with our families."
explanation.ko: 양측이 합의할 수 있는 급여를 정했고, 교대로 일할 수 있는 충분한 운전기사가 있어 과로나 탈진의 위험이 없습니다. 우리 중 많은 사람들이 여전히 휴가 기간 동안 가족과 함께 시간을 보낼 수 있을 것입니다.

explanation.ko: “전반적으로, 크리스마스가 다가옴에 따라 도시는 관광객과 휴가철 쇼핑객의 유입에 대비가 된 것으로 보입니다.” 이것은 결론 문장으로, 기사들이 과로 없이 추가 업무를 감당할 수 있다는 Reiner 씨의 발언 바로 뒤에 배치하는 것이 적절함 -> 위치 [4]

April 2 - Repairs will begin next Friday on the historic Marion Hall in downtown Marion. In its heyday, Marion Hall was a popular downtown destination for residents to dance, enjoy live music, and watch movies. However, it has lost its popularity gradually since the multiplex building was completed on Henson Street 4 years ago.

After all of the necessary repairs are made on Marion Hall, city officials will strive to invite various performers including famous theater companies, musicians, comedians, and speakers to the newly renovated theater. "We hope Marion Hall can serve as a new center for culture here in Marion," said Marion City Mayor Greg Fields.

The revitalization of Marion Hall is part of a larger project to enhance the public facilities in Marion. On April 29, the Marion Children's Park, which features a baseball field as well as several playgrounds, is scheduled to have its grand reopening.

items.description: As I'm sure you're aware, this week we must decide if we want to continue working with CC Wheel Delivery. After yesterday's meeting, it's clear that they are being sued for the accident that happened last week. -[1]- We all agreed that the whole company shouldn't be liable for the mistakes of a few careless workers. But, that was a conversation we had before we had really thought about the ramifications of our decision. -[2]- Unfortunately, the situation is escalating and there is about to be a lot of bad press. -[3]- It's true that many of them are our friends. But, we must protect our company, We can't handle anything that could alter our sales, For the last four months, we've been operating with a very thin margin for error. If our sales drop even the slightest, it could be detrimental. So, I'm suggesting that, as a means of protecting ourselves from any negative backlash, we cut our ties with CC Wheel Delivery. Maybe later, if they're able to rehabilitate their name, we'll work with them again, -[4]- I propose we vote one more time on whether or not to work with them.

September 21—What is the secret to delicious home-cooked meals? Kimberly Lee, host of the My Home Cooking television show and owner of her own restaurant chain, seems to know all the secrets. Her show has been on the air for over two years, and now she has a devoted group of followers around the country. When she sat down for an interview with us, she said that fresh vegetables and local produce are the key to cooking healthy and tasty food.

Ms. Lee is scheduled to publish her very first cookbook near the end of the month. The book is entitled Kimberly Lee's My Home Cooking, and it provides easy-to- follow recipes that can be made in less than 30 minutes. Over 40,000 copies have already been pre-ordered so far.

Ms. Lee says that the final page of the book will include a detachable fan club membership form. Those who fill the form out and send it in to the provided address will receive a monthly newsletter and exclusive recipes available only to those in the fan club. Fan club members will also receive a password that allows access to a fan club website.
To: Kimberly Lee <kimberlylee@kimberlylee.com>
From: Suzie Sanders <suziesanderrss@kimberlylee.com>
Date: October 12
Subject: Update

Dear Ms. Lee,

Great news! I'm happy to report that not only has your book been selling well, but the number of new members joining the fan cilub has been increasing drastically since it was published. I'm certain that the article in the newspaper helped generate considerable publicity for your book.

Also, we have received a lot of feedback from new members expressing a desire for more recipes for ·cakes, cookies, and candies to be featured in next month's newsletter. I think it would be a good idea to meet their needs this time.

Sincerely,

Suzie Sanders
Publlicity Coordinator

items.description:
Brand-X Coming town

March 9 - Popular Danish skincare company Brand--Xis finally launching their best-selling line in America. The 88-year-old company has been Denmark's leading skincare brand and the top selling cream, Xtreme 7, has been Europe's most popular facial cream for over 10 years. Though Americans may not have had access to these creams before, the brand is already generating much excitement. D erm atologist Dr. Francis Keenan explains, "Tests have shown that Xtreme 7 dramatically reduces the fine lines around the eye area and laugh lines after only 30 days of use, but the price of the cream is only a fraction of what department store brands sell for. I'll definitely recommend this cream to my clients."

"People have been asking about Xtreme 7 but the products haven't even arrived yet!" added Susan Chan, an employee at a beauty counter. "People are already calling in to pre- order."

A spokesperson for the company explained that Brand-X is making moves to expand into the North American and Asian markets. For now, only the best-selling line will be available sometime next month, outside of Europe, but within a year, more products will be available.
Brand-X Positions at American Headquarters in Westminster, California

Don't miss your chance to work In an exciting career in skincare and beauty with Brand-X. 80 administrative and customer service positions will be available regardless of experience. Applicants need to have good communication skills, bilingual ability in both English and Spanish is preferred but not necessary, and knowledge in computer use is a must. Applicants with experience in cosmetics, dermatology, or marketing will get a chance to work in several management positions for Brand-X. Please visit our website at www.brandx.com/jobs for more information. Ydu can fill out the application forms and send them in before March 20th. Interviews will take place at Hillway Building on 143 Garden Road. Be sure to bring your resumes and reference letters.
To: Professor David Mills
From: Jacqueline O'Hare
Date: March 28
Subject: Job

Dear Professor Mills,

Thank you so much for the reference letter you supplied me with. 1I was recenttlly hired by Brand-X and I begin my orientations next week Wednesday at 10:00 A.M. However, we have our statistics test at that time. Is there any way that I can take a make-up test a~t a different time or hand in another assignment as a replacement for the test? I would hate to miss the orientations which are mandatory and I don't want · to disappoint my new employers. The job should not have any other impact on my school work otherwise. 1I kindly appreciate your consideration in this.

Sincerely,
Jacquelline O'Hare

To: Bill Johnson <bj@action.net>
From: Laurie Wheeler <lwheeler@zipnet.com>
Date: October 11
Subject: Reservation Info

Dear Mr. Johnson,

I am writing you on behalf of the company I work for, Competitive Excellence. We work with productivity and efficiency training for corporations and small businesses. Lately, our stafff has been suffering from low morale, and while searrching the Internet for solutions, I came across your website www..action.net. I am interested in hearing more about the motivational speaking that you do. Specifically, could you tell me if your speeches are religious in nature? We have a diverse staff and I am looking for something that is secular. Please write me back with an overview of what you do and what your rates are for a presentation.

Laurie Wheeler,
Managing Director, Competitive Excellence
To: Laurie Wheeler <lwheeler@zipnet.com>
From: Bill Johnson <bj@action.net>
Date: October 13
Subject: Reservation Info

Dear Ms. Wheeler,

Thank you so much for your interest in Action. I am happy to answer your questions and provide you with a full breakdown of what we can do for you, your team, and your company. To begin with, all of our talks are secular, though not necessarily free from the concept of spirituality. Our professional speakers seek to motivate people to look internally to find their own spirit and help it rise. Morale, after all, is an intangible but essential aspect of an effective team. Please refer to the topic list and pricing guide I have attached to this e-mail. Once you have found a theme, speaker, and chosen the appropriate class size for your company, please send me a follow-up e-mail to schedule your event.

Bill Johnson,
Action Coordinator

explanation.en: 'Little' has an irregular comparative form ('less'), unlike most adjectives that just add '-er' — learn irregular comparatives by heart since they can't be guessed from spelling rules.
explanation.ko: 'little'는 대부분의 형용사가 '-er'만 붙이는 것과 달리 불규칙 비교급('less')을 가집니다 — 철자 규칙으로 추측할 수 없으므로 불규칙 비교급은 외워두세요.

questions.question: Before you distribute the report, ask Ms. Burns to check that ------ has all the necessary information.

explanation.en: A pronoun must match the gender/type of the noun it replaces — 'the report' is a thing, so it needs 'it', not a person-referring pronoun like 'her' or a possessive like 'our'.
explanation.ko: 대명사는 그것이 대체하는 명사의 성별/종류와 일치해야 합니다 — 'the report'는 사물이므로 'her' 같은 사람 지칭 대명사나 'our' 같은 소유격이 아니라 'it'이 필요합니다.

questions.question: According to consumers, using the new website is no ------ than calling the help center directly.

explanation.en: The word 'than' in a sentence is a strong signal that a comparative adjective or adverb is needed — scan for 'than' first, then pick the '-er' or 'more' form instead of the plain or superlative one.
explanation.ko: 문장에 'than'이 있으면 비교급 형용사나 부사가 필요하다는 강한 신호입니다 — 먼저 'than'을 찾은 다음, 원급이나 최상급이 아니라 '-er'이나 'more' 형태를 고르세요.

questions.question: Anyone who participates ------ the city's Annual Baking Competition will receive a coupon from Fresh Supermarket.

explanation.en: 'Participate in' is a fixed collocation — memorizing common verb-preposition pairs like this one saves time on test day instead of guessing based on what 'sounds right'.
explanation.ko: 'participate in'은 고정 표현입니다 — 이런 흔한 동사-전치사 짝을 외워두면 시험 당일 '느낌이 맞는' 것으로 추측하는 대신 시간을 절약할 수 있습니다.

questions.question: City officials are still debating Irving Enterprises' request ------ the outdated building.

explanation.en: 'Request to do something' takes a plain infinitive, just like 'want to', 'plan to', or 'need to' — group these verbs together mentally since they all follow the same simple pattern.
explanation.ko: 'request to do something'는 'want to', 'plan to', 'need to'처럼 단순 부정사를 취합니다 — 이 동사들은 모두 같은 단순 패턴을 따르므로 머릿속으로 함께 묶어두세요.

questions.question: Heron Glassworks ------ student groups of all ages for weekday tours of its warehouse and production floor.

explanation.en: When several verb options have close but distinct meanings (carry, keep safe, enclose, greet warmly), eliminate options whose core meaning doesn't logically fit the subject and object described.
explanation.ko: 여러 동사 선택지가 비슷하지만 서로 다른 의미(운반하다, 안전하게 보관하다, 안에 넣다, 따뜻하게 맞이하다)를 가질 때는, 핵심 의미가 설명된 주어와 목적어에 논리적으로 맞지 않는 선택지를 제외하세요.

questions.question: To combat mental illness, the clinic will take a more comprehensive ------ than it did in the past.

explanation.en: After 'take a more comprehensive ------', the blank is the object of the verb 'take' and needs a noun ('approach'), even though related adjective and adverb forms of the same word exist.
explanation.ko: 'take a more comprehensive ------' 뒤의 빈칸은 동사 'take'의 목적어이므로, 같은 단어의 관련 형용사·부사 형태가 있어도 명사(approach)가 필요합니다.

questions.question: Brandy can make withdrawals from any Salis Bank branch, but she usually visits the ------ one.

explanation.en: Superlatives ('closest') are used when comparing three or more options ('any branch'), while comparatives ('closer') compare just two — count how many things are being compared before choosing the form.
explanation.ko: 최상급('closest')은 세 개 이상을 비교할 때(어느 지점이든) 쓰이고, 비교급('closer')은 두 개만 비교합니다 — 형태를 고르기 전에 몇 개가 비교되는지 세어보세요.

questions.question: As a ------ for making contracts with a lot of new clients, Mr. Skinner was given additional vacation days.

explanation.en: When several noun options are close synonyms (reward, progress, solution, routine), read the full sentence for the specific cause-and-effect relationship before choosing — 'given for doing X' points to 'reward'.
explanation.ko: 여러 명사 선택지가 비슷한 의미(보상, 진전, 해결책, 일과)를 가질 때는, 고르기 전에 문장 전체를 읽어 구체적인 인과관계를 파악하세요 — 'X를 한 것에 대해 주어지는 것'은 'reward'를 가리킵니다.

questions.question: Please be seated according to the ------ name cards that have been placed on each table.

explanation.en: An adjective directly before a noun ('------ name cards') describes that noun's quality — check the word's ending (-ized often signals a past-participle adjective) rather than its verb or noun relatives.
explanation.ko: 명사 바로 앞의 형용사('------ name cards')는 그 명사의 성질을 설명합니다 — 관련된 동사나 명사 형태가 아니라 단어의 어미(-ized는 종종 과거분사형 형용사를 나타냄)를 확인하세요.

questions.question: The memo sent by Mr. Lee addressed a few ------ that were discovered during the quarterly inspection.

explanation.en: 'A few ------' needs a plural countable noun — check that the word you pick can actually take an 's' and makes sense as something that can be counted individually.
explanation.ko: 'a few ------'는 셀 수 있는 복수 명사가 필요합니다 — 고른 단어가 실제로 's'를 붙일 수 있고 개별적으로 셀 수 있는 것으로 말이 되는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: Many voters in this city are uninterested, and only about 15% of them are ------ active.

explanation.en: An adverb modifying an adjective ('------ active') describes to what degree or in what way that quality applies — look for the '-ly' form rather than the noun or plain adjective form of the same word.
explanation.ko: 형용사를 수식하는 부사('------ active')는 그 특성이 어느 정도, 어떤 방식으로 적용되는지 설명합니다 — 같은 단어의 명사형이나 원급 형용사가 아니라 '-ly' 형태를 찾으세요.

questions.question: This year's award winner, Cheryl Garner, taught basic first-aid skills to students and adults ------ the region.

explanation.en: 'Throughout' a time period or place means all through/all over it, distinct from 'during' (at some point within) or 'between' (in the middle of two things) — check if the sentence really means the entire span.
explanation.ko: 어떤 기간이나 장소에 'throughout'을 쓰면 그 전체에 걸쳐/전역에라는 뜻으로, 어떤 시점 안이라는 'during'이나 두 가지 사이라는 'between'과 다릅니다 — 문장이 정말 전체 기간을 의미하는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: ------, the cabin will be rented out for the entire month, but the owner would agree to four weekly rentals instead.

explanation.en: Sentence-opening adverbs that set a tone (ideally, reluctantly, absolutely, mutually) each carry a distinct attitude — read the rest of the sentence to see if it expresses a preference, reluctance, certainty, or mutual action.
explanation.ko: 문장 앞에서 어조를 정하는 부사(이상적으로, 마지못해, 완전히, 상호적으로)는 각각 다른 태도를 담고 있습니다 — 문장 나머지 부분을 읽어 선호, 마지못함, 확실성, 상호 행동 중 무엇을 나타내는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: The non-profit organization released to the press several documents ------ the largest donors and how much they contributed.

explanation.en: 'Documents detailing X' is a reduced relative clause meaning 'documents which detail X' — recognize that an '-ing' word right after a noun often replaces a 'which/who + verb' clause.
explanation.ko: 'documents detailing X'는 'X를 상세히 설명하는 문서'라는 뜻의 축약된 관계절입니다 — 명사 바로 뒤에 오는 '-ing' 단어는 종종 'which/who + 동사' 절을 대체한다는 것을 알아두세요.

questions.question: No passengers are allowed on board ------ the aircraft's door has been closed.

explanation.en: 'Once' meaning 'as soon as/from the moment that' introduces a time clause about a triggering event — different from 'despite' (contrast) or 'that' (a noun clause), so check what logical relationship the sentence needs.
explanation.ko: '~하자마자'를 뜻하는 'once'는 계기가 되는 사건에 대한 시간절을 이끕니다 — 대조를 나타내는 'despite'나 명사절을 이끄는 'that'과 다르므로, 문장이 어떤 논리적 관계를 필요로 하는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: A government ------ will visit the site to talk with protesters directly and seek a resolution.

explanation.en: 'A government representative' needs a noun for a person's role — check that the option describes a person (representative) rather than an abstract concept (representation) or a verb form.
explanation.ko: 'a government representative'는 사람의 역할을 나타내는 명사가 필요합니다 — 선택지가 추상적 개념(representation)이나 동사 형태가 아니라 사람(representative)을 나타내는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: An extensive ------ conducted by lvanex communications revealed that Internet speed was one of the most important factors to customers.

explanation.en: When a sentence describes collecting information or opinions from people, 'survey' fits better than similar business nouns like 'inventory' (a list of stock) or 'coverage' (insurance) — match the noun to the actual activity described.
explanation.ko: 문장이 사람들로부터 정보나 의견을 수집하는 것을 설명할 때는, 'inventory'(재고 목록)나 'coverage'(보험)보다 'survey'가 더 적합합니다 — 명사를 실제 설명된 활동에 맞추세요.

questions.question: Mr. Denson wanted to purchase a special edition gold-plated watch from Utica Watches, but there were ------ left.

explanation.en: After 'but' introducing a contrast, look for a word meaning 'none/nothing left' rather than options implying availability ('something', 'some') — the contrast word tells you the answer must be negative.
explanation.ko: 대조를 나타내는 'but' 뒤에서는 이용 가능성을 암시하는 선택지('something', 'some')가 아니라 '남은 것이 없다'는 뜻의 단어를 찾으세요 — 대조 단어는 답이 부정적이어야 함을 알려줍니다.

questions.question: Ms. May reminded us that the agreement was only ------ because it had not been approved yet.

explanation.en: 'Tentative' means not yet certain or confirmed — a useful word for describing agreements or plans that are still subject to change, distinct from words about urgency, spoilage, or habit.
explanation.ko: 'tentative'는 아직 확실하지 않거나 확정되지 않았다는 뜻입니다 — 아직 바뀔 수 있는 합의나 계획을 설명할 때 유용하며, 긴급성, 부패, 습관에 관한 단어와는 다릅니다.

questions.question: Following the restoration project, the lobby of the historical Kirkwood Hotel looked ------ like its original state.

explanation.en: An adverb modifying a linking verb like 'look' ('looked ------') describes the manner or degree of that impression — 'remarkably' emphasizes something surprising, so check if the sentence implies a notable change.
explanation.ko: 'look'('looked ------')처럼 연결동사를 수식하는 부사는 그 인상의 방식이나 정도를 설명합니다 — 'remarkably'는 놀라운 것을 강조하므로, 문장이 눈에 띄는 변화를 암시하는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: ------ the right environmental conditions, this tree will yield fresh fruit for most of the year.

explanation.en: 'With the right conditions' means 'given/under the right conditions' — 'with' followed by a noun phrase describing a favorable circumstance is a common pattern for expressing a supporting condition.
explanation.ko: 'with the right conditions'는 '적절한 조건 하에서'라는 뜻입니다 — 유리한 상황을 설명하는 명사구가 뒤따르는 'with'는 뒷받침하는 조건을 표현하는 흔한 패턴입니다.

questions.question: One of the interns ------ that the logo on the second page of the sales report was upside down.

explanation.en: Phrasal verbs with close meanings (pointed out, accounted for, looked after, came across) need careful reading of the full context — 'pointed out' fits noticing and mentioning a problem to others.
explanation.ko: 비슷한 의미의 구동사(지적하다, 차지하다, 돌보다, 우연히 발견하다)는 전체 맥락을 주의 깊게 읽어야 합니다 — 'pointed out'은 문제를 알아채고 다른 사람에게 언급하는 것에 맞습니다.

questions.question: ------ the parking lot is closed, both employees and customers will have to make use of street parking.

explanation.en: 'While' can mean 'during the time that' or 'whereas' (contrast) — check whether the sentence describes two things happening at the same time or two things being compared.
explanation.ko: 'while'는 '~하는 동안'이나 '~인 반면'(대조)을 의미할 수 있습니다 — 문장이 동시에 일어나는 두 가지를 설명하는지, 비교되는 두 가지를 설명하는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: If the new athletic shoes do well in the smaller test markets, their nationwide launch could be ------ .

explanation.en: 'Accelerated' means sped up — a common trap is words that sound business-related but don't actually mean 'faster' (convinced, directed, circulated); focus on the specific meaning of speed or timing.
explanation.ko: 'accelerated'는 속도가 빨라졌다는 뜻입니다 — 사업과 관련된 것처럼 들리지만 실제로는 '더 빠르다'는 의미가 아닌 단어들(설득했다, 지시했다, 배포했다)이 흔한 함정이므로, 속도나 시기의 구체적 의미에 집중하세요.

questions.question: The city hosted a display of ------ fireworks to celebrate the 100th anniversary of its founding.

explanation.en: An adjective directly before a noun ('------ fireworks') describes that noun — check the ending to confirm it's an adjective form, not a related verb, noun, or adverb from the same word family.
explanation.ko: 명사 바로 앞의 형용사('------ fireworks')는 그 명사를 수식합니다 — 같은 어족의 관련 동사, 명사, 부사가 아니라 형용사 형태인지 어미를 확인해 확정하세요.

questions.question: After investing heavily in Internet marketing campaigns, Bailey Coffee increased its annual profits ------ fifteen percent.

explanation.en: 'Increased by X percent' uses 'by' to show the amount or margin of change — memorize this pattern since 'among', 'between', and 'on' don't work the same way with percentages.
explanation.ko: 'increased by X percent'는 변화의 양이나 폭을 나타낼 때 'by'를 씁니다 — 'among', 'between', 'on'은 퍼센트와 같은 방식으로 쓰이지 않으므로 이 패턴을 외우세요.

questions.question: The receptionists change the artwork in the clinic's waiting room ------ and rearrange the layout of the furniture.

explanation.en: 'Periodically' means at regular intervals — a good fit for routine, repeated actions, distinct from words about closeness, tightness, or narrow margins that don't relate to frequency at all.
explanation.ko: 'periodically'는 정기적인 간격으로라는 뜻입니다 — 반복되는 일상적 행동에 잘 맞으며, 빈도와 전혀 관련 없는 친밀함, 단단함, 근소한 차이에 관한 단어와는 다릅니다.

questions.question: The policy that requires businesses to provide medical insurance applies only to those ------ more than twenty-five people.

explanation.en: 'Those employing more than X' is a reduced relative clause meaning 'those businesses which employ more than X' — recognize that dropping 'which' and changing the verb to '-ing' is a common way TOEIC shortens clauses.
explanation.ko: 'those employing more than X'는 'X명 이상을 고용하는 그 업체들'이라는 뜻의 축약된 관계절입니다 — 'which'를 빼고 동사를 '-ing'로 바꾸는 것이 TOEIC에서 절을 줄이는 흔한 방법임을 알아두세요.

items.description:
Beverly Boutique: Sales Assistant Position

Our boutique is looking for enthusiastic candidates for our sales assistant position. (131) ------.
Previous experience in a similar position is preferred, but not necessary. Organizational skills is also a must, as well as some experience with computer use. Most of all, we need someone who is personable, someone who can make customers feel (132) ------, and someone who is passionate about fashion. Duties will include serving customers, taking inventory, and minor jobs around the boutique such as sweeping and locking the doors at closing time. Payment will be by sales commission which gives employees more (133) ------ to serve their customers as 133. best they can. Hours will be flexible. For more information, please visit our website. If you (134) ------ in the position, please send your resume to Rita at rlan@bboutique.com.
items.descriptionKo: Beverly Boutique: 판매 보조 직책 저희 매장은 판매 보조 직책에 열정적인 지원자를 찾고 있습니다. 유사 직무 경험이 있으면 유리하지만 필수는 아닙니다. 조직력도 필수이며, 어느 정도의 컴퓨터 사용 경험도 필요합니다. 무엇보다도, 고객을 편안하게 만들 수 있는 개성 있는 사람, 패션에 열정적인 사람이 필요합니다. 업무에는 고객 응대, 재고 관리, 그리고 청소나 폐점 시 문 잠그기와 같은 매장 주변의 소소한 업무가 포함됩니다. 급여는 판매 수수료로 계산되어 직원들이 고객에게 최고의 서비스를 제공하도록 더 많은 동기를 부여합니다. 근무 시간은 유연합니다. 더 자세한 정보는 저희 웹사이트를 방문해 주세요. 이 직책에 관심이 있으시면 Rita의 이메일 rlan@bboutique.com으로 이력서를 보내주세요.

options: Our boutique is the leader in trendy fashions.
Candidates need to be friendly and able to communicate with customers in all kinds of situations.
Come visit our store to see what our business is about.
questions.correct: Candidates need to be friendly and able to communicate with customers in all kinds of situations.

explanation.en: (A) Our boutique is the leader in trendy fashions. (B) Hurry before the promotion ends. (C) Candidates need to be friendly and able to communicate with customers in all kinds of situations. (D) Come visit our store to see what our business is about. -> The passage is about hiring a sales assistant, so it should describe the personality/skills the candidate needs.
explanation.ko: 내용은 지원자 채용과 관련되어 있음

explanation.en: (A) comfortable -> makes customers feel at ease (B) appropriate (C) neglected (D) convenient
explanation.ko: (A) 편안한→고객을 편안하게 만드는

explanation.en: (A) influence (B) incentives -> commission-based pay motivates employees to serve customers well (C) insistence (D) consideration
explanation.ko: (B) 동기부여→수수료가 직원에게 동기를 부여함

explanation.en: Structure: be interested in = to have interest in something The paragraph is in present tense; subject is 'you' -> are interested
explanation.ko: Are interested in (주어가 you이므로 be동사는 are)

items.description:
Handy Maids Home Service

Call us at 555-1244
Handy Maids Home Service (135) ------ professional cleaning services for your business or home. We steam vacuum carpeted areas, polish hard-wood flooring, wipe away all traces of dust and dirt in hard-to-find areas, and clean out clutter. Our (136) ------service is second to none in the tri-state area. We provide a one-day service after esttimations are calculated. (137) ------, we provide weekly and monthly services for customers who request it.

The cleaning products we use are environmentally friendly and pet and child safe. (138) ------. Please visit our website at www..handymaids.com or call us for more information.
items.descriptionKo: Handy Maids 가정 서비스555-1244로 전화 주세요 가정 서비스는 귀하의 사업체나 가정에 전문 청소 서비스를 ---(135.)---합니다. 저희는 카펫 구역을 진공청소하고, 원목 바닥을 광내며, 손이 닿기 어려운 부분의 먼지와 얼룩을 모두 청소하고, 어지럽혀진 것을 정리합니다. 저희의 ---(136.)--- 서비스는 3개 주 지역에서 견줄 데가 없습니다. 견적이 완료된 후 당일 서비스를 제공하며, ---(137.)--- 요청하시는 고객님께는 주간 및 월간 서비스도 제공합니다.저희가 사용하는 청소 제품은 환경친화적이며 반려동물과 어린이에게도 안전합니다. ---(138)--- 더 많은 정보를 원하시면 저희 웹사이트 www.handymaids.com을 방문하거나 전화 주세요.

explanation.en: Provide something for somebody / provide somebody with something Subject 'Handy Maids Home Service' is singular, present tense -> provides
(A) unusual (B) peculiar (C) best (D) exceptional -> outstanding, unmatched service

explanation.en: Eliminate A and D (negative meaning doesn't fit the context). 'must be' is too strong/obligatory for this context -> would be

items.description:
Date: August 22
To: All Sales Team Members
From: Melinda Lackey, Sales Manager
Subject: Rental Policy

For some (143) ------ , we allowed sales reps to pay for their car rentals up front with their personal cards or cash and then be reimbursed later. This is no longer the policy. It has not been the policy for over two months now. As of June 15, all payments for rentals were supposed to have (144) ------ with the company card that was assigned to each of you. Larry in accounting has informed me that he has received 6 different reimbursement forms since then. I have gone ahead and allowed Larry to process those 6 forms. (145) ------. I'm sorry for the (146) ------ tone, but everyone was asked to do this in July. If you have any questions, please contact me directly.
items.descriptionKo: 날짜: 8월 22일 수신: 전체 영업팀원 발신: Melinda Lackey, 영업 관리자 제목: 렌터카 정책143__, 우리는 영업 담당자들이 개인 카드나 현금으로 렌터카 비용을 미리 지불하고 나중에 환급받도록 허용해 왔습니다. 이는 더 이상 정책이 아닙니다. 두 달 넘게 정책이 아니었습니다. 6월 15일부터, 모든 렌터카 비용 결제는 각자에게 지급된 회사 카드로 144__되어야 했습니다. 회계부의 Larry가 저에게 그 이후로 6가지 다른 종류의 환급 양식을 받았다고 알려주었습니다. 저는 우선 Larry에게 그 6개의 양식을 처리하도록 허락했습니다. 145__ 146__에 대해 사과드리지만, 7월부터는 모든 사람이 이를 따르도록 요구받았습니다. 질문이 있으시면 저에게 직접 연락해 주시기 바랍니다.

explanation.en: 'For some time' = occasionally, for a while
explanation.ko: For some times: 한동안, 때때로

explanation.en: Two actions are involved: 'were supposed to' (past) and the payment being made, which should have happened before/along with that -> passive + perfect infinitive: were supposed to have been made
explanation.ko: 결제는 회사 카드로 이루어졌어야/거래되었어야 했다..... 이 문장은 두 가지 동작을 포함함: 두 번째 동작(결제됨)은 첫 번째 동작(~해야 했다)보다 먼저 일어나므로, 두 번째 동작에 사용되는 시제는 첫 번째 동작의 시제보다 뒤에 와야 함 동작 1은 과거형(were) 사용→Were supposed to have + V3/ed (were supposed to V가 아님) 동작 2는 수동태→정답은: were supposed to have been made

options: Only Fonitna Rental should be used to book cars in the future
But, as of tomorrow, no one will be reimbursed.
He will redesign the form by the beginning of next week.
Everyone is required to turn in their cards as soon as possible.

From: Rick Campcell, Director of R&D
To: R&D Department
Subject: Change in Staff

I am writing to share news with you regarding the recent changes in the Research and Development office. Starting April 7, Bob Denkle will be our new project manager in the Research and Development Department. He has just completed a month-long training session and will replace Benjamin Palmer by the end of the week.

Mike Garcia, the HR director, will post an announcement of several openings throughout the departments by next week. For those who wish to transfer into a different department within the company, now would be a good time to apply.

items.description:
Re-Fit Closing Stores

February 9-Nemway Group has announced that 80 Re-Fit stores will be closing down around the country in the next six months with 100 more to follow within the year. -[1]- However, the last ten years has seen a steady decline in sales as consumers turned to other clothing retailers such as Zanas and HRM. -[2]- "I don't know, I just found the clothing to be outdated;" says a former customer. "They should have updated the styles and offered non-sporty options."
CEO Derrick Greenwich agrees. "We focused so much on particular styles of sportswear that we lost sight of the changing tastes of consumers. We're working on restructuring the company and offering consumers what they want. We'll come back bigger than ever:" -[3]- An internal review of the losses will continue to be conducted as nervous shareholders consider their next moves. -[4]- Nemway is hoping that a good portion of the Re-Fit stores will remain in operation as the company struggles to reinvent the brand.
items.descriptionKo: 매장 재폐쇄 2월 9일 - Nemway 그룹은 전국의 Re-Fit 매장 80곳이 향후 6개월 내에 문을 닫으며, 올해 안에 100곳 이상이 추가로 폐점될 것이라고 발표했습니다. -[1]- 그러나 지난 10년 동안 소비자들이 Zanas와 HRM 같은 다른 의류 소매업체로 옮겨가면서 매출이 계속 감소해 왔습니다. -[2]- "잘 모르겠어요, 그냥 옷이 유행에 뒤떨어졌다는 느낌이었어요"라고 한 오랜 고객이 말했습니다. "스타일을 새롭게 하고 스포티하지 않은 선택지도 제공했어야 했어요." CEO Derrick Greenwich도 이에 동의합니다. "우리는 특정 스포티한 스타일에 너무 집중한 나머지 끊임없이 변화하는 소비자 취향을 놓쳐버렸습니다. 우리는 회사를 재구조화하고 소비자가 원하는 것을 제공하기 위해 노력하고 있습니다. 우리는 그 어느 때보다 더 강해져서 돌아올 것입니다." -[3]- 손실에 대한 내부 검토는 계속 진행될 것이며, 그동안 주주들은 불안하게 다음 조치를 저울질하고 있습니다. -[4]- Nemway는 회사가 브랜드를 재창조하기 위해 고군분투하는 동안 Re-Fit 매장의 상당 부분이 계속 운영되기를 희망하고 있습니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about the Re-Fit brand?
options: The CEO is renaming the company.

explanation.en: This is shown by the 80 stores closing (with 100 more to follow), the steady decline in sales, and the company's effort to restructure.
explanation.ko: 80개 매장이 문을 닫고 곧 100개 매장이 추가로 문을 닫을 예정이며, 매출이 감소하고 있고 회사가 구조조정을 위해 노력하고 있다는 사실로 입증됨.

questions.question: The phrase "lost sight of" in the second paragraph is closest in meaning to:

explanation.en: "We focused so much on particular styles of sportswear that we lost sight of the changing tastes of consumers" - 'lost sight of' means they stopped paying attention to/ignored changing fashion trends.

questions.question: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3] and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "The clothing store, best known for its affordable but trendy sportswear, was very popular in the 90's and early 2000's."

explanation.en: This sentence describes the brand's past success. It is followed at position [1] by 'However, the last ten years...', which describes its decline - the two sentences contrast with each other, linked by 'However'.
explanation.ko: [1], [2], [3], [4]로 표시된 위치 중 다음 문장은 어디에 가장 잘 속합니까? "합리적인 가격에 스포티한 스타일로 유명한 이 의류 매장은 90년대와 2000년대 초반에 매우 인기가 있었다." 위 문단은 브랜드의 성공을 묘사하고 있습니다. [1] 위치 다음에는 브랜드의 하락을 묘사하는 "however, the last ten years...." 문장이 이어짐→However라는 접속사로 서로 반대되는 의미를 가진 두 문단을 연결하기에 적합함

items.description:
Ginger Lin[4:59]Just a reminder to everyone to please clear all your desks and shut down all electronic devices before you leave today. The floors will be polished and cleaned over the weekend.
Dimitri Roberts[5:00]Should we lock all the cabinets and drawers as well?
Ginger Lin[5:01]Yes. Please make sure that when the furniture is moved around, nothing falls out.
Dimitri Roberts[5:02]I'll make sure that everything is secure and locked before I leave.
Janet Leigh[5:03]Ginger, I'm done with our budget reports. I'll have a copy e-mailed to you soon before I send them off.
Ginger Lin[5:04]Thank you! And Lance,you'll have tore schedule your meeting with your client tomorrow.
Lance Sibley[5:04]I've already rescheduled our meeting to the following Monday. And to be on the safe side in case our offices are not ready by then, we'll be meeting at a cafe not far from here.
Ginger Lin[5:05]Alright. It looks like most things are in order. Let me know if I missed anything.
Janet Leigh[5:06]Actually, not everyone sent me their overtime hours,. Iwas still able to confirm through the sign-up sheets but Ineed everyone to confirm over e-mail before I send the payment forms to the Finance Department.
Dimitri Roberts[5:07]Oops, that's me. I'll send an e-mail now.
Karen Walker[5:07]Me too.
Janet Leigh[5:08]That's good. I can send the forms once I get your e-mails.
items.descriptionKo: Ginger Lin[4:59]오늘 퇴근 전에 책상을 정리하고 모든 전자기기를 꺼달라고 알리고 싶어요. 바닥은 주말 동안 광택 및 청소가 진행될 예정입니다. Dimitri Roberts[5:00]모든 캐비닛과 서랍도 잠가야 할까요? Ginger Lin[5:01]네. 물건들이 옮겨질 때 아무것도 떨어지지 않도록 확실히 해주세요. Dimitri Roberts[5:02]퇴근 전에 모든 것이 안전하게 잠겨 있는지 확인하겠습니다. Janet Leigh[5:03]Ginger, 예산 보고서 작성을 마쳤어요. 발송하기 전에 먼저 사본을 이메일로 보내드릴게요. Ginger Lin[5:04]고마워요. 그리고 Lance, 내일 고객과의 회의 일정을 다시 잡아야 할 것 같아요. Lance Sibley[5:04]회의를 다음 주 월요일로 옮겼어요. 그리고 만약을 대비해서, 사무실이 그때까지 준비되지 않을 경우를 대비해 여기서 멀지 않은 카페에서 만나기로 했어요. Ginger Lin[5:05]좋아요. 대부분 준비된 것 같네요. 제가 놓친 게 있으면 알려주세요. Janet Leigh[5:06]사실, 아무도 초과 근무 시간을 보내주지 않았어요. 등록 시트를 통해 확인할 수는 있지만, 재무부에 결제를 보내기 전에 모두 이메일로 확인해 주셔야 해요. Dimitri Roberts[5:07]죄송해요, 제가 그랬네요. 지금 바로 이메일 보낼게요. Karen Walker[5:07]저도요. Janet Leigh[5:08]좋아요. 여러분의 이메일을 받는 대로 양식을 보낼 수 있어요.
