items.description:
Helping Hands
8732 Bakersfield Avenue, Santa Clara, California
www.helpinghands.com
Regional Manager-Employment Opportunity

Helping Hands has been dedicated to providing quality, affordable housing for low-income individuals and families. For over 25 years; we have been acquiring multifamily communities and improving the properties to maintain their availability for those earning less than 50 percent of the area's average income. Our properties are currently located in cities throughout the state of Texas- including Austin, Dallas, and Houston- with plans to expand to make more homes available to more people.

We are looking for someone for the position of regional manager. The new manager will be stationed in Austin and will supervise and evaluate the performance of on-site management and ensure that the properties are well maintained. The candidate must have a bachelor's degree or higher in a business or management field, have a minimum of three years of experience in supervising other personnel, and possess certain certificates (more details in the application page).

Applications can be submitted in person Monday through Friday from 9:00 A.M. to 5:00 P.M. or through mail or e-mail. They will be accepted only if they are received before 5:00 P.M. on October 14.
items.descriptionKo: Helping Hands 8732 Bakersfield Avenue, Santa Clara, California www.helpinghands.com 지역 관리자 - 채용 기회Helping Hands는 저소득 개인과 가정에 양질의 저렴한 주택을 제공하는 데 헌신하고 있습니다. 지난 25년 동안, 우리는 가정들의 커뮤니티를 구축하고, 지역 평균 소득의 50퍼센트 미만을 버는 사람들을 계속 도울 수 있도록 시설을 개선해 왔습니다. 우리 시설은 현재 Austin, Dallas, Houston을 포함한 텍사스 주 전역의 도시에 위치해 있으며, 더 많은 사람들에게 더 많은 주택을 제공하기 위해 확장할 계획입니다.우리는 지역 관리자 직책을 맡을 사람을 찾고 있습니다. 새 관리자는 Austin에 배치되어 현장 관리자의 성과를 감독하고 평가하며 자산이 잘 관리되도록 할 것입니다. 지원자는 경영학이나 경영 관리 분야의 학사 이상 학위, 다른 직원을 관리한 최소 3년 경력, 그리고 특정 자격증(자세한 내용은 지원서 페이지 참조)을 갖추어야 합니다.지원서는 월요일부터 금요일, 오전 9시부터 오후 5시까지 직접 제출하거나 우편 또는 이메일을 통해 제출할 수 있습니다. 10월 14일 오후 5시까지 접수된 지원서만 수락됩니다.

To: cmason@centersports.com
From: sdixon@instaprinting.com

Subject: Your Inquiry

Dear Mr. Mason,

We are responding to the inquiry you made through our website yesterday. Insta Printing promises to provide faster, cheaper, and more reliable service than any of our competitors in the area. And we also guarantee to beat any price offered by a competitor.

As per your request, our company would be happy to help design and print jerseys for your soccer team. Besides casual wear, our company also has plenty of experience producing athletic wear for sports teams and clubs.

Customers can choose from a variety of materials and printing methods. These include denim, cotton, flannel, nylon and many more, and there are several printing methods including screen printing, heat press, and direct-to-garment printing.

Please feel free to contact me directly at 712-555-9804 to discuss the details further about working with Ilnsta Printing. We look forward to working with you and helping your organization achieve its goals.

Sincerely,

Stephen Dixon
Client Relations Representative, Ilnsta Printing

items.description:
(Man) -[1]- I remember when Sergio Hernandez first came to work here at Trout & Lee. He was a young man of thirty with a heart and mind filled with ambition and drive, -[2]- It is that ambition and drive, along with a lot of Integrity and intelligence, that made him one of the most valuable players in the garment business and us one of the most successful companies.
-[3]- I can't help but remember how emotional Iwas when Ileft the company to pursue a life of leisure last year. -[4]- Iknow the speech Serg. gave then came back to help me during the difficult transition into living without an office to go to and colleagues to be continually inspired by, and I hope the few humble words I've strung together will remind him of how well-respected he is and what an astounding life he has lived as he goes through the same process. Please, put your hands together for Mr. Sergio Hernandez.
items.descriptionKo: (한 남성) - [1] - Sergio Hernandez가 처음 Trout & Lee에 입사했을 때가 기억납니다. 그는 야망과 결단력으로 가득한 마음과 정신을 가진 서른 살의 젊은이였습니다. - [2] - 그 야망과 추진력, 그리고 많은 성실함과 지성이 그를 의류업계에서 가장 가치 있는 인재 중 한 명으로 만들었고, 우리 회사를 가장 성공적인 회사 중 하나로 만들었습니다. - [3] - 작년에 제 꿈을 좇기 위해 회사를 떠났을 때의 제 감정을 떠올리지 않을 수 없습니다. - [4] - 그 후 Serg.의 말이... 사무실도, 계속해서 영감을 주는 동료들도 없는 어려운 전환기에 저를 도와주기 위해 돌아왔다는 것을 알고 있으며, 제 몇 마디 말이 그가 얼마나 존경받고 있는지, 그리고 같은 과정을 겪으면서 얼마나 훌륭하게 살아왔는지를 그에게 상기시켜 줄 수 있기를 바랍니다. 여러분, Sergio Hernandez 씨를 위해 박수를 보내주십시오.

The type of employee he was

explanation.en: "He was a young man of thirty..." covers (A); "ambition and drive, along with a lot of integrity and intelligence" covers (B); "one of the most valuable players in the garment business" covers (C). His actual job title/position is never mentioned.
explanation.ko: Hernandez 씨에 대해 언급되지 않은 것은 무엇입니까? (A) 그가 회사에서 일하기 시작한 시기→ "He was a young man of thirty with a heart and ...." (B) 그의 성품 → "It is that ambition and drive, along with a lot of Integrity and intelligence" (C) 그가 종사한 업계→ "one of the most valuable players in the garment business" (D) 회사에서의 그의 직책→언급되지 않음

questions.question: In which of the marked positions [1], [2], [3], or [4] does this sentence best belong? "I feel it a great honor to be asked to speak about him here today."

explanation.en: At [1], 'him' wouldn't yet refer to anyone, since the person being discussed hasn't been established. At [2], the surrounding sentences flow together describing Hernandez's character, so inserting this sentence there would break that flow. At [3], the description of Hernandez has just been completed, so this sentence works well as a closing remark before the speech moves on to a new idea.
explanation.ko: [1], [2], [3] 또는 [4]로 표시된 위치 중 이 문장은 어디에 가장 잘 속합니까? "오늘 이 자리에서 그에 대해 이야기하도록 요청받은 것을 영광으로 생각합니다." (A) [1]→이 위치에 있으면 him이 누구인지 알 수 없으며, 앞 문장에서 지금 언급되는 사람에 대한 이야기가 없음. (B) [2]→위치 [2]의 앞뒤 문장은 Her 씨의 인품을 묘사하는 일관된 흐름의 정보임. 따라서 이 문장을 위치 2에 삽입하는 것은 적절하지 않음. (C) [3]→위치 [3] 앞의 내용은 Her 씨에 대한 전반적인 묘사를 막 마친 상태이므로, 이 문장이 지금까지의 이야기를 마무리하는 결론 문장이 될 수 있음. Her 씨가 어떤 사람인지 칭찬한 후 그에 대해 말하도록 요청받은 것을 영광으로 생각한다고 마무리함. 그리고 이후 단락은 다른 주제로 넘어감.

items.description:
Attention Passengers
Clinton Bus Lines

🚌 In response to customer feedback, Clinton Bus Lines will be expanding its bus routes connecting Texas to other metropolitan centers in the Southwest. Starting on May 1, the new routes listed below will take effect. In order to promote these new bus lines, we will be offering tickets at half price during the first week of operation. Improving your satisfaction is our main priority. To get more detailed information such as departure and arrival times, please visit our website at www.clintonbuses.com.

- From Dallas Bus Terminal to Phoenix, Arizona Bus Terminall
- From Austin Bus Terminall to Santa Fe, New Mexico Bus Terminal
- From Fort Worth Bus Terminall to Denver, Colorado Bus Terminal
To: erichanson@prplanning.com
From: dangregory@trentonlogistics.com
Date: April 27
Subject: Upcoming Visit

Dear Mr. Hanson,

I am currently finalizing all the details for my visit to your company's headquarters in Santa Fe. Thank you for inviting me down to take part in these business negotiations. Please let me know what time I should arrive. Will the meeting begin after lunchtime like it did last time?

You won't need to pick up me up, as I have arranged for a cab to pick me up at the Santa Fe Bus Terminal. Fortunately, a new bus line was established between where I live and your offices. It has made transit in the Southwestern region considerably convenient. There are routes that now travel to Denver and Phoenix as well. Also, thanks to some lucky circumstances, I will be able to buy my ticket to Santa Fe at half the original price.

I can't wait to see you and your co-workers again soon.
Dan Gregory
items.descriptionKo: 승객 안내Clinton Bus Lines🚌 고객의 의견에 따라, Clinton Bus Lines는 텍사스와 남서부의 다른 도시 중심지를 연결하는 버스 노선을 확장할 예정입니다. 5월 1일부터 아래에 나열된 새 노선이 시행됩니다. 이 새로운 버스 노선을 홍보하기 위해, 운영 첫 주 동안 티켓을 절반 가격에 제공할 예정입니다. 여러분의 만족도를 높이는 것이 우리의 최우선 과제입니다. 출발 및 도착 시간과 같은 더 자세한 정보를 얻으시려면 저희 웹사이트 www.clintonbusses.com을 방문해 주세요.- Dallas 버스 정류장에서 Phoenix, Arizona 버스 정류장까지 - Austin 버스 정류장에서 Santa Fe, New Mexico 버스 정류장까지 - Fort Worth 버스 정류장에서 Denver, Colorado 버스 정류장까지To: erichanson@prplanning.com From: dangregory@trentonlogistics.com 4월 27일 제목: 다가오는 방문Hanson 씨께,저는 지금 Santa Fe에 있는 귀사 본사 방문에 관한 모든 세부 사항을 마무리하고 있습니다. 이번 비즈니스 협상에 초대해 주셔서 감사합니다. 제가 언제 도착해야 하는지 알려주시기 바랍니다. 회의는 지난번처럼 점심시간 이후에 시작되나요? 저를 데리러 오실 필요는 없습니다. 이미 Santa Fe 버스 정류장에서 저를 태울 택시를 예약했습니다. 다행히도 제가 사는 곳과 귀사 사무실 사이에 새로운 버스 노선이 생겼습니다. 이는 남서부 지역에서의 이동을 훨씬 편리하게 만들어 주었습니다. 현재 Denver와 Phoenix로 가는 노선도 있습니다. 또한 운이 좋게도, Santa Fe로 가는 티켓을 절반 가격에 구매할 수 있게 되었습니다.곧 당신과 동료들을 다시 만나기를 고대하고 있습니다. Dan Gregory

explanation.en: Mr. Gregory got his ticket at half price, and half-price tickets are only sold during the new routes' first week of operation, from May 1 through the end of that week (May 7).
explanation.ko: Gregory 씨는 절반 가격으로 티켓을 구매했는데, 원가의 절반 가격은 새 버스 노선이 개통된 첫 주에만 판매됨, 즉 5월 1일 개통일부터 5월 7일이 포함된 주까지

To: Brian Petersen <bpetersen@atasteofclass.com>
From: Jason Hostrum <jhostrum@jhfurnishing.com>
Date: November 20
Subject: Office Christmas Party

Dear Mr. Peterson

I am looking to engage the services of your catering company, A Taste of Class, for our Christmas party at the end of this year. Ideally, we would like to have our event on Saturday, December 20. I just have a few questions about your services. First, do you provide decorations? I really want this year's party to be a hit; it is my first time being responsible for it and I really want to impress the boss. Second do you have a wide range of vegetarian dishes? We have 12 vegetarians on our staff of 35, so it will be important to provide them a full meal, not just appetizers. If you could get back to me with the answers to my questions and your availability for the 20th, I would greatly appreciate it.

Sincerely,

Jason Rostrum
Junior Secretary, Johnson Home Furnishing
To: Jason Hostrum <jhostrum@jhfurnishing.com>
From: Brian Petersen <bpetersen@atasteofclass.com>
Date: November 21
Subject: Office Christmas Party

Dear Mr. Rostrum,

I am delighted that you have contacted A T aste of Class to help make your Christmas party one to remember. Let me answer all ofyour questions and put your mind at ease. To begin with, we have one team left that can cater you for the 20oth of December, so you are in luck! As far as the decorations are concerned, we have several different themes to choose from; please visit our website at www.atasteofclass.com to see pictures of our successful events from the past. They are labeled with themes so you may just choose one that appeals to you. Your final inquiry regarding the vegetarian option will also require some decision- malkcing on your part. We offer gourmet dining and are happy to specially prepare 12 vegetarian meals, but that can be a little bit expensive. I don't know what your budget is, but might I suggest making the entire menu vegetarian? We have an outstanding vegetarian chef, Julia Monroe, who can prepare a full vegetarian buffet so delicious a lion would eat it! This option is also a lot more cost-effective than preparing two separate menus. After reviewing your options, please let me know what choices are best for you.

Sincerely,

Brian Petersen,
Booking and Sales Manager
A Taste of Class
To: Brian Petersen <bpetersen@atasteofclass.com>
From: Jason Hostrum <jhostrum@jhfurnishing.com>
Date: November 22
Subject: Office Christmas Party

Dear Mr. Petersen,

Thanks for your reply. I want to go ahead and book the event for Saturday the 20th of December. I want the decoration theme Winter Wonderland, and I have decided to take your advice and go with whatever menu chef Julia Monroe can put together for us. I really appreciate all of your recommendations and I just know this will be a great event!

All the best,

Jason Rostrum,
Junior Secretary, Johnson Home Furnishing

To: Raquel Jenkins <cservice@starproducts.com>
From: Jose Ramos<jramos.zipnet.com>
Date: October 14
Subject: Defective Hose

Dear Ms. Jenkins,

Recently, I purchased 5,000 yards of XP100 industrial hosing from your company, Star Products. The hosing was listed as capable of handling up to 1,000 pounds of pressure per square inch (psi). My company, Advanced Dynamic Cleaning, refitted all of our pressure washers with your hosing at considerable cost and time. Every single one of our pressure washers failed somewhere along the hosing from the joint of the gun to the compressor. Our compressors only create 500 psi, so I have to conclude that there is some defect in the design of your hose. I would like to get a refund of my purchase or a replacement of my order with hosing that meets industry standards. I have included my purchase order and a copy of the invoice.

Sincerely,
Jose Ramos
To: Jose Ramos <jramos.zipnet.com>
From: Raquel Jenkins <cservice@starproducts.com>
Date: October 16
Subject: Defective Hose

Dear Mr. Ramos,

We have received your report of a defective hose and reviewed the attached documents. We really value your business and hate that you went through such a waste of time and energy with our hosing. However, I am afraid to say that the mistake may be on your end. In looking over your purchase, you clearly ordered XP1 00 hosing x 5,000 yards. If you look at the specs for that hosing, it is only rated at appropriate for 100 psi. This could explain why all of your hosing failed. What I can offer you is an exchange of the remaining XP1 00 hosing in your inventory for a hosing more appropriate to your needs. We will do this at no charge and pay for the shipping as a show of our appreciation for your business. Please fill out the purchase order that I have attached and include it with the XP1 00 hosing when you ship it back to us for exchange.

Thank you,
Raquel Jenkins

items.descriptionKo: To: Raquel Jenkins <cservice@starproducts.com> From: Jose Ramos<jramos.zipnet.com> Date: 10월 14일 제목: 호스 결함, 불량Jenkins 씨께,최근에 저는 귀사인 Star Products에서 XP100 산업용 호스 5,000야드를 구매했습니다. 이 호스는 평방 인치당 1,000파운드(psi)의 압력을 견딜 수 있다고 명시되어 있습니다. 제 회사인 Advanced Dynamic Cleaning은 상당한 비용과 시간을 들여 모든 압력 세척기를 귀사의 호스로 재정비했습니다. 저희 압력 세척기 각각은 스프레이 건에서 압축기까지 이어지는 연결부 어딘가에서 호스에 문제가 발생하고 있습니다. 저희 공기 압축기는 500psi만 생성하므로, 귀사의 호스 설계에 어떤 결함이 있다고 결론지을 수밖에 없습니다. 저는 구매한 대금을 환불받거나, 산업 표준에 맞는 다른 호스로 주문을 교체받고 싶습니다. 주문서와 영수증 사본을 첨부했습니다.감사합니다, Jose RamosTo: Jose Ramos <jramos.zipnet.com> From: Raquel Jenkins <cservice@starproducts.com> Date: 10월 16일 제목: 호스 결함, 불량Ramos 씨께,저희는 호스 결함에 대한 귀하의 보고를 받았고 첨부된 문서를 검토했습니다. 저희는 귀하와의 거래를 정말 중요하게 여기며, 귀하가 저희 호스로 인해 그렇게 많은 시간과 노력을 낭비하셨다는 점에 대해 정말 유감스럽게 생각합니다. 그러나 유감스럽게도, 이 문제는 귀하 쪽의 실수일 수도 있다고 말씀드려야겠습니다. 귀하의 구매 내역을 확인해 보니, 귀하는 명확히 XP100 호스 5,000야드를 주문하셨습니다. 그 유형의 호스 사양을 확인해 보시면, 100psi에만 적합하도록 등급이 매겨져 있습니다. 이것이 귀하의 모든 호스가 결함을 일으킨 이유를 설명해 줄 수 있을 것입니다. 저희가 귀하를 위해 할 수 있는 일은 귀하의 재고에 남아 있는 XP100 호스를 귀하의 필요에 더 적합한 다른 유형으로 교환해 드리는 것입니다. 저희는 귀하의 사업에 대한 감사의 표시로 이를 무료로 진행하고 배송비도 부담해 드리겠습니다. 첨부한 주문서를 작성하시고, 교환을 위해 저희에게 XP100 호스를 반송하실 때 함께 보내주시기 바랍니다.감사합니다, Raquel JenkinsStar Products 주문서 제품명PSI필요 길이야드당 가격적용 할인XP100010002,500야드$.50XP100 제품과의 합의된 교환에 따른 총 할인

Subject: Fall Party

Dear Mr. Roberts,

My name is Leroy Jenkins and I am planning a family reunion for the first weekend of October. I have heard from some friends that your parties are absolutely the best. I really want to make a good impression with my sister's new in-laws; it will be the first time that they join our family for our annual reunion. I just have a few questions for you. My family is also a little bit picky with the food they like, so if it is possible for you to send a list of the foods that you provide and the cost per person, I would like to go through it and create my own menu.. The last question I have for you is staffing. I really don't want to be cleaning up and doing dishes during the party. Do you provide staff, and if so, how much do you charge for their service? Please write me back so we can get this party planned!

All the best,
Leroy Jenkins

questions.question: ------ the difference between the two brands is small, most consumers purchase the cheaper one.

explanation.en: This sentence tests reading comprehension of the whole logic chain (small price difference → most buy the cheaper option) rather than a single grammar point — wrong answers here typically reverse the cause-and-effect direction, so always trace which event causes which.
explanation.ko: 이 문장은 하나의 문법 요점이 아니라 전체 논리 사슬(작은 가격 차이 → 대부분 더 저렴한 것을 구매)에 대한 독해력을 시험합니다 — 여기서 오답은 일반적으로 인과관계의 방향을 뒤집으므로, 항상 어떤 사건이 어떤 사건을 일으키는지 추적하세요.

questions.question: Audience members were impressed that the question asked of the candidate was answered ------.

explanation.en: When a question is flagged as simply needing "an adverb", the trap options are usually the adjective or noun forms sharing the same root — don't be pulled toward a word that sounds thematically right; check its exact part of speech against what the blank modifies.
explanation.ko: 질문이 단순히 "부사"가 필요하다고 표시될 때, 함정 선택지는 보통 같은 어근을 공유하는 형용사나 명사 형태입니다 — 주제상 맞아 보이는 단어에 이끌리지 마세요; 빈칸이 무엇을 수식하는지에 맞춰 정확한 품사를 확인하세요.

questions.question: In an attempt ------ sustainable energy, city officials have had solar panels affixed to some public buildings.

explanation.en: "To + verb" expressing purpose ("I eat much to gain more weight") is often confused with "for + noun/V-ing", which also expresses purpose but requires a different grammatical structure after it — check whether what follows the blank is a verb or a noun to pick the right pattern.
explanation.ko: 목적을 표현하는 "To + 동사"("I eat much to gain more weight")는 마찬가지로 목적을 나타내지만 뒤에 다른 문법 구조가 필요한 "for + 명사/V-ing"와 자주 혼동됩니다 — 빈칸 뒤에 오는 것이 동사인지 명사인지 확인해 올바른 패턴을 고르세요.

questions.question: The slow ------ of the fire department resulted in severe damage to the building.

explanation.en: The pattern "Noun + of + Noun" signals that the blank needs a noun form, not a verb — "response" (noun) is easy to confuse with "respond" (verb) or "responsive" (adjective) since they share a root, so always check the exact suffix.
explanation.ko: "명사 + of + 명사" 패턴은 빈칸에 명사 형태가 필요함을 나타내며, 동사가 아닙니다 — "response"(명사)는 어근을 공유하기 때문에 "respond"(동사)나 "responsive"(형용사)와 혼동하기 쉬우므로, 항상 정확한 접미사를 확인하세요.

questions.question: After hours of searching, the source of the water leak was ------ identified by the plumber.

explanation.en: "Finally", "routinely", "rarely", and "strongly" are all valid adverbs grammatically, so this is a pure vocabulary-meaning question — the trap is picking one that fits generally rather than the one matching the specific time/frequency/degree nuance the sentence needs.
explanation.ko: "Finally", "routinely", "rarely", "strongly"는 모두 문법적으로 유효한 부사이므로, 이는 순전히 어휘 의미에 관한 질문입니다 — 함정은 대체로 맞는 것을 선택하는 것이지, 문장이 필요로 하는 구체적인 시간/빈도/정도의 뉘앙스에 맞는 것을 선택하지 않는 것입니다.

questions.question: Please tell ------ that the workshop has been moved to Conference Room 402.

explanation.en: "Everyone" is a singular pronoun despite referring to a group of people — a common mistake is pairing it with a plural verb; always remember indefinite pronouns like everyone/everybody/anyone take singular verbs even though their meaning feels plural.
explanation.ko: "Everyone"은 사람들의 그룹을 가리키지만 단수 대명사입니다 — 흔한 실수는 복수 동사와 짝짓는 것입니다; everyone/everybody/anyone 같은 부정대명사는 의미가 복수처럼 느껴져도 단수 동사를 취한다는 것을 항상 기억하세요.

questions.question: Highway 16 was widened over the summer to ------ the heavier traffic that is using the roadway.

explanation.en: "Accommodate" (to provide space for a group) is a vocabulary trap easily confused with similar-sounding verbs about hosting or fitting — always verify the verb's precise meaning matches whether the sentence is about physical space, time, or another kind of provision.
explanation.ko: "Accommodate"(그룹에게 공간을 제공하다)는 접대나 적합성에 관한 비슷하게 들리는 동사와 쉽게 혼동되는 어휘 함정입니다 — 문장이 물리적 공간, 시간, 아니면 다른 종류의 제공에 관한 것인지에 동사의 정확한 의미가 맞는지 항상 확인하세요.

questions.question: Meal vouchers were given to Beta Airways passengers ------ were not able to depart on time because of a booking error.

explanation.en: "Who" replacing "Beta Airways passengers" is a relative clause structure — a common trap is picking "whom" or "whose" instead, so always identify what the relative pronoun is replacing (a subject vs. an object vs. a possessive) before choosing.
explanation.ko: "Beta Airways passengers"를 대체하는 "Who"는 관계절 구조입니다 — 흔한 함정은 대신 "whom"이나 "whose"를 선택하는 것이므로, 선택하기 전에 관계대명사가 무엇을 대체하는지(주어 대 목적어 대 소유격) 항상 확인하세요.

questions.question: The catalog for the gallery contains an accurate ------ of each piece of artwork that is offered for sale.

explanation.en: The pattern "Noun/Noun phrase + of + Noun/Noun phrase" is the same trap as elsewhere in this test — whenever "of" follows the blank, strongly favor a noun over a verb form, even when a verb-looking option seems thematically closer.
explanation.ko: "명사/명사구 + of + 명사/명사구" 패턴은 이 시험의 다른 곳에서와 같은 함정입니다 — 빈칸 뒤에 "of"가 올 때마다, 동사처럼 보이는 선택지가 주제상 더 가까워 보이더라도 동사 형태보다 명사를 강하게 선호하세요.

questions.question: To ensure that old appliances are disposed of properly, the city will offer free removal of these devices ------ April 2 and April 5.

explanation.en: "Between time and time" (e.g. "between Monday and Friday") is a fixed structure — a common mistake is using "from...to" or "among" instead, so memorize that "between" specifically pairs with "and" when bracketing a time range.
explanation.ko: "Between 시간 and 시간"(예: "between Monday and Friday")은 고정된 구조입니다 — 흔한 실수는 대신 "from...to"나 "among"을 사용하는 것이므로, "between"이 시간 범위를 묶을 때 구체적으로 "and"와 짝을 이룬다는 것을 기억하세요.

questions.question: A buffet dinner is available to the guests, so they may eat ------ looks appetizing to them without having to place an order.

explanation.en: "Whatever" (meaning "it doesn't matter what") is easy to confuse with similar-looking indefinite words like "whichever" or "whoever" — each has a distinct scope (thing vs. choice vs. person), so match the word to exactly what kind of uncertainty the sentence expresses.
explanation.ko: "Whatever"("무엇이든 상관없다"라는 뜻)는 "whichever"나 "whoever" 같은 비슷하게 생긴 부정어와 혼동하기 쉽습니다 — 각각 고유한 범위(사물 대 선택 대 사람)를 가지므로, 문장이 표현하는 정확한 불확실성의 종류에 단어를 맞추세요.

questions.question: During the music festival, goods will be sold only by ------ vendors who have registered with the planners.

explanation.en: "Approved vendors" is a fixed collocation where "approved" functions as an adjective — a common trap is picking the verb form "approve" instead, forgetting that a word directly before a noun needs to function as a modifier.
explanation.ko: "Approved vendors"는 "approved"가 형용사로 기능하는 고정 연어입니다 — 흔한 함정은 대신 동사 형태 "approve"를 선택하는 것으로, 명사 바로 앞의 단어는 수식어로 기능해야 한다는 것을 잊는 것입니다.

questions.question: The grocery store chain Refresh Foods has ------ in organic products since it opened in 2001.

explanation.en: "Specialize in" is a fixed verb-preposition pairing — a common mistake is substituting a different preposition ("specialize on/for/at") that sounds plausible but is simply not the correct fixed collocation; memorize verb-preposition pairs as whole units.
explanation.ko: "Specialize in"은 고정된 동사-전치사 짝입니다 — 흔한 실수는 그럴듯하게 들리지만 올바른 고정 연어가 아닌 다른 전치사("specialize on/for/at")로 바꾸는 것입니다; 동사-전치사 짝을 전체 단위로 외우세요.

questions.question: The malfunction of the printer was ------ a component that had been inserted incorrectly during the assembly process.

explanation.en: "Due to" (meaning "because of") is often confused with "due" alone (meaning "expected/scheduled") — these look related but serve very different grammatical roles, so always check whether the sentence needs a cause explanation or a time/expectation meaning.
explanation.ko: "Due to"("~때문에"라는 뜻)는 단독의 "due"("예정된/기대되는"이라는 뜻)와 자주 혼동됩니다 — 이는 관련되어 보이지만 매우 다른 문법적 역할을 하므로, 문장이 원인 설명을 필요로 하는지 시간/기대의 의미를 필요로 하는지 항상 확인하세요.

questions.question: The proposed holiday schedule is ------ to most workers because they feel it is fair.

explanation.en: The pattern "to be + adjective" is a common trap for a verb-heavy sentence — after a form of "be", test-takers sometimes reach for a verb or noun option instead of the adjective that correctly completes the linking-verb structure.
explanation.ko: "to be + 형용사" 패턴은 동사가 많은 문장에서 흔한 함정입니다 — "be"의 형태 뒤에서, 응시자들은 때때로 연결동사 구조를 올바르게 완성하는 형용사 대신 동사나 명사 선택지로 손을 뻗습니다.

questions.question: The test will ------ prove whether or not the patient has the disease.

explanation.en: "Will + adverb + verb" places the adverb between the modal and the main verb — a common trap is placing a noun or adjective in this slot instead, forgetting that this specific mid-sentence position is reserved for adverbs modifying the verb that follows.
explanation.ko: "Will + 부사 + 동사"는 조동사와 본동사 사이에 부사를 배치합니다 — 흔한 함정은 이 자리에 명사나 형용사를 넣는 것으로, 이 특정 문장 중간 위치가 뒤따르는 동사를 수식하는 부사를 위해 예약되어 있다는 것을 잊는 것입니다.

questions.question: With over two hundred unique stores, the Plainview Mall ------ millions of shoppers on an annual basis.

explanation.en: "Attracts" (to pull/draw people or things by appealing qualities) is a vocabulary trap easily confused with verbs about physically moving or transporting something — always check whether the sentence is about appeal/interest or literal physical movement.
explanation.ko: "Attracts"(매력적인 특성으로 사람이나 사물을 끌어당기다)는 무언가를 물리적으로 이동시키거나 운반하는 것에 관한 동사와 혼동하기 쉬운 어휘 함정입니다 — 문장이 매력/관심에 관한 것인지 문자 그대로의 물리적 이동에 관한 것인지 항상 확인하세요.

questions.question: The participants will be judged on ------ performance, and the winners will be announced later in the awards ceremony.

explanation.en: "Athletic" (strong, healthy, good at sports) describing performance is a vocabulary-precision question — near-miss adjectives about general fitness or health can seem to fit but miss the specific sports-competence meaning the sentence needs.
explanation.ko: 성능을 묘사하는 "Athletic"(강하고, 건강하며, 스포츠에 능한)은 어휘 정확도의 문제입니다 — 일반적인 체력이나 건강에 관한 근접 형용사는 맞아 보일 수 있지만, 문장이 필요로 하는 스포츠 능력에 관한 구체적 의미를 놓칩니다.

questions.question: The York Foundation is an organization that has been supporting ------ in medical technology for the past decade.

explanation.en: "Support something" naturally takes a noun/noun phrase as its object ("advances") — a common trap is picking a verb form after "support", forgetting that a transitive verb here needs a noun object, not another action word.
explanation.ko: "Support something"는 자연스럽게 명사/명사구를 목적어로 취합니다("advances") — 흔한 함정은 "support" 뒤에 동사 형태를 선택하는 것으로, 여기 타동사가 명사 목적어를 필요로 하지 다른 동작어를 필요로 하지 않는다는 것을 잊는 것입니다.

questions.question: ------ the volleyball tournament is held indoors or outdoors depends heavily on the weather forecast for that day.

explanation.en: "Whether...or" is a fixed double-conjunction pattern — a common trap is breaking the pair apart by using "if...or" or "either...or" instead, which look similar but follow different grammatical rules; memorize "whether...or" as one inseparable unit.
explanation.ko: "Whether...or"는 고정된 이중 접속사 패턴입니다 — 흔한 함정은 이 쌍을 나누어 대신 "if...or"나 "either...or"를 사용하는 것으로, 비슷해 보이지만 다른 문법 규칙을 따릅니다; "whether...or"를 분리할 수 없는 하나의 단위로 외우세요.

questions.question: The company was under investigation after several former employees made allegations of unfair ------.

explanation.en: "Practices" (regularly done habits/customs, plural noun) is a vocabulary trap easily confused with "practice" as a verb (to rehearse) — check whether the sentence needs a countable noun referring to established routines or an action verb.
explanation.ko: "Practices"(정기적으로 행해지는 습관/관습, 복수 명사)는 동사 형태의 "practice"(연습하다)와 혼동하기 쉬운 어휘 함정입니다 — 문장이 확립된 관행을 가리키는 가산명사를 필요로 하는지 동작 동사를 필요로 하는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: ------ joined Vince's Gym, Mr. Pinter could attend group classes and health counseling sessions for free.

explanation.en: "Having joined Vince's Gym, Mr. Pinter could attend" is a reduced participle clause standing in for "Because Mr. Pinter has joined..." — the trap is not recognizing this shortened form and instead expecting a full subject+verb clause in that position.
explanation.ko: "Having joined Vince's Gym, Mr. Pinter could attend"는 "Because Mr. Pinter has joined..."를 대신하는 축약된 분사절입니다 — 함정은 이 축약형을 인식하지 못하고 대신 그 자리에 완전한 주어+동사절을 기대하는 것입니다.

questions.question: The best method for improving the ------ of your home at little cost is giving the exterior a fresh coat of paint.

explanation.en: "Appearance" (how something looks to others) is a vocabulary trap easily confused with related but distinct nouns like "appointment" or "apparent" — always verify the exact word matches the sentence's meaning about visual perception, not just a similar spelling.
explanation.ko: "Appearance"(무언가가 다른 사람에게 어떻게 보이는지)는 "appointment"나 "apparent"처럼 관련은 있지만 다른 명사와 혼동하기 쉬운 어휘 함정입니다 — 단지 철자가 비슷한 것이 아니라 정확한 단어가 시각적 인식에 관한 문장의 의미와 일치하는지 항상 확인하세요.

questions.question: Marketers believed that if the packaging were more ------ colored, consumers might pay more attention to the product.

explanation.en: "Variously" (in several different ways/times/by different people) modifying "colored" is a subtle adverb-of-manner choice — a common trap is picking a degree adverb (like "very") instead, missing that the sentence needs to express diversity of manner, not intensity.
explanation.ko: "colored"를 수식하는 "Variously"(여러 방식으로/여러 시점에/여러 사람에 의해)는 미묘한 방식 부사 선택입니다 — 흔한 함정은 대신 정도 부사("very" 같은)를 선택하는 것으로, 문장이 강도가 아니라 방식의 다양성을 표현해야 한다는 것을 놓치는 것입니다.

questions.question: The police officer directed the traffic ------ the detour ramp so that drivers could find the route easily.

explanation.en: "Toward" (in the direction of, closer to) is a preposition trap easily confused with similar directional words like "against" or "about" — check whether the sentence describes movement/orientation toward something, not opposition or a general topic.
explanation.ko: "Toward"(~의 방향으로, 더 가까이)는 "against"나 "about" 같은 비슷한 방향어와 혼동하기 쉬운 전치사 함정입니다 — 문장이 반대나 일반적인 주제가 아니라 무언가를 향한 이동/방향을 묘사하는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: Employees are asked to pair up with another ------ and check each other at the predetermined meeting place during fire drills.

explanation.en: "Colleague" (a co-worker, one of a group working together) is a vocabulary trap easily confused with "collaborator" or "college" (sound-alike) — always double-check the word refers to a workplace peer, not an institution or a different relationship.
explanation.ko: "Colleague"(동료, 함께 일하는 사람들 그룹 중 한 명)는 "collaborator"나 "college"(발음이 비슷한)와 혼동하기 쉬운 어휘 함정입니다 — 그 단어가 기관이나 다른 관계가 아니라 직장 동료를 가리키는지 항상 다시 확인하세요.

questions.question: The car owner submitted ------ evidence of the damage along with a mechanic's report to his insurance company.

explanation.en: "Submitted evidence" follows the pattern verb (past participle) + adjective + noun — a common trap is misordering these or picking a noun form of "submit" instead of the participle acting as a modifier before "evidence".
explanation.ko: "Submitted evidence"는 동사(과거분사) + 형용사 + 명사 패턴을 따릅니다 — 흔한 함정은 이 순서를 뒤바꾸거나 "evidence" 앞에서 수식어 역할을 하는 분사 대신 "submit"의 명사 형태를 선택하는 것입니다.

questions.question: The restrooms on the second floor are ------ unavailable because one of the sinks is being replaced.

explanation.en: "Temporarily" (not lasting long/for ever) is a vocabulary trap easily confused with "permanently" (its opposite) or "immediately" (about speed, not duration) — always match the adverb to whether the sentence is about how long something lasts.
explanation.ko: "Temporarily"(오래/영원히 지속되지 않는)는 "permanently"(반대말)나 "immediately"(속도에 관한 것이지 지속 시간이 아님)와 혼동하기 쉬운 어휘 함정입니다 — 문장이 무언가가 얼마나 오래 지속되는지에 관한 것인지에 부사를 항상 맞추세요.

questions.question: Because our sales representatives meet with high-level clients in the industry, ------ those with a professional manner will be considered for the position.

explanation.en: "Only" (limited to no more than / nothing other than) can function as both an adverb and adjective depending on position — a common trap is misplacing it in the sentence, which changes what it's limiting; check exactly what word or phrase "only" is meant to restrict.
explanation.ko: "Only"(그 이상이 아니게 제한된 / 그 외 다른 것이 아닌)는 위치에 따라 부사와 형용사 모두로 기능할 수 있습니다 — 흔한 함정은 문장에서 잘못된 위치에 놓는 것으로, 이는 그것이 제한하는 대상을 바꿉니다; "only"가 정확히 어떤 단어나 구를 제한하려는 것인지 확인하세요.

questions.question: On next week's radio program, our host will interview Kristen Dabney about her time working as an ------ for a UN official.

explanation.en: "Interpreter" (someone who translates spoken language) is a vocabulary trap easily confused with "translator" (who works with written language) or "interpretation" (the noun for the act itself) — match the exact word to whether the sentence is about a person, an action, or spoken vs. written language.
explanation.ko: "Interpreter"(구두 언어를 통역하는 사람)는 "translator"(문어를 다루는 사람)나 "interpretation"(그 행위 자체를 나타내는 명사)과 혼동하기 쉬운 어휘 함정입니다 — 문장이 사람, 행동, 아니면 구어 대 문어에 관한 것인지에 정확한 단어를 맞추세요.

Lockland Business News
September 8 — [1] - This comes as a relief for residents on both sides of the Canadian and American borders as many shoppers from Lockland often take the one-and-a half-hour drive into Canada to shop at the Cashco warehouse there. - [2] - This usually results in long waits at the border and a very crowded Canadian Cashco with more than half the shoppers from across the border. Many Canadian residents of Brentwood are resentful of the large crowds in their tiny town and Lockland residents have complained that tire closest American Cashco is located almost 5 hours away. - [3] - "I'm very excited," said Lockland resident Janice Burrows. "I heard it'll be huge. Maybe Canadians might start coming here to shop. But all kidding aside, we've been petitioning for a branch here for a long time." - [4] – The new Lockland Cashco is rumored to become one of the largest warehouses in America with full petrol service, pet center, restaurant, cafeterias, garden center, and medical clinic.

items.description:
Centerville County Shelter to Hold Marathon to Raise Money for the Homeless

A walking marathon will be held in Centerville County next Saturday. All proceeds from the event will be donated to the Centerville County Shelter. It is a public institution that provides food, lodging, and support services to the homeless, the elderly, and anyone in need. This will be the second time the event will be held, and organizers expect more participants than they had last year. This event is open to children and adults of all ages. However, children must be accompanied by an adult family member at all times. Centerville County Shelter was founded in 1981 with the mission of alleviating the hardships of homelessness, poverty, and hunger.

items.description:
Lichtenberg Air

September 24

To our passengers:

Beginning October 1, Lichtenberg Air will ask passengers to pay an extra 20 percent in baggage fees.. As you know, the reason for this increase is because of the rising fuell costs. We regret that the baggage fees have to be increased.

However, passengers are still allowed to have one carry-on bag free of charge. We would also like to emphasize that this has been the first increase in baggage fees for Lichtenberg Air in ten years.

As always, our goall is to provide safe and reliable transportation at a reasonable price. As the price of fuel lowers, we expect to eliminate the fee increase.

We thank you for choosing Lichtenberg Air.

344 Culler Boulevard
ElHe, MN 42195

Dear Ms. Lynch,

We are pleased that you have accepted our request to give a presentation at this year's Conference for Second Language Education. As you know, this conference will gather teachers of German, French, Chinese, and many other languages in one place to share classroom techniques and approaches. Aside from attending workshops and seminars, attendees will have ample opportunities to converse and network at a variety of events. This is an opportunity not to be missed.

This year's conference will be held at the Wilson Convention Center in Salem, Oregon. It will begin on Thursday, July 12, and last through Sunday, July 16. If requested, a laptop and other equipment can be loaned to speakers to be used during the conference. Any borrowed supplies must be returned on the final day of the conference. In addition to your payment for speaking, all speakers are also allowed to attend any other workshops and seminars free of charge.

Please notify us of your detailed travel itinerary. One of our staff members will arrive in a car at the airport to meet you and give you a ride to the venue. Please call our office at (456) 555-1345 to give this information before April 10. We are looking forward to seeing you at the conference.

Sincerely,

Dirk Klein
Conference Organizer

Because you are coming in from out of town, we would like to make your move as smooth a transition as possible. We understand that you will be arriving on April 29th and staying at the Boston Family Inn for a few days. The inn is about a 10-minute taxi drive to the Bandit Pharmaceutical Headquarters. - [2] - You can go to the front desk at the main lobby and ask for Ms. Jenna Rhimes in human resources. She will help new out-of-town employees settle into the city and answer any questions you may have. I have also attached telephone numbers for places and organizations that may be relevant for your move here. - [3]-

If you have any further questions or concerns, please feel free to call me at 555-1234 during my office hours Mondays to Fridays from 9:00A.M. to 7:00P.M.-[4] - Best of luck with your move here and I will see you on May 5.

Sincerely,
Joan Noonan
Human Resources

Blackrock Education Foundation
HOMENEWSABOUTRESOURCESCONTACT

February 10
Language Scholarship

The Blackrock Education Foundation would like to announce that we will begin taking applications for the 24th German Language Scholarship starting March 10 and ending on March 31. Applicants from diverse backgrounds are encouraged to apply. To qualify for the scholarship, applicants must:
- be currently enrolled in a master's program
- prove advanced proficiency in the German language
- submit a complete health check
- submit a recommendation from a previous language instructor

The German Language scholarship is intended for students who already speak German at an advanced level. Therefore, this scholarship is for students who plan to use the German language to study in Germany in the near future.

Recipients of the scholarship must complete monthly progress reports, submit all monthly expenses to the foundation, and maintain a B+ grade average.

Applications can be downloaded under the RESOURCES tab on our website. Please submit all necessary materials to Mr. Hans Richter, Blackrock Education Foundation Director. The address is 459 Pearson Road, Chicago, IL 60616. The review and selection process will take approximately two weeks. Any application with incomplete or missing documents will be rejected without exception. Results will be released on April 15.
To: Clint Porter <cporter@umc.com>
From: Hans Richter <richter@blackrockedu.com>
Date: April 15
Subject: Blackrock Scholarship
Attachment: scholarship_information

Dear Mr. Porter,

I would like to congratulate you as a recipient of the 24th German Language Scholarship. As a recipient of the scholarship, your travel expenses to Germany, tuition fee, and living expenses will all be supplied for the duration of one year. Attached is a booklet containing information on scholarship regulations and requirements. Please make sure to read it carefully. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to contact me. I will be e-mailing you within the next week with specific details for how to prepare for your upcoming studies.

Thanks,
Hans Richter
Director, Blackrock Education Foundation

items.description:
Respite for Commuters

A new ride-sharing app is gaining in popularity as bus and taxi fees continue to rise and commuters continue to look for more efficient routes. Jordan Mills, a small business owner who commutes into downtown from his home in Brentwood has to transfer buses twice, then, take the subway to get to his workplace. Not only did he find the commute quite costly and uncomfortable in the rush-hour crowds, he found it time consuming. But with the availability of the new app Freewheel, he found that he saved time and money with a quick ride available within 5 minutes of flagging for a ride from any location he was at. "This is definitely the future of transportation," said Jordan. "I can't get to work and back any other way now."

Jordan Mills isn't the only commuter who feels this way. An estimated 2000 new commuters in the city of Sherwood alone are expected to use the ride-sharing app within the next year and almost 500 new drivers have signed up to the program. Freewheel is available for download at the Freewheel website and at Miniapp.com and Amacom.com.
www. freewheel.com/history

The idea for Freewheel began when Michael Owens and his co-workers first started a carpooling program at the company they worked at. Owens had to transfer the subway three times and the bus twice to get to work and although he could drive, the parking was limited. He managed the group by assigning different drivers and mapped out routes to each co-worker's homes. He created an app that everyone could connect and communicate through so that the designated drivers and passengers could easily find each other. Five years later, Freewheel is now a major company with tens of thousands of users, both drivers and commuters around the country.

Freewheel is dedicated to keeping the cost of commuting down and the efficiency up. In time, it hopes to bring its services to people around the world.
Technology Initiatives
is proud to present the
New Innovation Award to;
Michael Owens, CEO of Freewheel

This award recognizes the innovation and creativity of new talent in the technology industry. It also acknowledges the effort to help consumers through the use of technology with a novel idea that has transformed the transportation community.

Susan Vaneer

items.descriptionKo: 통근자를 위한 휴식버스와 택시 요금이 계속 오르고 통근자들이 더 효율적인 경로를 계속 찾는 가운데, 새로운 라이드 셰어링 앱이 인기를 얻고 있습니다. 브렌트우드의 집에서 시내로 통근하는 소규모 사업주인 조던 밀스는 버스를 두 번 갈아탄 후 지하철을 타고 직장에 가야 했습니다. 그는 통근 비용이 상당히 비싸고 혼잡 시간대에 불편할 뿐만 아니라 시간도 많이 걸린다고 느꼈습니다. 그러나 새로운 Freewheel 앱이 등장하면서, 그는 자신이 서 있는 위치에 표시한 후 약 5분 만에 빠른 승차를 통해 시간과 돈을 절약하고 있다는 것을 알게 되었습니다. “이것은 확실히 교통의 미래입니다,”라고 조던은 말했습니다. “저는 이제 다른 방법으로는 출퇴근할 수 없어요.”조던 밀스만 이렇게 느끼는 것이 아닙니다. Sherwood시의 약 2000명의 신규 승객이 내년에 라이드 셰어링 앱을 사용할 것으로 예상되며, 거의 500명의 신규 운전자가 프로그램에 등록했습니다. Freewheel은 Freewheel 웹사이트와 Miniapp.com, Amacom.com에서 다운로드할 수 있습니다.www. freewheel.com/historyFreewheel의 아이디어는 마이클 오웬스와 그의 동료들이 근무하던 회사에서 처음 카풀 프로그램을 시작했을 때 시작되었습니다. 오웬스는 출근하기 위해 지하철을 세 번, 버스를 두 번 갈아타야 했고, 운전을 할 수 있었음에도 주차 공간이 제한되어 있었습니다. 그는 다양한 운전자를 지정하고 각 동료의 집까지 경로를 계획하여 그룹을 관리했습니다. 그는 지정된 운전자와 승객이 서로를 쉽게 찾을 수 있도록 사람들이 연결하고 소통할 수 있는 앱을 만들었습니다. 5년 후, Freewheel은 이제 전국적으로 운전자와 통근자를 포함해 수만 명의 사용자를 보유한 대기업이 되었습니다. Freewheel은 통근 비용을 낮게 유지하면서 효율성을 높이는 데 도움이 됩니다. 가까운 미래에 전 세계 사람들에게 서비스를 제공하기를 희망하고 있습니다.Technology Initiative 자랑스럽게 소개합니다 새로운 혁신상을; 마이클 오웬스, Freewheel의 CEO이 상은 기술 산업의 새로운 인재의 혁신과 창의성을 인정합니다. 또한 교통 커뮤니티를 바꾼 새로운 아이디어로 기술을 활용해 소비자를 돕는 노력을 인정합니다.수잔 베니어실행 매니저, Technology Initiatives

To: Ken Alberts <kalberts@emergentsolutions.com>
From: Clarissa Pierce <cpierce@actionservices.com>
Date: June13
Subject: Shipping Contracts

Hello Mr. Alberts,

I am writing on behalf of my company, Action Services. Our company specializes in creating personalized flower arrangements, gift baskets, and novelty gifts. Recently we have been going over our books and realized we were paying too much to our current shipping company. We would be interested in offering you the opportunity to take over our account if you could provide us with some competitive rates. I have included a recent invoice of shipping costs with our current carrier, Express Corp. If you feel that you could beat their prices, we would like to try to work with you. Please let me know what you think.

Sincerely,
Clarissa Pierce
Account Manager, Action Services
To: Clarissa Pierce <cpierce@actionservices.com>
From: Ken Alberts <kalberts@emergentsolutions.com>
Date: June 14
Subject: Shipping Contracts

Dear Ms. Pierce,

Thank you for contacting us at Emergent Solutions. I have taken a look at your invoice from your last bill from Express Corp. and I believe that we can beat their prices. I would be happy to send over my account director to try to tailor a delivery package that is perfect for your needs. Since most of the shipping that you do is within the state and composed of relatively small items, I believe our express courier service will be perfect. We use fuel efficient hybrid vehicles to run our small deliveries and are able to pass the savings on to our customers. As the Account Director, I look forward to working with Action Services in the future.

Sincerely,
Ken Alberts
To: Ken Alberts <kalberts@emergentsolutions.com>
From: Clarissa Pierce <cpierce@actionservices.com>
Date: June16
Subject: ShippingContracts

Mr. Alberts,

This sounds amazing! You have no idea how much it means to our company that you are using environmentally responsible transportation. Action Services was originally formed by a collection of Environmental Studies students at City College here. Everything we do is ethically sourced and recyclable. We can't wait to meet with your team.

Best,
Clarissa Pierce
Account Manager, Action Services

To: AaronDonald<adonald@acemail.com>
From: James Holt <holtrain@zipnet.net>
Date: Jan.12
Subject: First Quarter Performance Review

Dear Aaron,

I just wanted to give you a heads-up that the performance evaluations are going to be going forward as discussed. I know this was an area of stress for you in the fourth quarter of last year, so I wanted to give you plenty of advanced warning. You will need to bring your numbers up significantly if you want to pass the review. As you know, we have been struggling to make our sales goals over the past several years, and I am afraid Mr. Jones is determined to trim the staff if things don't change. I have far exceeded my target numbers, so I have included an attachment with some possible leads for sales. Give them a shot.

Good luck,
James
To: JamesHolt<holtrain@zipnet.net>
From: AaronDonald<adonald@acemail.com>
Date: Jan.12
Subject: First Quarter Performance Review

James,

Thank you so much for the leads. I will get on them right away. I don't know why my sales are slumping so much lately in the technologies division. It seems like every sales technique I learned in school isn't working anymore. I am thinking about changing industries if I don't pass our review when it comes out in March. My sister is opening a beauty parlor and she was asking me to become a barber. Imagine that! Anyway, thank you again for the notice about the possible layoffs corning up. I will try to get my numbers up to standards, but I think that Mr. Jones may have already decided to let me go.

All the best,
Aaron

questions.question: Recyclable materials such as glass and plastic are collected ------ weekly on Mondays and Thursdays.

explanation.en: Frequency expressions like 'twice weekly' pair a number word with a time period — words like 'much', 'yet', 'far' can't combine with a time period the same way, so look for the one that forms a real frequency phrase.
explanation.ko: 'twice weekly' 같은 빈도 표현은 숫자 단어와 기간을 짝짓습니다 — 'much', 'yet', 'far' 같은 단어는 그런 식으로 기간과 결합할 수 없으므로, 실제 빈도 구를 이루는 단어를 찾으세요.

questions.question: Due to congestion on the roads, an increasing number of manufacturers ------ transport their goods by train.

explanation.en: Time adverbs like 'now', 'currently', 'today' signal present-tense context — check the surrounding verb tense first, then pick the adverb that matches it.
explanation.ko: 'now', 'currently', 'today' 같은 시간 부사는 현재 시제 맥락을 나타냅니다 — 먼저 주변 동사의 시제를 확인한 다음 그것에 맞는 부사를 고르세요.

questions.question: When customers have a complaint, employees have been instructed ------ the supervisor on duty.

explanation.en: 'Be instructed to do something' is a fixed pattern where 'to' is followed by the base infinitive — the passive subject ('employees') receives an instruction, so expect a simple active infinitive after 'to', not a passive or perfect one.
explanation.ko: 'be instructed to do something'는 'to' 뒤에 기본 부정사가 오는 고정 패턴입니다 — 수동태 주어(직원들)가 지시를 받으므로, 'to' 뒤에는 수동형이나 완료형이 아니라 단순 능동 부정사가 와야 합니다.

questions.question: Old furniture, vintage jewelry, and other ------ are available for sale at this market.

explanation.en: When a list of items appears before the blank (like 'old furniture, vintage jewelry, and other ------'), the missing word must be a category that includes all of them — think of the umbrella term, not a random noun.
explanation.ko: 빈칸 앞에 물건 목록이 나올 때(예: 'old furniture, vintage jewelry, and other ------'), 빠진 단어는 그것들을 모두 포함하는 범주여야 합니다 — 무작위 명사가 아니라 포괄적인 용어를 생각하세요.

questions.question: ------ the necessary safety precautions are not taken, there could be a higher risk of injury.

explanation.en: 'If' clauses about safety or risk describe a hypothetical condition and its consequence — check that the second half of the sentence states a result before confirming 'if' is the right choice.
explanation.ko: 안전이나 위험에 관한 'if' 절은 가상의 조건과 그 결과를 설명합니다 — 문장 후반부가 결과를 진술하는지 확인한 뒤 'if'가 맞는 선택인지 확정하세요.

questions.question: Dissatisfied customers of Maple Housekeeping may terminate the contract ------ three days of the first cleaning session.

explanation.en: 'Within' a time period means before that period ends — useful for any sentence about deadlines, contracts, or return policies where an action must happen inside a limited window.
explanation.ko: 어떤 기간에 대해 'within'을 쓰면 그 기간이 끝나기 전이라는 뜻입니다 — 마감일, 계약, 반품 정책처럼 제한된 시간 안에 행동이 이루어져야 하는 문장에 유용합니다.

questions.question: The free clinic on Warren Street is ------ by volunteer doctors and nurses.

explanation.en: 'Staffed by' describes who works at a place — distinguish it from words like 'founded' (who started it) or 'retained' (kept/hired) by asking whether the sentence is about ongoing daily operation or a one-time event.
explanation.ko: 'staffed by'는 어떤 곳에서 누가 일하는지를 설명합니다 — 문장이 지속적인 일상 운영을 말하는지 일회성 사건을 말하는지 물어봄으로써 'founded'(누가 설립했는지)나 'retained'(유지/고용)와 구분하세요.

questions.question: Ms. Fox extended the operating hours of the store because she agreed ------ Mr. Arbor that they were not long enough.

explanation.en: 'Agree with someone' (a person) versus 'agree to something' (a plan or proposal) are both correct but used differently — check whether the blank is followed by a person or a plan before picking the preposition.
explanation.ko: 'agree with someone'(사람)와 'agree to something'(계획이나 제안)은 둘 다 맞지만 다르게 쓰입니다 — 전치사를 고르기 전에 빈칸 뒤에 사람이 오는지 계획이 오는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: Investigators visited the site to ensure that it complied with the ------ regulations in the field.

explanation.en: An adjective directly before a noun ('the ------ regulations') must describe that noun — check the ending of each option (-able/-ive endings are often adjectives) rather than guessing from meaning alone.
explanation.ko: 명사 바로 앞의 형용사('the ------ regulations')는 그 명사를 수식해야 합니다 — 의미만으로 추측하지 말고 각 선택지의 어미(-able/-ive 어미는 대개 형용사)를 확인하세요.

questions.question: The majority of occupants ------ live in Regal Towers are upset about the ongoing problems with their air conditioning systems.

explanation.en: 'Who' refers back to people ('occupants'), even when other words come in between — always trace the relative pronoun back to the noun it's replacing before choosing.
explanation.ko: 'who'는 사람(occupants)을 다시 가리키며, 다른 단어가 사이에 있어도 마찬가지입니다 — 선택하기 전에 항상 관계대명사가 대체하는 명사를 거슬러 확인하세요.

questions.question: Mr. Hughes broke up the staff into small discussion groups to improve ------ in meetings.

explanation.en: After 'improve', the blank is the object of the verb and needs a noun ('participation'), not a verb form — check whether the word functions as a thing being improved, not an action.
explanation.ko: 'improve' 뒤의 빈칸은 동사의 목적어이므로 동사 형태가 아니라 명사(participation)가 필요합니다 — 그 단어가 동작이 아니라 개선되는 대상으로 기능하는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: The exchange rate has increased by 3.2% compared to the ------ month of the previous year.

explanation.en: 'The same month' compared to a previous period signals a like-for-like comparison — this pattern appears often in TOEIC statistics sentences, so learn to spot the comparison being made.
explanation.ko: 이전 기간과 비교한 'the same month'는 동일 조건 비교를 나타냅니다 — 이 패턴은 TOEIC 통계 문장에서 자주 나오므로, 어떤 비교가 이루어지고 있는지 알아차리는 연습을 하세요.

questions.question: Brenda Tipton is ------ to win the race for mayor because she has the most experience of all the candidates.

explanation.en: 'Be predicted to do something' follows the pattern 'be + past participle + infinitive' — recognize this passive reporting structure whenever a sentence talks about what's expected or forecasted to happen.
explanation.ko: 'be predicted to do something'는 'be + 과거분사 + 부정사' 패턴을 따릅니다 — 문장이 예상되거나 예측되는 일을 말할 때마다 이 수동 보고 구문을 알아채세요.

questions.question: Those who attend the creative writing workshop will learn a variety of useful methods ------ the next two days.

explanation.en: 'Over' a period of time (like 'over the next two days') describes something happening throughout a duration — different from 'at' (a point in time) or 'toward' (a direction), so match the preposition to whether it's a span or a moment.
explanation.ko: 'over' 뒤에 기간이 오면(예: 'over the next two days') 그 기간 내내 일어나는 일을 설명합니다 — 시점을 나타내는 'at'이나 방향을 나타내는 'toward'와 다르므로, 기간인지 순간인지에 맞춰 전치사를 고르세요.

questions.question: By ------ planning the relocation in advance, we can minimize unexpected expenses and increase efficiency.

explanation.en: 'By carefully doing something' uses an adverb to modify the gerund that follows 'by' — check that the word describes how the action is done, not the action itself.
explanation.ko: 'by carefully doing something'는 'by' 뒤에 오는 동명사를 수식하기 위해 부사를 사용합니다 — 그 단어가 동작 자체가 아니라 동작이 어떻게 이루어지는지를 설명하는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: According to company policy, ------ requests for reimbursement of business expenses must be accompanied by a receipt.

explanation.en: 'All requests' (every single one, no exceptions) is different from 'every request' in structure but similar in meaning — watch for whether the noun after the blank is singular or plural to pick the grammatically correct quantifier.
explanation.ko: 'all requests'(모든 요청, 예외 없이)는 구조상 'every request'와 다르지만 의미는 비슷합니다 — 빈칸 뒤 명사가 단수인지 복수인지 확인해 문법적으로 맞는 한정사를 고르세요.

questions.question: Safe-Co has ------ home security products since its founding in 2008.

explanation.en: For a company's core activity, verbs like 'manufactured', 'produced', or 'developed' fit better than unrelated verbs — match the verb to the type of business described in the sentence.
explanation.ko: 회사의 핵심 활동에는 'manufactured', 'produced', 'developed' 같은 동사가 관련 없는 동사보다 더 잘 맞습니다 — 문장에 설명된 사업 유형에 동사를 맞추세요.

questions.question: ------ of an error on the order form, some of the construction materials were never shipped.

explanation.en: 'Because of' is followed directly by a noun phrase (not a full clause), while 'because' is followed by a subject and verb — check what comes right after the blank to choose correctly.
explanation.ko: 'because of'는 완전한 절이 아니라 명사구가 바로 뒤따르고, 'because'는 주어와 동사가 뒤따릅니다 — 빈칸 바로 뒤에 무엇이 오는지 확인해서 올바르게 선택하세요.

questions.question: The new policies were implemented in an effort to encourage better ------ among the corporation's departments.

explanation.en: After 'encourage better ------', the blank is the object of the verb phrase and needs a noun ('communication'), not a verb, adjective, or person — check what's grammatically required by its position.
explanation.ko: 'encourage better ------' 뒤의 빈칸은 동사구의 목적어이므로 동사, 형용사, 사람을 나타내는 명사가 아니라 명사(communication)가 필요합니다 — 그 위치에서 문법적으로 요구되는 것을 확인하세요.

questions.question: The size of private tours of the old castle will be limited ------ ten people.

explanation.en: 'Limited to' a number is a fixed collocation for capping a quantity — different from 'limited during' or 'limited of', which aren't real English expressions, so trust the collocation over a literal translation.
explanation.ko: 숫자와 함께 쓰는 'limited to'는 수량 상한을 나타내는 고정 표현입니다 — 실제 영어 표현이 아닌 'limited during'나 'limited of'와 다르므로, 직역보다 이 고정 표현을 믿으세요.

questions.question: Please do not use metal utensils when cooking with the pan ------ its surface doesn't get scratched.

explanation.en: 'So that' introduces a purpose clause explaining why an action is taken — different from 'while' (simultaneous time) or 'since' (reason or starting time), so ask what role the clause plays in the sentence.
explanation.ko: 'so that'는 어떤 행동을 하는 이유를 설명하는 목적절을 이끕니다 — 동시성을 나타내는 'while'이나 이유/시작 시점을 나타내는 'since'와 다르므로, 그 절이 문장에서 어떤 역할을 하는지 물어보세요.

questions.question: To ------ the monthly payment for the mortgage, Mr. Tyler would need a substantial salary increase.

explanation.en: 'Afford' means to have enough money for something — a common trap is confusing it with verbs of similar length but unrelated meaning, so always check that the verb's meaning actually fits a financial context.
explanation.ko: 'afford'는 어떤 것을 살 만한 돈이 있다는 뜻입니다 — 길이는 비슷하지만 의미가 무관한 동사와 혼동하는 것이 흔한 함정이므로, 동사의 의미가 실제로 재정적 맥락에 맞는지 항상 확인하세요.

questions.question: Environmentalists were pleased with the community's ------ in increasing recycling in the area.

explanation.en: 'Cooperation' describes people working together toward a shared goal — opposite-meaning words like 'indifference' are common wrong options in the same sentence, so check whether the context is positive or negative teamwork.
explanation.ko: 'cooperation'은 사람들이 공동 목표를 향해 함께 일하는 것을 설명합니다 — 'indifference' 같은 반대 의미의 단어가 같은 문장에서 흔한 오답으로 나오므로, 맥락이 긍정적인 팀워크인지 부정적인지 확인하세요.

questions.question: The National Health Organization reported on the ------ cases of the disease.

explanation.en: Past participles used as adjectives ('confirmed cases') describe a completed state — check if the noun being modified has already undergone the action described, rather than being in the process of it.
explanation.ko: 형용사로 쓰인 과거분사(confirmed cases)는 완료된 상태를 설명합니다 — 수식받는 명사가 이미 그 동작을 겪었는지, 아니면 진행 중인지 확인하세요.

questions.question: Due to a ------ in his political position, the senator no longer supported the proposed law on immigration.

explanation.en: 'A shift in' describes a change of direction or stance — useful whenever a sentence talks about someone's position, opinion, or policy changing, as opposed to a shortage or description of something.
explanation.ko: 'a shift in'은 방향이나 입장의 변화를 설명합니다 — 부족이나 어떤 것에 대한 설명과는 달리, 누군가의 입장, 의견, 정책이 바뀌는 것을 말할 때 유용합니다.

questions.question: ------ buildings in a neighborhood can lead to a net loss of property values for nearby homeowners.

explanation.en: 'Vacant' (empty, unoccupied) fits describing buildings that hurt neighborhood value — check that the adjective's meaning actually connects logically to the negative consequence described in the sentence.
explanation.ko: 'vacant'(비어 있는, 사용되지 않는)는 동네 가치를 해치는 건물을 설명하는 데 적합합니다 — 형용사의 의미가 문장에 설명된 부정적 결과와 실제로 논리적으로 연결되는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: Rather than decorating each conference room ------, the owner of Norris Hall bought furnishings in bulk and gave the spaces the same appearance.

explanation.en: 'Rather than decorating each room ------' needs an adverb to modify the gerund 'decorating' — recognize that 'rather than' comparisons often keep the same grammatical form (gerund + adverb) on both sides.
explanation.ko: 'rather than decorating each room ------'는 동명사 'decorating'을 수식할 부사가 필요합니다 — 'rather than' 비교는 종종 양쪽에서 같은 문법 형태(동명사+부사)를 유지한다는 점을 알아두세요.

questions.question: The director attributed the success of the film ------ to the experience and talent of the actor in the lead role.

explanation.en: 'Primarily' (mainly, mostly) fits when a sentence attributes success chiefly to one factor among possibly several — distinguish it from words about time or manner like 'punctually' or 'attentively'.
explanation.ko: 'primarily'(주로)는 문장이 여러 요인 중 하나에 성공을 주로 귀속시킬 때 적합합니다 — 'punctually'나 'attentively' 같은 시간이나 방식에 관한 단어와 구분하세요.

questions.question: The company's new software for online banking is ------ with most smartphone models.

explanation.en: 'Compatible with' describes two things that work together (software and devices) — a common trap is choosing a similar-sounding but unrelated adjective, so check the meaning fits a technical fit, not a physical or abstract one.
explanation.ko: 'compatible with'는 두 가지가 함께 작동하는 것(소프트웨어와 기기)을 설명합니다 — 비슷하게 들리지만 관련 없는 형용사를 고르는 것이 흔한 함정이므로, 의미가 물리적이거나 추상적인 것이 아니라 기술적 적합성에 맞는지 확인하세요.

questions.question: Employees are allowed to use vacation time whenever they want ------ it does not disrupt their assignments.

explanation.en: 'So long as' (provided that) introduces a condition that must be met — similar in meaning to 'as long as', it's different from 'except for' (an exception) or 'depending on' (a variable factor), so match the logical relationship carefully.
explanation.ko: 'so long as'(~하는 한)는 충족되어야 할 조건을 이끕니다 — 'as long as'와 의미가 비슷하며, 예외를 나타내는 'except for'나 가변 요인을 나타내는 'depending on'과는 다르므로, 논리적 관계를 신중하게 맞추세요.

items.description:
From: Vice President Donna Johnson
To: Helio Tech Employees
Date: July 5th
Subject: Lobby Renovation

Receiving the federal grant money last month (131) ------ us to invest in upgrading a few areas of our building. (132) ------ We will be remodeling the lobby starting July 12th. It should take approximately two weeks. (133) ------ that time, if you have a meeting with anyone from outside of the company, please schedule to have it at the Rose Street Café on the corner. We have set up a special account that anyone from the company can use over those two weeks.

Please, just sign and date your check and return it to your server. We are (134) ------ that this is a bit of an inconvenience, and we thank you for your cooperation.
items.descriptionKo: 발신: 부사장 도나 존슨 수신: 헬리오 테크 전 직원 날짜: 7월 5일 제목: 로비 개조 지난달 연방 보조금을 받은 덕분에 저희는 건물의 몇몇 구역을 업그레이드하는 데 투자할 수 있게 되었습니다. 이로부터 가장 먼저 혜택을 받을 구역은 로비입니다. 저희는 7월 12일부터 로비를 개조할 예정이며, 약 2주 정도 소요될 것으로 예상됩니다. 이 기간 동안 회사 외부의 누군가와 회의가 있으시다면, 모퉁이에 있는 로즈 스트리트 카페에서 진행하도록 일정을 잡아주시기 바랍니다. 회사의 누구나 이 2주 동안 사용할 수 있는 특별 계좌를 마련해 두었습니다. 영수증에 서명하고 날짜를 기입하신 후 담당 직원에게 돌려주시기 바랍니다. 이것이 다소 불편을 초래할 수 있다는 점을 알고 있으며, 협조해 주셔서 감사합니다.

explanation.en: The context describes an ongoing effect from receiving the grant, so the present tense "has allowed" (present perfect) fits best.
explanation.ko: 이 맥락은 보조금을 받은 것으로 인한 지속적인 영향을 설명하므로, 현재완료 "has allowed"가 가장 적합하다.

options: Construction will begin when the building permits are received.
This celebration will last for most of the month of July.
Considering the cost, the renovation might be postponed.
The first area that will benefit from this is the lobby.
questions.correct: The first area that will benefit from this is the lobby.

explanation.en: This sentence fits because it introduces the upcoming lobby remodeling described right after it.
explanation.ko: 이 문장은 바로 뒤에 설명되는 로비 개조 공사를 소개하기 때문에 적합하다.

explanation.en: "During" that two-week period correctly introduces the instruction about scheduling meetings elsewhere.
explanation.ko: "During" 그 2주 기간 동안이라는 표현은 회의를 다른 곳에서 잡으라는 지시를 올바르게 이끈다.

explanation.en: "Aware" fits the tone of management acknowledging that the renovation is an inconvenience.
explanation.ko: "Aware"는 경영진이 이번 개조가 다소 불편을 초래한다는 것을 인정하는 어조와 어울린다.

items.description:
Part-time Cook Needed

Paradise Café is looking (135) ------ a part-time line cook. Applicants must be able to work in a fast-paced environment and be familiar with all standard breakfast fare. (136) ------ This weekend schedule could change in the future. Ideally we are looking for an applicant that has (137) ------ one year of experience working as a short-order cook. Paradise Café is located right next to the post office in downtown Millstown. Please apply in person with a resume and be prepared to cook an egg dish to order. We (138) ------ forward to welcoming you to our team!
items.descriptionKo: 파트타임 요리사 구함 파라다이스 카페에서 파트타임 라인 쿡을 구하고 있습니다. 지원자는 빠르게 진행되는 환경에서 일할 수 있어야 하며 모든 표준 아침 메뉴에 익숙해야 합니다. 현재 저희는 평일 근무만 제공할 수 있지만, 필요할 경우 지원자는 주말에도 기꺼이 근무할 수 있어야 합니다. 이 주말 일정은 향후 변경될 수 있습니다. 이상적으로 저희는 단기 요리사로서 최소 1년의 경력을 가진 지원자를 찾고 있습니다. 파라다이스 카페는 밀스타운 시내 우체국 바로 옆에 위치해 있습니다. 이력서를 지참하여 직접 지원해 주시고, 주문에 따라 계란 요리를 준비할 준비를 해주세요. 저희 팀에 여러분을 맞이하게 되기를 기대합니다!

explanation.en: "To hire" is the infinitive form needed after "looking" (looking to hire a cook).
explanation.ko: "To hire"는 "looking" 뒤에 필요한 부정사 형태이다(looking to hire a cook).

options: Applicants should know how to make scrambled eggs.
People applying should know how to wash dishes.
Anyone applying should be able to work nights.
Currently, we can only offer weekday shifts but the applicant must be willing to work weekends if required.
questions.correct: Currently, we can only offer weekday shifts but the applicant must be willing to work weekends if required.

explanation.en: This sentence fits by warning that the weekend schedule could change, matching the surrounding context about work hours.
explanation.ko: 이 문장은 주말 일정이 변경될 수 있다고 경고하므로, 근무 시간에 관한 주변 맥락과 일치한다.

explanation.en: "At least" one year of experience sets a minimum requirement.
explanation.ko: "At least" 1년의 경력은 최소 요건을 설정한다.

explanation.en: "Look" forward is the base verb form needed after the subject "We."
explanation.ko: "Look" forward는 주어 "We" 뒤에 필요한 동사 원형이다.

items.description:
City Realty

City Realty is Washington's number one real estate company, serving the state for over 50 years. We (139) ------ recognized as the state's leading experts in the industry and many of our agents have been awarded for their excellence in service by Forbes Property Magazine. Our agents are (140) ------ to bringing their best knowledge and expertise to the table, and they have extensive know-how about the housing market dos and don'ts. Our agents specialize in different areas of the industry including corporate real estate, residential real estate, and rental properties. (141) ------

Our headquarters is located in the central downtown area where you can meet with one of our agents (142) ------ a free consultation. You can also visit our website www.cityrealty.com for property listings and further information.
items.descriptionKo: 시티 리얼티 시티 리얼티는 워싱턴 최고의 부동산 회사로, 50년 넘게 이 주에서 서비스를 제공해왔습니다. 저희는 이 업계에서 주 최고의 전문가로 인정받아왔으며, 저희 중개인들 다수가 포브스 부동산 매거진으로부터 서비스 우수상을 수상했습니다. 저희 중개인들은 최고의 지식과 전문성을 제공하는 데 전념하고 있으며, 주택 시장에서 해야 할 일과 하지 말아야 할 일에 대한 폭넓은 노하우를 가지고 있습니다. 저희 중개인들은 상업용 부동산, 주거용 부동산, 임대 부동산을 포함한 업계의 다양한 분야를 전문으로 합니다. 그들이 귀하의 특정 요구를 충족시켜 줄 것이라고 확신하셔도 됩니다. 저희 본사는 시내 중심가에 위치해 있으며, 그곳에서 무료 상담을 위해 저희 중개인 중 한 명을 만나실 수 있습니다. 또한 부동산 목록과 추가 정보를 위해 저희 웹사이트 www.cityrealty.com을 방문하실 수 있습니다.

explanation.en: "Have been" (present perfect) fits describing the company's long-standing recognition as experts.
explanation.ko: "Have been"(현재완료)은 회사가 오랫동안 전문가로 인정받아왔다는 것을 설명하는 데 어울린다.

explanation.en: "Committed to" (bringing their best knowledge) is the correct collocation.
explanation.ko: "Committed to"(최고의 지식을 제공하는 데 전념하는)는 올바른 연어이다.

options: You can be confident that they serve your specific needs.
You can rent hundreds of properties from our listings.
The agents in corporate real estate make the most earnings.
The residential agents are very busy with the rising housing market.
questions.correct: You can be confident that they serve your specific needs.

explanation.en: This sentence fits by reassuring readers that agents cater to their specific needs, following the discussion of expertise.
explanation.ko: 이 문장은 전문성에 대한 논의 후에, 중개인들이 독자의 특정 요구를 충족시켜 줄 것이라고 안심시키기 때문에 적합하다.

explanation.en: "For" a free consultation expresses the purpose of meeting with an agent.
explanation.ko: "For" 무료 상담은 중개인을 만나는 목적을 나타낸다.

items.description:
Employee Message Board
Holiday Office Party's Success and Appreciation
Posted by Julie Norton

I want to thank everyone who (143) ------ make this party a success. (144) ------ We had some ups and downs as we started preparing for this but the final result has been extraordinary. In fact, the (145) ------ consensus seems to be that this year's party was the best yet. We had the highest turnout ever and many seem to agree that this year's activities contributed to the party's success. It was a joy to see everyone get along so well and participate in all the events. We even (146) ------ our children's charity fundraising goals by over $1000. Once again, I would like to thank everyone.
items.descriptionKo: 직원 게시판 연말 사무실 파티의 성공과 감사 줄리 노턴 게시 이 파티를 성공으로 이끄는 데 도움을 주신 모든 분께 감사드리고 싶습니다. 업무 외 시간을 많이 할애하여 모든 것을 계획하는 데 도움을 준 키스, 그랜트, 바네사, 그리고 멜리사에게 특별히 감사드립니다. 이 행사를 준비하기 시작하면서 우여곡절이 있었지만, 최종 결과는 놀라웠습니다. 사실, 전반적인 의견은 올해 파티가 지금까지 중 최고였다는 것 같습니다. 저희는 역대 최고의 참석률을 기록했으며, 많은 분들이 올해의 활동들이 파티의 성공에 기여했다는 데 동의하는 것 같습니다. 모두가 그렇게 잘 어울리고 모든 행사에 참여하는 것을 보는 것은 기쁨이었습니다. 저희는 심지어 아동 자선 모금 목표를 1000달러 이상 초과 달성하기도 했습니다. 다시 한번, 모든 분께 감사드리고 싶습니다.

explanation.en: "Helped" (past tense) matches the past context of thanking people for what they did to make the party a success.
explanation.ko: "Helped"(과거)는 파티를 성공으로 만든 것에 대해 사람들에게 감사하는 과거 맥락과 일치한다.

options: I really enjoyed all the food and chatting with everyone.
I worked really hard to plan this event.
Special thanks to Keith, Grant, Vanessa, and Melissa, who spent many hours outside of work to help plan everything.
I'm glad to see that everyone made it to work today.
questions.correct: Special thanks to Keith, Grant, Vanessa, and Melissa, who spent many hours outside of work to help plan everything.

explanation.en: This sentence fits by specifically thanking named individuals for their extra effort, matching the appreciative tone.
explanation.ko: 이 문장은 감사의 어조와 일치하게 이름이 언급된 개인들에게 그들의 추가적인 노력에 대해 특별히 감사를 표하기 때문에 적합하다.

explanation.en: "General" consensus refers to the overall/common opinion among attendees.
explanation.ko: "General" consensus는 참석자들의 전반적인/공통된 의견을 의미한다.

explanation.en: "Exceeded" fits with surpassing a fundraising goal by a specific dollar amount.
explanation.ko: "Exceeded"는 특정 금액만큼 모금 목표를 초과하는 것과 어울린다.

items.description:
April 3

Larry Martin
Kansas Neat & Tidy
5448 Lakeside Drive
Arlington, Kansas 67514

Dear Mr. Martin,

We are interested in using your company's cleaning services for this year's Halley Valley Rock Festival. The festival will begin on Friday, June 14, and last the entire weekend, ending on the night of Sunday, June 16. However, unlike previous years, this year we would like your company to clean the festival grounds intermittently throughout the festival. Therefore, we will be providing your company with a temporary office trailer where your workers can take breaks from the heat.

We look forward to working with your company again this year.

Sincerely,
Karen Johnson
Festival Coordinator, Halley Valley Foundation
items.descriptionKo: 4월 3일 래리 마틴 캔자스 니트 앤 타이디 5448 레이크사이드 드라이브 알링턴, 캔자스 67514 마틴 씨께, 저희는 올해 할리 밸리 록 페스티벌을 위해 귀사의 청소 서비스를 이용하는 데 관심이 있습니다. 축제는 6월 14일 금요일에 시작하여 주말 내내 진행되며, 6월 16일 일요일 밤에 끝납니다. 하지만 예년과 달리, 올해는 귀사가 축제 기간 내내 간헐적으로 행사장을 청소해 주시기를 원합니다. 따라서 저희는 귀사에 임시 사무실 트레일러를 제공하여 근로자들이 더위를 피해 쉴 수 있도록 하겠습니다. 올해도 귀사와 함께 일하기를 기대합니다. 진심을 담아, 카렌 존슨 할리 밸리 재단 축제 코디네이터

questions.question: Who most likely is Mr. Martin?

explanation.en: The letter is addressed to Mr. Martin as "Kansas Neat & Tidy," a cleaning company, confirming he represents that business.
explanation.ko: 마틴 씨는 누구일 가능성이 가장 높은가? 이 편지는 청소 회사인 "Kansas Neat & Tidy"의 마틴 씨에게 보내진 것으로, 그가 그 사업체를 대표한다는 것을 확인해준다.

questions.question: According to the letter, what will be provided?

explanation.en: The letter states a trailer will be provided for workers to "take breaks from the heat," i.e., a sheltered area.
explanation.ko: 편지에 따르면, 무엇이 제공될 것인가? 편지는 근로자들이 "더위를 피할 수 있도록" 트레일러가 제공될 것이라고 명시하는데, 이는 곧 비바람을 피할 수 있는 공간을 의미한다.

items.description:
LAURA BURKE 5:09
Are you back in the city Monday?

ADVIK SHAN 5:15
I might be.

LAURA BURKE 5:16
So, you're undecided?

ADVIK SHAN 5:17
Yeah. This factory is running into all kinds of problems. Fix one thing and then something else comes up.

LAURA BURKE 5:17
I heard. Well, at least it's nice not to be stuck in the office.

ADVIK SHAN 5:18
That's true.

ADVIK SHAN 5:19
What's going on Monday?

LAURA BURKE 5:20
Ms. Harris wants to have a meeting with you when you get back. Nothing urgent.

ADVIK SHAN 5:22
Okay. I'll let you know when I get my schedule set.
items.descriptionKo: 로라 버크 5:09 월요일에 시내로 돌아오세요? 애드빅 샨 5:15 그럴 수도 있어요. 로라 버크 5:16 그럼, 아직 결정을 못 하신 거예요? 애드빅 샨 5:17 네. 이 공장에서 온갖 문제가 생기고 있어요. 하나 고치면 다른 게 또 생겨요. 로라 버크 5:17 들었어요. 뭐, 적어도 사무실에 갇혀 있지 않아서 좋겠네요. 애드빅 샨 5:18 맞아요. 애드빅 샨 5:19 월요일에 무슨 일이 있어요? 로라 버크 5:20 해리스 씨가 당신이 돌아오면 회의를 하고 싶어 해요. 급한 건 아니에요. 애드빅 샨 5:22 알겠어요. 일정이 정해지면 알려드릴게요.

questions.question: What is suggested about Mr. Shan?
options: He has recently taken over the operations of a manufacturing facility.
He doesn't know when he will be returning to his office.
questions.correct: He doesn't know when he will be returning to his office.

explanation.en: Mr. Shan says "I might be" and "I'll let you know when I get my schedule set," showing he is unsure about his return date.
explanation.ko: 샨 씨에 대해 무엇이 암시되는가? 샨 씨는 "I might be"와 "I'll let you know when I get my schedule set"라고 말하며, 자신의 복귀 날짜에 대해 확신하지 못함을 보여준다.

questions.question: At 5:18, what does Mr. Shan mean when he writes, "That's true"?
options: He is worried about the conditions of the factory.
He agrees that being out of the office is enjoyable.
He is positive he will be back on Monday.
questions.correct: He agrees that being out of the office is enjoyable.

explanation.en: "That's true" follows Laura's comment about it being "nice not to be stuck in the office," showing Advik agrees that being out of the office is enjoyable.
explanation.ko: 5시 18분에, 샨 씨가 "That's true"라고 쓴 것은 무슨 의미인가? "That's true"는 사무실에 갇혀 있지 않아서 "좋다"는 로라의 말에 이어지는 것으로, 애드빅이 사무실 밖에 있는 것이 즐겁다는 데 동의함을 보여준다.

items.description:
MEMO
To: All Employees
From: Betty Franklin, General Manager
Date: August 19
Subject: Receptionist

To all employees:
- [1] - Greta Jones, the receptionist at our studio will be taking some time off to deal with a personal matter. She will be gone from August 21st to September 5th. - [2] - Ms. Blanche will take care of the regular responsibilities that Ms. Jones usually handles including taking phone calls, handling appointments, organizing schedules, and dealing with clients. Please welcome Ms. Blanche to the studio and be available for her to ask questions if she has any.

Furthermore, if you have any long time clients that you give special prices and discounts to, please let Ms. Blanche know ahead of time. - [3] - She will charge the fees that are programmed into the computer system.

If you have any urgent concerns you need to discuss with Ms. Jones, or if you need to purchase any special hair dyes, treatment shampoos, or other requests that customers have, please do so today and tomorrow before she leaves. - [4] - You can contact me at any time if you have any further questions.
items.descriptionKo: 메모 수신: 전 직원 발신: 총지배인 베티 프랭클린 날짜: 8월 19일 제목: 접수원 전 직원께: - [1] - 저희 스튜디오의 접수원인 그레타 존스가 개인적인 일을 처리하기 위해 잠시 휴가를 낼 것입니다. 그녀는 8월 21일부터 9월 5일까지 자리를 비울 것입니다. - [2] - 블랑쉬 씨가 전화 받기, 예약 처리, 일정 관리, 고객 응대 등 존스 씨가 평소에 처리하던 일상적인 업무를 맡을 것입니다. 블랑쉬 씨를 스튜디오에서 환영해 주시고, 질문이 있으면 언제든 답변해 주시기 바랍니다. 또한, 특별 가격과 할인을 제공하는 오랜 고객이 있으시다면, 블랑쉬 씨에게 미리 알려주시기 바랍니다. - [3] - 그녀는 컴퓨터 시스템에 프로그램된 요금을 청구할 것입니다. 존스 씨와 논의해야 할 긴급한 문제가 있거나, 특별 염색약, 트리트먼트 샴푸 또는 고객의 다른 요청 사항을 구매해야 하는 경우, 그녀가 떠나기 전인 오늘과 내일 처리해 주시기 바랍니다. - [4] - 추가 질문이 있으시면 언제든지 저에게 연락하시기 바랍니다.

questions.question: Where do the recipients of the memo most likely work?

explanation.en: The memo discusses a receptionist, hair dyes, and treatment shampoos, indicating a hair salon setting.
explanation.ko: 이 메모의 수신자들은 어디에서 일할 가능성이 가장 높은가? 메모는 접수원, 염색약, 트리트먼트 샴푸에 대해 논의하고 있어 미용실 환경임을 시사한다.

questions.question: What is indicated about Greta Jones?
options: She will take some time off work.
questions.correct: She will take some time off work.

explanation.en: The memo says Greta Jones "will be taking some time off to deal with a personal matter," i.e., taking time off work.
explanation.ko: 그레타 존스에 대해 무엇이 명시되어 있는가? 메모는 그레타 존스가 "개인적인 일을 처리하기 위해 잠시 휴가를 낼 것"이라고 말하는데, 이는 일을 잠시 쉬는 것을 의미한다.

questions.question: By when should employees contact Ms. Jones with urgent business?

explanation.en: The memo instructs employees to raise urgent concerns "today and tomorrow before she leaves," i.e., before she leaves.
explanation.ko: 직원들은 긴급한 업무로 언제까지 존스 씨에게 연락해야 하는가? 메모는 직원들에게 긴급한 사안을 "그녀가 떠나기 전인 오늘과 내일" 제기하라고 지시하는데, 이는 그녀가 떠나기 전을 의미한다.

questions.question: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3] and [4] does the following sentence belong? "During this time, we have hired a temporary replacement, Judith Blanche."

explanation.en: The sentence about a "temporary replacement, Judith Blanche" logically follows the mention that Greta will be away, fitting position [2] right before her duties are described.
explanation.ko: 다음 문장은 [1], [2], [3], [4]로 표시된 위치 중 어디에 속하는가? "이 기간 동안, 저희는 임시 대체 인력인 주디스 블랑쉬를 고용했습니다." "임시 대체 인력인 주디스 블랑쉬"에 대한 이 문장은 그레타가 자리를 비울 것이라는 언급 다음에 논리적으로 이어지므로, 그녀의 업무가 설명되기 직전인 [2] 위치에 적합하다.

items.description:
Lisa Hancock 9:39
I'm stopping by a coffee shop on my way to work. What does everyone want? It's on me.

Nick Morton 9:39
Wow thanks! I'll have just black coffee.

Lilly Smith 9:40
Thanks. I'd like a latte. Can you also bring some sugar?

Lisa Hancock 9:41
Sure, I'll bring a couple of the sugar packets.

Richard Park 9:42
I can never turn down coffee. I'll also have a latte with some sugar.

Emily Jordan 9:42
I'd like a herbal tea if they have any. I don't drink anything caffeinated so any tea without caffeine would be great. Thanks.

Lisa Hancock 9:43
Alright then. I'll be there in about 20 minutes with your drinks. See you soon. Oh and before I forget, please make sure that our orders from Cindy's Boutique get set up in our showroom for our clients.

Richard Park 9:44
The boxes arrived this morning and our interns are working on unpacking them now. However, the order from Chantelle seems to have gone missing.

Lisa Hancock 9:45
What do you mean?

Nick Morton 9:45
We're trying to locate the package. We contacted Chantelle and they sent it to the wrong address.

Lisa Hancock 9:46
That's a disaster. Please try to find out where those dresses went.

Richard Park 9:47
Good news. I just got a message from the shipping company and they found the Chantelle order. They're redirecting the shipment to us.

Lisa Hancock 9:48
I almost had a panic attack. When will it get here?

Richard Park 9:48
This afternoon.
items.descriptionKo: 리사 핸콕 9:39 출근길에 커피숍에 들를게요. 다들 뭐 마실래요? 제가 살게요. 닉 모튼 9:39 와 고마워요! 저는 그냥 블랙커피로 할게요. 릴리 스미스 9:40 고마워요. 저는 라떼로 할게요. 설탕도 좀 가져다줄 수 있어요? 리사 핸콕 9:41 물론이죠, 설탕 봉지 몇 개 가져올게요. 리처드 파크 9:42 저는 커피를 거절할 수 없어요. 저도 설탕 넣은 라떼로 할게요. 에밀리 조던 9:42 있으면 허브차로 할게요. 저는 카페인이 든 건 안 마셔서 카페인 없는 차라면 뭐든 좋아요. 고마워요. 리사 핸콕 9:43 알겠어요. 20분 정도 후에 음료 가지고 갈게요. 이따 봐요. 아 참, 잊기 전에, 신디스 부티크에서 온 주문품이 고객들을 위해 저희 쇼룸에 진열되어 있는지 확인해 주세요. 리처드 파크 9:44 상자들이 오늘 아침에 도착해서 저희 인턴들이 지금 개봉하고 있어요. 그런데 샹텔에서 온 주문품이 없어진 것 같아요. 리사 핸콕 9:45 무슨 말이에요? 닉 모튼 9:45 저희가 소포를 찾으려고 하고 있어요. 샹텔에 연락했는데 그들이 잘못된 주소로 보냈대요. 리사 핸콕 9:46 큰일이네요. 그 드레스들이 어디로 갔는지 알아봐 주세요. 리처드 파크 9:47 좋은 소식이에요. 방금 운송 회사에서 메시지를 받았는데 샹텔 주문품을 찾았대요. 저희에게 재배송 중이에요. 리사 핸콕 9:48 저 거의 패닉 올 뻔했어요. 언제 도착해요? 리처드 파크 9:48 오늘 오후에요.

items.description:
To: All <csall@cherishedgoods.com>
From: Eric Nixon <enix@cherishedgoods.com>
Date: January 5, 10:00 A.M.
Subject: Shipping Error

Hello everyone,

Lilia Kent, the head of the shipping department, has informed me that yesterday our customer database experienced a system error and, as a result, many orders were sent to the wrong addresses. This morning, our department has already received multiple calls from customers complaining that they received the wrong package. Ms. Kent's department has been working hard to locate the cause of the mistake. Therefore, any customer that calls with a wrong delivery should be asked to return the package. Additionally, please inform the customers that they will be given a 10 percent discount on their next purchase.

Eric Nixon
